declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_finiteTypeQuasicoherentSubobject_extension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0853.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic
space, `U ⊂ X` a quasi-compact open, `ℱ` a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module and `𝒢 ⊂ ℱ|_U` a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_U`-submodule of finite type.  Then there is a quasi-coherent submodule
`𝒢' ⊂ ℱ` of finite type with `𝒢'|_U = 𝒢`, the equality being an isomorphism of `𝒢'|_U` with
`𝒢` commuting with the inclusions into `ℱ|_U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finiteTypeQuasicoherentSubobject_extension (j : U ⟶ X)
    (hj : IsOpenImmersion B S hS j.hom)
    (hXqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.1)
    (hXqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X.1)
    (hUqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS U.1)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite]
    (G : Subobject ((etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS j
      (isEtale_of_isOpenImmersion B S hS hj)).obj F))
    [(G : Modules.{u, u} B S hS U.1 U.2).IsQuasicoherentOnSite]
    [(G : Modules.{u, u} B S hS U.1 U.2).IsFiniteType] :
    ∃ G' : Subobject F, (G' : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2).IsQuasicoherentOnSite ∧
      (G' : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2).IsFiniteType ∧
      ∃ e : (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS j
            (isEtale_of_isOpenImmersion B S hS hj)).obj
          (G' : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) ≅ (G : Modules.{u, u} B S hS U.1 U.2),
        (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS j
            (isEtale_of_isOpenImmersion B S hS hj)).map G'.arrow = e.hom ≫ G.arrow
declarations.comment: submodules as subobjects, restriction to the open as étale module pullback

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_etaleSubmodule_extension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0853.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic space over `S`,
`U ⊆ X` a quasi-compact open subspace, `ℱ` a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module and `𝒢 ⊆ ℱ|_U` a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_U`-submodule of finite type.  Then there is a quasi-coherent submodule
`𝒢' ⊆ ℱ` of finite type with `𝒢'|_U = 𝒢`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etaleSubmodule_extension (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u}))
    (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (hXqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.1)
    (hXqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X.1)
    (U : Subfunctor X.1) (hU : IsOpenSubspace B S hS U)
    (hUqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS U.toFunctor)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    (G : ((etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (openSubspaceHom B S hS U hU)
      (isEtale_openSubspaceHom B S hS U hU)).obj F).Submodule)
    (hGq : G.toSheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) (hGf : G.toSheafOfModules.IsFiniteType) :
    ∃ G' : F.Submodule, G'.toSheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherentOnSite ∧
      G'.toSheafOfModules.IsFiniteType ∧
      etaleSubmoduleRestrict B S hS _ (isEtale_openSubspaceHom B S hS U hU) G' = G

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasFiniteTypeQuasicoherentIdealZeroLocus_of_isQuasiCompactSpace
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic space over `S` and let `U ⊆ X` be an
open subspace. If `U` is quasi-compact, then there is a finite type quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals
`ℐ ⊆ 𝒪_X` with `|X| ∖ |U| = |V(ℐ)|`.

This is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isFiniteTypeQuasicoherentIdeal_idealZeroLocus_eq_compl_range`,
which follows the source: the reduced sheaf of ideals of `|X| ∖ |U|` is cut down by Stacks 0853,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_etaleSubmodule_extension`, to a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals of
finite type with the same restriction to `U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteTypeQuasicoherentIdealZeroLocus_of_isQuasiCompactSpace
    (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u})) (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (hXqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.1)
    (hXqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X.1)
    {U : Subfunctor X.1} (hU : IsOpenSubspace B S hS U)
    (hUqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS U.toFunctor) :
    HasFiniteTypeQuasicoherentIdealZeroLocus B S hS X U
declarations.comment: part (2) implies part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompactSpace_of_hasFiniteTypeQuasicoherentIdealZeroLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0855, part (3) implies part (2).** Let `X` be a quasi-compact algebraic space over
`S` and let `U ⊆ X` be an open subspace.  If there is a finite type quasi-coherent sheaf of
ideals `ℐ ⊆ 𝒪_X` with `|X| ∖ |U| = |V(ℐ)|`, then `U` is quasi-compact.

An affine étale chart of `X` surjective on points exists by Tag 03H6.  The Zariski sheaf of
ideals which `ℐ` induces on the chart's scheme is of finite type, so the complement of its
support is a quasi-compact open of that affine — and hence quasi-compact — scheme, by part
(4) ⟹ (2) of [Stacks, Tag 01PH].  That complement maps onto `|U| = |X| ∖ |V(ℐ)|`, continuously,
so `|U|` is a quasi-compact subset of `|X|`, and Tag 03E4 turns that into quasi-compactness of
the open subspace `U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompactSpace_of_hasFiniteTypeQuasicoherentIdealZeroLocus
    (hXqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.1)
    {U : Subfunctor X.1} (hU : IsOpenSubspace B S hS U)
    (h : HasFiniteTypeQuasicoherentIdealZeroLocus B S hS X U) :
    IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS U.toFunctor
declarations.comment: part (3) implies part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.tfae_isQuasiCompact_openSubspace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0855.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic space over `S` and
let `U ⊆ X` be an open subspace.  The following are equivalent:

1. the inclusion `U → X` is quasi-compact,
2. `U` is quasi-compact, and
3. there exists a finite type quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals `ℐ ⊆ 𝒪_X` such that
   `|X| ∖ |U| = |V(ℐ)|`.
declarations.statement:
theorem tfae_isQuasiCompact_openSubspace (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u}))
    (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (hXqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.1)
    (hXqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X.1)
    (U : Subfunctor X.1) (hU : IsOpenSubspace B S hS U) :
    List.TFAE [IsQuasiCompact B S hS U.ι, IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS U.toFunctor,
      HasFiniteTypeQuasicoherentIdealZeroLocus B S hS X U]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompact_iff_isQuasiCompactSpace_openSubspace
declarations.doc:
For an open subspace of a quasi-compact and
quasi-separated algebraic space, quasi-compactness of the inclusion is equivalent to
quasi-compactness of its source.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompact_iff_isQuasiCompactSpace_openSubspace
    (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (hXqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.1)
    (hXqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X.1)
    (U : {U : Subfunctor X.1 // IsOpenSubspace B S hS U}) :
    IsQuasiCompact B S hS U.1.ι ↔ IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS U.1.toFunctor
declarations.comment: parts (1) and (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.mem_annihilatorSubmodule_obj_of_isAffine
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0856], part (2): the sections of the annihilator subsheaf over an affine
chart.**  Over an affine étale chart `W` of an algebraic space, a section of `G` lies in the
subsheaf annihilated by a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals `I` exactly when the sections of `I`
over `W` itself kill it — no restriction to a smaller chart has to be tested.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_annihilatorSubmodule_obj_of_isAffine
    (hI : I.toSheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) (W : (SmallEtale B S hS F)ᵒᵖ)
    (hW : IsAffine ((SmallEtale.toOver B S hS F ⋙ BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj W.unop))
    (s : G.val.obj W) :
    s ∈ (annihilatorSubmodule B S hS F hF I G).toSubmodule.obj W ↔
      ∀ a : (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
          (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS F hF).O).obj.obj W,
        a ∈ I.obj W → a • s = 0
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_germ_annihilatorSubmodule_iff
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0856], part (3): the geometric stalk of the annihilator subsheaf.**  Let `F`
be an algebraic space, `I ⊆ 𝒪_F` a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals of finite type and `G` a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_F`-module.  An element of the stalk of `G` at a geometric point `x̄` is the
germ of a section of the subsheaf annihilated by `I` exactly when every germ at `x̄` of a
section of `I` kills it; that is, `G'_x̄ = {s ∈ G_x̄ | I_x̄ s = 0}` inside `G_x̄`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_germ_annihilatorSubmodule_iff
    (hI : I.toSheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    (hIft : SheafOfModules.IsFiniteTypeOnSite I.toSheafOfModules)
    (x : GeometricPoint B S hS F)
    (s : geometricModuleStalk B S hS ⟨F, hF⟩ x G) :
    (∃ (N : SmallEtaleNeighborhood x)
        (t : (annihilatorSubmodule B S hS F hF I G).toSheafOfModules.val.obj (op N.chart)),
        geometricModuleStalkGerm B S hS ⟨F, hF⟩ x G N
          ((annihilatorSubmodule B S hS F hF I G).ι.val.app (op N.chart) t) = s) ↔
      ∀ (N : SmallEtaleNeighborhood x) (a : chartRing B S hS F hF N.chart),
        a ∈ I.obj (op N.chart) →
          etaleLocalRingGerm B S hS F x (op N) a • s = 0
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasicoherentOnSite_annihilatorSubmodule
declarations.doc:
**The annihilator subsheaf is quasi-coherent.**  Let `F` be an algebraic space, `I ⊆ 𝒪_F` a
quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals of finite type and `G` a quasi-coherent `𝒪_F`-module.  The subsheaf
of sections of `G` annihilated by `I` is quasi-coherent.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherentOnSite_annihilatorSubmodule
    (hI : I.toSheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    (hIft : SheafOfModules.IsFiniteTypeOnSite I.toSheafOfModules)
    (hG : G.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    (annihilatorSubmodule B S hS F hF I G).toSheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherentOnSite
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.annihilatorSubmodule
declarations.doc:
**The subsheaf of sections annihilated by an ideal sheaf on an algebraic space**, the
object of [Stacks, Tag 0856].  Its sections over an étale chart `W` are the sections of `G`
over `W` all of whose restrictions are annihilated by the sections of `I` there, and that rule
defines a submodule sheaf of `G`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def annihilatorSubmodule
    (I : (SheafOfModules.unit
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS F hF).O))).Submodule)
    (G : Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF) : G.Submodule
declarations.comment: the subsheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.mem_annihilatorSubmodule_obj
declarations.doc:
**The sections of the annihilator subsheaf of [Stacks, Tag 0856].**  A section `s` of `G`
over an étale chart is annihilated by `I` exactly when, over every chart `W'` over it, every
section of `I` kills the restriction of `s` to `W'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_annihilatorSubmodule_obj (W : (SmallEtale B S hS F)ᵒᵖ) (s : G.val.obj W) :
    s ∈ (annihilatorSubmodule B S hS F hF I G).toSubmodule.obj W ↔
      ∀ (W' : (SmallEtale B S hS F)ᵒᵖ) (g : W ⟶ W')
        (a : ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
            (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS F hF).O)).obj.obj W'),
        a ∈ I.obj W' → a • G.val.restrictₛₗ g s = 0
declarations.comment: the sections

registrations.name: annihilatorSubmodule
registrations.comment: the subsheaf of sections annihilated by `I`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pushforwardSubmodule_annihilatorSubmodule
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0858].**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces, `I ⊆ 𝒪_Y` a
sheaf of ideals and `M` an `𝒪_X`-module on the spaces-étale site.  The direct image along `f`
of the subsheaf of sections of `M` annihilated by `f^{-1}I · 𝒪_X` is the subsheaf of sections
of `f_*M` annihilated by `I`.

The source assumes `f` quasi-compact and quasi-separated, `I` quasi-coherent of finite type and
`M` quasi-coherent; all three are discharged as unnecessary, being needed in the source only so
that the subsheaf of [Stacks, Tag 0857] is available for `I` and `f_*M`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforwardSubmodule_annihilatorSubmodule (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (I : (SheafOfModules.unit
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (spacesEtaleRingedSite B S hS Y).O))).Submodule)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (spacesEtaleRingedSite B S hS X).O))) :
    Stacks.SheafOfModules.pushforwardSubmodule (spacesEtaleSharpRing B S hS f) M
        (CoverPreserving.of_isContinuous _ _ _)
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.annihilatorSubmodule M
          (RingedSite.mul_comm_ringSheaf (spacesEtaleRingedSite B S hS X))
          (Stacks.SheafOfModules.inverseImageIdeal (spacesEtaleSharpRing B S hS f) I)) =
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.annihilatorSubmodule
        ((_root_.SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u + 1}
          (spacesEtaleSharpRing B S hS f)).obj M)
        (RingedSite.mul_comm_ringSheaf (spacesEtaleRingedSite B S hS Y)) I

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sectionSupportedIn_iff_exists_pow_le_annihilator
declarations.doc:
Let `T` be a subset of the points of an algebraic space `F`, let
`U` be an affine étale chart of `F` and let `I` be a finitely generated ideal of the regular
functions on the chart whose zero locus is the preimage of `T`. A section of a quasi-coherent
`𝒪_F`-module over `U` is supported on `T` exactly when some power of `I` annihilates it.

Part (1), `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_fg_ideal_zeroLocus_eq_preimage_chartPointsMap`,
supplies such an `I` whenever `T` is closed and its complement is the point set of an open
subspace with quasi-compact inclusion; `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartRing` of a chart is the
ring of global functions on its scheme, so the two are ideals of the same ring.

Quasi-coherence enters only through
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsCartesianOnAffineCharts`, which it implies by Stacks 03DX; it is
derived here rather than assumed, since Stacks 0859 already assumes the module
quasi-coherent.
declarations.statement:
theorem sectionSupportedIn_iff_exists_pow_le_annihilator
    (G : Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF) (hG : G.IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    (T : Set (points B S hS F)) (U : SmallEtale B S hS F) (hU : IsAffine (chartScheme U))
    {I : Ideal (chartRing B S hS F hF U)} (hIfg : I.FG)
    (hI : chartPointsMap U ⁻¹' T =
      (chartScheme U).zeroLocus (U := ⊤) (I : Set (chartRing B S hS F hF U)))
    (s : G.val.obj (op U)) :
    SectionSupportedIn B S hS F hF T G U s ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • s = 0
declarations.comment: part (2): the supported sections over an affine chart are the ideal-power torsion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasicoherentOnSite_supportedSectionsSubmodule
declarations.doc:
Let `T ⊆ |F|` be a closed subset of the points of an algebraic
space `F` whose complement is the point set of an open subspace `O ⊆ F` with quasi-compact
inclusion, and let `G` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_F`-module.  Then the subsheaf of `G` of sections
supported on `T` is again quasi-coherent.

The hypotheses are `T` closed, `T ⨿ |O| = |F|`, and `O → F` quasi-compact.  Quasi-coherence
of the subsheaf is `SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherentOnSite` (Stacks 03DL (6)), the condition that
cuts out `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasicoherentSheaves` (Stacks 03G9); it follows from
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.bijective_sectionsBaseChange_supportedSectionsSubmodule` by
Descent, Proposition 03DX (2),
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasicoherentOnSite_iff_isCartesianOnAffineCharts`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherentOnSite_supportedSectionsSubmodule
    (G : Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF) (hG : G.IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    {T : Set (points B S hS F)} (hT : IsClosed T) {O : Subfunctor F}
    (hO : IsOpenSubspace B S hS O)
    (hOT : Set.range (pointsMap B S hS O.toFunctor O.ι) = Tᶜ)
    (hOqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS O.ι) :
    (supportedSectionsSubmodule B S hS F hF T G).toSheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherentOnSite
declarations.comment: part (3): the subsheaf of sections supported on T is quasi-coherent

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.supportedSectionsSubmoduleData
declarations.doc:
The subsheaf of sections supported in `T`, together with its defining local membership
criterion.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def supportedSectionsSubmoduleData (T : Set (points B S hS F))
    (G : Modules.{u, m} B S hS F hF) :
    {N : G.Submodule // ∀ (W : SmallEtale B S hS F)
      (s : G.val.obj (op W)),
      s ∈ N.toSubmodule.obj (op W) ↔
        SectionSupportedIn B S hS F hF T G W s}
declarations.comment: supported-section subsheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_fg_ideal_zeroLocus_eq_preimage_chartPointsMap
declarations.doc:
Let `T ⊆ |F|` be a closed subset of the points of an algebraic space `F`, and let `U ⊆ F` be
the open subspace whose points are the complement of `T`. If the inclusion `U → F` is
quasi-compact then on every affine étale chart `φ : W → F` the preimage `|φ|⁻¹(T)` is the zero
locus of a finitely generated ideal of `𝒪_F(W)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_fg_ideal_zeroLocus_eq_preimage_chartPointsMap (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    {T : Set (points B S hS F)} (hT : IsClosed T) {U : Subfunctor F}
    (hU : IsOpenSubspace B S hS U)
    (hUT : Set.range (pointsMap B S hS U.toFunctor U.ι) = Tᶜ)
    (hUqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS U.ι) (W : SmallEtale B S hS F)
    (hW : IsAffine (chartScheme W)) :
    ∃ I : Ideal Γ(chartScheme W, ⊤), I.FG ∧
      chartPointsMap W ⁻¹' T =
        (chartScheme W).zeroLocus (U := ⊤) (I : Set Γ(chartScheme W, ⊤))
declarations.comment: part (1): a finite type ideal cutting out the closed subset on an affine chart

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.supportedSectionsSubmoduleData
declarations.doc:
The subsheaf of sections supported in `T`, together with its defining local membership
criterion.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def supportedSectionsSubmoduleData (T : Set (points B S hS F))
    (G : Modules.{u, m} B S hS F hF) :
    {N : G.Submodule // ∀ (W : SmallEtale B S hS F)
      (s : G.val.obj (op W)),
      s ∈ N.toSubmodule.obj (op W) ↔
        SectionSupportedIn B S hS F hF T G W s}
declarations.comment: the subsheaf of sections supported on T

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.modulePushforward_supportedSectionsSubmodule_range_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085B with the direct image spelled as the one of Stacks 03LU.**  For a morphism
`f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S`, a closed subset `T` of the points of `Y` and an
`𝒪_X`-module `F`, the direct image `f_*` of Stacks 03LU of the subsheaf of sections supported
over `|f|⁻¹T` is the subsheaf of `f_*F` of sections supported on `T`: the two canonical
inclusions into `f_*F` have the same image over every étale chart of `Y`.

This is the same identification as
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pushforward_supportedSectionsSubmodule_range_eq`, which states it for
the direct image attached to the morphism of ringed topoi of Stacks 03G8.  Both spellings are
registered, because consumers of the tag are written against one or the other and the passage
between them is not available downstream: it is cheap only at the two small equations above,
which is why it is made here.
declarations.statement:
theorem modulePushforward_supportedSectionsSubmodule_range_eq
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (T : Set (points B S hS Y.1))
    (hT : @IsClosed _ (pointTopology B S hS Y.1) T)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (W : SmallEtale B S hS Y.1) :
    Set.range (((modulePushforward B S hS f).map
        (supportedSectionsSubmodule B S hS X.1 X.2
          (pointsMap B S hS X.1 f.hom ⁻¹' T) F).ι).val.app (op W)) =
      Set.range ((supportedSectionsSubmodule B S hS Y.1 Y.2 T
        ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj F)).ι.val.app (op W))
declarations.comment: the identification of the two subsheaves of the direct image, with the direct image spelled as the one of Stacks 03LU

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pushforward_supportedSectionsSubmodule_range_eq
declarations.doc:
For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S`, a closed subset
`T` of the points of `Y` and an `𝒪_X`-module `F`, the direct image of the subsheaf of sections
supported over `|f|⁻¹T` is the subsheaf of `f_*F` of sections supported on `T`: the two
canonical inclusions into `f_*F` have the same image over every étale chart of `Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforward_supportedSectionsSubmodule_range_eq
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (T : Set (points B S hS Y.1))
    (hT : @IsClosed _ (pointTopology B S hS Y.1) T)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (W : SmallEtale B S hS Y.1) :
    Set.range ((((smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS f).pushforwardModules).map
      (supportedSectionsSubmodule B S hS X.1 X.2
        (pointsMap B S hS X.1 f.hom ⁻¹' T) F).ι).val.app (op W)) =
    Set.range (((supportedSectionsSubmodule B S hS Y.1 Y.2 T
      (((smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS f).pushforwardModules).obj F)).ι).val.app (op W))
declarations.comment: the identification of the two subsheaves of the direct image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.GradedAlgebraPoints.F.baseChangeEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085C.** The canonical isomorphism `r : Proj_{X'}(g^*𝒜) ⟶ X' ×_X Proj_X(𝒜)`, on the
functor of quadruples: for every test object `T` a bijection `F'(T) ≃ X'(T) ×_{X(T)} F(T)`,
where `F` is the functor of Tag 084A of `𝒜` on `X` and `F'` the one of `g^*𝒜` on `X'`.

A quadruple `(d, f' : T → X', ℒ, ψ)` for `F'` goes to the pair `(f', (d, g ∘ f', ℒ, ψ))`, and a
pair `(f', (d, f, ℒ, ψ))` goes back to `(d, f', ℒ, ψ)`; the two are mutually inverse.
declarations.comment: the canonical isomorphism r, as the bijection F'(T) ≃ X'(T) ×_{X(T)} F(T) of the proof, for every test object; the isomorphism theta of the twists is not stated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.GradedAlgebraPoints.F.baseChangeEquiv_mk
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085C, the map `r` on a quadruple.** A quadruple `(d, f', ℒ, ψ)` of positive degree
for `g^*𝒜` goes to the `X'`-point `f'` together with the quadruple `(d, g ∘ f', ℒ, ψ)`
for `𝒜`.
declarations.statement:
theorem F.baseChangeEquiv_mk (r : GradedAlgebraPoints B S hS X) (g : X' ⟶ X)
    (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X') {d : ℤ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (P : (r.comap g).Quadruples T f d) :
    F.baseChangeEquiv r g T (F.mk (r.comap g) f hd P) =
      ⟨(f, F.mk r (f ≫ g) hd P), rfl⟩
declarations.comment: the map r sends a quadruple (d, f', L, psi) to the pair (f', (d, g f', L, psi))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.GradedAlgebraPoints.F.baseChangeEquiv_symm_mk
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085C, the inverse of `r`.** The `X'`-point `f'` together with a quadruple
`(d, g ∘ f', ℒ, ψ)` for `𝒜` of positive degree goes back to the quadruple `(d, f', ℒ, ψ)`
for `g^*𝒜`.
declarations.statement:
theorem F.baseChangeEquiv_symm_mk (r : GradedAlgebraPoints B S hS X) (g : X' ⟶ X)
    (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X') {d : ℤ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (P : (r.comap g).Quadruples T f d) :
    (F.baseChangeEquiv r g T).symm ⟨(f, F.mk r (f ≫ g) hd P), rfl⟩ =
      F.mk (r.comap g) f hd P
declarations.comment: the inverse of r sends (f', (d, g f', L, psi)) to the quadruple (d, f', L, psi)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.fibreBaseChangeTheta
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085C, the isomorphism `θ`, over a scheme point of `X'`.**

The inverse image, along the base change `r_T` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.fibreBaseChangeIso`, of the sheaf of `ℤ`-graded
algebras `⨁_{d ∈ ℤ} 𝒪(d)` on `T ×_X Proj_X(𝒜)` is the sheaf of `ℤ`-graded algebras
`⨁_{d ∈ ℤ} 𝒪(d)` on `T ×_{X'} Proj_{X'}(g^*𝒜)`.

The two twist algebras are Stacks 084D's, in the form
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.fibreTwistAlgebra`, so they are the twists of
Stacks 01NR of the two restricted algebras; those restricted algebras are equal, and `r` is the
isomorphism of the presented schemes that equality produces, so `θ` is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.thetaOfAlgebraEq`.  That `fibreBaseChangeIso` is the
base change of the isomorphism of algebraic spaces `r` is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjBaseChangePoints.toScheme_map_pointEquivOver_baseChangeIso`;
the compatibility of `θ` with `ψ` is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.pointPsiHom_heq`.
The source's `θ` on the algebraic space `Proj_{X'}(g^*𝒜)` itself needs the twists of Stacks 084D
as sheaves on the space, which need Stacks 084B; see the module docstring.
declarations.comment: the isomorphism theta over a scheme point f : T -> X' of X': an isomorphism of Z-graded algebras from the inverse image, along the base change of r to T (toScheme_map_pointEquivOver_baseChangeIso), of (+)_{d in Z} O(d) on T x_X Proj_X(A) to (+)_{d in Z} O(d) on T x_{X'} Proj_{X'}(g^*A), both being Tag 084D's twists of Tag 01NR; theta as a map of sheaves on the algebraic space Proj_{X'}(g^*A) needs those twists on the space, i.e. 084B

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.pointPsiHom_heq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085C: `θ` is compatible with `ψ`, over the scheme points of `X'`.**  Over a
`T`-point `f` of `X'`, the canonical homomorphism of graded algebras
`ψ : π_T^*(f^*g^*𝒜) ⟶ ⨁_{n ∈ ℤ} 𝒪(n)` of Stacks 084D for `Proj_{X'}(g^*𝒜)`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.pointPsiHom`) is the one for `Proj_X(𝒜)` at the
image point `f ∘ g`, transported along the identification of the two restricted algebras: the
source's `θ` carries `ψ` to `ψ`.  The graded algebras of twists themselves correspond in the same
way (`…pointTwistAlgebra_heq`), and so do the identifications `θ` of Stacks 01O3 with every
further base change (`…pointTwistTheta_heq`) and the `ψ` of Stacks 01NR after it
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.basePsi_pointTwistTheta`).
declarations.statement:
theorem pointPsiHom_heq (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X') :
    HEq (d'.pointPsiHom T f) (d.pointPsiHom T (f ≫ g))
declarations.comment: theta is compatible with psi: over a scheme point f : T -> X' the canonical homomorphism psi : pi_T^*(f^*g^*A) -> (+)_n O(n) of Tag 084D for Proj_{X'}(g^*A) is the one for Proj_X(A) at f g, across the identification of the two restricted algebras

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjBaseChangePoints.baseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085C, the canonical isomorphism `r : Proj_{X'}(g^*𝒜) ⟶ X' ×_X Proj_X(𝒜)`, as an
isomorphism of algebraic spaces.**

Let `g : X' ⟶ X` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`, let `π : P ⟶ X` be presented as
`Proj_X(𝒜)` and `π' : P' ⟶ X'` as its base change `Proj_{X'}(g^*𝒜)` in the sense of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjBaseChangePoints`.  Then `P'` is isomorphic to the fibre
product `X' ×_X P` as a presheaf on the big fppf site of `S`, that is, as an algebraic space.  At
a test object `T` the isomorphism is the bijection
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.basePointEquivPullback`, which over a `T`-point `f` of
`X'` sends a point of `P'` to the point of `P` over `f ∘ g` that the two identifications of
Stacks 084B at `f` attach to it — the source's proof builds `r` on the values of the functors in
the same way — and its naturality in the test object is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjBaseChangePoints.basePointEquivPullback_restrict`.

The relative Proj of an algebraic space is presented here, as for Stacks 084D, 085D and 085F,
through its base changes to the scheme points of the base: the space `Proj_X(𝒜)` itself is not
constructed from `𝒜` in this library, because Stacks 084B is not proved.
declarations.statement: def baseChangeIso : P' ≅ pullback g π
declarations.comment: the canonical isomorphism r : Proj_{X'}(g^*A) -> X' x_X Proj_X(A), as an isomorphism of presheaves on the big fppf site (that is, of algebraic spaces), natural in the test object; Proj_X(A) and Proj_{X'}(g^*A) are given by Stacks 084B's presentations over the scheme points of the base, Proj_X(A) not being constructed from A in this library (084B)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjBaseChangePoints.baseChangeIso_hom_fst
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085C: `r` is a morphism over `X'`.**  The isomorphism
`r : Proj_{X'}(g^*𝒜) ⟶ X' ×_X Proj_X(𝒜)` followed by the first projection is the structure
morphism of `Proj_{X'}(g^*𝒜)`.
declarations.statement: theorem baseChangeIso_hom_fst : h.baseChangeIso.hom ≫ pullback.fst g π = π'
declarations.comment: r is an isomorphism over X': followed by the first projection X' x_X Proj_X(A) -> X' it is the structure morphism of Proj_{X'}(g^*A)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjBaseChangePoints.baseChangeIso_hom_snd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085C: the description of `r` over the scheme points of `X'`.**  For a `T`-point `f`
of `X'`, a morphism `r : T' ⟶ T` and a `T'`-point `u` of `P' = Proj_{X'}(g^*𝒜)` over `f ∘ r`, the
second component of `r(u)` is the point of `P = Proj_X(𝒜)` over `f ∘ g ∘ r` that the
identifications `Proj_T(f^*g^*𝒜) = T ×_{X'} P'` and `Proj_T((f g)^*𝒜) = T ×_X P` of Stacks 084B
attach to `u` (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.baseChangePointEquiv`).  So over every
scheme `T` over `X'` the base change of `r` is the identification of the two scheme-level
relative Projs of one graded algebra, which is how the source describes `r` étale locally; with
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjBaseChangePoints.baseChangeIso_hom_unique` it determines
`r`.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChangeIso_hom_snd (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X')
    {T' : BigFppfOver B S hS} (r : T' ⟶ T)
    (u : {u : yoneda.obj T' ⟶ P' // u ≫ π' = yoneda.map r ≫ f}) :
    u.1 ≫ h.baseChangeIso.hom ≫ pullback.snd g π =
      (baseChangePointEquiv d d' g h.algebra_eq T f r u).1
declarations.comment: the description of r over the scheme points of X': over a point f : T -> X' the base change of r is the identification of Proj_T(f^*g^*A) = T x_{X'} Proj_{X'}(g^*A) with Proj_T((g f)^*A) = T x_X Proj_X(A) given by Stacks 084B

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjBaseChangePoints.toScheme_map_pointEquivOver_baseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085C: the isomorphism `θ` is taken across `r`.**  Over a `T`-point `f` of `X'`, the
morphism of schemes `T ×_{X'} Proj_{X'}(g^*𝒜) ⟶ T ×_X Proj_X(𝒜)` over `T` that `r` induces
through the two cartesian squares of Stacks 084B is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.fibreBaseChangeIso`.  So the isomorphism
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjPoints.fibreBaseChangeTheta`, which is stated as an
isomorphism from the inverse image along `fibreBaseChangeIso` of the twists on `T ×_X Proj_X(𝒜)`,
is the base change to `T` of the source's `θ : r^* pr₂^*(⨁_d 𝒪(d)) ⟶ ⨁_d 𝒪(d)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem toScheme_map_pointEquivOver_baseChangeIso (T : BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X') :
    (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map
        (d.pointEquivOver T (f ≫ g) (d'.fibreHom T f)
          ⟨d'.fibreToSpace T f ≫ h.baseChangeIso.hom ≫ pullback.snd g π,
            h.fibreToSpace_baseChangeIso_snd_comp T f⟩).1 =
      (fibreBaseChangeIso d d' g h.algebra_eq T f).hom
declarations.comment: theta is taken across r: over a scheme point f : T -> X' the morphism of schemes T x_{X'} Proj_{X'}(g^*A) -> T x_X Proj_X(A) over T that r induces through the cartesian squares of Stacks 084B is fibreBaseChangeIso, the morphism along which fibreBaseChangeTheta pulls back the twists

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.relativeProjBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085C, the isomorphism `r : Proj_{X'}(g^*𝒜) ⟶ X' ×_X Proj_X(𝒜)`**, for a morphism
`g : X' ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces over `S` and the quasi-coherent graded `𝒪_X`-algebra `𝒜` of
Situation 0849: an isomorphism of algebraic spaces from the relative Proj of `g^*𝒜` on `X'`
(`relativeProjFunctor` of `s.pullback g`) to the fibre product of `g` and the structure morphism
`Proj_X(𝒜) ⟶ X`.  It is an isomorphism over `X'` (`relativeProjBaseChangeIso_hom_fst`) and its
second component is `relativeProjBaseChangeHom`, which sends the class of a quadruple
`(d', f', ℒ', ψ')` to the class of `(d', g ∘ f', ℒ', ψ')`
(`relativeProjBaseChangeIso_hom_snd`).
declarations.statement:
def relativeProjBaseChangeIso :
    (s.pullback g).relativeProjFunctor ≅ Limits.pullback g.hom s.relativeProjπ
declarations.comment: the isomorphism r on the constructed relative Proj: Proj_{X'}(g^*A) ≅ X' x_X Proj_X(A), over X' and compatible with the projections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.relativeProjBaseChangeIso_hom_fst
declarations.doc: **`r` is an isomorphism over `X'`.**
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeProjBaseChangeIso_hom_fst :
    (s.relativeProjBaseChangeIso g).hom ≫ Limits.pullback.fst g.hom s.relativeProjπ =
      (s.pullback g).relativeProjπ
declarations.comment: r is an isomorphism over X', on the constructed relative Proj: r followed by the first projection X' x_X Proj_X(A) -> X' is the structure morphism Proj_{X'}(g^*A) -> X'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.relativeProjBaseChangeIso_hom_snd
declarations.doc: **The second component of `r` is the morphism `(d', f', ℒ', ψ') ↦ (d', g ∘ f', ℒ', ψ')`.**
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeProjBaseChangeIso_hom_snd :
    (s.relativeProjBaseChangeIso g).hom ≫ Limits.pullback.snd g.hom s.relativeProjπ =
      s.relativeProjBaseChangeHom g
declarations.comment: r on the constructed relative Proj sends the class of a quadruple (d', f', L', psi') to (f', (d', g f', L', psi')): followed by the second projection it is the morphism Proj_{X'}(g^*A) -> Proj_X(A) of quadruples

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.baseChangeTwistGradedAlgebraIsoOfPresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085C, the isomorphism `θ` of graded algebras, for any presentations of `X` and
`X'`.**  For a presentation `X = U/R` the twists `𝒪_P(d)` of `P = Proj_X(𝒜)` are descended along
it, and those of `P' = Proj_{X'}(g^*𝒜)` along the presentation `X' = U'/R'` with
`U' = U'₀ ×_X U` obtained from any presentation `X' = U'₀/R'₀`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Presentation.comap`); then
`θ : r^* pr_2^* (⨁_d 𝒪_P(d)) ≅ ⨁_d 𝒪_{P'}(d)` is an isomorphism of `ℤ`-graded `𝒪_{P'}`-algebras
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.baseChangeTwistGradedAlgebraIso`),
with `h = pr_2 ∘ r` the morphism `Proj_{X'}(g^*𝒜) ⟶ Proj_X(𝒜)`.
declarations.statement:
def baseChangeTwistGradedAlgebraIsoOfPresentation
    (Px₀ : Presentation s.site s.base s.containsBase X'.obj X'.property) :
    ModulePullbackGradedAlgebraIso (s.relativeProjBaseChangeSpaceHom g) (s.twistGradedAlgebra Px)
      ((s.pullback g).twistGradedAlgebra (Px.comap g.hom Px₀))
declarations.comment: theta for every presentation X = U/R of X (and X' = U'_0/R'_0 of X'), the twists of Proj_{X'}(g^*A) descended along the presentation of X' over U'_0 x_X U: the isomorphism r^* pr_2^* (+)_{d in Z} O_{Proj_X(A)}(d) -> (+)_{d in Z} O_{Proj_{X'}(g^*A)}(d) of Z-graded O_{Proj_{X'}(g^*A)}-algebras

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.relativeProjIsoF1OfGenerated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085D, part (1), on the constructed relative Proj.** For a quasi-coherent graded
`𝒪_X`-algebra `𝒜` on an algebraic space `X` generated as an `𝒜₀`-algebra by `𝒜₁`
(`RelativeProjSituation.IsGeneratedInDegreeOne`: over every affine étale chart `V` of `X` the
sections `⨁ₙ 𝒜ₙ(V)` are generated by `𝒜₁(V)` over `𝒜₀(V)`), the relative homogeneous spectrum
`P = Proj_X(𝒜)` constructed in Stacks 084A–084B represents the functor `F₁` which sends `T` to
the isomorphism classes of triples `(f, ℒ, ψ)`: `f : T → X`, `ℒ` an invertible `𝒪_T`-module, and
`ψ : f^*𝒜 ⟶ ⨁_{n ≥ 0} ℒ^{⊗ n}` a map of graded `𝒪_T`-algebras inducing a surjection
`f^*𝒜₁ ⟶ ℒ`.

`F₁` is `relativeProjF1Functor`, functorial by pullback of triples; the isomorphism is inverse to
the natural map `f1ToRelativeProj` sending a triple to the point of `P` it classifies (`P` is
lifted to the universe of `F₁`). `TA` is the choice of tensor algebras needed to write
`⨁_{n ≥ 0} ℒ^{⊗ n}`. It is `relativeProjIsoF1`, whose hypothesis on the restrictions of `𝒜` to
the étale charts follows from generation of `𝒜` itself
(`IsGeneratedInDegreeOne.isGeneratedInDegreeOneOnCharts`).
declarations.statement:
def relativeProjIsoF1OfGenerated (hgen : s.IsGeneratedInDegreeOne) :
    s.relativeProjFunctor ⋙ uliftFunctor.{u + 1} ≅ s.relativeProjF1Functor TA
declarations.comment: part (1), on the constructed relative Proj: for a quasi-coherent graded O_X-algebra A on an algebraic space X generated as an A_0-algebra by A_1 (over every affine object V of the small etale site of X, the ring of sections of A over V is generated by its degree-one part over its degree-zero part), the relative Proj P = relativeProjFunctor of Tags 084A-084B represents the functor F_1 of isomorphism classes of triples (f : T -> X, L invertible on T, psi : f^*A -> ⨁_{n >= 0} L^{tensor n} a map of graded O_T-algebras surjective in degree one), as a natural isomorphism of functors on the big fppf site; F_1 is functorial by pullback of triples (relativeProjF1Functor)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.epi_psiTwistHom_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085D (2).**  For a quasi-coherent graded `𝒪_X`-algebra `𝒜` on an algebraic space `X`
generated as an `𝒜₀`-algebra by `𝒜₁`, and `P = Proj_X(𝒜)` the relative Proj of
Stacks 084A–084B, the canonical map `ψ₁ : π^*𝒜₁ ⟶ 𝒪_P(1)` of Stacks 084D is surjective (an
epimorphism of `𝒪_P`-modules on the small étale site of `P`).

On the atlas `U ×_X P = Proj_U(u^*𝒜)` of `P` it is Tag 01NR's `ψ₁`, surjective by the case of
schemes; surjectivity descends along the surjective étale atlas.
declarations.statement: theorem epi_psiTwistHom_one (hgen : s.IsGeneratedInDegreeOne) : Epi (s.psiTwistHom Px 1)
declarations.comment: (2): for a quasi-coherent graded O_X-algebra A on an algebraic space X generated as an A_0-algebra by A_1 (s.IsGeneratedInDegreeOne), the canonical map psi_1 : pi^*A_1 -> O_P(1) of Tag 084D (psiTwistHom) on the relative Proj P = Proj_X(A) of Tags 084A-084B is surjective, i.e. an epimorphism of O_P-modules on the small etale site of P

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.isInvertibleModule_twistModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085D (3), invertibility.**  For a quasi-coherent graded `𝒪_X`-algebra `𝒜` on an
algebraic space `X` generated as an `𝒜₀`-algebra by `𝒜₁`, and `P = Proj_X(𝒜)` the relative Proj
of Stacks 084A–084B, every twist `𝒪_P(n)`, `n ∈ ℤ`, of Stacks 084D is an invertible
`𝒪_P`-module.

Its inverse image along the atlas `U ×_X P = Proj_U(u^*𝒜)` of `P` is the module attached to the
twist `𝒪(n)` of `Proj_U(u^*𝒜)`, invertible by the case of schemes; invertibility of a
quasi-coherent module descends along the fpqc covering formed by the atlas.
declarations.statement:
theorem isInvertibleModule_twistModule (hgen : s.IsGeneratedInDegreeOne) (n : ℤ) :
    IsInvertibleModule
      (⟨s.relativeProjFunctor, s.isAlgebraicSpace_relativeProjFunctor⟩ :
        AlgebraicSpaces s.site s.base s.containsBase)
      (s.twistModule Px n).obj
declarations.comment: (3), invertibility: for a quasi-coherent graded O_X-algebra A on an algebraic space X generated as an A_0-algebra by A_1 (s.IsGeneratedInDegreeOne), every twist O_P(n), n in Z, of Tag 084D (twistModule) on the relative Proj P = Proj_X(A) of Tags 084A-084B is an invertible O_P-module on the small etale site of P

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.isIso_mulSheaf_twistGradedAlgebra
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085D (3), multiplication.**  For a quasi-coherent graded `𝒪_X`-algebra `𝒜` on an
algebraic space `X` generated as an `𝒜₀`-algebra by `𝒜₁`, and `P = Proj_X(𝒜)` the relative Proj
of Stacks 084A–084B, the multiplication maps of `⨁_{n ∈ ℤ} 𝒪_P(n)` (Stacks 084D) induce
isomorphisms `𝒪_P(n) ⊗_{𝒪_P} 𝒪_P(m) ⟶ 𝒪_P(n + m)` for all integers `n` and `m`, the tensor
product being the tensor product sheaf of `𝒪_P`-modules.

It is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.isIso_twistAlgebraMul` read through the
identification of the two tensor products (`…mulSheaf_twistGradedAlgebra`).
declarations.comment: (3), multiplication: for a quasi-coherent graded O_X-algebra A on an algebraic space X generated as an A_0-algebra by A_1 (s.IsGeneratedInDegreeOne), the multiplication maps O_P(n) (x)_{O_P} O_P(m) -> O_P(n + m) of the graded algebra (+)_{n in Z} O_P(n) of Tag 084D (twistGradedAlgebra) on the relative Proj P = Proj_X(A) of Tags 084A-084B are isomorphisms for all integers n, m

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.relativeMapSubfunctor
declarations.doc:
**Tag 085F, the open subspace `U(ψ) ⊆ Q`.** The subfunctor of `Q = Proj_X(ℬ)` whose
`T`-points are the points lying in the domain of definition of `ψ`: those whose section of the
scheme-level relative Proj of `ℬ|_T` factors through the open `U(ψ|_T)` of Tag 07ZG.
declarations.statement: def relativeMapSubfunctor : Subfunctor Q
declarations.comment: the open subspace U(ψ) of Q

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.mem_relativeMapSubfunctor_iff
declarations.doc:
**Tag 085F's étale-local description of the open subspace.** A point of `Q` lying over a
point `f` of the base at `T`, along any `r : T' ⟶ T`, belongs to `U(ψ)` exactly when its section
of the scheme-level relative Proj of `ℬ|_T` factors through the open `U(ψ|_T)` of Tag 07ZG.

Read at an étale chart `W` of `X` and `r = 𝟙`, this is the assertion `U(ψ) ×_X W = U(ψ|_W)` of
the source.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_relativeMapSubfunctor_iff (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X)
    {T' : BigFppfOver B S hS} (r : T' ⟶ T) (u : yoneda.obj T' ⟶ Q)
    (hu : u ≫ πQ = yoneda.map r ≫ f) :
    yonedaEquiv u ∈ hψ.relativeMapSubfunctor.obj (op T') ↔
      dQ.sectionOfPoint T f r u hu ⁻¹ᵁ (hψ.hom T f).relativeMapDomain = ⊤
declarations.comment: the étale-local description of the open subspace U(ψ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.relativeMapSpaceHom
declarations.doc:
**Tag 085F, the morphism `r_ψ : U(ψ) ⟶ P` of algebraic spaces.** On a `T`-point of `U(ψ)`
it is the point of `P = Proj_X(𝒜)` whose section of the scheme-level relative Proj of `𝒜|_T` is
obtained from the section of `ℬ|_T` by the morphism `r_{ψ|_T}` of Tag 07ZG.
declarations.statement: def relativeMapSpaceHom : hψ.relativeMapSubfunctor.toFunctor ⟶ P
declarations.comment: the morphism r_ψ : U(ψ) ⟶ P

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.relativeMapSpaceHom_comp
declarations.doc: **Tag 085F: the morphism `r_ψ` is a morphism over `X`.**
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeMapSpaceHom_comp :
    hψ.relativeMapSpaceHom ≫ πP = hψ.relativeMapSubfunctor.ι ≫ πQ
declarations.comment: the morphism r_ψ is a morphism over X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.app_relativeMapSpaceHom
declarations.doc:
**Tag 085F's étale-local description of the morphism `r_ψ`.** On a point of `U(ψ)` lying
over a point `f` of the base at `T`, along any `r : T' ⟶ T`, the morphism `r_ψ` produces the
point of `P` whose section of the scheme-level relative Proj of `𝒜|_T` is the one the morphism
`r_{ψ|_T}` of Tag 07ZG produces; that last identification is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sectionOfPoint_pointHomOn`.

Read at an étale chart `W` of `X` and `r = 𝟙`, this is the assertion that `r_ψ` restricted to
`U(ψ) ×_X W` is the morphism `r_{ψ|_W}` of the source.
declarations.statement:
theorem app_relativeMapSpaceHom (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X)
    {T' : BigFppfOver B S hS} (r : T' ⟶ T) (u : yoneda.obj T' ⟶ Q)
    (hu : u ≫ πQ = yoneda.map r ≫ f) (hd : IsDefinedOn dP dQ hψ.hom T f r u hu)
    (hx : yonedaEquiv u ∈ hψ.relativeMapSubfunctor.obj (op T')) :
    hψ.relativeMapSpaceHom.app (op T') ⟨yonedaEquiv u, hx⟩ =
      yonedaEquiv (pointHomOn dP dQ hψ.hom T f r u hu hd)
declarations.comment: the étale-local description of the morphism r_ψ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.relativeMapSubfunctor_unique
declarations.doc:
**Tag 085F's description determines the open subspace.** A subfunctor of `Q` whose points
are exactly the points in the domain of definition of `ψ` is `U(ψ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeMapSubfunctor_unique (G : Subfunctor Q)
    (hG : ∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (u : yoneda.obj T ⟶ Q),
      yonedaEquiv u ∈ G.obj (op T) ↔ IsDefined dP dQ hψ.hom T u) :
    G = hψ.relativeMapSubfunctor
declarations.comment: the étale-local description determines U(ψ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.relativeMapSpaceHom_unique
declarations.doc:
**Tag 085F's description determines the morphism.** A morphism out of `U(ψ)` whose value at
every point is the point of `P` the scheme-level morphism `r_{ψ|_T}` of Tag 07ZG produces is
`r_ψ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeMapSpaceHom_unique (k : hψ.relativeMapSubfunctor.toFunctor ⟶ P)
    (hk : ∀ (Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ) (y : Q.obj Y)
      (hy : y ∈ hψ.relativeMapSubfunctor.obj Y),
      k.app Y ⟨y, hy⟩ = yonedaEquiv (pointHomAt dP dQ hψ.hom Y.unop (yonedaEquiv.symm y)
        ((hψ.mem_relativeMapSubfunctor_obj y).1 hy))) :
    k = hψ.relativeMapSpaceHom
declarations.comment: the étale-local description determines r_ψ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.isOpenSubspace_relativeMapSubfunctor
declarations.doc: **Tag 085F: `U(ψ)` is an open subspace of `Q = Proj_X(ℬ)`.**
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenSubspace_relativeMapSubfunctor (hQ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Q) :
    IsOpenSubspace B S hS hψ.relativeMapSubfunctor
declarations.comment: U(ψ) is an open subspace of Q

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.relativeTwistSpaceMap
declarations.doc:
**Tag 085F, the third component: the map `θ` on the twists, over a scheme point of the
base.**  For every `n : ℤ`,

`θ_n : r_ψ^*𝒪_P(n) ⟶ 𝒪_Q(n)|_{U(ψ)}`,

read over the scheme point `(T, f)` of `X` as the map Tag 07ZG attaches to the restriction
`ψ|_{T,f}` — a *single* morphism of sheaves of modules on the whole of `U(ψ|_{T,f})`, namely
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.Tag07ZGTwist.relativeTwistMap`.

This is `θ` itself, not a chart-by-chart approximation of it: Tag 085F *characterizes* `θ` by the
property that its restriction to `U(ψ) ×_X W` is the scheme-level `θ` of `ψ|_W` for every scheme
`W` étale over `X`, and that restriction is exactly what this is.  The characterization is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.relativeTwistSpaceMap_chart` and
`…relativeTwistSpaceMap_unique`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev relativeTwistSpaceMap (hψ : RelativeProjHomPoints dP dQ)
    (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X) (n : ℤ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (relativeMapHom (hψ.hom T f))).obj (dP.pointTwist T f n) ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (hψ.hom T f).relativeMapDomain.ι).obj (dQ.pointTwist T f n)
declarations.comment:
the third component: the map θ on the n-th twists, over a scheme point of the
base — the scheme-level θ of Tag 07ZG for the restricted map, which is what the tag's
étale-local characterization of θ asks for

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.relativeTwistAlgebraSpaceHom
declarations.doc:
**Tag 085F, the third component as a map of `ℤ`-graded algebras.**  The source asks for `θ`
as a homomorphism

`θ : r_ψ^*(⨁_{d ∈ ℤ} 𝒪_P(d)) ⟶ ⨁_{d ∈ ℤ} 𝒪_{U(ψ)}(d)`

of sheaves of `ℤ`-graded algebras, not only for the degreewise family; over a scheme point of the
base that is `Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.Tag07ZGTwist.relativeTwistAlgebraHom`, whose degree-`n`
component is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.relativeTwistSpaceMap`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev relativeTwistAlgebraSpaceHom (hψ : RelativeProjHomPoints dP dQ)
    (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X)
declarations.comment:
the third component as a map of ℤ-graded algebras, over a scheme point of the
base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.relativeTwistSpaceMap_chart
declarations.doc:
**Tag 085F's étale-local description of `θ`.**  Over the piece of `U(ψ|_{T,f})` lying over an
affine open `U` of the scheme point `T` of the base, `θ_n` is Tag 01MY's comparison map for the
induced homomorphism `Γ(U, 𝒜|_T) ⟶ Γ(U, ℬ|_T)` of graded rings of sections, conjugated by the
chart identifications of Tag 01NR.

This is the affine-local reading of the étale-local description; the étale-local description
itself — that `θ` restricted to `U(ψ) ×_X W` is the scheme-level `θ` of `ψ|_W` — holds by
construction, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.relativeTwistSpaceMap` being that
restriction.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeTwistSpaceMap_chart (hψ : RelativeProjHomPoints dP dQ)
    (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X) (n : ℤ)
    (U : ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T).affineOpens) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pieceIncl (hψ.hom T f) U)).map (hψ.relativeTwistSpaceMap T f n) =
      relativeTwistChart (hψ.hom T f) n U
declarations.comment:
the étale-local description of θ, read on the affine charts of a scheme point of
the base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.relativeTwistSpaceMap_unique
declarations.doc:
**Tag 085F's description determines `θ`.**  A map on the `n`-th twists whose restriction to
the piece over every affine open of the scheme point of the base is Tag 01MY's comparison map
there is `θ_n`.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeTwistSpaceMap_unique (hψ : RelativeProjHomPoints dP dQ)
    (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X) (n : ℤ)
    {θ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (relativeMapHom (hψ.hom T f))).obj (dP.pointTwist T f n) ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (hψ.hom T f).relativeMapDomain.ι).obj (dQ.pointTwist T f n)}
    (hθ : ∀ U : ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T).affineOpens,
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pieceIncl (hψ.hom T f) U)).map θ =
        relativeTwistChart (hψ.hom T f) n U) :
    θ = hψ.relativeTwistSpaceMap T f n
declarations.comment: the étale-local description determines θ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.relativeMapTriple_spec
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeMapTriple_spec :
    IsOpenSubspace B S hS (𝔥).relativeMapSubfunctor ∧
    (relativeMapSpaceMor h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k ψ).hom ≫ (𝔰₁).relativeProjπ =
      (relativeMapSpaceι h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k ψ).hom ≫ (𝔰₂).relativeProjπ ∧
    (∀ n : ℤ, type_of% (twistAlgebraHomOfMul_app h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k ψ Px
      (twistMap_mul h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k ψ Px) n)) ∧
    (∀ n : ℤ, type_of% (isDescendedChartHom_twistMap h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k ψ Px n)) ∧
    (∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X.1) {T' : BigFppfOver B S hS}
      (r : T' ⟶ T) (v : yoneda.obj T' ⟶ (𝔰₂).relativeProjFunctor)
      (hv : v ≫ (𝔰₂).relativeProjπ = yoneda.map r ≫ f),
      type_of% ((𝔥).mem_relativeMapSubfunctor_iff T f r v hv)) ∧
    (∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X.1) {T' : BigFppfOver B S hS}
      (r : T' ⟶ T) (v : yoneda.obj T' ⟶ (𝔰₂).relativeProjFunctor)
      (hv : v ≫ (𝔰₂).relativeProjπ = yoneda.map r ≫ f)
      (hd : IsDefinedOn (𝔰₁).relativeProjPoints (𝔰₂).relativeProjPoints (𝔥).hom T f r v hv)
      (hx : yonedaEquiv v ∈ (𝔥).relativeMapSubfunctor.obj (op T')),
      type_of% ((𝔥).app_relativeMapSpaceHom T f r v hv hd hx)) ∧
    (∀ G : Subfunctor (𝔰₂).relativeProjFunctor,
      type_of% ((𝔥).relativeMapSubfunctor_unique G)) ∧
    (∀ k : (𝔥).relativeMapSubfunctor.toFunctor ⟶ (𝔰₁).relativeProjFunctor,
      type_of% ((𝔥).relativeMapSpaceHom_unique k)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℤ) (χ : type_of% (twistMap h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k ψ Px n)),
      type_of% (eq_twistMap h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k ψ Px n (χ := χ))) ∧
    (∀ θ' : SheafOfModules.GradedAlgebra.Hom
        ((gradedPull (X := smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS 𝒢)
          (Y := smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS (projSpace₁ h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k))
          (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS
            (relativeMapSpaceMor h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k ψ))).obj
          ((𝔰₁).twistGradedAlgebra Px))
        ((gradedPull (X := smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS 𝒢)
          (Y := smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS (projSpace₂ h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k))
          (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS
            (relativeMapSpaceι h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k ψ))).obj
          ((𝔰₂).twistGradedAlgebra Px)),
      type_of% (eq_twistAlgebraHomOfMul h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k ψ Px
        (twistMap_mul h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k ψ Px) θ'))
declarations.comment: the triple (U(ψ), r_ψ, θ) with θ a map of graded algebras, its description by the triple of Tag 07ZG over the scheme points of X, and its uniqueness

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.comp_relativeMapSubfunctor_le
declarations.doc: **Tag 085G, the first assertion: `U(ψ ∘ φ) ⊆ U(ψ)`.**
declarations.statement:
theorem comp_relativeMapSubfunctor_le :
    (hφ.comp hψ).relativeMapSubfunctor ≤ hψ.relativeMapSubfunctor
declarations.comment: the domain U(ψ ∘ φ) lies in U(ψ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.mem_comp_relativeMapSubfunctor_iff
declarations.doc:
**Tag 085G, the first assertion: `U(ψ ∘ φ) = r_ψ^{-1}(U(φ))`.** A point of
`R = Proj_X(𝒞)` lying in `U(ψ)` lies in `U(ψ ∘ φ)` exactly when its image under
`r_ψ : U(ψ) ⟶ Q` lies in `U(φ)`.

Together with `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.comp_relativeMapSubfunctor_le`
this is the equality `U(ψ ∘ φ) = r_ψ^{-1}(U(φ))` of the source.  (The source writes the
right-hand side of that equality as `r_φ^{-1}(U(ψ))`, which does not typecheck: `r_φ` is defined
on an open of `Q` and takes values in `P`, while `U(ψ)` is an open of `R`.  The reading above is
the one the scheme-level analogue Tag 07ZH states, and it is the one the second assertion — which
the source states identically in both tags — requires.)
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_comp_relativeMapSubfunctor_iff (Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ) (y : R.obj Y)
    (hy : y ∈ hψ.relativeMapSubfunctor.obj Y) :
    y ∈ (hφ.comp hψ).relativeMapSubfunctor.obj Y ↔
      hψ.relativeMapSpaceHom.app Y ⟨y, hy⟩ ∈ hφ.relativeMapSubfunctor.obj Y
declarations.comment: U(ψ ∘ φ) is the inverse image of U(φ) under r_ψ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.app_comp_relativeMapSpaceHom
declarations.doc: **Tag 085G, the second assertion: `r_{ψ ∘ φ} = r_φ ∘ r_ψ|_{U(ψ ∘ φ)}`.**
declarations.statement:
theorem app_comp_relativeMapSpaceHom (Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ) (y : R.obj Y)
    (hy : y ∈ hψ.relativeMapSubfunctor.obj Y)
    (hc : y ∈ (hφ.comp hψ).relativeMapSubfunctor.obj Y)
    (hc2 : hψ.relativeMapSpaceHom.app Y ⟨y, hy⟩ ∈ hφ.relativeMapSubfunctor.obj Y) :
    (hφ.comp hψ).relativeMapSpaceHom.app Y ⟨y, hc⟩ =
      hφ.relativeMapSpaceHom.app Y ⟨hψ.relativeMapSpaceHom.app Y ⟨y, hy⟩, hc2⟩
declarations.comment: the morphism r_{ψ ∘ φ} is r_φ after r_ψ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.relativeTwistSpaceMap_comp
declarations.doc:
**Tag 085G, the third assertion: `θ_ψ ∘ r_ψ^*θ_φ = θ_{ψ ∘ φ}`**, over a scheme point
`(T, f)` of the base and in degree `n`.  The `n`-th map on twists of the composite is the inverse
image along the restriction of `r_ψ` to `U(ψ ∘ φ)` of the `n`-th map on twists of `φ`, followed
by the inverse image along the inclusion of `U(ψ ∘ φ)` into `U(ψ)` of the `n`-th map on twists of
`ψ`; the remaining factors are the inverse-image isomorphisms that identify the sources and
targets, named by the first two assertions at that point.

The source's "obvious notation" `r_ψ^*θ_φ` is the inverse image of
`θ_φ : r_φ^*𝒪_P(n) ⟶ 𝒪_{U(φ)}(n)` along `r_ψ|_{U(ψ ∘ φ)} : U(ψ ∘ φ) ⟶ U(φ)`, a map
`r_ψ^*r_φ^*𝒪_P(n) ⟶ r_ψ^*𝒪_Q(n)` over `U(ψ ∘ φ)`; it is composed with `θ_ψ` restricted to
`U(ψ ∘ φ)`, and `r_ψ^*r_φ^* = r_{ψ ∘ φ}^*` by the second assertion.  Tag 085F's `θ` is, in this
library, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.relativeTwistSpaceMap`, its restriction
over every scheme point `(T, f)` of `X`, so this is the assertion over every such point.  The
source's `θ` is a map of `ℤ`-graded algebras, and such a map is determined by its components, so
the degreewise identity is the identity of graded maps.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeTwistSpaceMap_comp (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X) (n : ℤ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr
          (relativeMapHomRestrict_comp_relativeMapHom (hφ.hom T f) (hψ.hom T f))).inv.app
        (relativeTwist (dP.algebra T f) n) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (relativeMapHomRestrict (hφ.hom T f) (hψ.hom T f))
          (relativeMapHom (hφ.hom T f))).inv.app (relativeTwist (dP.algebra T f) n) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (relativeMapHomRestrict (hφ.hom T f) (hψ.hom T f))).map
          (hφ.relativeTwistSpaceMap T f n) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (relativeMapHomRestrict (hφ.hom T f) (hψ.hom T f))
          (hφ.hom T f).relativeMapDomain.ι).hom.app (relativeTwist (dQ.algebra T f) n) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr
          (relativeMapHomRestrict_comp_ι (hφ.hom T f) (hψ.hom T f))).hom.app
        (relativeTwist (dQ.algebra T f) n) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp
          ((relativeProj (dR.algebra T f)).scheme.homOfLE
            (relativeMapDomain_comp_le (hφ.hom T f) (hψ.hom T f)))
          (relativeMapHom (hψ.hom T f))).inv.app (relativeTwist (dQ.algebra T f) n) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((relativeProj (dR.algebra T f)).scheme.homOfLE
          (relativeMapDomain_comp_le (hφ.hom T f) (hψ.hom T f)))).map
        (hψ.relativeTwistSpaceMap T f n) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp ((relativeProj (dR.algebra T f)).scheme.homOfLE
            (relativeMapDomain_comp_le (hφ.hom T f) (hψ.hom T f)))
          (hψ.hom T f).relativeMapDomain.ι).hom.app (relativeTwist (dR.algebra T f) n) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Scheme.homOfLE_ι (relativeProj (dR.algebra T f)).scheme
          (relativeMapDomain_comp_le (hφ.hom T f) (hψ.hom T f)))).hom.app
        (relativeTwist (dR.algebra T f) n) =
      (hφ.comp hψ).relativeTwistSpaceMap T f n
declarations.comment: (3): θ_ψ ∘ r_ψ^*θ_φ = θ_{ψ ∘ φ}, in every degree n and over every scheme point (T, f) of X, where Tag 085F's θ is given: the inverse image of θ_φ along the restriction r_ψ|_{U(ψ ∘ φ)} : U(ψ ∘ φ) ⟶ U(φ), followed by the restriction of θ_ψ to U(ψ ∘ φ), is θ_{ψ ∘ φ}, up to the canonical inverse-image isomorphisms

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.homPoints_comp_relativeMap_twist
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 085G].** Let `S` be a scheme, `X` an algebraic space over `S`, and `𝒜₁`, `𝒜₂`,
`𝒜₃` quasi-coherent graded `𝒪_X`-algebras (Situation 0849), with relative Projs
`P = Proj_X(𝒜₁)`, `Q = Proj_X(𝒜₂)` and `R = Proj_X(𝒜₃)`.  Let `φ : 𝒜₁ ⟶ 𝒜₂` and
`ψ : 𝒜₂ ⟶ 𝒜₃` be graded `𝒪_X`-algebra maps, and write `U(-)`, `r_-` and `θ_-` for the data of
Tag 085F attached to `φ`, `ψ` and `ψ ∘ φ` (`φ.comp ψ`) through
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.homPoints`.  Then

0. the map of graded algebras over the scheme points of the base attached to `ψ ∘ φ` is the
  composite of those attached to `φ` and `ψ`;
1. `U(ψ ∘ φ) = r_ψ^{-1}(U(φ))`, as subfunctors of `R` (the image under the inclusion of `U(ψ)` of
  the inverse image of `U(φ)` along `r_ψ`; the source prints `r_φ^{-1}(U(ψ))`, which does not
  typecheck, the names `φ` and `ψ` being interchanged, see the module docstring);
2. `r_{ψ ∘ φ} = r_φ ∘ r_ψ|_{U(ψ ∘ φ)}`, with `r_ψ|_{U(ψ ∘ φ)} : U(ψ ∘ φ) ⟶ U(φ)` the restriction
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.compRestrict`;
3. `θ_ψ ∘ r_ψ^*θ_φ = θ_{ψ ∘ φ}`: over every scheme point `(T, f)` of `X` — where Tag 085F's `θ`
  is given — and in every degree `n`, the map on twists of the composite is the inverse image of
  `θ_φ` along the restriction of `r_ψ`, followed by the inverse image of `θ_ψ` along the inclusion
  of `U(ψ ∘ φ)` into `U(ψ)`, up to the inverse-image isomorphisms identifying sources and targets.

There are no hypotheses beyond the data.
declarations.statement:
theorem homPoints_comp_relativeMap_twist :
    𝔥ψφ = (𝔥φ).comp (𝔥ψ) ∧
      (𝔥ψφ).relativeMapSubfunctor =
        ((𝔥φ).relativeMapSubfunctor.preimage (𝔥ψ).relativeMapSpaceHom).image
          (𝔥ψ).relativeMapSubfunctor.ι ∧
      (𝔥φ).compRestrict (𝔥ψ)
          (homPoints_comp h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k h₃c h₃n h₃q h₃k φ ψ) ≫
          (𝔥φ).relativeMapSpaceHom = (𝔥ψφ).relativeMapSpaceHom ∧
      ∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X.1) (n : ℤ),
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr
              (relativeMapHomRestrict_comp_relativeMapHom ((𝔥φ).hom T f) ((𝔥ψ).hom T f))).inv.app
            (relativeTwist (𝔡₁ T f) n) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (relativeMapHomRestrict ((𝔥φ).hom T f) ((𝔥ψ).hom T f))
              (relativeMapHom ((𝔥φ).hom T f))).inv.app
            (relativeTwist (𝔡₁ T f) n) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (relativeMapHomRestrict ((𝔥φ).hom T f) ((𝔥ψ).hom T f))).map
              ((𝔥φ).relativeTwistSpaceMap T f n) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (relativeMapHomRestrict ((𝔥φ).hom T f) ((𝔥ψ).hom T f))
              ((𝔥φ).hom T f).relativeMapDomain.ι).hom.app
            (relativeTwist (𝔡₂ T f) n) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr
              (relativeMapHomRestrict_comp_ι ((𝔥φ).hom T f) ((𝔥ψ).hom T f))).hom.app
            (relativeTwist (𝔡₂ T f) n) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp
              ((relativeProj (𝔡₃ T f)).scheme.homOfLE
                (relativeMapDomain_comp_le ((𝔥φ).hom T f) ((𝔥ψ).hom T f)))
              (relativeMapHom ((𝔥ψ).hom T f))).inv.app
            (relativeTwist (𝔡₂ T f) n) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((relativeProj (𝔡₃ T f)).scheme.homOfLE
              (relativeMapDomain_comp_le ((𝔥φ).hom T f) ((𝔥ψ).hom T f)))).map
            ((𝔥ψ).relativeTwistSpaceMap T f n) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp
              ((relativeProj (𝔡₃ T f)).scheme.homOfLE
                (relativeMapDomain_comp_le ((𝔥φ).hom T f) ((𝔥ψ).hom T f)))
              ((𝔥ψ).hom T f).relativeMapDomain.ι).hom.app
            (relativeTwist (𝔡₃ T f) n) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr
              (Scheme.homOfLE_ι (relativeProj (𝔡₃ T f)).scheme
                (relativeMapDomain_comp_le ((𝔥φ).hom T f) ((𝔥ψ).hom T f)))).hom.app
            (relativeTwist (𝔡₃ T f) n) =
          ((𝔥φ).comp (𝔥ψ)).relativeTwistSpaceMap T f n
declarations.comment: the tag's three assertions for the relative Projs of Situation 0849 and the data of Tag 085F attached to the algebra maps: U(ψ ∘ φ) = r_ψ^{-1}(U(φ)) as subfunctors of R (the source prints r_φ^{-1}(U(ψ)), which is type-incorrect, the names φ and ψ being interchanged), r_{ψ ∘ φ} = r_φ ∘ r_ψ|_{U(ψ ∘ φ)}, and θ_ψ ∘ r_ψ^*θ_φ = θ_{ψ ∘ φ} at every scheme point of the base, where Tag 085F's θ is given

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistCompare.NotIsoExample.not_isIso_relativeTwistMap
declarations.doc:
**The comparison map `θ₁ : r_ψ^*𝒪(1) ⟶ 𝒪(1)` of Stacks 07ZG for `ψ : A~ ⟶ B~` on `Spec R` is
not an isomorphism**, although `ψ` is surjective in every degree (`epi_sheafHom_app`).
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isIso_relativeTwistMap :
    ¬ IsIso (relativeTwistMap (sheafHom R) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
declarations.comment: (3), second half: the maps θ are not isomorphisms in general, even if A → B is surjective: A = R[x,y]/(x²) with deg x = 1, deg y = 2, B = A/(x) on Spec R, θ₁ is not an iso

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isDefinedOn_of_eventually_epi
declarations.doc:
If every restriction of `ψ` is an epimorphism in all sufficiently large degrees then every
point of `Q = Proj_X(ℬ)` lies in the domain of definition of `ψ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDefinedOn_of_eventually_epi
    (hsurj : ∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X),
      ∀ᶠ d : ℕ in atTop, Epi ((ψ T f).app (d : ℤ)))
    (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X) {T' : BigFppfOver B S hS}
    (r : T' ⟶ T) (u : yoneda.obj T' ⟶ Q) (hu : u ≫ πQ = yoneda.map r ≫ f) :
    IsDefinedOn dP dQ ψ T f r u hu
declarations.comment: part (1): every point of Q lies in the domain of definition

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isClosedImmersion_pointRelativeMapHom_of_eventually_epi
declarations.doc:
If every restriction of `ψ` is an epimorphism in all sufficiently large degrees then over each
scheme point `(T, f)` of `X` the morphism `r_{ψ|_{T,f}} : Proj_T(ℬ|_T) ⟶ Proj_T(𝒜|_T)` of Stacks
07ZG is a closed immersion of schemes.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_pointRelativeMapHom_of_eventually_epi
    (hsurj : ∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X),
      ∀ᶠ d : ℕ in atTop, Epi ((ψ T f).app (d : ℤ)))
    (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X) :
    _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion (relativeMapHom (ψ T f))
declarations.comment: part (2): a closed immersion over each scheme point of the base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.epi_pointTwistMap_of_eventually_epi
declarations.doc:
If every restriction of `ψ` is an epimorphism in all sufficiently large degrees then, over
every affine open of every scheme point of the base, the comparison maps of Stacks 01MY on the
`n`-th twist are epimorphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem epi_pointTwistMap_of_eventually_epi
    (hsurj : ∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X),
      ∀ᶠ d : ℕ in atTop, Epi ((ψ T f).app (d : ℤ)))
    (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X)
    {V : ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T).Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (n : ℤ) :
    Epi ((Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistCompare.projMapData ((dP.algebra T f).grading V)
      ((dQ.algebra T f).grading V) ((ψ T f).sectionHom V)).twistMap n)
declarations.comment: part (3): the maps on twists are surjective, chart by chart

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.relativeMapSubfunctor_eq_top_of_eventually_epi
declarations.doc:
If every restriction of `ψ` is an epimorphism in all sufficiently large degrees then the open
subspace `U(ψ)` of Stacks 085F is all of `Q = Proj_X(ℬ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeMapSubfunctor_eq_top_of_eventually_epi
    (hsurj : ∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X),
      ∀ᶠ d : ℕ in atTop, Epi ((hψ.hom T f).app (d : ℤ))) :
    hψ.relativeMapSubfunctor = ⊤
declarations.comment: part (1): U(ψ) = Q

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.relativeMapSubfunctor_homPoints_eq_top
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085H (1) for the canonical relative Projs: `U(ψ) = Q`.** If `ψ_d : 𝒜₁,d ⟶ 𝒜₂,d` is
surjective for `d ≫ 0`, the open subspace `U(ψ)` of Stacks 085F is all of
`Q = Proj_X(𝒜₂)`. This is also Stacks 085J (1), whose hypotheses contain these.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeMapSubfunctor_homPoints_eq_top
    (hsurj : ∀ᶠ d : ℕ in atTop, Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (ψ.app (d : ℤ)).val)) :
    (homPoints h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k ψ).relativeMapSubfunctor = ⊤

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.isClosedImmersion_relativeMapSpaceHom_homPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085H (2) for the canonical relative Projs: `r_ψ` is a closed immersion.** If
`ψ_d : 𝒜₁,d ⟶ 𝒜₂,d` is surjective for `d ≫ 0`, the morphism `r_ψ : U(ψ) ⟶ Proj_X(𝒜₁)` of
Stacks 085F, whose source is all of `Proj_X(𝒜₂)` by `relativeMapSubfunctor_homPoints_eq_top`, is
a closed immersion of algebraic spaces. This is also Stacks 085J (2), whose hypotheses contain
these.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_relativeMapSpaceHom_homPoints
    (hsurj : ∀ᶠ d : ℕ in atTop, Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (ψ.app (d : ℤ)).val)) :
    IsClosedImmersion B S hS (homPoints h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k ψ).relativeMapSpaceHom
declarations.comment: (2): r_ψ : Q ⟶ P is a closed immersion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.epi_twistMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085H (3), surjectivity: the maps `θ : r_ψ^*𝒪_P(n) ⟶ 𝒪_Q(n)` are surjective** when
`ψ_d` is surjective for `d ≫ 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem epi_twistMap
    (hsurj : ∀ᶠ d : ℕ in atTop, Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (ψ.app (d : ℤ)).val))
    (Px : Presentation B S hS X.1 X.2) (n : ℤ) :
    Epi (twistMap h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k ψ Px n)
declarations.comment: (3), first half: the maps θ : r_ψ^*O_P(n) → O_Q(n) are surjective (θ the glued map of 085F, twistMap), for ψ_d surjective for d ≫ 0

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.relativeMapSubfunctor_homPoints_eq_top_of_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085I (1): `U(ψ) = Q`.** If `ψ_d : 𝒜₁,d ⟶ 𝒜₂,d` is an isomorphism for `d ≫ 0`, the
open subspace `U(ψ)` of Stacks 085F is all of `Q = Proj_X(𝒜₂)`.

    (hiso : ∀ᶠ d : ℕ in atTop, IsIso (ψ.app (d : ℤ))) :

declarations.comment: (1): U(ψ) = Q, for ψ_d : A_d → B_d an isomorphism for d ≫ 0

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.isIso_relativeMapSpaceHom_homPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085I (2): `r_ψ : Q ⟶ P` is an isomorphism.** If `ψ_d : 𝒜₁,d ⟶ 𝒜₂,d` is an
isomorphism for `d ≫ 0`, the morphism `r_ψ : U(ψ) ⟶ Proj_X(𝒜₁)` of Stacks 085F, whose source is
all of `Q = Proj_X(𝒜₂)` by `relativeMapSubfunctor_homPoints_eq_top_of_isIso`, is an isomorphism
of algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:

declarations.comment: (2): r_ψ : Q → P is an isomorphism, for ψ_d an isomorphism for d ≫ 0

declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085I (3): the maps `θ : r_ψ^*𝒪_P(n) ⟶ 𝒪_Q(n)` are isomorphisms** when `ψ_d` is an
isomorphism for `d ≫ 0`. Here `θ_n` is the glued map of Stacks 085F (`twistMap`), built along a
presentation `Px` of `X`; it is read on the chart of `Px`, where it is the `θ_n` of Stacks 07ZG for

    (Px : Presentation B S hS X.1 X.2) (n : ℤ) :
    IsIso (twistMap h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k ψ Px n)

(3): the maps θ : r_ψ^*O_P(n) → O_Q(n) are isomorphisms (θ the glued map of 085F,

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isDefinedOn_of_eventually_epi
declarations.doc:
If every restriction of `ψ` is an epimorphism in all sufficiently large degrees then every
point of `Q = Proj_X(ℬ)` lies in the domain of definition of `ψ`.

declarations.doc:
If every restriction of `ψ` is an epimorphism in all sufficiently large degrees then over each
scheme point `(T, f)` of `X` the morphism `r_{ψ|_{T,f}} : Proj_T(ℬ|_T) ⟶ Proj_T(𝒜|_T)` of Stacks
07ZG is a closed immersion of schemes.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_pointTwistMap_of_generatedInDegreeOne
declarations.doc:
If every restriction of `ψ` is an epimorphism in all sufficiently large degrees and `𝒜` is
generated in degree one over every affine open of every scheme point of the base, the comparison
maps of Stacks 01MY on the twists over those affine opens are isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_pointTwistMap_of_generatedInDegreeOne
    (hsurj : ∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X),
      ∀ᶠ d : ℕ in atTop, Epi ((ψ T f).app (d : ℤ)))
    (hgen : ∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X)
      (U : ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T).Opens), IsAffineOpen U →
        (dP.algebra T f).IsGeneratedInDegreeOneAt U)
    (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X)
    {V : ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T).Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (n : ℤ) :
    IsIso ((Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistCompare.projMapData ((dP.algebra T f).grading V)
      ((dQ.algebra T f).grading V) ((ψ T f).sectionHom V)).twistMap n)
declarations.comment: part (3): the maps on twists are isomorphisms, chart by chart

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjHomPoints.relativeMapSubfunctor_eq_top_of_eventually_epi
declarations.doc:
If every restriction of `ψ` is an epimorphism in all sufficiently large degrees then the open

declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085H (1) for the canonical relative Projs: `U(ψ) = Q`.** If `ψ_d : 𝒜₁,d ⟶ 𝒜₂,d` is
surjective for `d ≫ 0`, the open subspace `U(ψ)` of Stacks 085F is all of
`Q = Proj_X(𝒜₂)`. This is also Stacks 085J (1), whose hypotheses contain these.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeMapSubfunctor_homPoints_eq_top
    (hsurj : ∀ᶠ d : ℕ in atTop, Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (ψ.app (d : ℤ)).val)) :
    (homPoints h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k ψ).relativeMapSubfunctor = ⊤

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.isClosedImmersion_relativeMapSpaceHom_homPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085H (2) for the canonical relative Projs: `r_ψ` is a closed immersion.** If
`ψ_d : 𝒜₁,d ⟶ 𝒜₂,d` is surjective for `d ≫ 0`, the morphism `r_ψ : U(ψ) ⟶ Proj_X(𝒜₁)` of
Stacks 085F, whose source is all of `Proj_X(𝒜₂)` by `relativeMapSubfunctor_homPoints_eq_top`, is
a closed immersion of algebraic spaces. This is also Stacks 085J (2), whose hypotheses contain
these.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_relativeMapSpaceHom_homPoints
    (hsurj : ∀ᶠ d : ℕ in atTop, Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (ψ.app (d : ℤ)).val)) :
    IsClosedImmersion B S hS (homPoints h₁c h₁n h₁q h₁k h₂c h₂n h₂q h₂k ψ).relativeMapSpaceHom
declarations.comment: (2): r_ψ : Q ⟶ P is a closed immersion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjSituation.isIso_twistMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 085J (3): the maps `θ : r_ψ^*𝒪_P(n) ⟶ 𝒪_Q(n)` are isomorphisms** when `ψ_d` is
surjective for `d ≫ 0` and `𝒜₁` is generated by its degree-one part over its degree-zero part.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_twistMap
    (hsurj : ∀ᶠ d : ℕ in atTop, Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (ψ.app (d : ℤ)).val))

(3): the maps θ : r_ψ^*O_P(n) → O_Q(n) are isomorphisms (θ the glued map of 085F,
