This is the content of Constructions, Section 089R: the functor `G(k, n) : Sch → Sets` sending a
scheme `S` to the isomorphism classes of surjections `𝒪_S^n → 𝒬` with `𝒬` finite locally free of
rank `n - k`, acting on morphisms by pullback (`AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.functor`, 089S), is
represented by a scheme (089T).
declarations.statement:
public theorem functor_isRepresentable (k n : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hkn : k < n) :
    (functor.{u} k n).IsRepresentable
declarations.comment: the Grassmannian functor G(k, n) on schemes is representable by a scheme for 0 < k < n

The Grassmannian functor `G(k, n)` is representable by a scheme when `0 < k < n`.

This is the content of Constructions, Section 089R: the functor `G(k, n) : Sch → Sets` sending a
scheme `S` to the isomorphism classes of surjections `𝒪_S^n → 𝒬` with `𝒬` finite locally free of
rank `n - k`, acting on morphisms by pullback (`AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.functor`, 089S), is
represented by a scheme (089T).

public theorem functor_isRepresentable (k n : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hkn : k < n) :
    (functor.{u} k n).IsRepresentable

The Grassmannian `G(k, n)` over the integers: the scheme representing the functor of finite

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpaceModuli.grassmannianSuccIso
declarations.doc:
The Grassmannian `G(n, n + 1)` over the integers is isomorphic to projective `n`-space, by
the comparison of their representations of the functor of finite locally free rank-one quotients
of the free module of rank `n + 1`.
declarations.statement:
def grassmannianSuccIso (n : ℕ) :
    Grassmannian.scheme.{u} n (n + 1) ≅ projectiveSpaceAtUniverse.{u} n

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpaceModuli.homEquiv_comp_grassmannianSuccIso_hom
declarations.doc:
The isomorphism `G(n, n + 1) ≅ ℙⁿ_ℤ` matches the two representations: the rank-one quotient
classified by a morphism `f` to the Grassmannian is classified, after composing with the
isomorphism, by the same point of the Grassmannian functor read through projective space.
declarations.statement:
theorem homEquiv_comp_grassmannianSuccIso_hom (n : ℕ) {Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Z ⟶ Grassmannian.scheme.{u} n (n + 1)) :
    (projectiveSpaceRepresentableBy.{u} n).homEquiv (f ≫ (grassmannianSuccIso.{u} n).hom) =
      (Grassmannian.schemeRepresentableBy.{u} n (n + 1)).homEquiv f
declarations.comment: the isomorphism matches the two moduli descriptions

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.AffineComparison.cohomologyIsoPushforward
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 089W].** For an affine morphism of schemes `f : X ⟶ S` and a quasi-coherent
`𝒪_X`-module `F`, the cohomology of `F` on `X` is the cohomology of its direct image on `S`, in
every degree `i ≥ 0`, as modules over `Γ(S, ⊤)` after restriction of scalars along `f^♯`.

The higher direct images vanish ([Stacks, Tag 01XC]), so `F` is acyclic for `f_*`, and the
direct image of an injective module has acyclic sections ([Stacks, Tag 01EX] part (2)), so the
right derived functor of `Γ(S, ⊤) ∘ f_*` collapses onto `H^i(S, f_* −)`; the other factor is
`Γ(X, ⊤)` with its scalars restricted, by [Stacks, Tag 01EZ].
declarations.statement:
public def cohomologyIsoPushforward [AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineHom f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (n : ℕ) :
    (ModuleCat.restrictScalars f.appTop.hom).obj
        (((moduleGlobalSections X).rightDerived n).obj F) ≅
      ((moduleGlobalSections S).rightDerived n).obj
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F)

declarations.name: Stacks.AffineCohomologyPushforward.cohomologyPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 089W].** For an affine morphism of schemes `f : X ⟶ S`, cohomology of a
quasi-coherent module is canonically isomorphic to cohomology of its pushforward, *naturally in
the module*: this is an isomorphism of functors on the category of quasi-coherent
`𝒪_X`-modules, not a choice of isomorphism for each one.
declarations.statement:
def cohomologyPushforwardIso [IsAffineHom f] (i : ℕ) :
    ObjectProperty.ι (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent (R := X.ringCatSheaf)) ⋙
        Hfunctor X.ringCatSheaf ⊤ i ≅
      ObjectProperty.ι (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent (R := X.ringCatSheaf)) ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.pushforward f ⋙ Hfunctor S.ringCatSheaf ⊤ i
declarations.comment: the natural isomorphism

declarations.name: Stacks.AffineCohomologyResolution.cohomologyPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 089W].** For an affine morphism, cohomology of a quasi-coherent module
is canonically isomorphic to cohomology of its pushforward. The isomorphism is a
natural isomorphism on the category of quasi-coherent modules, rather than an
unrelated choice of an isomorphism for each module.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def cohomologyPushforwardIso [IsAffineHom f] (i : ℕ) :
    ObjectProperty.ι (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf) ⋙
          Hfunctor X.ringCatSheaf ⊤ i ≅
      ObjectProperty.ι (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf) ⋙
          Scheme.Modules.pushforward f ⋙ Hfunctor S.ringCatSheaf ⊤ i
declarations.comment: the natural isomorphism

declarations.name: Stacks.AffineCohomologyResolution.cohomologyPushforwardIso_hom_eq
declarations.doc:
The affine cohomology isomorphism is computed by any map from the pushforward
of an injective resolution to an injective resolution of the pushforward that
preserves the augmentation. Global sections of the pushed-forward complex are
definitionally global sections of the original complex.
declarations.statement:
public theorem cohomologyPushforwardIso_hom_eq [IsAffineHom f] (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] (i : ℕ)
    (I : InjectiveResolution (C := SheafOfModules X.ringCatSheaf) F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution (C := SheafOfModules S.ringCatSheaf)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F))
    (φ : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
      I.cocomplex ⟶ J.cocomplex)
    (hφ : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (I.ι.f 0) ≫ φ.f 0 = J.ι.f 0) :
    (cohomologyPushforwardIso f i).hom.app ⟨F, inferInstance⟩ =
      (I.isoRightDerivedObj (secF X.ringCatSheaf ⊤) i).hom ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (((secF S.ringCatSheaf ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map φ) i ≫
        (J.isoRightDerivedObj (secF S.ringCatSheaf ⊤) i).inv
declarations.comment: comparison of resolutions

declarations.name: Stacks.AffineCohomologyResolution.cohomologyPushforwardIso_zero_hom
declarations.doc:
In degree zero, the affine cohomology isomorphism agrees with the ordinary
identification of global sections through the canonical maps to zeroth right
derived functors.
declarations.statement:
public theorem cohomologyPushforwardIso_zero_hom [IsAffineHom f] :
    Functor.whiskerLeft
          (ObjectProperty.ι (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf))
          (secF X.ringCatSheaf ⊤).toRightDerivedZero ≫
        (cohomologyPushforwardIso f 0).hom =
      Functor.whiskerLeft
          (ObjectProperty.ι (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf))
          (sectionsPushforwardIso f).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft
          (ObjectProperty.ι (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf) ⋙
            Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)
          (secF S.ringCatSheaf ⊤).toRightDerivedZero
declarations.comment: degree-zero normalization

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.exists_iso_projectiveSpace_hyperplane
declarations.doc:
**A hyperplane in `ℙⁿ_k` is `ℙ^{n-1}_k`, and `𝒪(1)` pulls back to `𝒪(1)`.**

For a nonzero homogeneous form `l` of degree one on `ℙⁿ_k = Proj k[T₀, …, Tₙ]` with `n = m + 1`,
there is an isomorphism `φ : ℙ^{n-1}_k ⟶ H` onto the hyperplane `H = Z(l)` under which the
pullback of `𝒪(1)` along `φ` composed with the inclusion `i : H ⟶ ℙⁿ_k` is `𝒪(1)`.

The last clause says that `φ` composed with the inclusion is a morphism **over `Spec k`**: it
carries the structure morphism of `ℙⁿ_k` to that of `ℙ^{n-1}_k`, both written as
`AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.toSpecZero` followed by `Spec` of the inclusion of the constants. This is
`Stacks.ProjectiveCohomology.projModelToSpec` in the spelling of that file, unfolded here so that
no import of it is needed; it holds because `φ.hom` composed with the inclusion *is* `Proj` of the
graded surjection of `Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.exists_gradedHom_ker_span_degreeOne`, which is a
`k`-algebra map. Without it the identification of the hyperplane with `ℙ^{n-1}_k` says nothing
about `k`-vector-space dimensions of cohomology, so no Euler characteristic can be transported
across it.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_iso_projectiveSpace_hyperplane
    (l : MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (m + 2)) k 1)
    (hl : (l : MvPolynomial (Fin (m + 2)) k) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ φ : AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (m + 1)) k)
        ≅ (hyperplane l).subscheme,
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (φ.hom ≫ (hyperplane l).subschemeι)).obj
          (twistingSheafModule (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (m + 2)) k) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
        ≅ twistingSheafModule
            (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (m + 1)) k) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧
      φ.hom ≫ (hyperplane l).subschemeι ≫
          Proj.toSpecZero (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (m + 2)) k) ≫
            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k
              ↥(MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (m + 2)) k 0))) =
        Proj.toSpecZero (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (m + 1)) k) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k
            ↥(MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (m + 1)) k 0)))
declarations.comment: for the hyperplane presented by a nonzero degree-one form

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.exists_iso_projectiveSpace_hyperplaneOfSection
declarations.doc:
**A hyperplane in `ℙⁿ_k` is `ℙ^{n-1}_k`, and `𝒪(1)` pulls back to `𝒪(1)`.**

A hyperplane in `ℙⁿ_k = Proj k[T₀, …, Tₙ]`, with `n = m + 1`, is the zero scheme `H = Z(s)` of a
nonzero global section `s` of `𝒪(1)`. There is an isomorphism `φ : ℙ^{n-1}_k ⟶ H` under which the
pullback of `𝒪(1)` along `φ` composed with the inclusion `i : H ⟶ ℙⁿ_k` is `𝒪(1)`, and `φ`
composed with that inclusion is a morphism over `Spec k`.

Such an `s` is the section of a nonzero homogeneous form of degree one, by
`Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.exists_degreeSection_eq`, so this is
`Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.exists_iso_projectiveSpace_hyperplane` with the form produced from the
section.

The over-`Spec k` clause is carried because the consumers of this tag in the hyperplane
restriction data of [Stacks, Tag 08A7] need the identification to respect the base: without it
the pushforward along `H ⟶ ℙⁿ_k` cannot be compared with one over `Spec k`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_iso_projectiveSpace_hyperplaneOfSection
    (s : twistGlobalSections (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (m + 2)) k) 1)
    (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    ∃ φ : AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (m + 1)) k)
        ≅ (hyperplaneOfSection s).subscheme,
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (φ.hom ≫ (hyperplaneOfSection s).subschemeι)).obj
          (twistingSheafModule (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (m + 2)) k) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
        ≅ twistingSheafModule
            (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (m + 1)) k) ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧
        φ.hom ≫ (hyperplaneOfSection s).subschemeι ≫
            Proj.toSpecZero (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (m + 2)) k) ≫
              Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k
                ↥(MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (m + 2)) k 0))) =
          Proj.toSpecZero (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (m + 1)) k) ≫
            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k
              ↥(MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (m + 1)) k 0)))

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpaceHyperplaneSection.exists_homogeneousSection_nonvanishing
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be an infinite field and let `ℱ` be a coherent module on `ℙⁿ_k = Proj k[T₀, …, Tₙ]`.
Then some nonzero linear form `f` gives a nonzero global section `f / 1` of `𝒪(1)` whose
nonvanishing locus contains every associated point of `ℱ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_homogeneousSection_nonvanishing [Infinite k]
    (F : (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (polyGrading k n)).Modules) [F.IsCoherent] :
    ∃ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k) (hf : f ∈ polyGrading k n 1), f ≠ 0 ∧
      (homogeneousSection (polyGrading k n) f hf).eval (op ⊤) ≠ 0 ∧
      Stacks.Divisors.associatedPoints F ⊆
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.nonvanishingOpen
          (X := (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (polyGrading k n)).toRingedSpace)
          (twistingModule (polyGrading k n) 1)
          (homogeneousSection (polyGrading k n) f hf) :
            Set ↥(AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (polyGrading k n)))
declarations.comment: the choice of the hyperplane section — a nonzero `s` vanishing at no associated point of `ℱ`, which is the one step needing `k` infinite; not the exact sequence

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpaceHyperplaneSection.shortExact_hyperplaneUnit_of_nonvanishing
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme with `ℙⁿ_S` locally Noetherian, let `ℱ` be an `𝒪`-module on `ℙⁿ_S` with
`ℱ(-1)` and `ℱ(-1) ⊗ 𝒪(1)` quasi-coherent, and let `s` be a global section of `𝒪(1)` that does
not vanish near any associated point of `ℱ(-1)`. Writing `i : H ⟶ ℙⁿ_S` for the hyperplane cut
out by `s`, the sequence

`0 ⟶ ℱ(-1) ⟶ ℱ ⟶ i_* i^* ℱ ⟶ 0`

is short exact, the first arrow being multiplication by `s` and the second the restriction to
`H`.
declarations.statement:
theorem shortExact_hyperplaneUnit_of_nonvanishing (S : Scheme.{u})
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (projectiveSpaceOver n S)]
    (F : (projectiveSpaceOver n S).Modules) (s : (twistOver n S 1).sections)
    [(tensorModules (projectiveSpaceOver n S) F (twistOver n S (-1))).IsQuasicoherent]
    [(tensorModules (projectiveSpaceOver n S) F (twistOver n S (-1)) ⊗
        twistOver n S 1).IsQuasicoherent]
    (hW : ∀ x ∈ Stacks.Divisors.associatedPoints
        (tensorModules (projectiveSpaceOver n S) F (twistOver n S (-1))),
      ∃ W : (projectiveSpaceOver n S).Opens, x ∈ W ∧ ∀ y ∈ W,
        y ∈ Stacks.SheafOfModules.nonvanishingLocus
          (X := (projectiveSpaceOver n S).toRingedSpace) (twistOver n S 1) s) :
    ∃ h : twistSectionMulNegOne n S F s ≫ hyperplaneUnit n S F s = 0,
      (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mk (twistSectionMulNegOne n S F s)
        (hyperplaneUnit n S F s) h).ShortExact
declarations.comment: the short exact sequence for an arbitrary coherent module

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_section_shortExact_hyperplaneUnit
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08A0].** Let `k` be an infinite field and let `ℱ` be a coherent sheaf on
`ℙⁿ_k`. Then there is a nonzero global section `s` of `𝒪(1)` such that, with `i : H ⟶ ℙⁿ_k` the
hyperplane cut out by `s`, the sequence

`0 ⟶ ℱ(-1) ⟶ ℱ ⟶ i_* i^* ℱ ⟶ 0`

is short exact — the first arrow being multiplication by `s`
(`…ProjectiveSpaceSectionMultiplication.twistSectionMulNegOne`) and the second the restriction
to `H` (`…ProjectiveSpaceSectionMultiplication.hyperplaneUnit`).

The section is produced by `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_form_section_nonvanishing` applied to the
coherent module `ℱ(-1)`, which is the only step at which `k` has to be infinite, and the
sequence is `…ProjectiveSpaceHyperplaneSection.shortExact_hyperplaneUnit_of_nonvanishing`; the
quasi-coherence that the latter asks of `ℱ(-1)` and of `ℱ(-1) ⊗ 𝒪(1)` holds for every coherent
`ℱ`, by [Stacks, Tag 0GQM].
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_section_shortExact_hyperplaneUnit (k : Type u) [Field k] [Infinite k] (n : ℕ)
    (F : (projectiveSpaceOverRing n (CommRingCat.of k)).Modules) [F.IsCoherent] :
    ∃ s : (twistOver n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) 1).sections,
      PresheafOfModules.sections.eval s (op ⊤) ≠ 0 ∧
      ∃ w : twistSectionMulNegOne n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) F s ≫
          hyperplaneUnit n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) F s = 0,
        (ShortComplex.mk (twistSectionMulNegOne n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) F s)
          (hyperplaneUnit n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) F s) w).ShortExact

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpaceSectionFiniteFamily.exists_section_forall_shortExact_coherent
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08A1].** Let `k` be an infinite field, let `n ≥ 1` and let `ℱ_i` be a finite
family of coherent `𝒪`-modules on `ℙⁿ_k`. Then a single nonzero global section `s` of `𝒪(1)`
serves all of them: with `i : H ⟶ ℙⁿ_k` the hyperplane cut out by `s`, the sequence

`0 ⟶ ℱ_i(-1) ⟶ ℱ_i ⟶ i_* i^* ℱ_i ⟶ 0`

of [Stacks, Tag 08A0] is short exact for every member of the family, the first arrow being
multiplication by `s` and the second the restriction to `H`.

This is the source's argument: [Stacks, Tag 08A0]
(`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_section_shortExact_hyperplaneUnit`) is applied to the coherent module
`⨁ ℱ_i`, and the resulting conditions descend to each summand by
`sectionWorksFor_of_retract`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_section_forall_shortExact_coherent {k : Type u} [Field k] [Infinite k]
    (_hn : 1 ≤ n) {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (F : ι → (projectiveSpaceOver n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))).Modules)
    (hF : ∀ i, (F i).IsCoherent) :
    ∃ s : (twistOver n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) 1).sections,
      PresheafOfModules.sections.eval s (op ⊤) ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i : ι,
      ∃ hz : twistSectionMulNegOne n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (F i) s ≫
          hyperplaneUnit n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (F i) s = 0,
        (ShortComplex.mk (twistSectionMulNegOne n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (F i) s)
          (hyperplaneUnit n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (F i) s) hz).ShortExact
declarations.comment: one section of O(1) works for a whole finite family of coherent modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsMRegular
declarations.doc:
A coherent sheaf on projective `n`-space over `k` is `m`-regular if its
cohomology in degree `i` vanishes after the twist by `m - i`, for `1 ≤ i ≤ n`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable abbrev IsMRegular (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ)
    (F : (projectiveSpaceOverRing n (.of k)).Modules) [F.IsCoherent] (m : ℤ) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isMRegular_iff_fieldExtension
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08A4].** Let `k ⊆ K` be an extension of fields and let `ℱ` be a coherent sheaf
on `ℙⁿ_k`. Then `ℱ` is `m`-regular if and only if its pullback to `ℙⁿ_K` is `m`-regular.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isMRegular_iff_fieldExtension (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (n : ℕ) (F : (projectiveSpaceOverRing n (.of k)).Modules) [F.IsCoherent] (m : ℤ) :
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian (projectiveSpaceOverRing n (.of K)) :=
      projectiveSpaceOver_isLocallyNoetherian n (Spec (.of K))
    letI : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (projectiveSpaceFieldExtensionMap k K n)).obj F).IsCoherent :=
      isCoherent_pullback (projectiveSpaceFieldExtensionMap k K n) F
    IsMRegular k n F m ↔
      IsMRegular K n
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projectiveSpaceFieldExtensionMap k K n)).obj F) m

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isMRegular_hyperplaneRestriction_of_nonvanishing
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08A5].** Let `k` be a field, `n ≥ 1`, `ℱ` a coherent sheaf on `ℙⁿ_k`, and let
`s` be a **nonzero** global section of `𝒪(1)` vanishing at no associated point of `ℱ` — the
hyperplane section of [Stacks, Tag 08A0], which over an infinite field always exists
(`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_hyperplane_isMRegular_pullback`). Write `i : H ⟶ ℙⁿ_k` for its
hyperplane and `𝒢 = i^*ℱ`. Then

* the sequence `0 ⟶ ℱ(-1) ⟶ ℱ ⟶ i_*𝒢 ⟶ 0` of Tag 08A0 is short exact, its arrows being
  multiplication by `s` and restriction to `H`;
* `H ≅ ℙ^{n-1}_k` as in [Stacks, Tag 089Z]: there is an identification `φ : ℙ^{n-1}_k ≅ H`, over
  `Spec k`, along which `𝒪(1)` restricts to `𝒪(1)`;
* and, for **every** such identification `φ` (one along which `𝒪(1)` restricts to `𝒪(1)`) and
  every `m`, if `ℱ` is `m`-regular then `𝒢` is `m`-regular on `H ≅ ℙ^{n-1}_k`, that is
  `φ^*𝒢 = (φ ≫ i)^*ℱ` is `m`-regular on `ℙ^{n-1}_k`.

The identification of Tag 089Z is not unique — it depends on a choice of coordinates on the
hyperplane — so the regularity is asserted for all of them rather than for one. The field need
not be infinite once `s` is given: that hypothesis of Tag 08A0 is used only to choose `s`.

The sequence is `…ProjectiveSpaceHyperplaneSection.shortExact_hyperplaneUnit_of_nonvanishing`;
the identification is `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_iso_zeroScheme_projectiveSpaceOverRing` applied
to the degree-one form presenting
`s` (`Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.exists_degreeSection_eq`); the regularity is
`AlgebraicGeometry.isMRegular_pullback_hyperplaneι_of_nonvanishing`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isMRegular_hyperplaneRestriction_of_nonvanishing (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ)
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (F : (projectiveSpaceOverRing n (CommRingCat.of k)).Modules) [F.IsCoherent]
    (s : (twistOver n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) 1).sections)
    (hs0 : PresheafOfModules.sections.eval s (op ⊤) ≠ 0)
    (hs : Stacks.Divisors.associatedPoints F ⊆
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.nonvanishingLocus (twistOver n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) 1) s) :
    (∃ w : twistSectionMulNegOne n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) F s ≫
          hyperplaneUnit n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) F s = 0,
        (ShortComplex.mk (twistSectionMulNegOne n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) F s)
          (hyperplaneUnit n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) F s) w).ShortExact) ∧
      (∃ φ : projectiveSpaceOverRing (n - 1) (CommRingCat.of k) ≅
          (hyperplane n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) s).subscheme,
        Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
            (φ.hom ≫ hyperplaneι n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) s)).obj
              (twistOver n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) 1) ≅
            twistOver (n - 1) (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) 1) ∧
          φ.hom ≫ hyperplaneι n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) s ≫
              (projectiveSpaceOverRing n (CommRingCat.of k) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) =
            projectiveSpaceOverRing (n - 1) (CommRingCat.of k) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ∧
      ∀ φ : projectiveSpaceOverRing (n - 1) (CommRingCat.of k) ≅
          (hyperplane n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) s).subscheme,
        Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
            (φ.hom ≫ hyperplaneι n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) s)).obj
              (twistOver n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) 1) ≅
            twistOver (n - 1) (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) 1) →
        ∀ m : ℤ, IsMRegular k n F m →
          haveI := projectiveSpaceOver_isLocallyNoetherian (n - 1) (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
          haveI := isCoherent_pullback (φ.hom ≫ hyperplaneι n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) s) F
          IsMRegular k (n - 1)
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
              (φ.hom ≫ hyperplaneι n (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) s)).obj F) m
declarations.comment: in the situation of Tag 08A0, for every nonzero section s of O(1) avoiding the associated points of F: the sequence of Tag 08A0 is short exact, H(s) ≅ P^{n-1}_k as in Tag 089Z, and along every such identification the restriction of an m-regular F is m-regular

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isMRegular_add_one
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08A6].** Let `k` be a field, let `n ≥ 0` and let `ℱ` be a coherent sheaf on
`ℙⁿ_k`. If `ℱ` is `m`-regular then `ℱ` is `(m + 1)`-regular.

The argument is an induction on `n`, vacuous for `n = 0`. Passing to `k(t)`, which is infinite,
changes nothing by [Stacks, Tag 08A4]; there a hyperplane `j : ℙ^{n-1} ⟶ ℙⁿ` is available, the
restriction `𝒢` of `ℱ` to it is `m`-regular by [Stacks, Tag 08A5] and hence `(m+1)`-regular by
induction, and the segment
`H^i(ℙⁿ, ℱ(m-i)) ⟶ H^i(ℙⁿ, ℱ(m+1-i)) ⟶ H^i(ℙ^{n-1}, 𝒢(m+1-i))` of the long exact sequence has
both ends zero — the right one by `(m+1)`-regularity of `𝒢` for `i ≤ n-1`, and by vanishing
above the dimension for `i = n`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isMRegular_add_one
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ)
    (F : (projectiveSpaceOverRing n (.of k)).Modules) [F.IsCoherent] (m : ℤ)
    (hF : IsMRegular k n F m) :
    IsMRegular k n F (m + 1)
declarations.comment: an m-regular coherent sheaf on projective space is (m+1)-regular

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.span_mulSections_eq_top_of_isMRegular
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08A7].** Let `k` be a field, `n ≥ 0` and `ℱ` a coherent sheaf on `ℙⁿ_k`. If
`ℱ` is `m`-regular then the multiplication map

`H⁰(ℙⁿ_k, ℱ(m)) ⊗_k H⁰(ℙⁿ_k, 𝒪(1)) ⟶ H⁰(ℙⁿ_k, ℱ(m+1))`

is surjective — equivalently, the `k`-span of the products is everything.

The proof is the source's induction on `n`. For `n = 0` multiplication by a generator of the
trivial sheaf `𝒪(1)` is already an isomorphism. For the step, the inductive hypothesis writes the
restriction of a class `t ∈ H⁰(ℱ(m+1))` to the hyperplane as a combination of products
`σ · g`; each `g` lifts to `ℙ^{n+1}_k` because `m`-regularity makes `H¹(ℱ(m-1))` vanish, each `σ`
lifts by [Stacks, Tag 089Z], and subtracting the lifted combination leaves a class restricting to
zero, which by exactness of the restriction sequence is `s` times a class in `H⁰(ℱ(m))`.
declarations.statement:
theorem span_mulSections_eq_top_of_isMRegular (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (pkg : ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : (projectiveSpaceOverRing (n + 1) (.of k)).Modules),
      F.IsCoherent → Nonempty (HyperplaneRestrictionPackage k n F)) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : (projectiveSpaceOverRing n (.of k)).Modules) (hFc : F.IsCoherent) (m : ℤ),
      @IsMRegular k _ n F hFc m → mulSectionsSpan k n F m = ⊤
declarations.comment: for an arbitrary field, with the hyperplane restriction data of Tags 08A0, 0EGK and 089Z carried in `HyperplaneRestrictionPackage`; the induction on `n`, the base case and the use of `m`-regularity to lift a section off the hyperplane are proved. Over an infinite field every clause of that package but `liftSection` is proved too -- see `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_hyperplaneRestrictionData`. Surjectivity out of the tensor product is stated as the `k`-span of the products being `⊤`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.span_mulSections_eq_top_of_isMRegular_field
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08A7] over an arbitrary field.** Let `k` be a field, `n ≥ 0`, and let `ℱ` be a
coherent sheaf on `ℙⁿ_k` which is `m`-regular. Then the `k`-span of the products of global
sections of `ℱ(m)` with global sections of `𝒪(1)` is all of `H⁰(ℙⁿ_k, ℱ(m+1))`, i.e. the
multiplication map out of `H⁰(ℱ(m)) ⊗_k H⁰(𝒪(1))` is surjective.

`AlgebraicGeometry.span_mulSections_eq_top_of_isMRegular` proves this from the hyperplane
restriction data of [Stacks, Tag 08A7], which
`AlgebraicGeometry.nonempty_hyperplaneRestrictionPackage` supplies over an infinite field;
`AlgebraicGeometry.span_mulSections_eq_top_of_isMRegular_of_infinite` is the source's reduction to
that case.

Surjectivity of a `k`-bilinear multiplication out of a tensor product is the same statement as the
span of the products being everything — the image of the induced linear map on
`H⁰(ℱ(m)) ⊗_k H⁰(𝒪(1))` is generated by the images of the pure tensors — so the conclusion below
is the source's, not a weakening of it. The field is arbitrary, as in the source: `[Infinite k]`
appears only inside the proof.
declarations.statement:
theorem span_mulSections_eq_top_of_isMRegular_field (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ)
    (F : (projectiveSpaceOverRing n (.of k)).Modules) [F.IsCoherent] (m : ℤ)
    (hF : IsMRegular k n F m) :
    mulSectionsSpan k n F m = ⊤

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isGeneratedByGlobalSections_projectiveTwist_of_isMRegular_field
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be a field, let `n ≥ 0`, and let `ℱ` be a coherent sheaf on `ℙⁿ_k`. If `ℱ` is
`m`-regular then `ℱ(m)` is globally generated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGeneratedByGlobalSections_projectiveTwist_of_isMRegular_field (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (n : ℕ) (F : (projectiveSpaceOverRing n (.of k)).Modules) [F.IsCoherent] (m : ℤ)
    (hF : IsMRegular k n F m) :
    SheafOfModules.IsGeneratedByGlobalSections (projectiveTwist n F m)
declarations.comment: an m-regular coherent sheaf on projective space over a field is globally generated after the twist by m. Everything the source's proof uses is proved: that `ℱ(d)` is globally generated for all `d ≫ 0` is `Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.exists_isGeneratedByGlobalSections_projectiveTwist_of_isCoherent`, clause (7) of Tag 01Q3 read through the comparison of `projectiveTwist` with the tensor powers of the hyperplane sheaf; the surjectivity of the multiplication map on global sections is Tag 08A7 over an arbitrary field, `AlgebraicGeometry.span_mulSections_eq_top_of_isMRegular_field`; and the regularity at each twist the descent passes through is Tag 08A6, `AlgebraicGeometry.isMRegular_add_one`. The descent is organized as a sequence of single-twist steps rather than the source's one-shot use of degree-`d-m` forms, each step using the degree-one multiplication of Tag 08A7. Globally generated is `SheafOfModules.IsGeneratedByGlobalSections`, Stacks 03DE (3).

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.eulerCharacteristic_add_of_shortExact
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08AA].** For a short exact sequence `0 ⟶ ℱ₁ ⟶ ℱ₂ ⟶ ℱ₃ ⟶ 0` of coherent
modules on a scheme proper over a field, `χ(X, ℱ₂) = χ(X, ℱ₁) + χ(X, ℱ₃)`.

The finiteness input [Stacks, Tag 02O6], which
`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Variety/EulerChar/CoherentFiniteness.lean` carried as an explicit
hypothesis `hfin : CohomologyFiniteDimensionalOverField`, is supplied here by
`AlgebraicGeometry.finiteDimensional_cohomologyOverField_of_isProper`; the vanishing input
[Stacks, Tag 01XJ] is discharged inside
`AlgebraicGeometry.eulerCharacteristic_add_of_shortExact_of_finiteDimensional'`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem eulerCharacteristic_add_of_shortExact (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f] {S : ShortComplex X.Modules} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [S.X₁.IsCoherent] [S.X₂.IsCoherent] [S.X₃.IsCoherent] :
    eulerCharacteristic k f S.X₂ =
      eulerCharacteristic k f S.X₁ + eulerCharacteristic k f S.X₃

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.eulerCharacteristic_baseChange_field
declarations.doc:
**The Euler characteristic is unchanged by extension of the ground field.** Let `k'/k` be an
extension of fields, let `X` be a proper scheme over `k`, let `ℱ` be a coherent `𝒪_X`-module and
let `ℱ'` be the pullback of `ℱ` to a base change `X'` of `X` to `k'`. Then
`χ(X, ℱ) = χ(X', ℱ')`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem eulerCharacteristic_baseChange_field
    (h : IsPullback g' f' f (specMapAlgebraMap k k')) [IsProper f] (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsCoherent] :
    eulerCharacteristic k f F =
      @eulerCharacteristic k' _ X' f' (isProper_of_isPullback_specMapAlgebraMap k k' g' f' f h)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F)
        (isCoherent_pullback_of_isPullback_specMapAlgebraMap k k' g' f' f h F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_polynomial_eval_eq_hilbertPolynomial
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08AC].** Let `k` be a field, let `n ≥ 0` and let `ℱ` be a coherent sheaf on
`ℙⁿ_k`. Then the function `d ↦ χ(ℙⁿ_k, ℱ(d))` is a polynomial: there is a `P ∈ ℚ[X]` with
`χ(ℙⁿ_k, ℱ(d)) = P(d)` for **every** `d ∈ ℤ`. **No hypothesis.**

The `n`-th backward difference of the Hilbert polynomial is constant
(`AlgebraicGeometry.isDifferenceBounded_hilbertPolynomial`, the source's induction on `n`), and a
function on `ℤ` with a constant iterated backward difference is a polynomial at every integer
(`exists_polynomial_of_isDifferenceBounded`, the every-integer form of [Stacks, Tag 00JZ] the
source's proof ends with).

The weaker eventual reading of "is a polynomial", [Stacks, Tag 00JX]'s `IsNumericalPolynomial`,
is `AlgebraicGeometry.isNumericalPolynomial_hilbertPolynomial'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_polynomial_eval_eq_hilbertPolynomial (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ)
    (F : (projectiveSpaceOverRing n (.of k)).Modules) [F.IsCoherent] :
    ∃ P : Polynomial ℚ, ∀ d : ℤ, (hilbertPolynomial k n F d : ℚ) = P.eval (d : ℚ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hilbertPolynomial
declarations.doc:
The Hilbert polynomial, viewed as an integer-valued function of the twist
degree, of a coherent sheaf on projective space over a field.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def hilbertPolynomial (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ)
    (F : (projectiveSpaceOverRing n (.of k)).Modules) [F.IsCoherent] : ℤ → ℤ

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.exists_eval_eq_finrank_cohomologyOverField_zero
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08AE].** Let `k` be a field, let `n ≥ 0`, let `ℱ` be a coherent sheaf on
`ℙⁿ_k = Proj k[T₀, …, Tₙ]` and let `P ∈ ℚ[t]` be its Hilbert polynomial, that is, a polynomial
agreeing at every integer `d` with the Euler characteristic `χ(ℙⁿ_k, ℱ(d))` of the `d`-th twist.
Then

`P(d) = dim_k H⁰(ℙⁿ_k, ℱ(d))`

for all `d` large enough.

The proof is the source's one sentence: the higher cohomology of a high enough twist vanishes
([Stacks, Tag 01YS] clause (4),
`Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.SerreVanishing.exists_isZero_Hgroup_twist_of_isCoherent`), so the
alternating sum defining the Euler characteristic collapses to its degree-zero term. The
hypothesis `hP` is the definition of the Hilbert polynomial, [Stacks, Tag 08AD]; see the module
docstring for why it is written out here rather than cited as
`AlgebraicGeometry.hilbertPolynomial`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_eval_eq_finrank_cohomologyOverField_zero (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ)
    (F : (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (polyGrading k n)).Modules)
    (hF : _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F) (P : Polynomial ℚ)
    (hP : ∀ d : ℤ, P.eval (d : ℚ) = (((∑ᶠ i : ℕ, (-1 : ℤ) ^ i *
      (Module.finrank k (cohomologyOverField k (projModelToSpec k n)
        (twistSheafOfModules (polyGrading k n) F d) i) : ℤ) : ℤ)) : ℚ)) :
    ∃ d₀ : ℤ, ∀ d : ℤ, d₀ ≤ d →
      P.eval (d : ℚ) = (Module.finrank k (cohomologyOverField k (projModelToSpec k n)
        (twistSheafOfModules (polyGrading k n) F d) 0) : ℚ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isMRegular_kernel_free_of_hilbertPolynomial
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08AG].** Let `n ≥ 0`, `r ≥ 1` and `P ∈ ℚ[t]`. There is a single integer `m`
such that for **every** field `k`, every coherent sheaf `𝒬` on `ℙⁿ_k` with Hilbert polynomial `P`
and every epimorphism `q : 𝒪^{⊕r} ⟶ 𝒬`, the kernel of `q` is `m`-regular.

The quantifier order is the statement: `m` is produced from `n`, `r` and `P` alone, before the
field and before the sequence.

Over an infinite field this is
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isMRegular_kernel_free_of_hilbertPolynomial_of_infinite`, the source's
induction on the dimension. An arbitrary field is reduced to that case by base change to the
rational function field `k(t)`, which is infinite (`AlgebraicGeometry.infinite_ratFunc`):
`ℙⁿ_{k(t)} ⟶ ℙⁿ_k` is flat, so the kernel sequence base-changes to the kernel sequence of a
surjection of `𝒪^{⊕r}` onto the base change of `𝒬`; the Hilbert polynomial is unchanged
([Stacks, Tag 08AB], `AlgebraicGeometry.hilbertPolynomial_pullback_fieldExtension`); and
`m`-regularity descends along the extension by [Stacks, Tag 08A4],
`AlgebraicGeometry.isMRegular_iff_fieldExtension`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isMRegular_kernel_free_of_hilbertPolynomial (n r : ℕ)
    (P : Polynomial ℚ) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k]
      (Q : (projectiveSpaceOverRing n (.of k)).Modules) [Q.IsCoherent]
      (q : freeModules k n r ⟶ Q) [Epi q],
      (∀ d : ℤ, (hilbertPolynomial k n Q d : ℚ) = P.eval (d : ℚ)) →
      @IsMRegular k _ n (kernel q) (CoherentAbelian.isCoherent_kernel q) m
declarations.comment: with the free sheaf of the source, the short exact sequence read as an epimorphism from it, and the Hilbert polynomial of Tag 08AD compared with a rational polynomial at every integer

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AH.** The étale local ring of an algebraic space at a geometric point is a
local ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (x : GeometricPoint B S hS F) :
    IsLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS F x)
declarations.comment: local ring

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isNoetherianRing_etaleLocalRing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AH.** The étale local ring of a Noetherian algebraic space at a geometric point
is a Noetherian ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNoetherianRing_etaleLocalRing (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u}))
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    (hNoetherian : IsNoetherian B S hS hZ F) (x : GeometricPoint B S hS F) :
    IsNoetherianRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS F x)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEquivalence_affineQuasicoherentDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AI, first assertion.**  Let `f : Y ⟶ X` be an affine morphism of algebraic spaces
over `S` and `𝒜 = f_*𝒪_Y`.  The functor `ℱ ↦ f_*ℱ` from quasi-coherent `𝒪_Y`-modules to
quasi-coherent `𝒜`-modules is an equivalence of categories.

The functor is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.affineQuasicoherentDirectImage`, which is the direct image
of Stacks 03D1 on the nose (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.affineQuasicoherentDirectImage_comp_ι`); its
quasi-inverse is `𝒢 ↦ 𝒪_Y ⊗_{f⁻¹𝒜} f⁻¹𝒢`.  The second assertion of the tag is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasicoherentOnSite_restrictScalars_structureSharp_iff`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_affineQuasicoherentDirectImage (hf : IsAffineHom B S hS f.hom) :
    (affineQuasicoherentDirectImage B S hS f hf).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: the functor F ↦ f_*F from quasi-coherent 𝒪_Y-modules to quasi-coherent f_*𝒪_Y-modules is an equivalence of categories, for an affine morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasicoherentOnSite_restrictScalars_structureSharp_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AI, second assertion.**  Let `f : Y ⟶ X` be an affine morphism of algebraic spaces
over `S` and let `𝒜 = f_*𝒪_Y`.  An `𝒜`-module is quasi-coherent as an `𝒪_X`-module — that is,
after restriction of scalars along the structure map `f♯ : 𝒪_X ⟶ 𝒜` of Stacks 03G8 — if and only
if it is quasi-coherent as an `𝒜`-module.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasicoherentOnSite_restrictScalars_iff` at `A = f_*𝒪_Y`,
whose quasi-coherence as an `𝒪_X`-module is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasicoherentOnSite_restrictScalars_structureRingSheafDirectImage`,
the first assertion of Stacks 07U8 at the structure sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherentOnSite_restrictScalars_structureSharp_iff (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsAffineHom B S hS f.hom)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureRingSheafDirectImage B S hS f)) :
    ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u} (structureSharp B S hS f)).obj
        M).IsQuasicoherentOnSite ↔ M.IsQuasicoherentOnSite
declarations.comment: an 𝒜-module is quasi-coherent as an 𝒪_X-module if and only if it is quasi-coherent as an 𝒜-module

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasicoherentDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AI, the functor.** Direct image as a functor `QCoh(𝒪_Y) ⥤ QCoh(A)`, granted
that it preserves quasi-coherence. This is the functor `F ↦ f_*F` whose invertibility is the
first sentence of the tag.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def quasicoherentDirectImage (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hqc : DirectImagePreservesQuasicoherence B S hS f) :
    QuasicoherentSheaves.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2 ⥤
      (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite (affineDirectImageAlgebra B S hS f)).FullSubcategory
declarations.comment: the functor F ↦ f_*F on quasi-coherent modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallyClosed_of_isSurjective_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AJ, universally closed image.** Let `X ⟶ Y ⟶ T` be morphisms of algebraic
spaces over `S`. If `X` is universally closed over `T` and `X ⟶ Y` is surjective, then `Y` is
universally closed over `T`.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyClosed_of_isSurjective_comp
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hT : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS T) (f : X ⟶ Y) (q : Y ⟶ T)
    (hfq : UniversallyClosed B S hS (f ≫ q)) (hf : IsSurjective B S hS f) :
    UniversallyClosed B S hS q
declarations.comment: universally closed image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProper_of_isSurjective_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AJ, properness of the image.** Let `X ⟶ Y ⟶ T` be morphisms of algebraic
spaces over `S`. If `X` is universally closed over `T`, the morphism `X ⟶ Y` is surjective and
`Y` is separated and of finite type over `T`, then `Y` is proper over `T`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_of_isSurjective_comp
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hT : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS T) (f : X ⟶ Y) (q : Y ⟶ T)
    (hfq : UniversallyClosed B S hS (f ≫ q)) (hf : IsSurjective B S hS f)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS q) (hft : IsFiniteType B S hS q) :
    IsProper B S hS q
declarations.comment: properness of the image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallyClosed_of_isSurjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AJ, first assertion.** Let `p : X ⟶ Z` and `q : Y ⟶ Z` be morphisms of
algebraic spaces over `S` and let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism over `Z`. If `p` is universally
closed and `f` is surjective, then `q` is universally closed.

A base change `T ×_Z Y ⟶ T` of `q` is, after the pasting isomorphism
`(T ×_Z Y) ×_Y X ≅ T ×_Z X`, preceded by the base change of `f`, which is surjective on
points by Stacks 03MH; the composite is the base change `T ×_Z X ⟶ T` of `p`, closed by
hypothesis.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyClosed_of_isSurjective {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (_hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (_hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (_hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : X ⟶ Z) (q : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hcomm : f ≫ q = p) (hf : IsSurjective B S hS f)
    (hp : UniversallyClosed B S hS p) :
    UniversallyClosed B S hS q
declarations.comment: first assertion: universal closedness

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProper_of_isSurjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AJ, second assertion.** In the situation of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallyClosed_of_isSurjective`, if moreover `q` is separated and
of finite type, then `q` is proper.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_of_isSurjective {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : X ⟶ Z) (q : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hcomm : f ≫ q = p) (hf : IsSurjective B S hS f)
    (hp : UniversallyClosed B S hS p)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS q) (hft : IsFiniteType B S hS q) :
    IsProper B S hS q
declarations.comment: second assertion: properness

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universalHomeomorphism_ι_reducedClosedSubspace_univ
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AK.** The canonical morphism from the reduction of an algebraic space over `S` —
the reduced closed subspace supported on all of its points — to the space itself is a universal
homeomorphism.

The four clauses are independent of one another: continuity is clause (2) of Stacks 03BX,
injectivity is Stacks 06RV applied to the base change of a subfunctor inclusion, surjectivity is
Stacks 03H4 together with the computation of the point set of the reduction, and openness is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallyOpen_ι_reducedClosedSubspace_univ`. None of them needs the
inclusion to be representable, so no effective descent hypothesis appears.
declarations.statement:
theorem universalHomeomorphism_ι_reducedClosedSubspace_univ (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    UniversalHomeomorphism B S hS
      (reducedClosedSubspace B S hS X hX Set.univ isClosed_univ).ι

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinite_fieldMorphism_of_moduleFinite_residueField
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AL, the finite case.** Let `X` be a decent algebraic space over a scheme `S` and
let `p` be a field-valued point of `X` with field of definition `k`, so a commutative diagram
`Spec k ⟶ X ⟶ S`. If the image point `s` of `Spec k ⟶ S` is a closed point of `S` and `k` is
finite over the residue field `κ(s)`, then `Spec k ⟶ X` is a finite morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinite_fieldMorphism_of_moduleFinite_residueField (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hdec : IsDecentSpace B S hS X) (p : FieldValuedPoint B S hS X)
    (hs : IsClosed ({(S.SpecToEquivOfField p.carrier p.toBase).1} : Set S))
    (hfin : letI := (S.SpecToEquivOfField p.carrier p.toBase).2.hom.toAlgebra
      Module.Finite (S.residueField (S.SpecToEquivOfField p.carrier p.toBase).1) p.carrier) :
    IsFinite B S hS (fieldMorphism B S hS X p)
declarations.comment: finite morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isClosedImmersion_fieldMorphism_of_isIso_residueField
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AL, the closed-immersion case.** Let `X` be a decent algebraic space over a
scheme `S` and let `p` be a field-valued point of `X` with field of definition `k`, so a
commutative diagram `Spec k ⟶ X ⟶ S`. If the image point `s` of `Spec k ⟶ S` is a closed point
of `S` and the residue field embedding `κ(s) ⟶ k` is an isomorphism, then `Spec k ⟶ X` is a
closed immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_fieldMorphism_of_isIso_residueField (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hdec : IsDecentSpace B S hS X) (p : FieldValuedPoint B S hS X)
    (hs : IsClosed ({(S.SpecToEquivOfField p.carrier p.toBase).1} : Set S))
    (hrat : IsIso (S.SpecToEquivOfField p.carrier p.toBase).2) :
    IsClosedImmersion B S hS (fieldMorphism B S hS X p)
declarations.comment: closed immersion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pushforwardCoherentEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AM.**  Let `S` be a scheme, let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed immersion of locally
Noetherian algebraic spaces over `S` and let `ℐ ⊆ 𝒪_X` be the quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals
cutting out `Z`.  The functor `i_*` induces an equivalence between the category of coherent
`𝒪_Z`-modules and the category of coherent `𝒪_X`-modules annihilated by `ℐ`.

The equivalence comes paired with the natural isomorphism identifying its functor, composed with
the inclusion of the full subcategory, with `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.modulePushforward` — so what
is asserted is that **`i_*` itself** is an equivalence onto the coherent annihilated modules, and
not merely that the two categories are equivalent.  The pairing is the shape in which the
scheme-level Stacks 087T is stated at
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.Tag087TCoherentImage.coherentPushforwardEquivalence`.

The functor is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pushforwardCoherent`, its full faithfulness is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fullyFaithfulPushforwardCoherent` — part (2) of Stacks 04CJ, the
`67.14.1` of the source's proof — and its essential surjectivity is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.essSurj_pushforwardCoherent`, which rests on coherence of the inverse
image together with the essential-image clause of Stacks 08KS for algebraic spaces.  That the
functor lands in the *coherent* annihilated modules is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCoherent_modulePushforward_of_isClosedImmersion`.
declarations.statement:
def pushforwardCoherentEquivalence
    (hX : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X.1 (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (hZ : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Z.1 (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (hi : IsClosedImmersion B S hS i.hom) :
    Σ e : CoherentModules.{u, u} B S hS Z.1 Z.2 ≌
        (coherentAnnihilatedByKerIdeal B S hS i).FullSubcategory,
      e.functor ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (coherentAnnihilatedByKerIdeal B S hS i) ≅
        ObjectProperty.ι _ ⋙ modulePushforward B S hS i

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.coherentModulePushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AM**, the induced functor, with the target weakened: direct image as a functor
`Coh(𝒪_X) ⥤ {𝓕 ∈ Mod(𝒪_Y) | 𝓘𝓕 = 0}` from the coherent modules of Stacks 07UA.

The source states the target as the *coherent* `𝒪_Y`-modules annihilated by `𝓘`, which would need
coherence of `f_*` of a coherent module; see the implementation notes.
declarations.comment: the induced functor into the modules annihilated by the ideal

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fullyFaithfulCoherentModulePushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AM**, the full-faithfulness half of the equivalence: direct image along a closed
immersion of algebraic spaces is fully faithful on coherent modules.

Essential surjectivity is not proved; see the implementation notes for the one input it is
missing and for the coherence of `f_*` that its target needs.
declarations.comment: full faithfulness of the direct image on coherent modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.property_of_isCoherent_of_integralWitness
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08AN**, corrected as recorded in the errata.  Let `X` be a Noetherian
algebraic space over a scheme `S` and let `P` be a property of coherent `𝒪_X`-modules such that

1. for a short exact sequence of coherent modules, if two out of three terms have `P` then so
   does the third;
2. if `P` holds for the direct sum of `r ≥ 1` copies of a coherent module then it holds for that
   module;
3. for every reduced closed subspace `Z ⊆ X` with `|Z|` irreducible there is a coherent module
   on `X` whose scheme-theoretic support is `Z` and which has `P`.

Then `P` holds for every coherent module on `X`, provided `|X|` is nonempty or `P` holds on zero
modules (`h0`).

The alternative `h0` is the correction: the source's statement fails on an algebraic space with
no points (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.not_forall_false_of_isEmpty_points`), and on such a space the
zero module is the one coherent module, so `P` on zero modules is exactly what is missing there.
On a space with a point `h0` holds by its first alternative and the statement is the source's.
No result of another tag is carried: Stacks 07UR, the coherence of `i_*I` and Stacks 07UQ are
theorems of the library, used through
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.property_of_integralWitness_and_twoOutOfThree_of_isNoetherian`, and on a
space with a point `P` on zero modules follows from (1) and (3) by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.forall_isZero_property_of_nonempty`.
declarations.statement:
theorem property_of_isCoherent_of_integralWitness (hZtop : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u}))
    (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (hX : IsNoetherian B S hS hZtop X.1)
    (P : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2 → Prop)
    (h0 : Nonempty (points B S hS X.1) ∨ ∀ M : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2, IsZero M → P M)
    (h1 : TwoOutOfThreeCoherent B S hS X P) (h2 : ClosedUnderCoherentDirectSumDescent B S hS X P)
    (h3 : HasCoherentWitnessOnIntegralSubspaces B S hS X P)
    (M : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hM : IsCoherent B S hS X.1 X.2 M) : P M
declarations.comment: corrected: |X| is also required to be nonempty, or P to hold on zero modules; without this the statement fails on an algebraic space with no points, for the property False

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ProjectiveSpaceImmersion.twist
declarations.doc:
**The twist `L = i^* O_{P^n_Y}(1)` of Stacks 08AQ**: the inverse image of the hyperplane
sheaf of `P^n_S` along `X ⟶ P^n_Y ⟶ P^n_S`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def twist (D : ProjectiveSpaceImmersion B S hS n hP X Y) :
    Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2
declarations.comment: the twist L = i^* O_{P^n_Y}(1) of the statement

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_twistBound_isZero_rightDerived_modulePushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AQ.** Let `i : X ⟶ P^n_Y` be a closed immersion of algebraic spaces over `S` with
`Y` Noetherian, let `f : X ⟶ Y` be the composite with the projection and let
`L = i^* O_{P^n_Y}(1)`. For a coherent `𝒪_X`-module `F` there is a `d₀` such that

`R^p f_*(F ⊗ L^{⊗ d}) = 0` for all `d ≥ d₀` and all `p > 0`.

The proof is the source's: over one surjective étale chart of `Y` with Noetherian affine scheme,
the restriction of `F ⊗ L^{⊗ d}` is a coherent module twisted by an ample invertible module on a
scheme proper over that affine scheme, and Serre's vanishing theorem (Stacks 02O1) applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_twistBound_isZero_rightDerived_modulePushforward
    (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u})) (n : ℕ)
    (hP : B.Contains (projectiveSpaceOver n S)) {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (D : ProjectiveSpaceImmersion B S hS n hP X Y)
    (hY : IsNoetherian B S hS hZ Y.1) (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hF : IsCoherent B S hS X.1 X.2 F) :
    have := hasInjectiveResolutions_modules B S hS X.1 X.2
    ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p →
      IsZero (((modulePushforward B S hS D.hom).rightDerived p).obj
        (F ⊗ tensorPow B S hS D.twist d))
declarations.comment: the complete statement, for Y Noetherian and F coherent

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCoherent_rightDerived_modulePushforward_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AR.**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` with `Y`
locally Noetherian, and let `𝓕` be a coherent `𝒪_X`-module.  Then `R^i f_*𝓕` is a coherent
`𝒪_Y`-module for every `i ≥ 0`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCoherent_higherDirectImage_of_isProper`: `R^i f_*𝓕` is
quasi-coherent by Stacks 0720, so by Stacks 07UB it suffices that its sections over every affine
étale chart `V` of `Y` are finite; by Stacks 03LX and the degeneration of the Leray spectral
sequence over the affine `V` they are the cohomology of `𝓕` restricted to the proper base change
`X_V ⟶ V`, which is finite by the dévissage of Stacks 08AN with the witness from Chow's
lemma, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasFiniteCohomologyOver_of_isProper`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherent_rightDerived_modulePushforward_of_isProper (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (hY : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y.1 (fun V : Scheme.{u} ↦ IsLocallyNoetherian V))
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hF : IsCoherent B S hS X.1 X.2 F) (i : ℕ) :
    have := hasInjectiveResolutions_modules B S hS X.1 X.2
    IsCoherent B S hS Y.1 Y.2 (((modulePushforward B S hS f).rightDerived i).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCoherent_higherDirectImage_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AR.**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` with `Y`
locally Noetherian, and let `𝓕` be a coherent `𝒪_X`-module.  Then `R^i f_*𝓕` is a coherent
`𝒪_Y`-module for every `i`.

`R^i f_*𝓕` is quasi-coherent by Stacks 0720, so by Stacks 07UB it suffices that its sections over
every affine étale chart `V` of `Y` are finite over `𝒪_Y(V)`.  Those sections are the sections
over the identity chart of the restriction of `R^i f_*𝓕` to `V`, which is
`R^i f'_*(𝓕|_U)` for the base change `f' : U = V ×_Y X ⟶ V` by Stacks 03LX; over the affine
scheme `V` this is `R^i Γ(V, f'_* −)(𝓕|_U)`, the higher direct images of `f'` being
quasi-coherent and hence acyclic over the affine `V` (Stacks 0720 and 03DW, degenerating the
Leray spectral sequence).  The base change `f'` is proper (Stacks 0EPD) and `𝓕|_U` is coherent,
so `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasFiniteCohomologyOver_of_isProper` applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherent_higherDirectImage_of_isProper {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (hY : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y.1 (fun V : Scheme.{u} ↦ IsLocallyNoetherian V))
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hF : IsCoherent B S hS X.1 X.2 F) (i : ℕ) :
    have := hasInjectiveResolutions_modules B S hS X.1 X.2
    IsCoherent B S hS Y.1 Y.2 (((modulePushforward B S hS f).rightDerived i).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.moduleFinite_cohomologyOverBase_of_isProper_of_isCoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AS.**  Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, `f : X ⟶ Spec A` a proper morphism of
algebraic spaces and `F` a coherent `𝒪_X`-module.  Then `Hⁱ(X, F)` is a finite `A`-module for
every `i ≥ 0`.

Here `Hⁱ(X, F)` is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cohomologyOverBase`, at any module universe
`max (u + 1) w`.  `F` is the universe lift of a coherent module at the universe `u` of the
structure rings, where the finiteness is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.moduleFinite_cohomology_of_isProper` (the affine case of Stacks 08AR),
and the cohomology over the base of a lift is the lift of the cohomology.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleFinite_cohomologyOverBase_of_isProper_of_isCoherent
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hA : B.Contains (Spec (.of A)))
    [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (X : (BigFppfOver B (Spec (.of A)) hA)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of A)) hA X)
    (f : X ⟶ yoneda.obj (baseObject A B hA)) (hf : IsProper B (Spec (.of A)) hA f)
    (F : Modules.{u, max (u + 1) w} B (Spec (.of A)) hA X hX)
    [IsCoherent B (Spec (.of A)) hA X hX F] (i : ℕ) :
    Module.Finite A (cohomologyOverBase.{u, w} A B hA X hX F i)
declarations.comment: H^i(X, F) as cohomologyOverBase, at every module universe max (u + 1) w

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.moduleFinite_cohomology_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AS.**  Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, `f : X ⟶ Spec A` a proper morphism of
algebraic spaces and `F` a coherent `𝒪_X`-module.  Then `Hⁱ(X, F)` is a finite `A`-module for
every `i ≥ 0`.

The right derived functors of `Γ(Spec A, f_* −)` are finite over the functions on `Spec A` at
a coherent module (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasFiniteCohomologyOver_of_isProper`, the core of
Stacks 08AR), and `Γ(Spec A, f_* −)` is `Γ(X, −)` as a functor to `A`-modules
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.globalSectionsOverBaseIso`); restriction of scalars and the universe
lift are exact, so they pass through the right derived functors.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleFinite_cohomology_of_isProper [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (X : (BigFppfOver B (Spec (.of A)) hA)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of A)) hA X)
    (f : X ⟶ yoneda.obj (baseObject A B hA)) (hf : IsProper B (Spec (.of A)) hA f)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of A)) hA X hX) [IsCoherent B (Spec (.of A)) hA X hX F]
    (i : ℕ) :
    Module.Finite A ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (baseRingHom A B hA X hX)).obj
      (((globalSectionsFunctor.{u + 1, u, u, u}
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
          (smallEtaleRingedSite B (Spec (.of A)) hA X hX).O)).rightDerived
          i).obj F))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.moduleFinite_cohomology_of_isProper_of_algebra
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AT.**  Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, `R` a finitely generated `A`-algebra and
`f : X ⟶ Spec A` a proper morphism of algebraic spaces.  Let `F` be a quasi-coherent
`𝒪_X`-module which is a module over `f^* R̃` of finite type: an action `ρ : R →+* End F`
restricting on `A` to multiplication by the scalars, such that over every affine étale chart `U`
of `X` the sections `F(U)` are generated over `𝒪(U)` by the `ρ(R)`-translates of finitely many
sections.
Then `Hⁱ(X, F)` is a finite `R`-module for every `i`.

The source states this for a graded `R` and a graded module; the grading is not used, and the
graded module `Hⁱ(X, F)` of the source is the cohomology of the total module `F` here.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleFinite_cohomology_of_isProper_of_algebra [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {X : AlgebraicSpaces B (Spec (.of A)) hA} (f : X ⟶ schemeSpace (baseObject A B hA))
    (hf : IsProper B (Spec (.of A)) hA f.hom) (F : Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of A)) hA X.1 X.2)
    (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) (ρ : R →+* End F)
    (hρ : ∀ a, (ρ (algebraMap A R a)).asHom = globalSmul _ (baseRingHom A B hA X.1 X.2 a) F)
    (hfin : ∀ U : SmallEtale B (Spec (.of A)) hA X.1,
      IsAffine ((SmallEtale.toOver B (Spec (.of A)) hA X.1 ⋙
        BigFppfOver.toScheme B (Spec (.of A)) hA).obj U) →
      ∃ g : Finset (F.val.obj (op U)), Submodule.span (chartRing B (Spec (.of A)) hA X.1 X.2 U)
        {x | ∃ r, ∃ y ∈ g, x = (ρ r).asHom.val.app (op U) y} = ⊤)
    (i : ℕ) :
    letI := (spaceCohomology B (Spec (.of A)) hA X i).endActionModule ρ
    Module.Finite R ((spaceCohomology B (Spec (.of A)) hA X i).obj F)
declarations.comment: ungraded, which is more general: the grading is never used by the proof

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalFunctionsSituation.idealPowerMultiple
declarations.doc:
**The submodule `Iⁿℱ` of Situation 08AV** (Section 08AU): the submodule of `ℱ` generated by
the products of local sections of `ℱ` and elements of `Iⁿ`, the image of multiplication by the
global functions coming from `Iⁿ`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev idealPowerMultiple (n : ℕ) :
    Modules.{u, max (u + 1) w} S.site (Spec (.of S.ring)) S.containsBase S.space.1 S.space.2
declarations.comment: the submodule Iⁿℱ of ℱ generated as an 𝒪_X-module by products of local sections of ℱ and elements of Iⁿ, in Situation 08AV

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalFunctionsSituation.isQuasicoherentOnSite_idealPowerSubmodule
declarations.doc:
**`Iⁿℱ` is quasi-coherent** (Section 08AU): it is the image of a morphism from a direct sum
of copies of the coherent, hence quasi-coherent, module `ℱ` to `ℱ`; a direct sum of
quasi-coherent modules is quasi-coherent (Stacks 03M1 (1)) and so is the image of a morphism of
quasi-coherent modules (Stacks 03M1 (3)).
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherentOnSite_idealPowerSubmodule (n : ℕ) :
    (idealPowerSubmodule S n).IsQuasicoherentOnSite
declarations.comment: Iⁿℱ is a quasi-coherent submodule of ℱ, in Situation 08AV

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalFunctionsSituation.imageSubobject_idealPowerTensorMap
declarations.doc:
**`Iⁿℱ` is the image of `f^*Ĩⁿ ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ ⟶ ℱ`** (Section 08AU), in Situation 08AV: as
subobjects of `ℱ`, the image of the map `f^*Ĩⁿ ⊗ ℱ ⟶ 𝒪_X ⊗ ℱ ≅ ℱ` is the submodule `Iⁿℱ`
generated by the products of local sections of `ℱ` and elements of `Iⁿ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem imageSubobject_idealPowerTensorMap (n : ℕ) :
    imageSubobject (idealPowerTensorMap S n) = Subobject.mk (idealPowerSubmoduleι S n)
declarations.comment: Iⁿℱ is the image of f^*Ĩⁿ ⊗ ℱ → ℱ, in Situation 08AV; the source writes f^*Ĩ for the ideal Iⁿ of the submodule Iⁿℱ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalFunctionsSituation.idealPowerSubmodule_spec
declarations.doc:
**Section 08AU**, in Situation 08AV: the submodule `Iⁿℱ` of `ℱ` generated by the products of
local sections of `ℱ` and elements of `Iⁿ` is quasi-coherent, and it is the image of the map
`f^*Ĩⁿ ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ ⟶ ℱ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem idealPowerSubmodule_spec (n : ℕ) :
    (idealPowerSubmodule S n).IsQuasicoherentOnSite ∧
      imageSubobject (idealPowerTensorMap S n) = Subobject.mk (idealPowerSubmoduleι S n)
declarations.comment: Iⁿℱ is a quasi-coherent submodule of ℱ and is the image of f^*Ĩⁿ ⊗ ℱ → ℱ, in Situation 08AV

declarations.doc:

`Spec A`, and a coherent module on that space.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isReesFinite_cohomologyIdealPowerSystem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AW.**  In Situation 08AV — `A` Noetherian, `I ⊆ A` an ideal, `f : X ⟶ Spec A`
proper and `F` a coherent `𝒪_X`-module — for every `p` the graded module `⨁ₙ Hᵖ(X, Iⁿ F)` is a
finite module over the Rees algebra `B = ⨁ₙ Iⁿ`.

The graded module structure is that of the Rees system `cohomologyIdealPowerSystem`: an element
`a ∈ Iᵏ` acts as the cohomology of multiplication by `a`, from `Iⁿ F` to `Iᵏ⁺ⁿ F`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isReesFinite_cohomologyIdealPowerSystem [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (f : X ⟶ schemeSpace (baseObject A B hA)) (hf : IsProper B (Spec (.of A)) hA f.hom)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of A)) hA X.1 X.2) [hF : IsCoherent B (Spec (.of A)) hA X.1 X.2 F]
    (I : Ideal A) (p : ℕ) :
    (cohomologyIdealPowerSystem (baseRingHom A B hA X.1 X.2) F I p).IsReesFinite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_surjective_cohomologyIdealPowerMul_and_range_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AX.**  In Situation 08AV — `A` Noetherian, `I ⊆ A` an ideal, `f : X ⟶ Spec A`
proper and `F` a coherent `𝒪_X`-module — for every `p` there is an integer `c ≥ 0` such that

1. the multiplication map `Iⁿ⁻ᶜ ⊗ Hᵖ(X, Iᶜ F) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, Iⁿ F)` is surjective for all `n ≥ c`,
   here written for `n = m + c`;
2. the image of `Hᵖ(X, Iⁿ⁺ᵐ F) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, Iⁿ F)` is contained in `Iᵐ⁻ᶜ Hᵖ(X, Iⁿ F)` for all
   `n ≥ 0` and `m ≥ c`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_surjective_cohomologyIdealPowerMul_and_range_le [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (f : X ⟶ schemeSpace (baseObject A B hA)) (hf : IsProper B (Spec (.of A)) hA f.hom)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of A)) hA X.1 X.2) [IsCoherent B (Spec (.of A)) hA X.1 X.2 F]
    (I : Ideal A) (p : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : ℕ, (∀ m : ℕ, Function.Surjective (TensorProduct.lift
        (cohomologyIdealPowerMul (baseRingHom A B hA X.1 X.2) F I p m c le_rfl))) ∧
      ∀ n m : ℕ, c ≤ m →
        LinearMap.range (cohomologyIdealPowerTr (baseRingHom A B hA X.1 X.2) F I p
          (Nat.le_add_right n m)) ≤
          I ^ (m - c) • (⊤ : Submodule A
            (cohomologyIdealPower (baseRingHom A B hA X.1 X.2) F I p n))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_ker_cohomologyIdealQuotientProj_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AY, clause (1).**  In Situation 08AV, for every `p` there is a `c₁ ≥ 0` such that
`ker (Hᵖ(X, F) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, F / Iⁿ F)) ⊆ Iⁿ⁻ᶜ¹ Hᵖ(X, F)` for all `n ≥ c₁`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_ker_cohomologyIdealQuotientProj_le [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (f : X ⟶ schemeSpace (baseObject A B hA)) (hf : IsProper B (Spec (.of A)) hA f.hom)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of A)) hA X.1 X.2) [IsCoherent B (Spec (.of A)) hA X.1 X.2 F]
    (I : Ideal A) (p : ℕ) :
    ∃ c₁ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, c₁ ≤ n →
      LinearMap.ker (C1573.cohomologyIdealQuotientProj (baseRingHom A B hA X.1 X.2) F I p n) ≤
        I ^ (n - c₁) • (⊤ : Submodule A (cohomologyRes (baseRingHom A B hA X.1 X.2) p F))
declarations.comment: clause (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_range_cohomologyIdealQuotientTr_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AY, clause (3).**  In Situation 08AV, for every `p` and every `n` there is a
`c₂(n) ≥ n` such that `im (Hᵖ(X, F / Iᵏ F) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, F / Iⁿ F)) = im (Hᵖ(X, F) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, F / Iⁿ F))`
for all `k ≥ c₂(n)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_range_cohomologyIdealQuotientTr_eq [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (f : X ⟶ schemeSpace (baseObject A B hA)) (hf : IsProper B (Spec (.of A)) hA f.hom)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of A)) hA X.1 X.2) [hF : IsCoherent B (Spec (.of A)) hA X.1 X.2 F]
    (I : Ideal A) (p n : ℕ) :
    ∃ c₂ : ℕ, n ≤ c₂ ∧ ∀ (k : ℕ) (h : n ≤ k), c₂ ≤ k →
      LinearMap.range (C1573.cohomologyIdealQuotientTr (baseRingHom A B hA X.1 X.2) F I p h) =
        LinearMap.range (C1573.cohomologyIdealQuotientProj (baseRingHom A B hA X.1 X.2) F I p n)
declarations.comment: clause (3)

declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08AZ, the isomorphism.**  In Situation 08AV, for every `p` the maps
`Hᵖ(X, F) / Iⁿ Hᵖ(X, F) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, F / Iⁿ F)` define an isomorphism
`Hᵖ(X, F)^∧ ⟶ lim_n Hᵖ(X, F / Iⁿ F)` from the `I`-adic completion; that it is defined by those
maps is `formalFunctionsEquiv_apply`.
declarations.comment: the isomorphism of limits

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formalFunctionsEquiv_apply

`Hᵖ(X, F) / Iⁿ Hᵖ(X, F) ⟶ Hᵖ(X, F / Iⁿ F)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem formalFunctionsEquiv_apply

      C1573.adicQuotientMap _
        (C1573.cohomologyIdealQuotientProj (baseRingHom A B hA X.1 X.2) F I p) I
