declarations.statement: theorem of_isCompact [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (S : X.Opens) (hS : IsCompact (S : Set X)) : P S
declarations.comment: induction on quasi-compact opens

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CompactOpenInduction.top
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08DR], the conclusion at `X` itself.** For a quasi-compact quasi-separated
scheme, `P ⊤` holds.
declarations.statement: theorem top [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [CompactSpace X] : P ⊤
declarations.comment: induction on quasi-compact opens

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.InductionPrinciple.induction_isCompact_open
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08DR], the Induction Principle.** Let `X` be a quasi-separated scheme and
let `P` be a property of the opens of `X` which holds for every affine open and which, given a
quasi-compact open `U` and an affine open `V`, passes from `U`, `V` and `U ⊓ V` to `U ⊔ V`.
Then `P` holds for every quasi-compact open of `X`.

The source assumes in addition that `X` is quasi-compact; that hypothesis is not used for the
conclusion about an arbitrary quasi-compact open, and `induction_top` records the clause of the
source that does use it.
declarations.statement:
theorem induction_isCompact_open [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (W : X.Opens)
    (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X)) : P W

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.InductionPrinciple.induction_top
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08DR], the clause "and in particular for `X`".** On a quasi-compact
quasi-separated scheme the induction principle applies to the whole space.
declarations.statement: theorem induction_top [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] : P ⊤
declarations.comment: in particular for X

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProperSupportCoherent.isCoherent_higherDirectImage_of_properSupp
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be locally Noetherian, let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of finite type and let `F` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module of finite type whose support is proper over `S`. Then the higher
direct image `R ᵖ f_* F` is a coherent `𝒪_S`-module in every degree.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherent_higherDirectImage_of_properSupp
    (hF : IsProperOver f ⟨SheafOfModules.supp F, SheafOfModules.isClosed_supp F⟩) (p : ℤ) :
    (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerivedPlus p).obj F).IsCoherent

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasCoproducts_quasicoherentDerivedCategory
declarations.doc: The derived category of `𝒪_X`-modules with quasi-coherent cohomology has direct sums.
declarations.statement:
instance hasCoproducts_quasicoherentDerivedCategory (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    HasCoproducts.{u} (QuasicoherentDerivedCategory X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.kFlat_tilde
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08DV.** If `K` is a K-flat complex of `A`-modules, then `K̃` is a
K-flat complex of `𝒪_{Spec A}`-modules.

By the stalk criterion for K-flatness (Stacks 06YB) it suffices that the stalk complex of `K̃`
at every point `x` be K-flat over the stalk ring. That stalk complex is the extension of
scalars of `K` along `A → 𝒪_{Spec A, x}` (`tildeStalkComplexIso`), and extension of scalars
preserves K-flatness (Stacks 06Y1).
declarations.statement:
theorem kFlat_tilde (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (hK : CochainComplex.KFlat.{u, u} K) :
    Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsKFlat (specCommRingSheaf A) (tildeComplexMod K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineSchemePullbackComparison
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08DW] part (2) for a morphism of arbitrary affine schemes.** Let `g : Y ⟶ X` be
a morphism of affine schemes, given by the ring map `g.appTop : Γ(X, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(Y, ⊤)`. Then the
square

  `D(Γ(X, ⊤)) ⟶ D(𝒪_X)`, `D(Γ(Y, ⊤)) ⟶ D(𝒪_Y)`, `- ⊗ᴸ Γ(Y, ⊤)` on the left and `Lg^*` on the
  right,

commutes: `Lg^*` of the complex of sheaves associated to an object of `D(Γ(X, ⊤))` is the complex
of sheaves associated to its derived extension of scalars.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.affinePullbackComparison` conjugated by the two canonical isomorphisms
`X ≅ Spec Γ(X, ⊤)` and `Y ≅ Spec Γ(Y, ⊤)`, the composition formula
`Stacks.Duality.derivedPullbackCompIso` crossing the resulting two triangles.
declarations.comment: part (2) for a morphism of arbitrary affine schemes

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPullback'
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08DW] part (1): `Lf^*` sends `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` into `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`.** For an
arbitrary morphism of schemes `f : X ⟶ Y` and a complex `K` of `𝒪_Y`-modules all of whose
cohomology sheaves are quasi-coherent, every cohomology sheaf of `Lf^*K` is quasi-coherent.

This is `Stacks.Duality.isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPullback`, with `hess` found by instance
search from `AlgebraicGeometry.derivedTilde_isEquivalence`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPullback' {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) (i : ℤ) :
    ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules i).obj
      ((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj)).IsQuasicoherent
declarations.comment: part (1): derived pullback preserves quasi-coherence of cohomology

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.quasiCoherentDerivedPullback'
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08DW] part (1), as a functor.** Derived pullback along a morphism of schemes
restricts to a functor `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` between the derived categories of complexes
with quasi-coherent cohomology.

This is `Stacks.Duality.quasiCoherentDerivedPullback` at
`Stacks.Duality.isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPullback'`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y ⥤ quasiCoherentDerivedCategory X
declarations.comment: part (1): the restriction D_QCoh(𝒪_Y) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_X) of derived pullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPullback_anyModel
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08DW] part (1) at an arbitrary model of the two derived categories: `Lf^*`
sends `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` into `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`.** For an arbitrary morphism of schemes `f : X ⟶ Y` and
an object `E` of `D(𝒪_Y)` all of whose cohomology sheaves are quasi-coherent, every cohomology
sheaf of `Lf^*E` is quasi-coherent.

The model of the two derived categories is a free `[HasDerivedCategory.{w}]` binder, so this
serves the locally small model of `Stacks.Duality.isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPullback'` and
`CategoryTheory.HasDerivedCategory.standard` alike. By [Stacks, Tag 06YF] the object `E` is the
class of a K-flat complex `P`, at that model `Lf^*E` is the class of `f^*P` by
`Stacks.Cohomology.derivedPullbackIsoPullbackOfKFlat`, and the cohomology sheaves of `f^*P` are
quasi-coherent by `isQuasicoherent_homology_modulePullback_of_kFlat`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPullback_anyModel {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₂} (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y.toRingedSpace)))
    (hE : ∀ j : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y.toRingedSpace)) j).obj E).IsQuasicoherent) (i : ℤ) :
    ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace))
        i).obj
      ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        f.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E)).IsQuasicoherent
declarations.comment: part (1) at an arbitrary model of the two derived categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineTensorComplexIso
declarations.doc:
**The totalised affine tensor comparison.** For complexes `M^•` and `K^•` of `R`-modules, the
complex of `𝒪_{Spec R}`-modules associated to the total tensor complex `Tot(M^• ⊗_R K^•)` is
canonically the total tensor complex `Tot(M̃^• ⊗_{𝒪_{Spec R}} K̃^•)` of the associated complexes.

The isomorphism is returned together with the formula for its value on the summand of total
degree `n` indexed by `(i, j)`: there it is the degreewise comparison
`AlgebraicGeometry.tildeTensorIso` of [Stacks, Tag 01I8] at `M^i` and `K^j`. That formula
determines the isomorphism, since the source of total degree `n` is the direct sum of those
summands, so it is carried in the type rather than stated separately.
declarations.statement:
public def affineTensorComplexIso (R : CommRingCat.{u})
    (M K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) :
    { e : tildeComplexMod (A := R) (M ⊗ K) ≅
        ((tensorComplex.{u, u, u} (specCommRingSheaf R)).obj (tildeComplexMod (A := R) M)).obj
          (tildeComplexMod (A := R) K) //
      ∀ (i j n : ℤ) (h : i + j = n),
        (tilde.functor R).map (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor M K
            (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} R)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) i j n h) ≫ e.hom.f n =
          (tildeTensorIso R (M.X i) (K.X j)).hom ≫
            HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor (tildeComplexMod (A := R) M)
              (tildeComplexMod (A := R) K)
              (sheafTensor.{u, u, u, u, u} (specCommRingSheaf R)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) i j n h }
declarations.comment: part (2): the totalised ordinary comparison

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineDerivedTensorIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08DX, part (2).** On the spectrum of a commutative ring `R`, the
derived tensor product of two associated complexes of sheaves of modules is the complex
associated to their derived tensor product over `R`:

`M̃^• ⊗_{𝒪_{Spec R}}^{L} K̃^•  ≅  (M^• ⊗_R^{L} K^•)~`.

Both arguments are replaced by K-flat representatives, where the two derived tensor products are
computed by ordinary total tensor complexes and the comparison is the totalised ordinary
comparison `affineTensorComplexIso` of [Stacks, Tag 01I8]; the representatives are supplied by
the definite choices of `kFlatRep`.
declarations.statement:
public def affineDerivedTensorIso (R : CommRingCat.{u})
    (M K : CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.DObj (R : Type u)) :
    (((Stacks.Cohomology.TorAmplitude.derTensor.{u, u} (Spec R).toRingedSpace).tensor.obj
          ((tildeDS R).obj M)).obj ((tildeDS R).obj K)) ≅
      (tildeDS R).obj
        (((CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.canonicalDerivedTensorProduct
          (R : Type u)).tensor.obj M).obj K)
declarations.comment: part (2): the affine comparison

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineDerivedTensorIsoStandard
declarations.doc:
On the spectrum of a commutative ring `R`, the derived tensor product of the complexes of
sheaves of modules associated to `M` and `K` is the complex associated to their derived tensor
product over `R`, at the standard model:

`M̃^• ⊗^L_{𝒪_{Spec R}} K̃^•  ≅  (M^• ⊗^L_R K^•)~`.
declarations.statement:
def affineDerivedTensorIsoStandard (M K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)) :
    ((derivedTensorAsSiteDatum (Spec R).sheaf).tensor.obj
          ((Stacks.Duality.derivedTildeStructureSheafModules R).obj M)).obj
        ((Stacks.Duality.derivedTildeStructureSheafModules R).obj K) ≅
      (Stacks.Duality.derivedTildeStructureSheafModules R).obj
        (((canonicalDerivedTensorProduct (R : Type u)).tensor.obj M).obj K)
declarations.comment: part (2): the affine comparison, at the standard model

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedTensor
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08DX] part (1): `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` is closed under the derived tensor product.**
Let `X` be a scheme and let `K` and `L` be complexes of `𝒪_X`-modules all of whose cohomology
sheaves are quasi-coherent. Then every cohomology sheaf of `K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} L` is quasi-coherent.

This is `isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedTensor_of_tensorTilde` with its hypothesis discharged by
`exists_iso_derivedTilde_derivedTensor`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedTensor (X : Scheme.{u})
    (K L : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory X) (i : ℤ) :
    ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules i).obj
      (((derivedTensor X).obj K.obj).obj L.obj)).IsQuasicoherent
declarations.comment: part (1): D_QCoh is closed under derived tensor product

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.quasiCoherentDerivedTensor
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08DX] part (1), as structure: the derived tensor product restricts to
`D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`.** This is
`quasiCoherentDerivedTensor_of_tensorTilde` with its hypothesis discharged by
`exists_iso_derivedTilde_derivedTensor`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev quasiCoherentDerivedTensor (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    quasiCoherentDerivedCategory X ⥤ quasiCoherentDerivedCategory X ⥤
      quasiCoherentDerivedCategory X
declarations.comment: part (1): the restriction D_QCoh ⥤ D_QCoh ⥤ D_QCoh of the derived tensor product

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedTensor_anyModel
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08DX] part (1) at an arbitrary model of `D(𝒪_X)`: `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` is closed
under the derived tensor product.**  For a scheme `X` and objects `E`, `A` of `D(𝒪_X)` all of
whose cohomology sheaves are quasi-coherent, every cohomology sheaf of `E ⊗^𝐋_{𝒪_X} A` is
quasi-coherent.

The model of the derived category is a free `[HasDerivedCategory.{w}]` binder, so this serves the
locally small model of `Stacks.Duality.isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedTensor` and
`CategoryTheory.HasDerivedCategory.standard` alike.  `A` is the class of a K-flat complex `P` by
[Stacks, Tag 06YS], `E` is the class of some complex `C`, the K-flat comparison of
[Stacks, Tag 06YU] identifies `E ⊗^𝐋_{𝒪_X} A` with the class of `Tot(C ⊗_{𝒪_X} P)`, and the
cohomology of that complex is quasi-coherent by `isQuasicoherent_homology_tensorComplex`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedTensor_anyModel (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (Modules X.toRingedSpace.sheaf)]
    (E A : DerivedCategory (Modules X.toRingedSpace.sheaf))
    (hE : ∀ j : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (Modules X.toRingedSpace.sheaf) j).obj E).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hA : ∀ j : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (Modules X.toRingedSpace.sheaf) j).obj A).IsQuasicoherent) (i : ℤ) :
    ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules X.toRingedSpace.sheaf) i).obj
      (((derivedTensorProductFunctor X.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj E).obj A)).IsQuasicoherent
declarations.comment: part (1) at an arbitrary model of the derived category

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.isQuasicoherent_homology_specDerivedTensor
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08DX] part (1) on an affine scheme, at the standard model.** If every
cohomology sheaf of `A` and of `B` is quasi-coherent, then so is every cohomology sheaf of
`A ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_{Spec R}} B`.

This is `Stacks.Duality.isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedTensor_spec`, whose only locally
small-pinned input was essential surjectivity of derived sheafification, [Stacks, Tag 06Z0];
that is available at the standard model as
`AlgebraicGeometry.StandardModel.exists_iso_mapDerivedCategory`, so the argument runs verbatim.
`A` and `B` are derived sheafifications of complexes of `R`-modules,
`exists_iso_derivedTilde_derivedTensor_standard` makes their derived tensor product one as well,
and the cohomology sheaves of a derived sheafification are quasi-coherent by construction.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isQuasicoherent_homology_specDerivedTensor (R : CommRingCat.{u})
    (A B : DerivedCategory (Spec R).Modules)
    (hA : ∀ n : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Spec R).Modules n).obj A).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hB : ∀ n : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Spec R).Modules n).obj B).IsQuasicoherent)
    (i : ℤ) :
    ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Spec R).Modules i).obj
      (((specDerivedTensor R).obj A).obj B)).IsQuasicoherent
declarations.comment: part (1) on an affine scheme, at the standard model of the derived category

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.DerivedPushforward.preservesColimitsOfShape_discrete_qcqsQuasiCoherentDerivedPushforward_locallySmall
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08DZ].** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a quasi-separated and quasi-compact morphism of
schemes. Then `Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_S)` commutes with direct sums: for every index type
`α` of the scheme universe it preserves `α`-indexed direct sums.

The index types are those of the scheme universe because those are the ones for which
`D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` has direct sums at all ([Stacks, Tag 08DT],
`Stacks.Duality.DerivedPushforward.hasCoproducts_quasiCoherentDerivedCategory`).

This is the tag at the locally small model of the derived categories, where that universe of index
types is also the morphism universe; the companion registration
`preservesColimitsOfShape_discrete_qcqsQuasiCoherentDerivedPushforward`
is the tag at `CategoryTheory.HasDerivedCategory.standard`, where the two universes differ.
declarations.statement:
theorem preservesColimitsOfShape_discrete_qcqsQuasiCoherentDerivedPushforward_locallySmall
    (α : Type u) :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete α)
      (qcqsQuasiCoherentDerivedPushforwardLocallySmall f)
declarations.comment: locally_small_model

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.DerivedPushforward.preservesColimitsOfShape_discrete_qcqsQuasiCoherentDerivedPushforward
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08DZ].** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a quasi-separated and quasi-compact morphism of
schemes. Then `Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_S)` commutes with direct sums: for every index type
`α` of the scheme universe it preserves `α`-indexed direct sums.

The index types are those of the scheme universe because those are the ones for which
`D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` has direct sums at all ([Stacks, Tag 08DT],
`AlgebraicGeometry.hasCoproducts_quasicoherentDerivedCategory`).
declarations.statement:
theorem preservesColimitsOfShape_discrete_qcqsQuasiCoherentDerivedPushforward (α : Type u) :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete α) (qcqsQuasiCoherentDerivedPushforward f)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.DerivedPushforward.preservesColimitsOfShape_discrete_qcqsRestrictedDerivedPushforward
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08DZ] at the locally small model, for the canonical restricted functor.** Let
`f : X ⟶ Y` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes with `Y` quasi-compact.
Then `Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` commutes with direct sums indexed by any type of the
scheme universe — which at this model is also the morphism universe of the category, so this is
the hypothesis [Stacks, Tag 0A8G] asks for.

`DerivedPushforward.preservesColimitsOfShape_discrete_qcqsQuasiCoherentDerivedPushforward` is
the same statement at `CategoryTheory.HasDerivedCategory.standard`, where `HasCoproducts` of the
morphism universe is false and the statement therefore cannot be fed to Brown representability.
declarations.statement:
instance preservesColimitsOfShape_discrete_qcqsRestrictedDerivedPushforward (α : Type u) :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete α) (qcqsRestrictedDerivedPushforward f)
declarations.comment: at the locally small model, which is the one Brown representability runs at

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.coherentDerivedComparison_mem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08E1.** The derived inclusion of coherent modules has coherent
cohomology in every degree.
declarations.statement:
theorem coherentDerivedComparison_mem
    {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) RingCat.{u}) :
    let P : ObjectProperty (_root_.SheafOfModules.{u} R) := fun M => IsCoherent M
    letI : Preadditive P.FullSubcategory := Abelian.toPreadditive
    letI : Preadditive (_root_.SheafOfModules.{u} R) := Abelian.toPreadditive
    let I : P.FullSubcategory ⥤ _root_.SheafOfModules.{u} R := P.ι
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits I :=
      ObjectProperty.preservesFiniteLimits_ι_of_isWeakSerreClass P
    letI : PreservesFiniteColimits I :=
      ObjectProperty.preservesFiniteColimits_ι_of_isWeakSerreClass P
    letI : I.Additive := I.additive_of_preserves_binary_products
    ∀ K : DerivedCategory (CoherentModules R),
      (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB P) (I.mapDerivedCategory.obj K)
declarations.comment: well-definedness

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.coherentDerivedComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08E1.** The canonical functor from the derived category of coherent
modules to the subcategory of the derived category with coherent cohomology.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def coherentDerivedComparison
    {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) RingCat.{u}) :
    DerivedCategory (CoherentModules R) ⥤
      (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
        (fun M : _root_.SheafOfModules.{u} R => IsCoherent M)).FullSubcategory
declarations.comment: comparison functor

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.coherentDerivedComparison_comp_inclusion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08E1.** Forgetting the coherence condition after comparison gives the
derived functor of the inclusion of coherent modules.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def coherentDerivedComparison_comp_inclusion
    {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) RingCat.{u}) :
    let P : ObjectProperty (_root_.SheafOfModules.{u} R) := fun M => IsCoherent M
    letI : Preadditive P.FullSubcategory := Abelian.toPreadditive
    letI : Preadditive (_root_.SheafOfModules.{u} R) := Abelian.toPreadditive
    let I : P.FullSubcategory ⥤ _root_.SheafOfModules.{u} R := P.ι
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits I :=
      ObjectProperty.preservesFiniteLimits_ι_of_isWeakSerreClass P
    letI : PreservesFiniteColimits I :=
      ObjectProperty.preservesFiniteColimits_ι_of_isWeakSerreClass P
    letI : I.Additive := I.additive_of_preserves_binary_products
    coherentDerivedComparison R ⋙ (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB P).ι ≅
      I.mapDerivedCategory
declarations.comment: canonical comparison

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProperSupportCoherent.derivedCategoryBBounded_derivedPushforward_of_isProperOver_supp_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08E2].** Let `S` be a Noetherian scheme, `f : X ⟶ S` locally of finite type
and `E` a bounded object of `D(𝒪_X)` whose cohomology sheaves are coherent with support proper
over `S`. Then `Rf_*E` is an object of `D^b_Coh(𝒪_S)`.

The dévissage is applied to the window `[a, b]` of `E`; at each cohomology sheaf of `E` its
hypothesis is `hasCoherentBoundedDirectImages_of_isProperOver_supp_unconditional`, this library's
form of [Stacks, Tag 08DS] together with the uniform vanishing of [Stacks, Tag 01XJ].
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategoryBBounded_derivedPushforward_of_isProperOver_supp_unconditional
    [IsNoetherian S] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (E : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hcoh : ∀ j : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules j).obj E).IsCoherent)
    (hsupp : ∀ j : ℤ, IsProperOver f
      ⟨SheafOfModules.supp ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules j).obj E),
        @SheafOfModules.isClosed_supp _ _ _ (hcoh j).isFiniteType⟩)
    (a b : ℤ) (hGE : E.IsGE a) (hLE : E.IsLE b) :
    DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBBounded (fun N : S.Modules => N.IsCoherent)
      ((derivedPushforwardModules f).obj E)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProperSupportCoherent.derivedCategoryBBounded_derivedPushforward_of_properSupp
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08E2].** Let `S` be a Noetherian scheme, let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of finite
type and let `E` be a bounded object of `D(𝒪_X)` whose cohomology sheaves are coherent with
support proper over `S`. Then `Rf_*E` is an object of `D^b_Coh(𝒪_S)`.

The dévissage `derivedCategoryBBounded_derivedPushforward_of_isProperOver_supp` asks for
[Stacks, Tag 02O5] in the affine-base form
`AlgebraicGeometry.ProperCoherentImage.HigherDirectImageIsCoherentOverAffineBase`, which
`AlgebraicGeometry.ProperCoherenceWitness.higherDirectImageIsCoherentOverAffineBase` supplies.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategoryBBounded_derivedPushforward_of_properSupp {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [IsNoetherian S] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (E : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hcoh : ∀ j : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules j).obj E).IsCoherent)
    (hsupp : ∀ j : ℤ, IsProperOver f
      ⟨SheafOfModules.supp ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules j).obj E),
        @SheafOfModules.isClosed_supp _ _ _ (hcoh j).isFiniteType⟩)
    (a b : ℤ) (hGE : E.IsGE a) (hLE : E.IsLE b) :
    DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBBounded (fun N : S.Modules => N.IsCoherent)
      ((derivedPushforwardModules f).obj E)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProperSupportCoherent.derivedCategoryBBounded_derivedPushforward
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08E2].** Let `S` be a Noetherian scheme, `f : X ⟶ S` locally of finite type
and `E` an object of `D^b_Coh(𝒪_X)` such that the support of `H^i(E)` is proper over `S` for all
`i`. Then `Rf_*E` is an object of `D^b_Coh(𝒪_S)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategoryBBounded_derivedPushforward [IsNoetherian S]
    (E : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hcoh : ∀ j : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules j).obj E).IsCoherent)
    (hsupp : ∀ j : ℤ, IsProperOver f
      ⟨SheafOfModules.supp ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules j).obj E),
        @SheafOfModules.isClosed_supp _ _ _ (hcoh j).isFiniteType⟩)
    (a b : ℤ) (hGE : E.IsGE a) (hLE : E.IsLE b) :
    DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBBounded (fun N : S.Modules => N.IsCoherent)
      ((derivedPushforwardModules f).obj E)

declarations.name: AdicKoszul.exists_koszulPower_lift
declarations.doc:
A degree-zero class of a quasi-coherent complex on `Spec A`, supported on the
closed complement of a union of `r` basic opens in the indicated range, comes
from a Koszul complex on powers of the defining equations.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_koszulPower_lift {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {r : ℕ}
    (f : Fin r → A) (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (hE : ∀ i : Fin r, ∀ n : ℤ, -(r : ℤ) + 1 ≤ n → n ≤ 0 →
      ∀ x : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) n).obj E,
        ∃ k : ℕ, f i ^ k • x = 0)
    (s : DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (((CochainComplex.singleFunctors (ModuleCat.{u} A)).functor 0).obj
        (ModuleCat.of A A)) ⟶ E) :
    ∃ e : ℕ, ∃ t : (AdicKoszul.canonicalKoszulPowerSystem f).obj ⟨e⟩ ⟶ E,
      s = DerivedCategory.Q.map (AdicKoszul.koszulPowerUnit f e) ≫ t

declarations.name: Stacks.Koszul.PowerLift.exists_koszulPower_lift
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08E3] over a ring**, with the target read as a term of the canonical Koszul
power system `AdicKoszul.canonicalKoszulPowerSystem`. That system is defined at
`CategoryTheory.HasDerivedCategory.standard`, so this form of the statement is available only at
that model; `Stacks.Koszul.PowerLift.exists_koszulPower_lift_koszulCochain` is the same result at
an arbitrary one.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_koszulPower_lift {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → A)
    (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (hE : ∀ i : Fin r, ∀ n : ℤ, -(r : ℤ) + 1 ≤ n → n ≤ 0 →
      ∀ x : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) n).obj E,
        ∃ k : ℕ, f i ^ k • x = 0)
    (s : DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (((CochainComplex.singleFunctors (ModuleCat.{u} A)).functor 0).obj
        (ModuleCat.of A A)) ⟶ E) :
    ∃ e : ℕ, ∃ t : (AdicKoszul.canonicalKoszulPowerSystem f).obj ⟨e⟩ ⟶ E,
      s = DerivedCategory.Q.map (AdicKoszul.koszulPowerUnit f e) ≫ t

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isQuasicoherent_homology_of_isPseudoCoherent_scheme
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a scheme. If `E` is an `m`-pseudo-coherent object of `D(𝒪_X)`, then `H^i(E)` is a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module for `i > m`, and every point of `X` has an open neighbourhood `U` on
which `H^m(E)` is a quotient of a quasi-coherent `𝒪_U`-module. If `E` is pseudo-coherent, then `E`
is an object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`.

The three clauses are `isQuasicoherent_homology_of_isPseudoCoherentFrom`,
`exists_local_epi_homology_of_isPseudoCoherentFrom` and
`isQuasicoherentDerived_of_isPseudoCoherent`.

**Stacks erratum.** The source states the degree-`m` clause globally, that `H^m(E)` is a quotient
of a quasi-coherent module on all of `X`; that is false (see the counterexample in the docstring
of `exists_local_epi_homology_of_isPseudoCoherentFrom`), and the corrected clause is the local
one stated here.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isQuasicoherent_homology_of_isPseudoCoherent_scheme (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{d} (StrictlyPerfect.OXMod.{u, u, u} X.toRingedSpace)] :
    (∀ (E : DerivedCategory (StrictlyPerfect.OXMod.{u, u, u} X.toRingedSpace)) (m : ℤ),
      RingedSpace.IsPseudoCoherentFrom (X := X.toRingedSpace) E m →
        (∀ i : ℤ, m < i → ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (StrictlyPerfect.OXMod.{u, u, u} X.toRingedSpace) i).obj E).IsQuasicoherent) ∧
        ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ ∃ M : U.toScheme.Modules, M.IsQuasicoherent ∧
          ∃ f : M ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (StrictlyPerfect.OXMod.{u, u, u} X.toRingedSpace) m).obj E), Epi f) ∧
    ∀ E : DerivedCategory (StrictlyPerfect.OXMod.{u, u, u} X.toRingedSpace),
      RingedSpace.IsPseudoCoherent (X := X.toRingedSpace) E →
        DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
          (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent
            (StrictlyPerfect.structureSheafOfRings X.toRingedSpace)) E

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.isPseudoCoherentFrom_tilde_iff
declarations.doc:
**Tag 08E7 for `m`-pseudo-coherence.** A complex of `A`-modules is `m`-pseudo-coherent exactly
when the complex of `𝒪`-modules it determines on `Spec A` is `m`-pseudo-coherent.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isPseudoCoherentFrom_tilde_iff {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (m : ℤ) :
    IsPseudoCoherentFrom (X := (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).toRingedSpace)
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of A) :
            ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤ OXMod.{u, u} (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).toRingedSpace
            ).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M)) m ↔
      StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.IsPseudoCoherentFrom (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M) m
declarations.comment: m-pseudo-coherent

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.isPseudoCoherent_tilde_iff
declarations.doc:
**Tag 08E7 for pseudo-coherence.** A complex of `A`-modules is pseudo-coherent exactly when the
complex of `𝒪`-modules it determines on `Spec A` is pseudo-coherent. Both sides are equivalent to
the conjunction over all degrees of the fixed-degree condition: on the module side by Stacks 064W,
on the sheaf side because Tag 08CC part (2) lets the one complex representing the object serve as
the `m`-pseudo-coherent representative for every `m`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isPseudoCoherent_tilde_iff {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) :
    IsPseudoCoherent (X := (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).toRingedSpace)
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of A) :
            ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤ OXMod.{u, u} (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).toRingedSpace
            ).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M)) ↔
      StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.IsPseudoCoherent (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M)
declarations.comment: pseudo-coherent

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.isPseudoCoherentFrom_tilde_iff_locallySmall
declarations.doc:
**Tag 08E7 for `m`-pseudo-coherence, at the locally small derived category.** A complex of
`A`-modules is `m`-pseudo-coherent exactly when the complex of `𝒪`-modules it determines on
`Spec A` is `m`-pseudo-coherent as an object of the derived category of `𝒪_{Spec A}`-modules
whose morphisms are in `Type u`. That is the derived category at which derived sheafification and
the affine base-change comparison are stated.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isPseudoCoherentFrom_tilde_iff_locallySmall {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (m : ℤ) :
    IsPseudoCoherentFrom (X := (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).toRingedSpace)
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of A) :
            ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤ OXMod.{u, u} (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).toRingedSpace
            ).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M)) m ↔
      StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.IsPseudoCoherentFrom (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M) m
declarations.comment: m-pseudo-coherent, at the locally small derived category

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.isPseudoCoherent_tilde_iff_locallySmall
declarations.doc:
**Tag 08E7 for pseudo-coherence, at the locally small derived category.** A complex of
`A`-modules is pseudo-coherent exactly when the complex of `𝒪`-modules it determines on `Spec A`
is pseudo-coherent as an object of the derived category of `𝒪_{Spec A}`-modules whose morphisms
are in `Type u`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isPseudoCoherent_tilde_iff_locallySmall {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) :
    IsPseudoCoherent (X := (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).toRingedSpace)
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of A) :
            ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤ OXMod.{u, u} (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).toRingedSpace
            ).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M)) ↔
      StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.IsPseudoCoherent (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M)
declarations.comment: pseudo-coherent, at the locally small derived category

declarations.name: Stacks.AffineTilde.isPseudoCoherentFrom_of_isPseudoCoherentFrom_tildeComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08E7, the direction from sheaves to modules.** If the object of `D(𝒪_{Spec R})`
determined by a complex `M^•` of `R`-modules is `m`-pseudo-coherent (Stacks 08CB (3)), then `M^•`
is `m`-pseudo-coherent as a complex of `R`-modules (Stacks 064Q (1)).

The standard opens over which the localization of `M^•` is `m`-pseudo-coherent generate the unit
ideal, because every point of `Spec R` lies in one of them; a finite subfamily still does, and
Stacks 066D descends `m`-pseudo-coherence along it.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPseudoCoherentFrom_of_isPseudoCoherentFrom_tildeComplex
    (h : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.IsPseudoCoherentFrom
      (X := (Spec R).toRingedSpace) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (tildeComplex M)) m) :
    IsPseudoCoherentFrom (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M) m
declarations.comment: m-pseudo-coherent, the direction from sheaves to modules

declarations.name: Stacks.AffineTilde.isPseudoCoherent_of_isPseudoCoherent_tildeComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08E7, the direction from sheaves to modules, all degrees at once.** If the object of
`D(𝒪_{Spec R})` determined by a complex `M^•` of `R`-modules is pseudo-coherent (Stacks 08CB (3)),
then `M^•` is pseudo-coherent as a complex of `R`-modules (Stacks 064Q (2)).

Both notions are `m`-pseudo-coherence for every `m` — at the level of sheaves by definition, at
the level of modules by Stacks 064U
(`StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.pseudoCoherent_iff_all`) — so this is the previous result applied
degree by degree, with the representative the hypothesis supplies serving for all degrees.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPseudoCoherent_of_isPseudoCoherent_tildeComplex
    (h : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.IsPseudoCoherent
      (X := (Spec R).toRingedSpace) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (tildeComplex M))) :
    IsPseudoCoherent (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M)
declarations.comment: pseudo-coherent, the direction from sheaves to modules

declarations.name: Stacks.AffineTilde.isPseudoCoherentFrom_tildeComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08E7, the direction from modules to sheaves.** If a complex `M^•` of `R`-modules is
`m`-pseudo-coherent (Stacks 064Q (1)), then the object of `D(𝒪_{Spec R})` it determines is
`m`-pseudo-coherent (Stacks 08CB (3)).
declarations.statement:
theorem isPseudoCoherentFrom_tildeComplex (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (m : ℤ)
    (h : StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.IsPseudoCoherentFrom (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M) m) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.IsPseudoCoherentFrom
      (X := (Spec R).toRingedSpace) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (tildeComplex M)) m
declarations.comment: m-pseudo-coherent, the direction from modules to sheaves

declarations.name: Stacks.AffineTilde.isPseudoCoherent_tildeComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08E7, the direction from modules to sheaves, all degrees at once.** If a complex
`M^•` of `R`-modules is pseudo-coherent (Stacks 064Q (2)), then the object of `D(𝒪_{Spec R})` it
determines is pseudo-coherent (Stacks 08CB (3)).

Both notions of pseudo-coherence are `m`-pseudo-coherence for every `m` — at the level of modules
by Stacks 064U
(`StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.pseudoCoherent_iff_all`), at the level of sheaves by definition —
so this follows from `Stacks.AffineTilde.isPseudoCoherentComplexFrom_tildeComplex` degree by
degree, with the single representative `\widetilde{M^•}` serving for all degrees.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPseudoCoherent_tildeComplex (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)
    (h : StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.IsPseudoCoherent (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M)) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.IsPseudoCoherent
      (X := (Spec R).toRingedSpace) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (tildeComplex M))
declarations.comment: pseudo-coherent, the direction from modules to sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPseudoCoherentFrom_iff_coherent_homology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08E8.** Let `X` be a Noetherian scheme, let `E` be an object of
`D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` and let `m` be an integer. Then `E` is `m`-pseudo-coherent if and only if `Hⁱ(E)`
is coherent for every `i ≥ m` and vanishes for `i ≫ 0`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isPseudoCoherentFrom_iff_coherent_homology (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (E : (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
      (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf)).FullSubcategory)
    (m : ℤ) :
    RingedSpace.IsPseudoCoherentFrom (X := X.toRingedSpace) E.1 m ↔
      ((∀ i : ℤ, m ≤ i →
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules i).obj E.1).IsCoherent) ∧
        DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedAbove E.1)
declarations.comment: equivalence in degree m

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPseudoCoherent_iff_boundedAbove_coherent_homology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08E8, the final statement.** On a Noetherian scheme an object of
`D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` is pseudo-coherent if and only if it is bounded above and all of its cohomology
sheaves are coherent, that is, if and only if it is an object of `D⁻_Coh(𝒪_X)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isPseudoCoherent_iff_boundedAbove_coherent_homology (X : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian X]
    (E : (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
      (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf)).FullSubcategory) :
    RingedSpace.IsPseudoCoherent (X := X.toRingedSpace) E.1 ↔
      (DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedAbove E.1 ∧
        ∀ i : ℤ,
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules i).obj E.1).IsCoherent)
declarations.comment: identification with D⁻_Coh

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasTorAmplitude_tilde_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08E9 (1).** Let `X = Spec R` be an affine scheme and let `M` be an object of `D(R)`.
Then the associated object `M̃` of `D(𝒪_X)` has Tor amplitude in `[a, b]` if and only if `M` has
Tor amplitude in `[a, b]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasTorAmplitude_tilde_iff (M : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)) (a b : ℤ) :
    Stacks.Cohomology.TorAmplitude.HasTorAmplitude (Spec R).toRingedSpace
        ((tilde.functor R).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) a b ↔
      StacksDraft.TorAmplitude.HasTorAmplitudeCanonical R M a b
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasFiniteTorDimension_tilde_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08E9 (2).** Let `X = Spec R` be an affine scheme and let `M` be an object of `D(R)`.
Then the associated object `M̃` of `D(𝒪_X)` has finite Tor dimension if and only if `M` has finite
Tor dimension.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteTorDimension_tilde_iff (M : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)) :
    Stacks.Cohomology.TorAmplitude.HasFiniteTorDimension (Spec R).toRingedSpace
        ((tilde.functor R).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) ↔
      StacksDraft.TorAmplitude.HasFiniteTorDimensionCanonical R M
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasTorAmplitude_iff_hasTorAmplitudeOnQuasicoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08EA.** Let `X` be a quasi-separated scheme, `E` an object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` and
`a ≤ b`. The following are equivalent:

1. `E` has Tor amplitude in `[a, b]`;
2. `H^i(E ⊗^L_{𝒪_X} ℱ) = 0` for `i ∉ [a, b]` and every quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `ℱ`.

Neither direction uses `a ≤ b`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasTorAmplitude_iff_hasTorAmplitudeOnQuasicoherent {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (E : DerivedCategory (OXMod.{u, u} X.toRingedSpace)) (a b : ℤ)
    (hqc : ∀ n : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules n).obj E).IsQuasicoherent) :
    Stacks.Cohomology.TorAmplitude.HasTorAmplitude X.toRingedSpace E a b ↔
      Stacks.Cohomology.TorAmplitude.HasTorAmplitudeOnQuasicoherent X.toRingedSpace E a b

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPerfect_tilde_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08EB.** Let `X = Spec R` be an affine scheme and let `M` be an object of `D(R)`. Then
the associated object `M̃` of `D(𝒪_X)` is a perfect object of `D(𝒪_X)` if and only if `M` is a
perfect object of `D(R)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_tilde_iff (M : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)) :
    Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect
        ((tilde.functor R).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) ↔
      StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect M

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPerfect_tilde_iff_of_model
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08EB at an arbitrary pair of chosen derived categories.** Let `X = Spec R` be an
affine scheme and let `M` be an object of `D(R)`, for any chosen model of `D(R)` and any chosen
model of `D(𝒪_X)`, with the two morphism universes unrelated. Then the associated object `M̃` of
`D(𝒪_X)` is a perfect object of `D(𝒪_X)` if and only if `M` is a perfect object of `D(R)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_tilde_iff_of_model [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    [hS : HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (Spec R).Modules] (M : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)) :
    @Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect (Spec R).toRingedSpace hS
        ((tilde.functor R).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) ↔
      StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect M

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_quasicoherentDerived_lift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08ED.** Every quasi-coherent derived object on a quasi-compact open
subscheme extends to a quasi-coherent derived object on the ambient scheme: the functor
`D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⟶ D_QCoh(𝒪_U)` given by restriction is essentially surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_quasicoherentDerived_lift (E : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory U) :
    ∃ F : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory X,
      Nonempty ((derivedPullback j.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj F.obj ≅ E.obj)
declarations.comment: unbounded derived category

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_quasicoherentDerived_plus_lift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08ED.** A bounded-below quasi-coherent derived object on a
quasi-compact open subscheme has a bounded-below quasi-coherent lift: the functor
`D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⟶ D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_U)` given by restriction is essentially surjective.

No quasi-compactness of the ambient scheme is needed, the derived direct image preserving a
lower cohomological bound for an arbitrary morphism of schemes.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_quasicoherentDerived_plus_lift (E : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory U)
    (hE : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus E.obj) :
    ∃ F : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory X,
      DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus F.obj ∧
      Nonempty ((derivedPullback j.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj F.obj ≅ E.obj)
declarations.comment: bounded-below derived category

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_quasicoherentDerived_minus_lift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08ED.** A bounded-above quasi-coherent derived object on a
quasi-compact open subscheme of a quasi-compact scheme has a bounded-above quasi-coherent lift:
the functor `D⁻_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⟶ D⁻_QCoh(𝒪_U)` given by restriction is essentially surjective.

Quasi-compactness of the ambient scheme is what bounds the cohomological dimension of `j`, and
so bounds the shift by which the derived direct image can raise an upper bound.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_quasicoherentDerived_minus_lift [CompactSpace X]
    (E : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory U) (hE : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.minus E.obj) :
    ∃ F : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory X,
      DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.minus F.obj ∧
      Nonempty ((derivedPullback j.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj F.obj ≅ E.obj)
declarations.comment: bounded-above derived category

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_quasicoherentDerived_bounded_lift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08ED.** A bounded quasi-coherent derived object on a quasi-compact
open subscheme of a quasi-compact scheme has a bounded quasi-coherent lift: the functor
`D^b_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⟶ D^b_QCoh(𝒪_U)` given by restriction is essentially surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_quasicoherentDerived_bounded_lift [CompactSpace X]
    (E : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory U) (hE : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded E.obj) :
    ∃ F : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory X,
      DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded F.obj ∧
      Nonempty ((derivedPullback j.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj F.obj ≅ E.obj)
declarations.comment: bounded derived category

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_boundedAbove_finiteFree_lift
declarations.doc:
A pseudo-coherent derived object on a quasi-compact open of an affine
scheme is the restriction of a bounded-above complex of finite free modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_boundedAbove_finiteFree_lift
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{d} (OXMod.{u} (X.toRingedSpace.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding))]
    (E : DerivedCategory (OXMod.{u} (X.toRingedSpace.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding)))
    (hE : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.IsPseudoCoherent
      (X := X.toRingedSpace.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding) E) :
    ∃ P : CochainComplex (OXMod.{u} X.toRingedSpace) ℤ,
      (∃ b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, b < i → CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero (P.X i)) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, ∃ I : Type u, Finite I ∧ Nonempty
        (P.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := structureSheafOfRings X.toRingedSpace) I)) ∧
      Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((RingedSpace.restrictModules X.toRingedSpace U).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P) ≅ E)

declarations.name: Stacks.DerivedQCoh.exists_pos_subsingleton_hom_singleFunctor_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08EF.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme and let
`E ∈ D^b_{QCoh}(𝒪_X)`. There exists an integer `n₀ > 0` such that
`Ext^n_{D(𝒪_X)}(ℰ, E) = 0` for every finite locally free `𝒪_X`-module `ℰ` and every `n ≥ n₀`.

The Ext group is the group of morphisms `ℰ ⟶ E⟦n⟧` in `D(𝒪_X)`, with `ℰ` placed in
cohomological degree zero, and its vanishing is subsingletonness of that group.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_pos_subsingleton_hom_singleFunctor_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (E : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hE : DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBBounded
      (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf) E) :
    ∃ n₀ : ℤ, 0 < n₀ ∧
      ∀ ℰ : X.Modules, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} ℰ →
        ∀ n : ℤ, n₀ ≤ n →
          Subsingleton ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj ℰ ⟶ E⟦n⟧)

declarations.name: Stacks.DerivedQCoh.OpenLift.exists_finiteLocallyFree_biprod_iso_restrict_of_isPerfect
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08EG].** Let `X` be an affine scheme and `U ⊆ X` a quasi-compact open. For
every perfect object `E` of `D(𝒪_U)` there are an integer `r`, a finite locally free
`𝒪_U`-module `ℱ` and a perfect complex `P` of `𝒪_X`-modules with `ℱ[-r] ⊕ E ≅ P|_U`, where
`ℱ[-r]` is `ℱ` placed in cohomological degree `r`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finiteLocallyFree_biprod_iso_restrict_of_isPerfect
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    (E : DerivedCategory U.toScheme.Modules)
    (hE : IsPerfect (X := U.toScheme.toRingedSpace) E) :
    ∃ (r : ℤ) (F : U.toScheme.Modules) (P : CochainComplex (OXMod.{u, u, u} X.toRingedSpace) ℤ),
      AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} F ∧
      IsPerfectComplex P ∧
      Nonempty (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor U.toScheme.Modules r).obj F ⊞ E) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.restrictModules.{u, u} X.toRingedSpace
            U).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P))

declarations.name: Stacks.DerivedQCoh.OpenLift.exists_isPerfect_derivedTensor_lift_of_isAffine
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be an affine scheme and `U ⊆ X` a quasi-compact open. Let `E, E'` be objects of
`D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` with `E` perfect. For every morphism `α : E|_U ⟶ E'|_U` there are a perfect object
`I` of `D(𝒪_X)`, a morphism `b : I ⟶ 𝒪_X` whose restriction to `U` is an isomorphism, and a
morphism `γ : E ⊗^L I ⟶ E'`, such that, writing `β : E ⊗^L I ⟶ E ⊗^L 𝒪_X ≅ E` for the morphism
induced by `b`, the object `E₁ = E ⊗^L I` is perfect, `β|_U` is an isomorphism and
`α = γ|_U ∘ (β|_U)⁻¹`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isPerfect_derivedTensor_lift_of_isAffine (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X]
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    (E E' : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules X.ringCatSheaf))
    (hE : Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect.{u, u, u + 1} (X := X.toRingedSpace) E)
    (hE' : ∀ i : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules i).obj E').IsQuasicoherent)
    (α : (derivedRestrict U.ι).obj E ⟶ (derivedRestrict U.ι).obj E') :
    letI := derivedMonoidalStructure X.sheaf
    ∃ (I : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules X.ringCatSheaf))
      (b : I ⟶ 𝟙_ (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules X.ringCatSheaf))) (γ : E ⊗ I ⟶ E'),
      Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect.{u, u, u + 1} (X := X.toRingedSpace) I ∧
      IsIso ((derivedRestrict U.ι).map b) ∧
      Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect.{u, u, u + 1} (X := X.toRingedSpace)
        (E ⊗ I : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules X.ringCatSheaf)) ∧
      IsIso ((derivedRestrict U.ι).map (E ◁ b ≫ (ρ_ E).hom)) ∧
      (derivedRestrict U.ι).map (E ◁ b ≫ (ρ_ E).hom) ≫ α = (derivedRestrict U.ι).map γ

declarations.name: Stacks.DerivedQCoh.OpenLift.exists_isPerfectComplex_restrict_iso_biprod_shift_of_isAffine
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be an affine scheme and `U ⊆ X` a quasi-compact open. For every perfect object `F` of
`D(𝒪_U)` the object `F ⊕ F[1]` is the restriction of a perfect object of `D(𝒪_X)`: there is a
perfect complex `P` of `𝒪_X`-modules whose degreewise restriction to `U` represents `F ⊕ F[1]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isPerfectComplex_restrict_iso_biprod_shift_of_isAffine (X : Scheme.{u})
    [IsAffine X] (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    (F : DerivedCategory U.toScheme.Modules)
    (hF : Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect (X := U.toScheme.toRingedSpace) F) :
    ∃ P : CochainComplex (StrictlyPerfect.OXMod.{u, u, u} X.toRingedSpace) ℤ,
      Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfectComplex P ∧
      Nonempty ((F ⊞ F⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.restrictModules.{u, u} X.toRingedSpace
          U).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P))

declarations.name: Stacks.PowerTorsion.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_isPerfect_of_cohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08EJ] on an affine scheme.** Let `R` be a commutative ring, let `f : R` and
let `X = Spec R`. Let `α : E ⟶ E'` be a morphism of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` such that `E` is perfect and
`E'` is supported on the closed subset `T = V(f)`, that is, the cohomology sheaves of `E'` have
vanishing stalks at every point off `V(f)`. Then `f ^ n • α = 0` for some `n ≥ 0`.

Both objects are `Ñ` for an object `N` of `D(R)` by [Stacks, Tag 06Z0], perfectness of `E`
becomes perfectness of its preimage `M` by [Stacks, Tag 08EB], and the support condition on `E'`
becomes `f`-power torsion of the cohomology modules of the preimage `N`. The statement in `D(R)`
is `StacksDraft.Perfect.homPowerTorsion_of_isPerfect`; derived sheafification carries its
conclusion back, being `R`-linear and fully faithful.

This is the base case of the induction over the quasi-compact opens that proves the statement
for a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme,
`Stacks.PowerTorsion.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_isPerfect_of_cohomologySupportedOn_qcqs`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_isPerfect_of_cohomologySupportedOn (f : R)
    {E E' : DerivedCategory (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules}
    (hE : Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect
      (X := (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).toRingedSpace) E)
    (hEq : ∀ n : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules n).obj E).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hE'q : ∀ n : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules n).obj E').IsQuasicoherent)
    (hsupp : CohomologySupportedOn (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).ringCatSheaf
      (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus {f}) E')
    (α : E ⟶ E') :
    letI : Linear R (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules := modulesLinear R (specBase R)
    ∃ k : ℕ, f ^ k • α = 0
declarations.comment: on an affine scheme, in D(𝒪_X); the base case of the induction over the quasi-compact opens that gives the quasi-compact quasi-separated case

declarations.name: Stacks.DerivedQCoh.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_isPerfect_of_cohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme and let
`f ∈ Γ(X, 𝒪_X)`. Let `E` and `E'` be objects of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` with `E` perfect and `E'`
cohomologically supported on `T = V(f)`. Then for every `α : E ⟶ E'` there is an `n ≥ 0` with
`f ^ n · α = 0`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_isPerfect_of_cohomologySupportedOn {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (f : Γ(X, ⊤))
    (E F : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hFqc : ∀ i : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules i).obj F).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hE : Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect (X := X.toRingedSpace) E)
    (hF : AlgebraicGeometry.CohomologySupportedOn X.ringCatSheaf (X.zeroLocus {f}) F)
    (α : E ⟶ F) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, globalScalar X.ringCatSheaf f ^ n • α = 0
declarations.comment: on a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme, the statement in full

declarations.name: Stacks.PowerTorsion.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_isPerfect_of_cohomologySupportedOn_qcqs
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08EJ].** Let `X` be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme and let
`f ∈ Γ(X, 𝒪_X)`. Let `α : E ⟶ E'` be a morphism of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` such that `E` is perfect and
`E'` is supported on the closed subset `T = V(f)`, that is, the cohomology sheaves of `E'` have
vanishing stalks at every point where `f` does not vanish. Then `f ^ n • α = 0` for some
`n ≥ 0`.

The scalar acts through the `Γ(X, 𝒪_X)`-linear structure
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.linearOfRingHom` of the identity ring map, which is a definition and
not an instance -- a scheme does not determine a base ring -- and so appears as a `letI` in the
statement.

This is `Stacks.PowerTorsion.powerTorsionProperty_top` at the degree `0`, the shift being
undone by the unitor of the shift.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_isPerfect_of_cohomologySupportedOn_qcqs {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (f : Γ(X, ⊤)) (E E' : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hE : IsPerfect (X := ringedSpace X) E)
    (hEq : ∀ n : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules n).obj E).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hE'q : ∀ n : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules n).obj E').IsQuasicoherent)
    (hsupp : CohomologySupportedOn X.ringCatSheaf ((X.basicOpen f : Set X)ᶜ) E')
    (α : E ⟶ E') :
    letI : Linear Γ(X, ⊤) X.Modules := Scheme.linearOfRingHom X Γ(X, ⊤) (RingHom.id Γ(X, ⊤))
    ∃ k : ℕ, f ^ k • α = 0

declarations.name: StacksDraft.Perfect.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_isPerfect_of_support_subset_zeroLocus
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be a commutative ring and let `f : A`. Let `α : E ⟶ E'` be a morphism in `D(A)` such
that `E` is perfect and `E'` is supported on `T = V(f)`, that is, every cohomology module of `E'`
has support contained in the zero locus of `f`. Then there is an `n ≥ 0` with `f ^ n • α = 0`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_isPerfect_of_support_subset_zeroLocus (f : A)
    {E E' : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)} (hE : IsPerfect E)
    (hE' : ∀ p : ℤ, Module.support A
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) p).obj E' : Type u) ⊆
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus {f})
    (α : E ⟶ E') : ∃ n : ℕ, f ^ n • α = 0
declarations.comment: affine case, in D(A); the geometric form on an affine scheme, and the quasi-compact quasi-separated case, are in the AlgebraicGeometry directory

declarations.name: Stacks.DerivedQCoh.OpenLift.exists_isPerfectComplex_supported_restrict_iso_biprod_shift_of_isAffine
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be an affine scheme, `T ⊆ X` a closed subset with
`X ∖ T` quasi-compact and `U ⊆ X` a quasi-compact open. For every perfect object `F` of
`D(𝒪_U)` whose cohomology is supported on `T ∩ U`, the object `F ⊕ F[1]` is the restriction of a
perfect object of `D(𝒪_X)` with cohomology supported on `T`: there is a perfect complex `P` of
`𝒪_X`-modules, with cohomology supported on `T`, whose degreewise restriction to `U` represents
`F ⊕ F[1]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isPerfectComplex_supported_restrict_iso_biprod_shift_of_isAffine
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X]
    (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTc : IsCompact Tᶜ)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    (F : DerivedCategory U.toScheme.Modules)
    (hF : IsPerfect (X := U.toScheme.toRingedSpace) F)
    (hFT : CohomologySupportedOn U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf (Subtype.val ⁻¹' T) F) :
    ∃ P : CochainComplex (StrictlyPerfect.OXMod.{u, u, u} X.toRingedSpace) ℤ,
      IsPerfectComplex P ∧
      CohomologySupportedOn X.ringCatSheaf T (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ∧
      Nonempty ((F ⊞ F⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.restrictModules.{u, u} X.toRingedSpace
          U).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.HasPerfectApproximation
declarations.doc:
Approximation holds for the triple `(T, E, m)`: there is a perfect object of the derived
category of `𝒪_X`-modules, cohomologically supported on `T`, mapping to `E` by a map which is an
isomorphism on cohomology in every degree above `m` and an epimorphism on cohomology in
degree `m`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev HasPerfectApproximation (X : Scheme.{u}) (T : Set X)
    (E : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} X.Modules) (m : ℤ) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.HasApproximationByPerfectComplexes
declarations.doc:
The scheme `X` satisfies approximation by perfect complexes: for every closed subset `T`
with retrocompact complement there is an integer `r` such that every sufficiently
pseudo-coherent derived object with quasi-coherent cohomology supported on `T` in high degrees
admits a perfect approximation.
declarations.statement: abbrev HasApproximationByPerfectComplexes (X : Scheme.{u}) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.hasPerfectApproximation_of_open
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08EP.** Let `T` be a closed subset of a scheme `X` contained in an
open subscheme `U`, and let `E` be an object of the derived category of `𝒪_X`-modules whose
cohomology vanishes off `T` in every degree at least `m`. If approximation by a perfect complex
holds for the restriction of `E` to `U`, relative to the preimage of `T` and the same degree
`m`, then it holds for `E`.

The perfect object is the extension by zero `j_! P` of an approximation `P` over `U`: it is
perfect because the derived pushforward of a perfect object with closed support is perfect
(Stacks 08DP) and agrees there with extension by zero (Stacks 08DF), and its cohomology is
supported on `T` because extension by zero preserves the support. The map to `E` is the
extension by zero of the approximation, followed by the derived counit of `j_! ⊣ j^*`; the
support hypothesis on `E` makes the underived counit invertible on each cohomology sheaf in
degree at least `m`, and hence the derived counit invertible on cohomology there.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPerfectApproximation_of_open
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTU : T ⊆ (U : Set X))
    (E : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} X.Modules) (m : ℤ)
    (hApprox : HasPerfectApproximation (U : Scheme.{u})
      ((fun x : U ↦ (x.1 : X)) ⁻¹' T)
      ((RingedSpace.restrictModules X.toRingedSpace U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E) m)
    (hSupport : ∀ i : ℤ, m ≤ i → ∀ x : X, x ∉ T →
      IsZero (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (X := X)
        (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules i).obj E).val.presheaf) x)) :
    HasPerfectApproximation X T E m

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PerfectApproximation.approximationHolds_of_affineCover
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be an affine scheme. Approximation holds for every triple `(T, E, m)` with `E` an
object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` for which there is an integer `r ≥ 0` such that

1. `E` is `m`-pseudo-coherent,
2. `Hⁱ(E)` is supported on `T` for `i ≥ m - r + 1`,
3. `X ∖ T` is the union of `r` affine opens `U₁, …, U_r`.
declarations.statement:
theorem approximationHolds_of_affineCover (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (T : Set X)
    {r : ℕ} (U : Fin r → X.Opens) (hU : ∀ k, IsAffineOpen (U k))
    (hcover : ((⨆ k, U k : X.Opens) : Set X) = Tᶜ)
    (E : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} X.Modules) (m : ℤ)
    (hqc : ∀ i : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules i).obj E).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hpc : RingedSpace.IsPseudoCoherentFrom (X := X.toRingedSpace) E m)
    (hsupp : ∀ i : ℤ, m - (r : ℤ) + 1 ≤ i → ∀ x : X, x ∉ T →
      IsZero (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (X := X)
        (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules i).obj E).val.presheaf) x)) :
    ApproximationHolds X T E m
declarations.comment: first assertion: approximation for triples on an affine scheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PerfectApproximation.approximationByPerfectComplexes_of_isAffine
declarations.doc:
**Approximation by perfect complexes holds on an affine scheme.** This is the second
assertion of [Stacks, Tag 08EQ]: the case of `Spec R`,
`AlgebraicGeometry.PerfectApproximation.approximationByPerfectComplexes_spec`, transported
along `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.isoSpec`.
declarations.statement:
theorem approximationByPerfectComplexes_of_isAffine (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] :
    ApproximationByPerfectComplexes X
declarations.comment: second assertion: approximation by perfect complexes on an affine scheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PerfectApproximation.hasApproximationByPerfectComplexes_of_isAffine
declarations.doc:
**Approximation by perfect complexes holds on an affine scheme**, in the encoding of
`AlgebraicGeometry.HasApproximationByPerfectComplexes`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasApproximationByPerfectComplexes_of_isAffine (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] :
    HasApproximationByPerfectComplexes X
declarations.comment: second assertion: approximation by perfect complexes on an affine scheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PerfectApproximation.hasApproximationByPerfectComplexes_of_sup_affine
declarations.doc:
Let `X = U ∪ V` be an open cover with `U` quasi-compact, `V` affine and `U ∩ V`
quasi-compact. If approximation by perfect complexes holds on `U`, then it holds on `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasApproximationByPerfectComplexes_of_sup_affine {X : Scheme.{u}} (U V : X.Opens)
    (hUV : U ⊔ V = ⊤) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (hUVc : IsCompact ((U : Set X) ∩ V)) (h : HasApproximationByPerfectComplexes U.toScheme) :
    HasApproximationByPerfectComplexes X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PerfectApproximation.approximationByPerfectComplexes_sup_affine
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08ER].** Let `X` be a scheme, let `X = U ∪ V` be an open covering with `U`
quasi-compact, `V` affine and `U ∩ V` quasi-compact. If approximation by perfect complexes holds
on `U`, then it holds on `X`.

The integer attached to a closed subset `T` with retrocompact complement is `a + b`, where `a`
is the integer attached on `U` to `T ∩ U` and `b` the integer attached on `V` to `T ∖ U`, both
taken nonnegative. Given a triple `(T, E, m)` satisfying the hypotheses for that integer, the
approximation is built by induction on the largest degree in which the cohomology of `E`
survives on `U`: below `m - b` the cohomology of `E` is supported on `T ∖ U ⊆ V` in all relevant
degrees and [Stacks, Tag 08EQ] on `V` together with [Stacks, Tag 08EP] finishes, while above it
the glueing step of [Stacks, Tag 09IM] turns an approximation on `U` in that degree into a
perfect object on `X` surjective there, and the cone of the resulting map survives on `U` in one
degree fewer.
declarations.statement:
theorem approximationByPerfectComplexes_sup_affine (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V : X.Opens)
    (hVaff : IsAffineOpen V) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤)
    (hUc : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hUVc : IsCompact ((U ⊓ V : X.Opens) : Set X))
    (hUapp : ApproximationByPerfectComplexes (U : Scheme.{u})) :
    ApproximationByPerfectComplexes X
declarations.comment: approximation by perfect complexes passes from a quasi-compact open to its union with an affine open meeting it in a quasi-compact open; nothing is carried, and the statement is at the standard derived category of the sheaves of modules of the scheme, the model the whole chapter is written at

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PerfectApproximation.hasApproximationByPerfectComplexes_sup_affine
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08ER]**, in the encoding of
`AlgebraicGeometry.HasApproximationByPerfectComplexes`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasApproximationByPerfectComplexes_sup_affine (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V : X.Opens)
    (hVaff : IsAffineOpen V) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤)
    (hUc : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hUVc : IsCompact ((U ⊓ V : X.Opens) : Set X))
    (hUapp : HasApproximationByPerfectComplexes (U : Scheme.{u})) :
    HasApproximationByPerfectComplexes X
declarations.comment: the same statement in the second encoding of the property of Tag 08EN; nothing is carried, and the derived category is the standard model, as in the first encoding

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PerfectApproximation.approximationByPerfectComplexes_of_qcqs
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08ES].** Approximation by perfect complexes holds on every quasi-compact and
quasi-separated scheme.

The induction principle of [Stacks, Tag 08DR] applied to the property that approximation holds
on an open subscheme: the affine case is [Stacks, Tag 08EQ] and the union step is
[Stacks, Tag 08ER].
declarations.statement:
theorem approximationByPerfectComplexes_of_qcqs (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] : ApproximationByPerfectComplexes X
declarations.comment: approximation by perfect complexes on a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme; nothing is carried, and the statement is at the standard derived category of the sheaves of modules of the scheme, the model the whole chapter is written at

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PerfectApproximation.hasApproximationByPerfectComplexes
declarations.doc: Approximation by perfect complexes holds on every quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasApproximationByPerfectComplexes (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] : HasApproximationByPerfectComplexes X

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedProjectionFormula.isIso_projectionFormulaMap_of_openCover
declarations.doc:
**The projection-formula morphism of [Stacks, Tag 0B53] is invertible as soon as it is after
restriction to the members of an open cover of the base.**

For an arbitrary morphism of schemes `f : X ⟶ Y`, arbitrary `E ∈ D(𝒪_X)` and `K ∈ D(𝒪_Y)`, and a
family of opens `U i` covering `Y`: if the projection-formula map for the restricted morphism
`f|_{U_i} : f^{-1}U_i ⟶ U_i` at the restricted complexes `Lg_i'^*E` and `Lg_i^*K` is invertible
for every `i`, then the projection-formula map for `f` at `E` and `K` is invertible.

This is the localization argument of the proof of [Stacks, Tag 08EU], over an open cover of the
base.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_projectionFormulaMap_of_openCover {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Y.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ y : Y, ∃ i, y ∈ U i)
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace)))
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y.toRingedSpace)))
    (h : ∀ i, IsIso (projectionFormulaMap (f ∣_ U i).toLRSHom.toShHom
      ((derivedPullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ U i).ι.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E)
      ((derivedPullback (U i).ι.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj K))) :
    IsIso (projectionFormulaMap f.toLRSHom.toShHom E K)
declarations.comment: the localization argument of the source's proof, closed over an open cover: for an arbitrary morphism of schemes and arbitrary complexes, invertibility of the projection-formula map for f|_U at the restricted complexes, for U running through an open cover of the base, implies invertibility of the map for f; the affine case of the tag is NOT proved here, so the tag is not closed

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedProjectionFormula.isIso_derivedPullback_map_projectionFormulaMap_of_isOpenImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Invertibility of the derived projection-formula map of [Stacks, Tag 0B53] descends along an
open immersion of the base, for schemes.**

For a Cartesian square of schemes whose bottom arrow `g` is an open immersion, the derived
pullback along `g` of the projection-formula map for `f` is invertible as soon as the map for `f'`
at the restricted complexes is.

The other horizontal arrow `g'` is then an open immersion too, being a base change of `g`, and
the square stays Cartesian in ringed spaces by
`Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedBaseChange.isPullback_toShHom_of_isOpenImmersion`, so
`Stacks.Cohomology.ProjectionFormulaPerfect.isIso_derivedPullback_map_projectionFormulaMap`
applies.  This is the form the source's
localization argument is run in: it replaces the base `Y` by an open `V ⊆ Y` and `X` by its
preimage.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedPullback_map_projectionFormulaMap_of_isOpenImmersion
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion g] (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace)))
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y.toRingedSpace)))
    (h : IsIso (projectionFormulaMap f'.toLRSHom.toShHom
      ((derivedPullback g'.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E)
      ((derivedPullback g.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj K))) :
    IsIso ((derivedPullback g.toLRSHom.toShHom).map
      (projectionFormulaMap f.toLRSHom.toShHom E K))
declarations.comment: the localization step of the source's proof, for schemes: for a Cartesian square of schemes whose bottom arrow is an open immersion, invertibility of the projection-formula map for f' at the restricted complexes implies invertibility of the derived pullback along g of the map for f; unconditional in both complexes, but only one implication of the source's reduction — the affine case and the descent from an open cover back to the base are not proved

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.projectionFormulaIsIsoOnQuasicoherent
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08EU].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of
schemes. For `E` in `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` and `K` in `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` the projection-formula morphism of
[Stacks, Tag 0B53]

`R f_* E ⊗^𝐋_{𝒪_Y} K ⟶ R f_*(E ⊗^𝐋_{𝒪_X} L f^* K)`

is an isomorphism; that is, `AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectionFormulaIsIsoOnQuasicoherent` holds.
declarations.statement:
theorem projectionFormulaIsIsoOnQuasicoherent :
    ProjectionFormulaIsIsoOnQuasicoherent.{u}
declarations.comment: the whole tag, in the shape of the proposition AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectionFormulaIsIsoOnQuasicoherent, which this proves

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ProjectionFormulaDevissage.isIso_projectionFormulaMap_twoOutOfThree
declarations.doc:
Let `Δ` be a distinguished triangle of `D(𝒪_Y)`. If the projection-formula morphism of
[Stacks, Tag 0B53] is invertible at every shift of two of the three vertices of `Δ`, it is
invertible at every shift of the third, in each of the three rotations.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_projectionFormulaMap_twoOutOfThree
    (Δ : Triangle (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y))))
    (hΔ : Δ ∈ distTriang _) :
    ((∀ n : ℤ, IsIso (projectionFormulaMap f E (Δ.obj₁⟦n⟧))) →
        (∀ n : ℤ, IsIso (projectionFormulaMap f E (Δ.obj₂⟦n⟧))) →
        ∀ n : ℤ, IsIso (projectionFormulaMap f E (Δ.obj₃⟦n⟧))) ∧
      ((∀ n : ℤ, IsIso (projectionFormulaMap f E (Δ.obj₁⟦n⟧))) →
        (∀ n : ℤ, IsIso (projectionFormulaMap f E (Δ.obj₃⟦n⟧))) →
        ∀ n : ℤ, IsIso (projectionFormulaMap f E (Δ.obj₂⟦n⟧))) ∧
      ((∀ n : ℤ, IsIso (projectionFormulaMap f E (Δ.obj₂⟦n⟧))) →
        (∀ n : ℤ, IsIso (projectionFormulaMap f E (Δ.obj₃⟦n⟧))) →
        ∀ n : ℤ, IsIso (projectionFormulaMap f E (Δ.obj₁⟦n⟧)))
declarations.comment: the triangle step of the source's dévissage, with no hypothesis: for a distinguished triangle of D(𝒪_Y), invertibility of the Tag 0B53 map at all shifts of two of the three vertices gives it at all shifts of the third, in each of the three rotations. The source states this as `two out of three of the functors being exact`; the direct-sum step is isIso_projectionFormulaMap_coproduct and the affine reduction is isIso_projectionFormulaMap_of_derivedModuleFunctor, both of which carry a geometric input and so are not registered

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ProjectionFormulaGeneralBase.isIso_projectionFormulaMap_of_isQuasicoherent
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08EU].**  For a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes
`f : X ⟶ Y`, an `E` in `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` and a `K` in `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`, the projection-formula
morphism `Rf_*E ⊗^𝐋_{𝒪_Y} K ⟶ Rf_*(E ⊗^𝐋_{𝒪_X} Lf^*K)` of [Stacks, Tag 0B53] is invertible.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_projectionFormulaMap_of_isQuasicoherent {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiCompact f] [AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiSeparated f]
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace)))
    (hE : quasicoherentDerivedProperty X E)
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y.toRingedSpace)))
    (hK : quasicoherentDerivedProperty Y K) :
    IsIso (projectionFormulaMap f.toLRSHom.toShHom E K)
declarations.comment: the tag in full: for a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes f : X ⟶ Y, an E in D_QCoh(𝒪_X) and a K in D_QCoh(𝒪_Y), the Tag 0B53 map Rf_*E ⊗ᴸ K ⟶ Rf_*(E ⊗ᴸ Lf^*K) is invertible, with no hypothesis beyond those. The source's first step, that invertibility is a local question on Y, is carried out here: over an affine open V ⊆ Y the square of Tag 0B6B identifies L((V).ι)^* of the map with the map for the base change f ∣_ V, every other arrow of that square being invertible because (V).ι is an open immersion; the map for f ∣_ V is the affine case; and invertibility in D(𝒪_Y) is local on the affine opens of Y

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ProjectionFormulaOverAffineBase.isIso_projectionFormulaMap_of_isQuasicoherent
declarations.doc:
Let `g : X ⟶ Spec A` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes, let `E` be
an object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` and let `K` be an object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_{Spec A})`. Then the
projection-formula morphism

`Rg_*E ⊗^𝐋_{𝒪_{Spec A}} K ⟶ Rg_*(E ⊗^𝐋_{𝒪_X} Lg^*K)`

is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_projectionFormulaMap_of_isQuasicoherent
    [AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiCompact g] [AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiSeparated g]
    (E : DerivedCategory (_root_.SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace)))
    (hE : quasicoherentDerivedProperty X E)
    (K : DerivedCategory (_root_.SheafOfModules.{u}
      (structureSheafRing (Spec A).toRingedSpace)))
    (hK : quasicoherentDerivedProperty (Spec A) K) :
    IsIso (projectionFormulaMap g.toLRSHom.toShHom E K)
declarations.comment: the affine case, with no hypothesis beyond the tag's own: for a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes g : X ⟶ Spec A, an E in D_QCoh(𝒪_X) and a K in D_QCoh(𝒪_{Spec A}), the Tag 0B53 map Rg_*E ⊗ᴸ K ⟶ Rg_*(E ⊗ᴸ Lg^*K) is invertible. This is the source's dévissage carried out — direct sums (Tag 08DZ), distinguished triangles, and the reduction to the shifts of the structure sheaf through the equivalence D(A) ≌ D_QCoh(𝒪_{Spec A}) of Tag 06Z0 and the remark of Tag 09PB. This is the tag over a base of the form Spec A; the source's first step, the reduction of a general base Y to an affine one, is carried out in Stacks.Cohomology.ProjectionFormulaGeneralBase, where the tag is registered in full

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ProjectionFormulaPerfect.isIso_derivedPullback_map_projectionFormulaMap
declarations.doc:
**The projection-formula morphism of [Stacks, Tag 0B53] is invertible after derived pullback
along an open immersion of the base, as soon as it is invertible upstairs.**

Let

```
          g'
   X' ----------→ X
   |              |
f' |              | f
   v      g       v
   Y' ----------→ Y
```

be a Cartesian square of ringed spaces whose horizontal arrows `g` and `g'` are open immersions,
and let `E ∈ D(𝒪_X)`, `K ∈ D(𝒪_Y)`.  If the projection-formula morphism for `f'` at
`L(g')^*E` and `Lg^*K` is invertible, then `Lg^*` of the projection-formula morphism for `f` at
`E` and `K` is invertible.

This is [Stacks, Tag 0B6B] read for invertibility.  Of the six arrows of that square, five are
invertible here — the two comparisons of [Stacks, Tag 079U] because they are components of
`Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPullbackTensor.derivedPullbackTensorIso`, the two derived base-change
maps by
`Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedBaseChange.isIso_derivedBaseChangeMap_of_isOpenImmersions`, and the
projection-formula morphism for `f'` by hypothesis — so the sixth, `Lg^*` of the
projection-formula morphism for `f`, is invertible too.

There is no boundedness, flatness, quasi-coherence or perfectness hypothesis on `E` or `K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedPullback_map_projectionFormulaMap
    [SheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion g'] [SheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion g]
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)))
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y)))
    (h : IsIso (projectionFormulaMap f' ((derivedPullback g').obj E)
      ((derivedPullback g).obj K))) :
    IsIso ((derivedPullback g).map (projectionFormulaMap f E K))
declarations.comment: the localization step of the source's proof: for a Cartesian square of ringed spaces whose horizontal arrows are open immersions, invertibility of the projection-formula map for f' at the restricted complexes implies invertibility of the derived pullback along g of the map for f; unconditional in both complexes, but only one implication of the source's reduction — the affine case and the passage from an open cover back to the base are not proved

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ProjectionFormulaQCoh.isIso_projectionFormulaMap_of_isDQCoh
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08EU].**  For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes
