    [X.J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{0}]
    [∀ U : X.C, HasSheafify (X.J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{0}]
    [∀ U : X.C, (X.J.over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{0}]
    [∀ U : X.C, (X.J.over U).HasSheafCompose (forget₂ RingCat.{0} AddCommGrpCat.{0})]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{d} (SheafOfModules.{0} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))]
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{0} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))) (m : ℤ)
    (hK : X.IsPseudoCoherentFrom K m)
    (hvanish : ∀ i : ℤ, m + 1 < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{0} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)) i).obj K)) :
    ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{0} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)) (m + 1)).obj
        K).IsFinitePresentation
declarations.comment: finite_presentation_top_cohomology

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.HasTorAmplitude
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08FZ (1).** An object `E` of `D(O)` has *Tor amplitude in `[a, b]`* for the derived
tensor product `T` if, for every sheaf of `O`-modules `F`, the derived tensor product of `E`
with `F` placed in degree zero has vanishing cohomology in every degree outside `[a, b]`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def HasTorAmplitude
    (T : DerivedTensorProduct.{u, v, w, d} X) (E : RingedSite.DerivedModules.{u, v, w, d} X)
    (a b : ℤ) : Prop
declarations.comment: tor amplitude in an interval

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.HasFiniteTorDimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08FZ (2).** An object `E` of `D(O)` has *finite Tor dimension* for the derived
tensor product `T` if it has Tor amplitude in some interval.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def HasFiniteTorDimension (T : DerivedTensorProduct.{u, v, w, d} X)
    (E : RingedSite.DerivedModules.{u, v, w, d} X) : Prop
declarations.comment: finite tor dimension

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.HasTorDimensionLE
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08FZ, the last sentence.** A sheaf of `O`-modules `F` has *Tor dimension at most
`n`* when `F[0]`, viewed as an object of `D(O)`, has Tor amplitude in `[-n, 0]`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def HasTorDimensionLE (T : DerivedTensorProduct.{u, v, w, d} X)
    (F : RingedSite.Modules.{u, v, w} X) (n : ℤ) : Prop
declarations.comment: tor dimension of a module

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.hasTorAmplitude_of_coversTop
declarations.doc:
**Tor amplitude in a fixed interval descends along a covering family.** Let `V : ι → C` be a
family of objects covering the final object of the site. If the restriction of `E` to the
localized ringed site at each `V i` has Tor amplitude in `[a, b]`, measured against the derived
tensor product `T' (V i)` on that slice, then `E` has Tor amplitude in `[a, b]` for `T`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasTorAmplitude_of_coversTop
    (T : DerivedTensorProduct.{c, u, u, d} X)
    (T' : ∀ U : X.C, DerivedTensorProduct.{max c u, u, u, d} (X.over U))
    {ι : Type t} {V : ι → X.C} (hV : X.J.CoversTop V)
    (E : RingedSite.DerivedModules.{c, u, u, d} X) (a b : ℤ)
    (hamp : ∀ i, HasTorAmplitude (T' (V i))
      ((RingedSite.derivedRestriction.{c, u, u, d} X (V i)).obj E) a b) :
    HasTorAmplitude T E a b
declarations.comment: the descent of tor amplitude in a fixed interval from a covering family to the object covered

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.hasFiniteTorDimension_of_locallyHasFiniteTorDimension
declarations.doc:
**On a quasi-compact site, locally finite Tor dimension is finite Tor dimension.** If the
site has a terminal object which is quasi-compact in the sense of Stacks 090H and `E` locally has
finite Tor dimension, then `E` has finite Tor dimension.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteTorDimension_of_locallyHasFiniteTorDimension
    (T : DerivedTensorProduct.{c, u, u, d} X)
    (T' : ∀ U : X.C, DerivedTensorProduct.{max c u, u, u, d} (X.over U))
    (E : RingedSite.DerivedModules.{c, u, u, d} X)
    (hE : LocallyHasFiniteTorDimension T' E)
    (U : X.C) (hU : IsTerminal U) (hqc : X.J.IsQuasiCompactObject U) :
    HasFiniteTorDimension T E
declarations.comment: on a quasi-compact site, locally finite tor dimension is finite tor dimension

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.LocallyHasFiniteTorDimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08FZ (3).** An object `E` of `D(O)` *locally has finite Tor dimension* if every
object `U` of `C` carries a covering family on each member `V` of which the restriction of `E` to
the localized ringed site has finite Tor dimension. Finite Tor dimension on the slice over `V`
is measured against the given derived tensor product `T V` on that slice.
declarations.statement:
def LocallyHasFiniteTorDimension
    (T : ∀ U : X.C, DerivedTensorProduct.{max u v, v, w, d} (X.over U))
    (E : RingedSite.DerivedModules.{u, v, w, d} X) : Prop
declarations.comment: locally finite tor dimension

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.isFlat_cokernel_of_hasTorAmplitude
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08G0.** The cokernel of the differential into the lowest degree of the
Tor-amplitude interval of a bounded above complex of flat `O`-modules is a flat `O`-module.

The complex is K-flat by Stacks 06YQ, so the Tor-amplitude hypothesis makes the three-term
complex `K^{a-2} ⊗ F ⟶ K^{a-1} ⊗ F ⟶ K^a ⊗ F` exact for every `O`-module `F`. Hence
`Coker(d^{a-1}) ⊗ -` preserves monomorphisms, and being right exact as well it is exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFlat_cokernel_of_hasTorAmplitude (T : DerivedTensorProduct.{u, v, w, d} X)
    (K : CochainComplex (RingedSite.Modules.{u, v, w} X) ℤ) (a b : ℤ)
    (hbound : ∃ n : ℤ, K.IsStrictlyLE n)
    (hflat : ∀ i : ℤ,
      AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{v, u, w, w} (O := X.O) (K.X i))
    (hamp : HasTorAmplitude T (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) a b) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{v, u, w, w} (O := X.O)
      (cokernel (K.d (a - 1) a))
declarations.comment: variant: Tor amplitude measured against a derived tensor product datum `T` on D(O); the tag is Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.isFlat_cokernel_of_hasTorAmplitude_canonical

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.isFlat_cokernel_of_hasTorAmplitude_canonical
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08G0, for the derived tensor product of the site.** Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site
and let `K` be a bounded above complex of flat `O`-modules which, as an object of `D(O)`, has
Tor amplitude in `[a, b]` for the derived tensor product
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.canonicalDerivedTensorProduct` of Stacks 06YU. Then the cokernel of the
differential `K^{a-1} ⟶ K^a` is a flat `O`-module.

No derived tensor product datum is supplied: the one Tor amplitude is measured against is the
one Stacks 06YU constructs.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFlat_cokernel_of_hasTorAmplitude_canonical
    (K : CochainComplex (RingedSite.Modules.{u, u, u} X) ℤ) (a b : ℤ)
    (hbound : ∃ n : ℤ, K.IsStrictlyLE n)
    (hflat : ∀ i : ℤ,
      AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{u, u, u, u} (O := X.O) (K.X i)) :
    letI : HasSheafify X.J AddCommGrpCat.{u} := inferInstance
    letI : X.J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u} := inferInstance
    letI := Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor_obj_additive.{u, u, u, u, u} X.O
    HasTorAmplitude (Stacks.SheafOfModules.canonicalDerivedTensorProduct.{u, u, d} X)
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) a b →
      AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{u, u, u, u} (O := X.O)
        (cokernel (K.d (a - 1) a))

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.hasTorAmplitude_iff_exists_flatRepresentative
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08G1.** An object of `D(O)` has Tor amplitude in `[a, b]` exactly when some complex
of flat `O`-modules vanishing in every degree outside `[a, b]` represents it.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasTorAmplitude_iff_exists_flatRepresentative
    (T : DerivedTensorProduct.{u, v, w, d} Y)
    (E : RingedSite.DerivedModules.{u, v, w, d} Y) (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    HasTorAmplitude T E a b ↔
      ∃ K : CochainComplex (RingedSite.Modules.{u, v, w} Y) ℤ,
        (∀ i : ℤ, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{v, u, w, w}
          (O := Y.O) (K.X i)) ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, i ∉ Set.Icc a b → IsZero (K.X i)) ∧
        Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K ≅ E)

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.hasTorAmplitude_canonical_iff_exists_flatRepresentative
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08G1, for the derived tensor product of the site.** An object of `D(O)` has Tor
amplitude in `[a, b]`, measured against the derived tensor product
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.canonicalDerivedTensorProduct` of Stacks 06YU, exactly when some
complex of flat `O`-modules vanishing in every degree outside `[a, b]` represents it.

No derived tensor product datum is assumed: the one the statement speaks of is the one Stacks
06YU constructs.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasTorAmplitude_canonical_iff_exists_flatRepresentative
    (E : RingedSite.DerivedModules.{u, u, u, d} X) (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    letI : HasSheafify X.J AddCommGrpCat.{u} := inferInstance
    letI : X.J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u} := inferInstance
    letI := Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor_obj_additive.{u, u, u, u, u} X.O
    HasTorAmplitude (Stacks.SheafOfModules.canonicalDerivedTensorProduct.{u, u, d} X) E a b ↔
      ∃ K : CochainComplex (RingedSite.Modules.{u, u, u} X) ℤ,
        (∀ i : ℤ, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{u, u, u, u}
          (O := X.O) (K.X i)) ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, i ∉ Set.Icc a b → IsZero (K.X i)) ∧
        Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K ≅ E)
declarations.comment: for the derived tensor product of the site, with no datum assumed

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.hasTorAmplitude_obj₃
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08G2 (1).** In a distinguished triangle `K ⟶ L ⟶ M ⟶ K[1]` of `D(O)`, if `K` has
Tor amplitude in `[a + 1, b + 1]` and `L` has Tor amplitude in `[a, b]`, then `M` has Tor
amplitude in `[a, b]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasTorAmplitude_obj₃
    (tri : Triangle (RingedSite.DerivedModules.{u, v, w, d} X))
    (htri : tri ∈ distinguishedTriangles) (a b : ℤ)
    (hK : HasTorAmplitude T tri.obj₁ (a + 1) (b + 1))
    (hL : HasTorAmplitude T tri.obj₂ a b) :
    HasTorAmplitude T tri.obj₃ a b

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.hasTorAmplitude_obj₂
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08G2 (2).** In a distinguished triangle `K ⟶ L ⟶ M ⟶ K[1]` of `D(O)`, if `K` and
`M` both have Tor amplitude in `[a, b]`, then so does `L`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasTorAmplitude_obj₂
    (tri : Triangle (RingedSite.DerivedModules.{u, v, w, d} X))
    (htri : tri ∈ distinguishedTriangles) (a b : ℤ)
    (hK : HasTorAmplitude T tri.obj₁ a b)
    (hM : HasTorAmplitude T tri.obj₃ a b) :
    HasTorAmplitude T tri.obj₂ a b

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.hasTorAmplitude_obj₁
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08G2 (3).** In a distinguished triangle `K ⟶ L ⟶ M ⟶ K[1]` of `D(O)`, if `L` has
Tor amplitude in `[a + 1, b + 1]` and `M` has Tor amplitude in `[a, b]`, then `K` has Tor
amplitude in `[a + 1, b + 1]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasTorAmplitude_obj₁
    (tri : Triangle (RingedSite.DerivedModules.{u, v, w, d} X))
    (htri : tri ∈ distinguishedTriangles) (a b : ℤ)
    (hL : HasTorAmplitude T tri.obj₂ (a + 1) (b + 1))
    (hM : HasTorAmplitude T tri.obj₃ a b) :
    HasTorAmplitude T tri.obj₁ (a + 1) (b + 1)

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.hasTorAmplitude_of_biprod
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08G3.** If the direct sum `K ⊕ L` of two objects of `D(O)` has Tor amplitude in
`[a, b]`, then both `K` and `L` have Tor amplitude in `[a, b]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasTorAmplitude_of_biprod (K L : RingedSite.DerivedModules.{u, v, w, d} X) (a b : ℤ)
    (h : HasTorAmplitude T (K ⊞ L) a b) :
    HasTorAmplitude T K a b ∧ HasTorAmplitude T L a b

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.IsPerfectComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08G5, perfect complexes.** A complex `E` of `O`-modules is *perfect* if every
object `U` of the site admits a covering `{V → U}` over each member of which there are a
strictly perfect complex `P` of `O|_V`-modules and a quasi-isomorphism `P ⟶ E|_V`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def IsPerfectComplex
    (E : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{m} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)) ℤ) :
    Prop
declarations.comment: perfect complexes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.IsPerfect
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08G5, perfect objects of the derived category.** An object of `D(O)` is *perfect*
if it is isomorphic to the image of a perfect complex.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def IsPerfect
    [HasDerivedCategory.{d} (SheafOfModules.{m} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))]
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{m} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))) :
    Prop
declarations.comment: perfect derived-category objects

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.isPerfect_of_coveringFamily_strictlyPerfect
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08G6, part (1).** Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site whose underlying category has a
final object `T` and let `E` be an object of `D(O)`. If there are a covering `{V → T}`, strictly
perfect complexes `P_V` of `O|_V`-modules and isomorphisms `P_V ≅ E|_V` in `D(O|_V)`, then `E` is
perfect.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_of_coveringFamily_strictlyPerfect
    (T : X.C) (hT : IsTerminal T)
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)))
    (h : ∃ S : Presieve T, Sieve.generate S ∈ X.J T ∧
      ∀ ⦃V : X.C⦄ (f : V ⟶ T), S f →
        ∃ P : CochainComplex
            (SheafOfModules.{w} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O).over V)) ℤ,
          IsStrictlyPerfect ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O).over V) P ∧
            Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅
              (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)
                V).mapDerivedCategory.obj E)) :
    X.IsPerfect E
declarations.comment: local_strictly_perfect_implies_perfect

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.isPerfect_of_coveringFamily_strictlyPerfect_general
declarations.doc:
Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site whose underlying category has a final object `T` and let `E` be
an object of `D(O)`. If there are a covering `{V → T}`, strictly perfect complexes `P_V` of
`O|_V`-modules and isomorphisms `P_V ≅ E|_V` in `D(O|_V)`, then `E` is perfect.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_of_coveringFamily_strictlyPerfect_general
    (T : X.C) (hT : IsTerminal T)
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{w}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf.{u, v, w} X.O)))
    (h : ∃ S : Presieve T, Sieve.generate S ∈ X.J T ∧
      ∀ ⦃V : X.C⦄ (f : V ⟶ T), S f →
        ∃ P : CochainComplex
            (SheafOfModules.{w} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf.{u, v, w} X.O).over V)) ℤ,
          IsStrictlyPerfect ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf.{u, v, w} X.O).over V) P ∧
            Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅
              (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf.{u, v, w} X.O)
                V).mapDerivedCategory.obj E)) :
    X.IsPerfect E
declarations.comment: local_strictly_perfect_implies_perfect

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.isPerfectComplex_of_isPerfect_representation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08G6, part (2).** Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site and let `K` be a perfect object of
`D(O)`. Then every complex of `O`-modules representing `K` is a perfect complex.
declarations.comment: perfect_independent_of_representative

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.torAmplitudePerfectnessCriterion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08G7.** Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site and let `T` be a derived tensor product on
`D(O)`. An object of `D(O)` with Tor amplitude in `[a, b]` for `T`, with `a ≤ b`, which is
`(a - 1)`-pseudo-coherent, is perfect.

The proof reads Tor amplitude on each slice `(C/U, O|_U)`, which needs a derived tensor product
there; that is the derived tensor product of Stacks 06YU,
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.canonicalDerivedTensorProduct`, which exists on each slice under the
hypotheses already in force, so it is not a parameter of the statement.
declarations.statement:
theorem torAmplitudePerfectnessCriterion
    (T : DerivedTensorProduct.{0, 0, 0, d} Z) :
    TorAmplitudePerfectnessCriterion T

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.isPerfect_iff_isPseudoCoherent_and_locallyHasFiniteTorDimension
declarations.doc:
Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site. An object of `D(O)` is perfect if and only if it is
pseudo-coherent and locally has finite Tor dimension, measured on each slice `(C/U, O|_U)` against
the derived tensor product `Stacks.SheafOfModules.canonicalDerivedTensorProduct`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_iff_isPseudoCoherent_and_locallyHasFiniteTorDimension
    (E : RingedSite.DerivedModules.{0, 0, 0, d} Z) :
    Z.IsPerfect E ↔ Z.IsPseudoCoherent E ∧
      LocallyHasFiniteTorDimension
        (fun U : Z.C => canonicalDerivedTensorProduct.{0, 0, d} (Z.over U)) E

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.TorAmplitude.hasFiniteTorDimension_of_ringedSite_isPerfect
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08G8 globally, on a quasi-compact ringed space.** An object of `D(O_X)` which is
perfect for the site of opens of `X` has finite Tor dimension against any derived tensor product
datum of Stacks 06YU on that site.

Perfectness is transported to the ringed-space spelling by
`Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.isPerfect_of_ringedSite`, which is what makes the
Tor-amplitude machinery applicable; `locallyHasFiniteTorDimension_of_isPerfect` then supplies the
local intervals, quasi-compactness makes them one interval, and the bridge reads it against
`T`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFiniteTorDimension_of_ringedSite_isPerfect [CompactSpace X.carrier]
    (T : Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.{u, u, u, d}
      (AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.ringedSite X))
    (E : DerivedCategory (OXMod.{u, u} X))
    (hE : (AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.ringedSite X).IsPerfect E) :
    Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.HasFiniteTorDimension
      (X := AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.ringedSite X) T E
declarations.comment: a perfect object has finite tor dimension, globally on a quasi-compact space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.isPerfect_obj₃_of_distinguished
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08G9, third object.** In a distinguished triangle of `D(O)`, the third object is
perfect if the first two are.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_obj₃_of_distinguished
    (T : Triangle
      (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{0} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))))
    (hT : T ∈ distinguishedTriangles)
    (h₁ : X.IsPerfect T.obj₁) (h₂ : X.IsPerfect T.obj₂) :
    X.IsPerfect T.obj₃
declarations.comment: third object

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.isPerfect_obj₂_of_distinguished
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08G9, second object.** In a distinguished triangle of `D(O)`, the second object is
perfect if the other two are.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_obj₂_of_distinguished
    (T : Triangle
      (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{0} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))))
    (hT : T ∈ distinguishedTriangles)
    (h₁ : X.IsPerfect T.obj₁) (h₃ : X.IsPerfect T.obj₃) :
    X.IsPerfect T.obj₂
declarations.comment: second object

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.isPerfect_obj₁_of_distinguished
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08G9, first object.** In a distinguished triangle of `D(O)`, the first object is
perfect if the other two are.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_obj₁_of_distinguished
    (T : Triangle
      (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{0} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))))
    (hT : T ∈ distinguishedTriangles)
    (h₂ : X.IsPerfect T.obj₂) (h₃ : X.IsPerfect T.obj₃) :
    X.IsPerfect T.obj₁
declarations.comment: first object

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.isPerfect_left_of_biprod
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GA.** Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site and let `K` and `L` be objects of `D(O)`. If
`K ⊞ L` is perfect, then so is `K`.

By Stacks 08G8 the biproduct is pseudo-coherent and locally has finite Tor dimension; Stacks
08FW gives the first condition for `K` and Stacks 08G3 the second, and Stacks 08G8 read
backwards gives perfectness. Stacks 08G8 is read against the derived tensor product of Stacks
06YU on the slices and on the iterated slices; neither occurs in the statement.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_left_of_biprod
    (K L : RingedSite.DerivedModules.{0, 0, 0, d} Z) (h : Z.IsPerfect (K ⊞ L)) :
    Z.IsPerfect K
declarations.comment: first summand

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.isPerfect_right_of_biprod
declarations.doc: **Stacks 08GA.** If `K ⊞ L` is perfect, then so is `L`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_right_of_biprod
    (K L : RingedSite.DerivedModules.{0, 0, 0, d} Z) (h : Z.IsPerfect (K ⊞ L)) :
    Z.IsPerfect L
declarations.comment: second summand

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineHom_of_isAffineHom_comp_of_isAffineHom_diagonal
declarations.doc:
Let `X ⟶ Y ⟶ T` be morphisms of presheaves on the big fppf site of `S`. If the composite
`X ⟶ T` is affine and the relative diagonal of `Y ⟶ T` is affine, then `X ⟶ Y` is affine.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffineHom_of_isAffineHom_comp_of_isAffineHom_diagonal
    {X Y T : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ T)
    (hfg : IsAffineHom B S hS (f ≫ g))
    (hΔ : IsAffineHom B S hS (pullback.diagonal g)) :
    IsAffineHom B S hS f
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineHom_of_isAffineHom_comp_of_isSeparated
declarations.doc:
Let `X ⟶ Y ⟶ T` be morphisms of presheaves on the big fppf site of `S`. If the composite
`X ⟶ T` is affine and `Y ⟶ T` is separated, then `X ⟶ Y` is affine.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffineHom_of_isAffineHom_comp_of_isSeparated
    {X Y T : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ T)
    (hfg : IsAffineHom B S hS (f ≫ g)) (hg : IsSeparated B S hS g) :
    IsAffineHom B S hS f
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineHom_of_affine_source_of_isAffineHom_diag
declarations.doc:
A morphism from an affine object of the big fppf site of `S` to a presheaf whose absolute
diagonal, in the sense of Stacks 03BS, is affine is affine.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffineHom_of_affine_source_of_isAffineHom_diag
    {Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (X : BigAffineFppf B S hS)
    (f : yoneda.obj ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj X) ⟶ Y)
    (hΔ : IsAffineHom B (⊤_ Scheme.{u}) hZ (diag (viewOverIntegers B S hS hZ Y))) :
    IsAffineHom B S hS f
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineHom_of_affine_source_of_isAbsolutelySeparated
declarations.doc:
A morphism from an affine object of the big fppf site of `S` to a separated algebraic space,
in the absolute sense of Stacks 03BS, is affine: its absolute diagonal is a closed immersion,
hence affine by Stacks 07U2.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffineHom_of_affine_source_of_isAbsolutelySeparated
    {Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (X : BigAffineFppf B S hS)
    (f : yoneda.obj ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj X) ⟶ Y)
    (hsep : IsAbsolutelySeparated B S hS hZ Y) :
    IsAffineHom B S hS f
declarations.comment: part (4)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCoherent_higherDirectImage_of_hasProperSupport
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GC.**  Let `S` be a scheme, let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces
over `S` which is locally of finite type with `Y` locally Noetherian, and let `𝓕` be a coherent
`𝒪_X`-module whose support is proper over `Y`.  Then `R^p f_*𝓕` is a coherent `𝒪_Y`-module for
every `p`.

By `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_closedSubspace_higherDirectImage_iso`,
`R^p f_*𝓕 ≅ R^p (i ≫ f)_*𝓖` for a closed subspace `i : Z → X` proper over `Y` and a coherent
`𝒪_Z`-module `𝓖`; that is coherent by Stacks 08AR.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherent_higherDirectImage_of_hasProperSupport (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f.hom)
    (hY : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y.1 (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hF : IsCoherent B S hS X.1 X.2 F)
    (hsupp : HasProperSupport B S hS X.2 Y.2 f.hom hf ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj F))
    (p : ℕ) :
    have := hasInjectiveResolutions_modules B S hS X.1 X.2
    IsCoherent B S hS Y.1 Y.2 (((modulePushforward B S hS f).rightDerived p).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCoherent_rightDerived_modulePushforward_of_properSupport
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is locally of finite type,
with `Y` locally Noetherian, and let `𝓕` be a coherent `𝒪_X`-module with support proper over
`Y`. Then `R^p f_*𝓕` is a coherent `𝒪_Y`-module for every `p`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherent_rightDerived_modulePushforward_of_properSupport
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f.hom)
    (hY : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y.1 (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hF : IsCoherent B S hS X.1 X.2 F)
    (hsupp : HasProperSupport B S hS X.2 Y.2 f.hom hf ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj F))
    (p : ℕ) :
    have := hasInjectiveResolutions_modules B S hS X.1 X.2
    IsCoherent B S hS Y.1 Y.2 (((modulePushforward B S hS f).rightDerived p).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedModulePushforwardEtaleRestrictIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GE.**  Let `S` be a scheme, let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over
`S`, let `g : Y' ⟶ Y` be an étale morphism, set `X' = Y' ×_Y X` and let `f' : X' ⟶ Y'` be the
projection.  Then restricting the unbounded derived direct image along `g` agrees with taking the
derived direct image along `f'` after restricting along `i`:
`(Rf_*E)|_{Y'} ≅ Rf'_*(E|_{X'})` for `E` in `D(𝒪_X)`.

The four derived functors are arbitrary choices equipped with their canonical units, so the
result applies in particular to the standard `Rf_*` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasRightDerivedFunctor_modulePushforward` and to the exact restriction
functors.  Extension by zero along `i` enters as data, for the reason recorded in the
implementation notes of this file and in Stacks 08HA; it is the only such input, because on the
`Rf ⋙ Rg` side exactness of restriction along `g` already makes the comparison invertible.
declarations.statement:
def derivedModulePushforwardEtaleRestrictIso (sq : IsPullback i f' f g)
    (hg : IsEtale B S hS g.hom)
    {iShriek : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X'.1 X'.2 ⥤ Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2}
    (adji : iShriek ⊣ etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS i
      (isEtale_of_isPullback B S hS f' i g f sq.flip hg))
    [iShriek.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits iShriek] [PreservesFiniteColimits iShriek]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X'.1 X'.2)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y'.1 Y'.2)]
    (Rf : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2))
    (Rf' : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X'.1 X'.2) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y'.1 Y'.2))
    (Ri : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X'.1 X'.2))
    (Rg : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y'.1 Y'.2))
    (αf : (modulePushforward B S hS f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ Rf)
    (αf' : (modulePushforward B S hS f').mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ Rf')
    (αi : (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS i
          (isEtale_of_isPullback B S hS f' i g f sq.flip hg)).mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ Ri)
    (αg : (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS g hg).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ Rg)
    [Rf.IsRightDerivedFunctor αf
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [Rf'.IsRightDerivedFunctor αf'
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X'.1 X'.2) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [Ri.IsRightDerivedFunctor αi
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [Rg.IsRightDerivedFunctor αg
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))] :
    Rf ⋙ Rg ≅ Ri ⋙ Rf'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedModulePushforwardEtaleRestrictIsoOfIsEtale
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme, let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`, let
`g : Y' ⟶ Y` be an étale morphism, set `X' = Y' ×_Y X` (the square `sq` is cartesian) and let
`f' : X' ⟶ Y'` be the projection. Then `(Rf_*E)|_{Y'} ≅ Rf'_*(E|_{X'})` naturally in `E ∈ D(𝒪_X)`,
where `Rf`, `Rf'`, `Ri` and `Rg` are any right derived functors of the direct images along `f`,
`f'` and of the restrictions along `i`, `g`, with units `αf`, `αf'`, `αi` and `αg`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedModulePushforwardEtaleRestrictIsoOfIsEtale (sq : IsPullback i f' f g)
    (hg : IsEtale B S hS g.hom)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X'.1 X'.2)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y'.1 Y'.2)]
    (Rf : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2))
    (Rf' : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X'.1 X'.2) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y'.1 Y'.2))
    (Ri : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X'.1 X'.2))
    (Rg : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y'.1 Y'.2))
    (αf : (modulePushforward B S hS f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ Rf)
    (αf' : (modulePushforward B S hS f').mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ Rf')
    (αi : (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS i
          (isEtale_of_isPullback B S hS f' i g f sq.flip hg)).mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ Ri)
    (αg : (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS g hg).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ Rg)
    [Rf.IsRightDerivedFunctor αf
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [Rf'.IsRightDerivedFunctor αf'
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X'.1 X'.2) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [Ri.IsRightDerivedFunctor αi
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [Rg.IsRightDerivedFunctor αg
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))] :
    Rf ⋙ Rg ≅ Ri ⋙ Rf'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GF.** An object `E` of `D(𝒪_F)` is *supported on* a subset `T` of `|F|` when
every one of its cohomology sheaves `Hⁱ(E)` is supported on `T`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev CohomologySupportedOn
    [HasSheafify (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS F hF).J AddCommGrpCat.{m}]
    [(smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS F hF).J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{m}]
    (T : Set (points B S hS F))
    (E : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, m} B S hS F hF)) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_edsEtaleDerivedAdjunction_unit_app_of_cohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GG, clause (2)(a).**  Let `(U ⊆ X, j : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary distinguished
square of algebraic spaces and `T = |X| \ |U|`.  For an object `F` of `D(𝒪_V)` supported on
`j^{-1}T` the unit `F ⟶ (j_!F)|_V` of the derived adjunction `j_! ⊣ (-)|_V` is an
isomorphism.

Both functors are exact, so on cohomology the derived unit is the unit at `Hⁱ(F)`, which is an
isomorphism by the stalk computation of Equation 08GU, the square having exactly one lift of
each geometric point over `T`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_edsEtaleDerivedAdjunction_unit_app_of_cohomologySupportedOn
    (F : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1 (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2))
    (hF : CohomologySupportedOn B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1 (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2
      (edsEtalePreimageComplementPoints B S hS hsq) F) :
    IsIso ((edsEtaleDerivedAdjunction B S hS hsq).unit.app F)
declarations.comment: clause (2)(a): F ⟶ (j_!F)|_V is an isomorphism for F supported on j^{-1}T

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_derivedCounit_edsEtale_of_cohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
Let `(U ⊆ X, j : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary distinguished square of algebraic spaces over a
scheme `S` and set `T = |X| \ |U|`.  For `E` in `D(𝒪_X)` supported on `T`, the counit
`j_!(E|_V) ⟶ E` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedCounit_edsEtale_of_cohomologySupportedOn
    (E : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2))
    (hE : CohomologySupportedOn B S hS W.1 W.2 (edsComplementPoints B S hS Uo) E) :
    IsIso ((NatTrans.mapDerivedCategory (edsEtaleShriekAdjunction B S hS hsq).counit).app E)
declarations.comment:
clause (1)(b): the derived counit j_!(E|_V) ⟶ E is an isomorphism for E in D(O_X)
supported on T = |X| \ |U|, unconditionally

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_derivedUnit_edsEtale_of_cohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
Let `(U ⊆ X, j : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary distinguished square of algebraic spaces over a
scheme `S` and set `T = |X| \ |U|`.  For `F` in `D(𝒪_V)` supported on `j⁻¹T`, the unit
`F ⟶ (j_!F)|_V` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedUnit_edsEtale_of_cohomologySupportedOn
    (F : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1 (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2))
    (hF : CohomologySupportedOn B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1 (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2
      (edsEtalePreimageComplementPoints B S hS hsq) F) :
    IsIso ((Adjunction.mapDerivedCategory (edsEtaleShriekAdjunction B S hS hsq)).unit.app F)
declarations.comment:
clause (2)(a): the unit F ⟶ (j_!F)|_V is an isomorphism for F in D(O_V) supported
on j^{-1}T, unconditionally

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_derivedUnit_edsDerivedRestrictPushEtale_of_cohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
Let `(U ⊆ X, j : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary distinguished square of algebraic spaces over a
scheme `S` and set `T = |X| \ |U|`. For an object `E` of `D(𝒪_X)` supported on `T`, the
canonical map `E ⟶ Rj_{V,*}(E|_V)` into the chosen total right derived direct image is an
isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedUnit_edsDerivedRestrictPushEtale_of_cohomologySupportedOn
    (E : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2))
    (hE : CohomologySupportedOn B S hS W.1 W.2 (edsComplementPoints B S hS Uo) E) :
    IsIso ((derivedUnitOfNatTrans (edsAdjEtale B S hS hsq).unit
      (edsDerivedRestrictPushEtale B S hS hsq)
      (edsTotalRightDerivedUnitEtale B S hS hsq)).app E)
declarations.comment: clause (1)(a): the canonical map E ⟶ Rj_*(E|_V) is an isomorphism for E supported on |X| \ |U|, at the chosen total right derived functors

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_unit_derivedRestrict_of_cohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
Let `(U ⊆ X, j : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary distinguished square of algebraic spaces over a
scheme `S` and set `T = |X| \ |U|`.  Let `Rj_*` be a right adjoint of derived restriction
`(-)|_V : D(𝒪_X) ⥤ D(𝒪_V)`.  If `E` in `D(𝒪_X)` is supported on `T`, then the unit
`E ⟶ Rj_*(E|_V)` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_unit_derivedRestrict_of_cohomologySupportedOn
    {RpushD : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1
        (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2) ⥤ DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2)}
    (adjPush : (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
      (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ RpushD)
    (E : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2))
    (hE : CohomologySupportedOn B S hS W.1 W.2 (edsComplementPoints B S hS Uo) E) :
    IsIso (adjPush.unit.app E)
declarations.comment:
clause (1)(a): for E in D(O_X) supported on T = |X| \ |U| the map
E ⟶ Rj_*(E|_V), the unit of the adjunction between derived restriction and the derived direct
image, is an isomorphism. Rj_* is any right adjoint of derived restriction, which pins it and its
unit; a total right derived functor of j_* is one, by
etaleModulePullbackDerivedPushforwardAdjunction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_counit_derivedRestrict_of_cohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
Let `(U ⊆ X, j : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary distinguished square of algebraic spaces over a
scheme `S` and set `T = |X| \ |U|`.  Let `j_!` be a left adjoint of derived restriction
`(-)|_V : D(𝒪_X) ⥤ D(𝒪_V)`.  If `E` in `D(𝒪_X)` is supported on `T`, then the counit
`j_!(E|_V) ⟶ E` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_counit_derivedRestrict_of_cohomologySupportedOn
    {shriekD : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1
        (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2) ⥤ DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2)}
    (adjShriek : shriekD ⊣ (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
      (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory)
    (E : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2))
    (hE : CohomologySupportedOn B S hS W.1 W.2 (edsComplementPoints B S hS Uo) E) :
    IsIso (adjShriek.counit.app E)
declarations.comment:
clause (1)(b): for E in D(O_X) supported on T = |X| \ |U| the map
j_!(E|_V) ⟶ E, the counit of the adjunction between derived extension by zero and derived
restriction, is an isomorphism. j_! is any left adjoint of derived restriction, which pins it and
its counit; the derived functor of etaleModuleLowerShriek is one

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_unit_derivedShriek_of_cohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
Let `(U ⊆ X, j : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary distinguished square of algebraic spaces over a
scheme `S` and set `T = |X| \ |U|`.  Let `j_!` be a left adjoint of derived restriction
`(-)|_V : D(𝒪_X) ⥤ D(𝒪_V)`.  If `F` in `D(𝒪_V)` is supported on `j^{-1}T`, then the unit
`F ⟶ (j_!F)|_V` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_unit_derivedShriek_of_cohomologySupportedOn
    {shriekD : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1
        (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2) ⥤ DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2)}
    (adjShriek : shriekD ⊣ (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
      (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory)
    (F : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1
      (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2))
    (hF : CohomologySupportedOn B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1 (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2
      (edsEtalePreimageComplementPoints B S hS hsq) F) :
    IsIso (adjShriek.unit.app F)
declarations.comment:
clause (2)(a): for F in D(O_V) supported on the preimage of T = |X| \ |U| the map
F ⟶ (j_!F)|_V, the unit of the adjunction between derived extension by zero and derived
restriction, is an isomorphism. j_! is any left adjoint of derived restriction, which pins it and
its unit; the derived functor of etaleModuleLowerShriek is one

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_counit_derivedPushforward_of_cohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
Let `(U ⊆ X, j : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary distinguished square of algebraic spaces over a
scheme `S` and set `T = |X| \ |U|`.  Let `Rj_*` be a right adjoint of derived restriction
`(-)|_V : D(𝒪_X) ⥤ D(𝒪_V)`.  If `F` in `D(𝒪_V)` is supported on `j^{-1}T`, then the counit
`(Rj_*F)|_V ⟶ F` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_counit_derivedPushforward_of_cohomologySupportedOn
    {RpushD : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1
        (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2) ⥤ DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2)}
    (adjPush : (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
      (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ RpushD)
    (F : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1
      (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2))
    (hF : CohomologySupportedOn B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1 (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2
      (edsEtalePreimageComplementPoints B S hS hsq) F) :
    IsIso (adjPush.counit.app F)
declarations.comment:
clause (2)(b): for F in D(O_V) supported on the preimage of T = |X| \ |U| the
map (Rj_*F)|_V ⟶ F, the counit of the adjunction between derived restriction and the derived
direct image, is an isomorphism. Rj_* is any right adjoint of derived restriction, which pins it
and its counit; a total right derived functor of j_* is one, by
etaleModulePullbackDerivedPushforwardAdjunction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_supportedShriekToPushforward_of_supported
declarations.doc:
Let `(U ⊆ X, j : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary distinguished square of algebraic spaces over a
scheme `S` and set `T = |X| \ |U|`.  Let `j_!` and `Rj_*` be a left and a right adjoint of
derived restriction `(-)|_V : D(𝒪_X) ⥤ D(𝒪_V)`.  If `F` in `D(𝒪_V)` is supported on `j^{-1}T`,
then the comparison `j_!F ⟶ Rj_*F` (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.supportedShriekToPushforward`) is
an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_supportedShriekToPushforward_of_supported
    {shriekD RpushD : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1
        (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2) ⥤ DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2)}
    (adjShriek : shriekD ⊣ (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
      (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory)
    (adjPush : (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
      (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ RpushD)
    (F : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1
      (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2))
    (hF : CohomologySupportedOn B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1 (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2
      (edsEtalePreimageComplementPoints B S hS hsq) F) :
    IsIso (supportedShriekToPushforward B S hS hsq adjShriek adjPush F
      (isIso_unit_derivedShriek_of_cohomologySupportedOn B S hS hsq adjShriek F hF))
declarations.comment:
clause (2)(c): for F in D(O_V) supported on the preimage of T = |X| \ |U| the
comparison j_!F ⟶ Rj_*F is an isomorphism. The comparison is supportedShriekToPushforward, the
adjunct under derived restriction ⊣ Rj_* of the inverse of the unit F ⟶ (j_!F)|_V, which is
invertible by clause (2)(a), isIso_unit_derivedShriek_of_cohomologySupportedOn. j_! and Rj_* are
any left and right adjoints of derived restriction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_of_cohomologySupportedOn_edsEtale
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme, let `(U ⊆ X, j : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary distinguished square of
algebraic spaces over `S` and set `T = |X| \ |U|`.  Let `j_!` and `Rj_*` be a left and a right
adjoint of derived restriction `(-)|_V : D(𝒪_X) ⥤ D(𝒪_V)`.

1. If `E` in `D(𝒪_X)` is supported on `T`, then (a) `E ⟶ Rj_*(E|_V)` and (b) `j_!(E|_V) ⟶ E`
   are isomorphisms.
2. If `F` in `D(𝒪_V)` is supported on `j^{-1}T`, then (a) `F ⟶ (j_!F)|_V`, (b)
   `(Rj_*F)|_V ⟶ F` and (c) `j_!F ⟶ Rj_*F` are isomorphisms.

The maps of (1)(a), (1)(b), (2)(a), (2)(b) are the units and counits of the two adjunctions,
and the map of (2)(c) is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.supportedShriekToPushforward`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_of_cohomologySupportedOn_edsEtale
    {shriekD RpushD : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1
        (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2) ⥤ DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2)}
    (adjShriek : shriekD ⊣ (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
      (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory)
    (adjPush : (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
      (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ RpushD) :
    (∀ E : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2),
      CohomologySupportedOn B S hS W.1 W.2 (edsComplementPoints B S hS Uo) E →
        IsIso (adjPush.unit.app E) ∧ IsIso (adjShriek.counit.app E)) ∧
    (∀ (F : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1
        (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2))
      (hF : CohomologySupportedOn B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1 (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2
        (edsEtalePreimageComplementPoints B S hS hsq) F),
        IsIso (adjShriek.unit.app F) ∧ IsIso (adjPush.counit.app F) ∧
          IsIso (supportedShriekToPushforward B S hS hsq adjShriek adjPush F
            (isIso_unit_derivedShriek_of_cohomologySupportedOn B S hS hsq adjShriek F hF)))
declarations.comment:
all five clauses: for E in D(O_X) supported on T = |X| \ |U| the unit
E ⟶ Rj_*(E|_V) and the counit j_!(E|_V) ⟶ E are isomorphisms, and for F in D(O_V) supported on
the preimage of T the unit F ⟶ (j_!F)|_V, the counit (Rj_*F)|_V ⟶ F and the comparison
j_!F ⟶ Rj_*F are isomorphisms. j_! and Rj_* are any left and right adjoints of derived
restriction, which pins them and their units and counits; the derived functor of
etaleModuleLowerShriek and a total right derived functor of j_* are such adjoints

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_derivedCounit_etaleModuleLowerShriek_of_cohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GG, clause (1)(b).**  Let `(U ⊆ X, j : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary distinguished
square of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S` and set `T = |X| \ |U|`.  Let `E` be an object of
`D(𝒪_X)` supported on `T`.  Then the derived counit `j_!(E|_V) ⟶ E` of the adjunction
`j_! ⊣ (-)|_V` is an isomorphism.

The extension by zero is the one the library constructs, part (1) of Stacks 08GV for it is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.shortExact_edsShriekMayerVietoris`, and the vanishing of the
restrictions to `U` and to `P = U ×_X V` is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_etaleModulePullback_mapDerivedCategory_of_cohomologySupportedOn`.
The deduction itself is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_counit_mapDerivedCategory_of_cohomologySupportedOn`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedCounit_etaleModuleLowerShriek_of_cohomologySupportedOn
    (E : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2))
    (hE : CohomologySupportedOn B S hS W.1 W.2 (edsComplementPoints B S hS Uo) E) :
    IsIso ((NatTrans.mapDerivedCategory
      (edsLowerShriekAdjEtale B S hS hsq).counit).app E)
declarations.comment: clause (1)(b): the derived counit j_!(E|_V) ⟶ E is an isomorphism for E supported on |X| \ |U|

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_counit_edsEtale_rightAdjoint_of_cohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GG, clause (2)(b).**  Let `(U ⊆ X, j : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary distinguished
square of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S` and set `T = |X| \ |U|`.  For `F` in `D(𝒪_V)`
supported on `j⁻¹T`, the counit `(Rj_*F)|_V ⟶ F` is an isomorphism.

`Rj_*` is a right adjoint of derived restriction, given with its adjunction.  The proof is
`CategoryTheory.Adjunction.isIso_counit_of_isIso_unit_of_isIso_counit` applied to
`j_! ⊣ (-)|_V ⊣ Rj_*`; its three inputs are clause (2)(a) at `F` and at `(Rj_*F)|_V`, and
clause (1)(b) at `Rj_*F`, which is supported on `T` because it vanishes on `U`
(`isZero_edsDerivedRestrictOpen_rightAdjoint_of_cohomologySupportedOn`).
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_counit_edsEtale_rightAdjoint_of_cohomologySupportedOn
    (F : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1 (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2))
    (hF : CohomologySupportedOn B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1 (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2
      (edsEtalePreimageComplementPoints B S hS hsq) F) :
    IsIso (adjPush.counit.app F)
declarations.comment:
clause (2)(b): the counit (Rj_*F)|_V ⟶ F is an isomorphism for F in D(O_V)
supported on j^{-1}T, unconditionally; Rj_* is a right adjoint of derived restriction, given
with its adjunction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_unit_edsEtale_rightAdjoint_of_cohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GG, clause (1)(a).**  Let `(U ⊆ X, j : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary distinguished
square of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S` and set `T = |X| \ |U|`.  For `E` in `D(𝒪_X)`
supported on `T`, the unit `E ⟶ Rj_*(E|_V)` is an isomorphism.

Its restriction to `V` is a section of the counit at `E|_V`, which is invertible by clause
(2)(b); both `E` and `Rj_*(E|_V)` are supported on `T`, and a map between such objects which is
invertible on `V` is invertible (`isIso_of_isIso_edsDerivedRestrictEtale_map`).
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_unit_edsEtale_rightAdjoint_of_cohomologySupportedOn
    (E : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2))
    (hE : CohomologySupportedOn B S hS W.1 W.2 (edsComplementPoints B S hS Uo) E) :
    IsIso (adjPush.unit.app E)
declarations.comment:
clause (1)(a): the unit E ⟶ Rj_*(E|_V) is an isomorphism for E in D(O_X)
supported on T = |X| \ |U|, unconditionally; Rj_* is a right adjoint of derived restriction,
given with its adjunction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_supportedShriekToPushforward_of_cohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GG, clause (2)(c).**  Let `(U ⊆ X, j : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary distinguished
square of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S` and set `T = |X| \ |U|`.  For `F` in `D(𝒪_V)`
supported on `j⁻¹T`, the comparison `j_!F ⟶ Rj_*F` is an isomorphism.

The comparison is the library's `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.supportedShriekToPushforward`, the
adjunct of the inverse of the unit of clause (2)(a); its invertibility is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_supportedShriekToPushforward` with all four of its inputs, clauses
(2)(a), (2)(b) and (1)(a) at `j_!F` and at `Rj_*F`, now theorems.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_supportedShriekToPushforward_of_cohomologySupportedOn
    (F : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1 (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2))
    (hF : CohomologySupportedOn B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1 (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2
      (edsEtalePreimageComplementPoints B S hS hsq) F) :
    IsIso (supportedShriekToPushforward B S hS hsq
      (Adjunction.mapDerivedCategory (edsEtaleShriekAdjunction B S hS hsq)) adjPush F
      (isIso_derivedUnit_edsEtale_of_cohomologySupportedOn B S hS hsq F hF))
declarations.comment:
clause (2)(c): the comparison j_!F ⟶ Rj_*F is an isomorphism for F in D(O_V)
supported on j^{-1}T, unconditionally; j_! and Rj_* are the left and right adjoints of derived
restriction, given with their adjunctions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.nonempty_representedQuasicoherentDerivedPullbackIso_and_pushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GH.** Let `g : T' ⟶ T` be a morphism of the big fppf site over `S`, so that
`f = h_g : X' ⟶ X` is a morphism of representable algebraic spaces represented by the morphism of
schemes `g_0 : X'_0 ⟶ X_0`.  Under the equivalences `D_QCoh(𝒪_{X_0}) ≌ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` of
Stacks 071Q,

1. `Lg_0^* : D_QCoh(𝒪_{X_0}) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_{X'_0})` corresponds to
   `Lf^* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_{X'})`, and
2. if `f` is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, `Rg_{0,*} : D_QCoh(𝒪_{X'_0}) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_{X_0})`
   corresponds to `Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_{X'}) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_representedQuasicoherentDerivedPullbackIso_and_pushforwardIso :
    Nonempty (Stacks.Duality.quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' (B.inclusion.map g.left) ⋙
        (representedDualityQuasicoherentDerivedEquivalence B S hS T').functor ≅
      (representedDualityQuasicoherentDerivedEquivalence B S hS T).functor ⋙
        quasicoherentDerivedModulePullback (representedSpaceMap B S hS g)) ∧
    ∀ (hfqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS (representedSpaceMap B S hS g).hom)
      (hfqs : IsQuasiSeparated B S hS (representedSpaceMap B S hS g).hom),
      Nonempty (Stacks.Duality.quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward (B.inclusion.map g.left)
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_representedSchemeMap g hfqc hfqs) ⋙
          (representedDualityQuasicoherentDerivedEquivalence B S hS T).functor ≅
        (representedDualityQuasicoherentDerivedEquivalence B S hS T').functor ⋙
          quasicoherentDerivedPushforward B S hS (representedSpaceMap B S hS g) hfqc hfqs)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.coherentDerivedComparison_mem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GJ, well-definedness.**  The derived functor of the inclusion of the coherent
`𝒪_F`-modules has coherent cohomology in every degree: the inclusion is exact, so it commutes
with cohomology.
declarations.statement:
theorem coherentDerivedComparison_mem (K : DerivedCategory (CoherentModules.{u, u} B S hS F hF)) :
    DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (isCoherent.{u, u} B S hS F hF)
      ((isCoherent.{u, u} B S hS F hF).ι.mapDerivedCategory.obj K)
declarations.comment: well-definedness

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.coherentDerivedComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GJ.**  The canonical functor from the derived category of the coherent
`𝒪_F`-modules to the derived category of all `𝒪_F`-modules with coherent cohomology,

`D(Coh(𝒪_F)) ⟶ D_Coh(𝒪_F)`,

obtained by factoring the derived functor of the exact inclusion `Coh(𝒪_F) ⥤ Mod(𝒪_F)` through
`D_Coh(𝒪_F)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def coherentDerivedComparison :
    DerivedCategory (CoherentModules.{u, u} B S hS F hF) ⥤
      CoherentDerivedCategory.{u} B S hS F hF

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.coherentDerivedComparisonCompιIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GJ, the canonical comparison.**  The functor `D(Coh(𝒪_F)) ⥤ D_Coh(𝒪_F)` followed
by the inclusion of `D_Coh(𝒪_F)` into `D(𝒪_F)` is the derived functor of the inclusion
`Coh(𝒪_F) ⥤ Mod(𝒪_F)`; that is, the comparison is a factorisation of the latter.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def coherentDerivedComparisonCompιIso :
    coherentDerivedComparison B S hS F hF ⋙
        (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (isCoherent.{u, u} B S hS F hF)).ι ≅
      (isCoherent.{u, u} B S hS F hF).ι.mapDerivedCategory
declarations.comment: canonical comparison

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedCategoryBBounded_derivedModulePushforward_of_hasProperSupport
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme and `f : X ⟶ Y` a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is locally
of finite type, with `Y` Noetherian.  Let `E ∈ D^b_{Coh}(𝒪_X)` be such that the support of
`H^i(E)` is proper over `Y` for all `i`.  Then `Rf_*E ∈ D^b_{Coh}(𝒪_Y)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategoryBBounded_derivedModulePushforward_of_hasProperSupport
    (hTop : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u})) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f.hom)
    (hY : IsNoetherian B S hS hTop Y.1)
    (E : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2))
    (hE : derivedCategoryBBounded (isCoherent.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) E)
    (hsupp : ∀ i : ℤ, HasProperSupport B S hS X.2 Y.2 f.hom hf
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) i).obj E))) :
    derivedCategoryBBounded (isCoherent.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2)
      ((Stacks.DerivedFunctor.totalRightDerived (modulePushforward B S hS f)).obj E)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsElementaryDistinguishedSquare
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GM.** An open subspace `U` of an algebraic space `W` together with an étale
morphism `f : V ⟶ W` which is an isomorphism over the reduced closed subspace on the
complement of `U` form an *elementary distinguished square*.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isElementaryDistinguishedSquare_iff
declarations.doc:
An elementary distinguished square is exactly an open subspace together with an étale
morphism which is an isomorphism over the reduced closed complement of that subspace.
declarations.statement:
theorem isElementaryDistinguishedSquare_iff (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) {W V : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hW : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS W) (U : Subfunctor W) (f : V ⟶ W) :
    IsElementaryDistinguishedSquare B S hS hW U f ↔
      (IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS V ∧ IsOpenSubspace B S hS U ∧ IsEtale B S hS f ∧
        ∃ hT : IsClosed (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS U.toFunctor U.ι))ᶜ,
          IsIso ((reducedClosedSubspace B S hS W hW
            (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS U.toFunctor U.ι))ᶜ hT).fromPreimage f))
declarations.comment: characterization

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isElementaryDistinguishedSquare_preimage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GN, part (2).** An elementary distinguished square stays elementary
distinguished after base change along any morphism of algebraic spaces: the open subspace is
replaced by its preimage and the étale morphism by its base change.
declarations.statement:
theorem isElementaryDistinguishedSquare_preimage (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S)
    {W V W' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hW : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS W)
    (hW' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS W') (U : Subfunctor W) (f : V ⟶ W)
    (h : IsElementaryDistinguishedSquare B S hS hW U f) (p : W' ⟶ W) :
    IsElementaryDistinguishedSquare B S hS hW' (U.preimage p) (Limits.pullback.snd f p)
declarations.comment: base_change

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isElementaryDistinguishedSquare_openRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GN, restriction to open subspaces.** Let `U ⊆ U'` be open subspaces of `W` and
let `V'` be an open subspace of `V`. The union of the point set of `U'` with the image of the
point set of `V'` is the point set of an open subspace `W'` of `W`; the morphism `V' ⟶ W`
factors through `W'`, and the square formed by `U'` inside `W'` and that factorisation is
again elementary distinguished.

The union is described by its set of points rather than as the range of `V'.ι ≫ f`, which
need not be an open subspace, and `U'` is presented inside `W'` as the range of the canonical
inclusion `U' ⟶ W'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isElementaryDistinguishedSquare_openRestriction (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {W V : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hW : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS W)
    (U : Subfunctor W) (f : V ⟶ W)
    (hsq : IsElementaryDistinguishedSquare B S hS hW U f)
    (V' : Subfunctor V) (hV' : IsOpenSubspace B S hS V')
    (U' : Subfunctor W) (hU' : IsOpenSubspace B S hS U') (hUU' : U ≤ U') :
    ∃ (W' : Subfunctor W) (hW' : IsOpenSubspace B S hS W') (hU'W' : U' ≤ W')
      (f' : V'.toFunctor ⟶ W'.toFunctor),
      (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS W'.toFunctor W'.ι) =
        Set.range (pointsMap B S hS U'.toFunctor U'.ι) ∪
          Set.range (pointsMap B S hS V'.toFunctor (V'.ι ≫ f))) ∧
      (f' ≫ W'.ι = V'.ι ≫ f) ∧
      IsElementaryDistinguishedSquare B S hS hW'.1
        (Subfunctor.range (Subfunctor.homOfLe hU'W')) f'
declarations.comment: open_restriction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isElementaryDistinguishedSquare_relocalizeRestrict
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GN, change of base scheme.** An elementary distinguished square over `S` stays
elementary distinguished after restriction along a morphism `g : S' ⟶ S` of the site: the open
subspace is replaced by the image of the restricted inclusion and the étale morphism by its
restriction.
declarations.statement:
theorem isElementaryDistinguishedSquare_relocalizeRestrict (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (S S' : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) (hS' : B.Contains S')
    (g : B.obj hS' ⟶ B.obj hS) {W V : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hW : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS W) (U : Subfunctor W) (f : V ⟶ W)
    (h : IsElementaryDistinguishedSquare B S hS hW U f) :
    IsElementaryDistinguishedSquare B S' hS'
      (isAlgebraicSpace_relocalizeRestrict B S' S hS' hS g W hW)
      (Subfunctor.range ((OverShriek.relocalizeRestrict g).map U.ι))
      ((OverShriek.relocalizeRestrict g).map f)
declarations.comment: scheme_change

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.qcqs_induction_on
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GP.** Induction on the quasi-compact quasi-separated objects of the
spaces-étale site of a quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic space `X`: a property of
algebraic spaces étale over `X` which holds on the affine ones and is inherited across an
elementary distinguished square with affine étale member holds on all of them.
declarations.statement:
public theorem qcqs_induction_on
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u}))
    (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (P : (Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) →
      (Y ⟶ X.1) → Prop)
    (haff : ∀ V : SpacesEtale B S hS X,
      IsAffineSpace B S hS V.1.left.1 →
        P V.1.left.1 V.1.hom.hom)
    (hstep : ∀ (W V : SpacesEtale B S hS X)
      (U : Subfunctor W.1.left.1)
      (f : V.1.left.1 ⟶ W.1.left.1),
      (f ≫ W.1.hom.hom = V.1.hom.hom) →
      IsElementaryDistinguishedSquare B S hS W.1.left.property U f →
      IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS W.1.left.1 →
      IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ W.1.left.1 →
      IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS U.toFunctor →
      IsAffineSpace B S hS V.1.left.1 →
      P U.toFunctor (U.ι ≫ W.1.hom.hom) →
      P V.1.left.1 V.1.hom.hom →
      P (pullback U.ι f)
        (pullback.fst U.ι f ≫ U.ι ≫ W.1.hom.hom) →
      P W.1.left.1 W.1.hom.hom) :
    ∀ Y : SpacesEtale B S hS X,
      IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS Y.1.left.1 →
      IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ Y.1.left.1 →
      P Y.1.left.1 Y.1.hom.hom
declarations.comment: every quasi-compact quasi-separated étale object

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.qcqs_induction_on_self
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GP** for the base space: a property of algebraic spaces étale over a
quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic space `X` which holds on the affine ones and is
inherited across an elementary distinguished square with affine étale member holds for `X`
itself, taken with its identity morphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem qcqs_induction_on_self
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u}))
    (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (hXqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.1)
    (hXqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X.1)
    (P : (Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) →
      (Y ⟶ X.1) → Prop)
    (haff : ∀ V : SpacesEtale B S hS X,
      IsAffineSpace B S hS V.1.left.1 →
        P V.1.left.1 V.1.hom.hom)
    (hstep : ∀ (W V : SpacesEtale B S hS X)
      (U : Subfunctor W.1.left.1)
      (f : V.1.left.1 ⟶ W.1.left.1),
      (f ≫ W.1.hom.hom = V.1.hom.hom) →
      IsElementaryDistinguishedSquare B S hS W.1.left.property U f →
      IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS W.1.left.1 →
      IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ W.1.left.1 →
      IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS U.toFunctor →
      IsAffineSpace B S hS V.1.left.1 →
      P U.toFunctor (U.ι ≫ W.1.hom.hom) →
      P V.1.left.1 V.1.hom.hom →
      P (pullback U.ι f)
        (pullback.fst U.ι f ≫ U.ι ≫ W.1.hom.hom) →
      P W.1.left.1 W.1.hom.hom) :
    P X.1 (𝟙 X.1)
declarations.comment: the base space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.qcqs_induction_on_collection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GQ.** Induction inside a collection `𝓑` of objects of the spaces-étale site of
a quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic space `X`: a property of the members of `𝓑` holds
throughout `𝓑` as soon as `𝓑` consists of quasi-compact quasi-separated objects, is closed
under quasi-compact open subspaces and contains every affine object, the property holds on
the affine objects, and it is inherited across an elementary distinguished square whose
ambient object lies in `𝓑` and whose étale member is affine.
declarations.statement:
public theorem qcqs_induction_on_collection
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u}))
    (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (𝓑 P : (Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) →
      (Y ⟶ X.1) → Prop)
    (hBqcqs : ∀ W : SpacesEtale B S hS X,
      𝓑 W.1.left.1 W.1.hom.hom →
      IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS W.1.left.1 ∧
        IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ W.1.left.1)
    (hBopen : ∀ (W : SpacesEtale B S hS X)
      (U : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (i : U ⟶ W.1.left.1),
      𝓑 W.1.left.1 W.1.hom.hom →
      IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS U →
      IsOpenImmersion B S hS i →
      IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS U →
      𝓑 U (i ≫ W.1.hom.hom))
    (hBaff : ∀ V : SpacesEtale B S hS X,
      IsAffineSpace B S hS V.1.left.1 →
        𝓑 V.1.left.1 V.1.hom.hom)
    (hPaff : ∀ V : SpacesEtale B S hS X,
      IsAffineSpace B S hS V.1.left.1 →
        P V.1.left.1 V.1.hom.hom)
    (hstep : ∀ (W V : SpacesEtale B S hS X)
      (U : Subfunctor W.1.left.1)
      (f : V.1.left.1 ⟶ W.1.left.1),
      (f ≫ W.1.hom.hom = V.1.hom.hom) →
      IsElementaryDistinguishedSquare B S hS W.1.left.property U f →
      𝓑 W.1.left.1 W.1.hom.hom →
      IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS U.toFunctor →
      IsAffineSpace B S hS V.1.left.1 →
      P U.toFunctor (U.ι ≫ W.1.hom.hom) →
      P V.1.left.1 V.1.hom.hom →
      P (pullback U.ι f)
        (pullback.fst U.ι f ≫ U.ι ≫ W.1.hom.hom) →
      P W.1.left.1 W.1.hom.hom) :
    ∀ W : SpacesEtale B S hS X,
      𝓑 W.1.left.1 W.1.hom.hom →
      P W.1.left.1 W.1.hom.hom

declarations.doc: The quasi-compact separated algebraic spaces in the spaces-étale site.

declarations.statement:

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsQuasiCompactSeparated.of_openImmersion
declarations.doc: A quasi-compact open subspace of a member is again a member.
declarations.statement:
public theorem IsQuasiCompactSeparated.of_openImmersion
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u}))

declarations.doc: Every affine object of the spaces-étale site belongs to the collection.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.qcqs_induction_on_quasiCompactSeparated
declarations.doc: Induction on quasi-compact separated objects of the spaces-étale site.
declarations.statement:
public theorem qcqs_induction_on_quasiCompactSeparated
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u}))
    (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (P : (Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) →
      (Y ⟶ X.1) → Prop)
    (hPaff : ∀ V : SpacesEtale B S hS X,
      IsAffineSpace B S hS V.1.left.1 →
        P V.1.left.1 V.1.hom.hom)
    (hstep : ∀ (W V : SpacesEtale B S hS X)
      (U : Subfunctor W.1.left.1)
      (f : V.1.left.1 ⟶ W.1.left.1),
      (f ≫ W.1.hom.hom = V.1.hom.hom) →
      IsElementaryDistinguishedSquare B S hS W.1.left.property U f →
      IsQuasiCompactSeparated B S hS hZ W.1.left.1 →
      IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS U.toFunctor →
      IsAffineSpace B S hS V.1.left.1 →
      P U.toFunctor (U.ι ≫ W.1.hom.hom) →
      P V.1.left.1 V.1.hom.hom →
      P (pullback U.ι f)
        (pullback.fst U.ι f ≫ U.ι ≫ W.1.hom.hom) →
      P W.1.left.1 W.1.hom.hom) :
    ∀ W : SpacesEtale B S hS X,
      IsQuasiCompactSeparated B S hS hZ W.1.left.1 →
        P W.1.left.1 W.1.hom.hom
declarations.comment: separated_objects
