declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleModulePullbackStalkIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GT** in its restriction reading.  The stalk at a geometric point `ū` of `U` of
the étale restriction of an `𝒪_X`-module along an étale `j : U ⟶ X` is the stalk of that module
at the image point `x̄ = j ∘ ū`, naturally in the module.

Restriction reindexes sections along postcomposition of charts with `j`, and postcomposition is
initial on small étale neighbourhoods, so the comparison is the germ map.
declarations.statement:
def etaleModulePullbackStalkIso (j : U ⟶ X) (hj : IsEtale B S hS j.hom)
    (y : GeometricPoint B S hS U.1) :
    etaleModulePullback.{u, m} B S hS j hj ⋙
        moduleUnderlyingPresheaf.{u, m} B S hS U.1 U.2 ⋙ stalkSetFunctor y ≅
      moduleUnderlyingPresheaf.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2 ⋙
        stalkSetFunctor (geometricPointMap j.hom y)
declarations.comment: the stalks of an étale restriction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleModulePullbackStalkIso_hom_app_moduleGerm
declarations.doc:
The comparison of Stacks 08GT for étale restriction is the germ map: it carries the germ at
`ū` of a section over a chart of `U` to the germ at `x̄` of the same section, read over the
composite chart of `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem etaleModulePullbackStalkIso_hom_app_moduleGerm (j : U ⟶ X)
    (hj : IsEtale B S hS j.hom) (y : GeometricPoint B S hS U.1)
    (M : Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2) (W : SmallEtaleNeighborhood y)
    (a : ((etaleModulePullback.{u, m} B S hS j hj).obj M).val.obj (Opposite.op W.chart)) :
    (etaleModulePullbackStalkIso.{u, m} B S hS j hj y).hom.app M
        (moduleGerm.{u, m} B S hS U.1 U.2
          ((etaleModulePullback.{u, m} B S hS j hj).obj M) W a) =
      moduleGerm.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2 M
        ((SmallEtaleNeighborhood.postcomp B S hS j hj y).obj W) a
declarations.comment: the étale restriction comparison on germs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.modulePullbackStalkIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks' Equation 08GT.**  Let `j : U ⟶ X` be an étale morphism of algebraic spaces over
`S`, let `F` be an `𝒪_X`-module and let `ū` be a geometric point of `U` with image `x̄` in `X`.
Then the stalk of the restriction `F|_U = j^*F` at `ū` is the stalk of `F` at `x̄`, naturally
in `F`:

`(F|_U)_ū = F_x̄`.

The pullback of modules is étale restriction by clause (2) of Stacks 03LV, and the stalks of an
étale restriction are `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleModulePullbackStalkIso`.
declarations.statement:
def modulePullbackStalkIso (j : U ⟶ X) (hj : IsEtale B S hS j.hom)
    (y : GeometricPoint B S hS U.1) :
    modulePullback B S hS j ⋙
        moduleUnderlyingPresheaf.{u, u} B S hS U.1 U.2 ⋙ stalkSetFunctor y ≅
      moduleUnderlyingPresheaf.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2 ⋙
        stalkSetFunctor (geometricPointMap j.hom y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.modulePullbackStalkIso_hom_app_moduleGerm
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GT, canonicity.**  The comparison `(F|_U)_ū = F_x̄` sends the germ at `ū` of a
section of `j^*F` over a chart of `U` to the germ at `x̄` of its image under the identification
of Stacks 03LV of the pullback with étale restriction.  So it is the canonical identification
and not merely some natural isomorphism of the two stalk functors.
declarations.statement:
theorem modulePullbackStalkIso_hom_app_moduleGerm (j : U ⟶ X) (hj : IsEtale B S hS j.hom)
    (y : GeometricPoint B S hS U.1) (M : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (W : SmallEtaleNeighborhood y)
    (a : ((modulePullback B S hS j).obj M).val.obj (Opposite.op W.chart)) :
    (modulePullbackStalkIso B S hS j hj y).hom.app M
        (moduleGerm.{u, u} B S hS U.1 U.2 ((modulePullback B S hS j).obj M) W a) =
      moduleGerm.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2 M
        ((SmallEtaleNeighborhood.postcomp B S hS j hj y).obj W)
        (((modulePullbackIsoEtaleModulePullback B S hS j hj).hom.app M).val.app
          (Opposite.op W.chart) a)
declarations.comment: the comparison on germs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.modulePullbackStalkIso_germ_add
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GT** is an identification of modules and not merely of sets: on germs the
comparison respects addition, the sum being taken in the sections of `j^*F` over a chart of `U`
on one side and in the sections of `F` over the composite chart of `X` on the other.
declarations.statement:
theorem modulePullbackStalkIso_germ_add (j : U ⟶ X) (hj : IsEtale B S hS j.hom)
    (y : GeometricPoint B S hS U.1) (M : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (W : SmallEtaleNeighborhood y)
    (a b : ((modulePullback B S hS j).obj M).val.obj (Opposite.op W.chart)) :
    (modulePullbackStalkIso B S hS j hj y).hom.app M
        (moduleGerm.{u, u} B S hS U.1 U.2 ((modulePullback B S hS j).obj M) W (a + b)) =
      moduleGerm.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2 M
        ((SmallEtaleNeighborhood.postcomp B S hS j hj y).obj W)
        (((modulePullbackIsoEtaleModulePullback B S hS j hj).hom.app M).val.app
            (Opposite.op W.chart) a +
          ((modulePullbackIsoEtaleModulePullback B S hS j hj).hom.app M).val.app
            (Opposite.op W.chart) b)
declarations.comment: additivity on germs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.modulePullbackStalkIso_germ_smul
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GT** is an identification of modules and not merely of abelian groups: on germs
the comparison respects the action of the structure sheaf.  The scalar is a section of `𝒪_U`
over a chart of `U`, which is a section of `𝒪_X` over the composite chart of `X` — étale
postcomposition leaves the underlying scheme of a chart, hence its regular functions,
unchanged.
declarations.statement:
theorem modulePullbackStalkIso_germ_smul (j : U ⟶ X) (hj : IsEtale B S hS j.hom)
    (y : GeometricPoint B S hS U.1) (M : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (W : SmallEtaleNeighborhood y)
    (r : ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS U.1 U.2).O)).obj.obj
      (Opposite.op W.chart))
    (a : ((modulePullback B S hS j).obj M).val.obj (Opposite.op W.chart)) :
    (modulePullbackStalkIso B S hS j hj y).hom.app M
        (moduleGerm.{u, u} B S hS U.1 U.2 ((modulePullback B S hS j).obj M) W (r • a)) =
      moduleGerm.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2 M
        ((SmallEtaleNeighborhood.postcomp B S hS j hj y).obj W)
        (r • ((modulePullbackIsoEtaleModulePullback B S hS j hj).hom.app M).val.app
          (Opposite.op W.chart) a)
declarations.comment: action on germs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictionPresheafFiberIso
declarations.doc:
For the fibre functors of points of the small étale site, the fibre at the point attached to
a lift `t` of `x̄` of the restriction along `f` of a presheaf on the small étale site of `Y` is
the fibre of that presheaf at `x̄`, naturally in the presheaf.
declarations.statement:
def restrictionPresheafFiberIso (t : GeometricPointLift B S hS f.hom x) :
    (Functor.whiskeringLeft (SmallEtale B S hS X.1)ᵒᵖ (SmallEtale B S hS Y.1)ᵒᵖ A).obj
          (smallEtalePostcomp B S hS f hf).op ⋙
        (liftSitePoint B S hS f t).presheafFiber ≅
      (etaleSitePoint B S hS Y.1 x Y.2).presheafFiber
declarations.comment: the fibre of a restriction at a lift

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictionPresheafFiberIso_toPresheafFiber
declarations.doc:
On germs, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictionPresheafFiberIso` carries the germ at the lift
`t` of a section over an étale chart `W` of `X` to the germ at `x̄` of the same section, read over
the chart `W` of `Y` and at the induced lift.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictionPresheafFiberIso_toPresheafFiber (t : GeometricPointLift B S hS f.hom x)
    (P : (SmallEtale B S hS Y.1)ᵒᵖ ⥤ A) (W : SmallEtale B S hS X.1)
    (w : (liftSitePoint B S hS f t).fiber.obj W) :
    (liftSitePoint B S hS f t).toPresheafFiber W w
          ((smallEtalePostcomp B S hS f hf).op ⋙ P) ≫
        (restrictionPresheafFiberIso B S hS f hf t).hom.app P =
      (etaleSitePoint B S hS Y.1 x Y.2).toPresheafFiber
        ((smallEtalePostcomp B S hS f hf).obj W) (pushLift B S hS f hf W t w) P
declarations.comment: the comparison on germs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictionSheafFiberIso
declarations.doc:
For abelian sheaves, the fibre at the point attached to a lift
`t` of `x̄` of the restriction along `f` of an abelian sheaf on the small étale site of `Y` is
its fibre at `x̄`, naturally in the sheaf.
declarations.comment: the fibre of a restriction of abelian sheaves at a lift

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictionSheafFiberIso_toPresheafFiber
declarations.doc:
On germs, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictionSheafFiberIso` carries the germ at
the lift `t` of a section over an étale chart `W` of `X` to the germ at `x̄` of the same section
over `W` read as a chart of `Y`, at the induced lift.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictionSheafFiberIso_toPresheafFiber (t : GeometricPointLift B S hS f.hom x)
    (G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (W : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) (w : (liftSitePoint B S hS f t).fiber.obj W) :
    (liftSitePoint B S hS f t).toPresheafFiber W w
          ((abelianEtaleRestriction B S hS f hf).obj G).obj ≫
        (restrictionSheafFiberIso B S hS f hf t).hom.app G =
      (etaleSitePoint B S hS Y.1 x Y.2).toPresheafFiber
        ((smallEtalePostcomp B S hS f hf).obj W) (pushLift B S hS f hf W t w) G.obj
declarations.comment: the comparison of abelian sheaf fibres on germs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ExtensionByZeroStalk.stalkExtensionByZeroIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GU.** Equation 75.10.0.2: for an étale morphism `j_U : U ⟶ X` of algebraic
spaces, a sheaf of `𝒪_U`-modules `𝒢` and a geometric point `x̄ : Spec(k) ⟶ X`, the stalk of
the extension by zero `j_{U!}𝒢` at `x̄` is the direct sum of the stalks of `𝒢` at the
geometric points `ū : Spec(k) ⟶ U` with `j_U ∘ ū = x̄`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ExtensionByZeroStalk.isZero_moduleStalk_extensionByZero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GU.** At a geometric point of `X` admitting no lift to `U` the stalk of
`j_{U!}𝒢` vanishes.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_moduleStalk_extensionByZero (V : (spacesEtaleRingedSite B S hS X).C)
    (x : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1)
    (G : SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (spacesEtaleRingedSite B S hS X).O).over V))
    [IsEmpty (Lifts V x)] :
    IsZero (moduleStalk x ((extensionByZero V).obj G))
declarations.comment: vanishing away from the image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ExtensionByZeroStalk.liftsEquivGeometricPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GU.** The index set of Equation 08GU is the set of geometric points of `U`
lying over the given geometric point of `X`.
declarations.comment: the index set

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.EtaleShriekStalk.liftedStalkι_stalkExtensionByZeroIso_inv_counit
declarations.doc:
Under the decomposition of the stalk of `f_!(G|_X)` as the direct sum over the lifts of `x̄`
of the stalks of `G|_X`, the stalk of the counit `f_!(G|_X) ⟶ G` restricts on the summand of a
lift `t` to the identification of the stalk of `G|_X` at `t` with the stalk of `G` at `x̄`.
declarations.statement:
theorem liftedStalkι_stalkExtensionByZeroIso_inv_counit
    (t : GeometricPointLift B S hS f.hom x) :
    liftedStalkι B S hS f x ((abelianEtaleRestriction B S hS f hf).obj G) t ≫
        (stalkExtensionByZeroIso B S hS f hf x
            ((abelianEtaleRestriction B S hS f hf).obj G)).inv ≫
          (etaleSitePoint B S hS Y.1 x Y.2).sheafFiber.map
            ((abelianEtaleExtensionByZeroAdjunction B S hS f hf).counit.app G) =
      (restrictionSheafFiberIso B S hS f hf t).hom.app G
declarations.comment: the counit on one summand of the stalk

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.EtaleShriekStalk.stalkExtensionByZeroIso_inv_counit
declarations.doc:
The stalk of the counit of extension by zero is the fold map: under the decomposition of the
stalk of `f_!(G|_X)` as the direct sum over the lifts `t` of `x̄` of the stalks of `G|_X` at
those lifts, and the identification of each of those with the stalk of `G` at `x̄`, the counit
`f_!(G|_X) ⟶ G` becomes the map out of the direct sum whose component at every lift is that
identification.
declarations.statement:
theorem stalkExtensionByZeroIso_inv_counit :
    (stalkExtensionByZeroIso B S hS f hf x
          ((abelianEtaleRestriction B S hS f hf).obj G)).inv ≫
        (etaleSitePoint B S hS Y.1 x Y.2).sheafFiber.map
          ((abelianEtaleExtensionByZeroAdjunction B S hS f hf).counit.app G) =
      Sigma.desc fun t : GeometricPointLift B S hS f.hom x =>
        (restrictionSheafFiberIso B S hS f hf t).hom.app G
declarations.comment: the counit on stalks

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.EtaleShriekStalk.mono_sheafFiber_extensionByZero_map
declarations.doc:
If a morphism of abelian sheaves on `X` has monomorphic stalks at every lift of a geometric
point `x` of `Y`, then the stalk at `x` of its extension by zero is a monomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem mono_sheafFiber_extensionByZero_map
    {G H : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (ψ : G ⟶ H)
    (hψ : ∀ t : GeometricPointLift B S hS f.hom x,
      Mono ((liftSitePoint B S hS f t).sheafFiber.map ψ)) :
    Mono ((etaleSitePoint B S hS Y.1 x Y.2).sheafFiber.map
      ((abelianEtaleExtensionByZero B S hS f hf).map ψ))
declarations.comment: the stalk of an extension by zero of a monomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.EtaleShriekStalk.stalkExtensionByZeroIso
declarations.doc:
The stalk at a geometric point `x̄` of `Y` of the extension by zero of an abelian étale sheaf
on `X` is the direct sum of its stalks at the lifts of `x̄` to `X`.
declarations.statement:
def stalkExtensionByZeroIso
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    (etaleSitePoint B S hS Y.1 x Y.2).sheafFiber.obj
        ((abelianEtaleExtensionByZero B S hS f hf).obj F) ≅
      (∐ fun t : GeometricPointLift B S hS f.hom x =>
        (liftSitePoint B S hS f t).sheafFiber.obj F)
declarations.comment: the stalk of an extension by zero of abelian sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.EtaleShriekStalk.stalkExtensionByZeroIso_germ
declarations.doc:
The stalk isomorphism sends the germ of a section over an étale chart `W` of `X`, viewed in
the extension by zero through the adjunction unit, to its germ at the induced lift, in the
corresponding summand.
declarations.statement:
theorem stalkExtensionByZeroIso_germ
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (W : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) (t : GeometricPointLift B S hS f.hom x)
    (w : (liftSitePoint B S hS f t).fiber.obj W) :
    extensionByZeroUnitApp B S hS f hf F W ≫
        (etaleSitePoint B S hS Y.1 x Y.2).toPresheafFiber
          ((smallEtalePostcomp B S hS f hf).obj W) (pushLift B S hS f hf W t w)
          ((abelianEtaleExtensionByZero B S hS f hf).obj F).obj ≫
        (stalkExtensionByZeroIso B S hS f hf x F).hom =
      liftedGerm B S hS f x F t W w ≫ liftedStalkι B S hS f x F t
declarations.comment: the germ computation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.EtaleShriekStalk.stalkExtensionByZeroIso_naturality
declarations.doc: The stalk decomposition `stalkExtensionByZeroIso` is natural in the abelian sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem stalkExtensionByZeroIso_naturality
    {F G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (a : F ⟶ G) :
    (etaleSitePoint B S hS Y.1 x Y.2).sheafFiber.map
          ((abelianEtaleExtensionByZero B S hS f hf).map a) ≫
        (stalkExtensionByZeroIso B S hS f hf x G).hom =
      (stalkExtensionByZeroIso B S hS f hf x F).hom ≫
        (stalkFamily B S hS f x ⋙
          Sigma.functor (GeometricPointLift B S hS f.hom x)).map a
declarations.comment: naturality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.EtaleShriekStalk.isZero_stalkExtensionByZero_of_isEmpty
declarations.doc: The extension by zero has zero stalk at every geometric point of `Y` with no lift to `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_stalkExtensionByZero_of_isEmpty
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    [IsEmpty (GeometricPointLift B S hS f.hom x)] :
    IsZero ((etaleSitePoint B S hS Y.1 x Y.2).sheafFiber.obj
      ((abelianEtaleExtensionByZero B S hS f hf).obj F))
declarations.comment: vanishing away from the image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.EtaleShriekStalk.isIso_sheafFiber_extensionByZero_map
declarations.doc:
**The stalk of an extension by zero of a map of abelian sheaves is the direct sum of the
stalks of that map at the lifts**, hence invertible as soon as all of those are.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_sheafFiber_extensionByZero_map
    {G H : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (ψ : G ⟶ H)
    (hψ : ∀ t : GeometricPointLift B S hS f.hom x,
      IsIso ((liftSitePoint B S hS f t).sheafFiber.map ψ)) :
    IsIso ((etaleSitePoint B S hS Y.1 x Y.2).sheafFiber.map
      ((abelianEtaleExtensionByZero B S hS f hf).map ψ))
declarations.comment: the stalk of an extension by zero of a map

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_sheafFiber_toSheaf_etaleModuleShriek_map_of_lifts
declarations.doc:
**The stalk of the extension by zero of a map of modules is invertible as soon as the stalks
of that map at all the lifts of the point are.**
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_sheafFiber_toSheaf_etaleModuleShriek_map_of_lifts
    {M N : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2} (α : M ⟶ N)
    (hα : ∀ t : GeometricPointLift B S hS f.hom x,
      IsIso ((liftSitePoint B S hS f t).sheafFiber.map
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (etaleRingSheaf B S hS X)).map α))) :
    IsIso ((etaleSitePoint B S hS Y.1 x Y.2).sheafFiber.map
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (etaleRingSheaf B S hS Y)).map
        ((etaleModuleLowerShriek B S hS f hf).map α)))
declarations.comment: the stalk of an extension by zero of a map of modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cohomologySupportedOn_mapDerivedCategory_etaleModuleLowerShriek
declarations.doc:
If an object `K` of `D(𝒪_X)` is supported on `|f|⁻¹T` in the sense of Stacks 08GF, then its
extension by zero along the étale morphism `f` is supported on `T`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cohomologySupportedOn_mapDerivedCategory_etaleModuleLowerShriek
    (K : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)) (T : Set (points B S hS Y.1))
    (hK : CohomologySupportedOn B S hS X.1 X.2 (pointsMap B S hS X.1 f.hom ⁻¹' T) K) :
    CohomologySupportedOn B S hS Y.1 Y.2 T
      ((etaleModuleLowerShriek B S hS f hf).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)
declarations.comment: the support of an extension by zero of an object of the derived category

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.mayerVietoris_shortExact_and_mem_distTriang
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GV.**  Let `(U ⊆ X, j_V : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary distinguished square of
algebraic spaces over a scheme `S` and let `P = U ×_X V`.  Write `(-)|_Y` for restriction of
modules along an étale morphism `j_Y : Y ⟶ X` and `j_{Y!}` for its extension by zero,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleModuleLowerShriek`, with counit `j_{Y!}(F|_Y) ⟶ F`, and let `a`
and `b` be the two comparisons out of the intersection attached to its two factorizations.
Then

1. for every sheaf of `𝒪_X`-modules `F` the sequence

   `0 ⟶ j_{P!}F|_P ⟶ j_{U!}F|_U ⊕ j_{V!}F|_V ⟶ F ⟶ 0`,

   with maps `(a, -b)` and the sum of the two counits, is short exact, and
2. every object `E` of the unbounded derived category `D(𝒪_X)` sits in a distinguished triangle

   `j_{P!}E|_P ⟶ j_{U!}E|_U ⊕ j_{V!}E|_V ⟶ E ⟶ (j_{P!}E|_P)[1]`,

   whose first two maps are the derived transformations of `(a, -b)` and of the two counits.

The exactness of the three extensions by zero, Stacks 03DJ, is the theorem
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.preservesFiniteLimits_etaleModuleLowerShriek` together with
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleModuleLowerShriek_additive` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.preservesFiniteColimits_etaleModuleLowerShriek`, which is what makes
their derived functors available; it is proved, not assumed.
declarations.statement:
theorem mayerVietoris_shortExact_and_mem_distTriang :
    (∀ F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2,
        (ShortComplex.mayerVietoris
          ((edsShriekOpenComparison B S hS hsq
              (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)
                (isEtale_edsOpenHom B S hS hsq))
              (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsInterHom B S hS hsq)
                (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq))).app F)
          ((edsShriekEtaleComparison B S hS hsq
              (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
                (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq))
              (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsInterHom B S hS hsq)
                (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq))).app F)
          ((etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)
            (isEtale_edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)).counit.app F)
          ((etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
            (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)).counit.app F)
          (zero_edsShriekMayerVietoris B S hS hsq
            (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)
              (isEtale_edsOpenHom B S hS hsq))
            (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
              (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq))
            (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsInterHom B S hS hsq)
              (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq)) F)).ShortExact) ∧
      ∀ E : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2),
        ∃ δ, Triangle.mk
            (biprod.lift
              ((NatTrans.mapDerivedCategory
                (edsShriekOpenComparison B S hS hsq
                  (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)
                    (isEtale_edsOpenHom B S hS hsq))
                  (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsInterHom B S hS hsq)
                    (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq)))).app E)
              (-((NatTrans.mapDerivedCategory
                (edsShriekEtaleComparison B S hS hsq
                  (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
                    (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq))
                  (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsInterHom B S hS hsq)
                    (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq)))).app E)))
            (biprod.desc
                ((NatTrans.mapDerivedCategory
                  (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)
                    (isEtale_edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)).counit).app E)
                ((NatTrans.mapDerivedCategory
                  (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
                    (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)).counit).app E) ≫
              (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryIdIso
                (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2)).hom.app E) δ ∈
          distTriang (DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.shortExact_edsRestrictPushMayerVietorisLowerShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GW part (1), with nothing assumed.**  Let `(U ⊆ X, j_V : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary
distinguished square of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`, let `P = U ×_X V`, write `(-)|_Y`
for restriction of modules along `j_Y : Y ⟶ X` and `j_{Y,*}` for the direct image of Stacks
03LU.  Then for every sheaf of `𝒪_X`-modules `F` the sequence

`0 ⟶ F ⟶ j_{U,*}F|_U ⊕ j_{V,*}F|_V ⟶ j_{P,*}F|_P ⟶ 0`

is short exact.  Its first map is the pair of canonical units `F ⟶ j_{Y,*}F|_Y` of the
adjunctions `(-)|_Y ⊣ j_{Y,*}` and its second is the difference of the conjugates, under the
adjunctions `j_{Y!}((-)|_Y) ⊣ j_{Y,*}((-)|_Y)`, of the two extension-by-zero comparisons
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.edsShriekOpenComparison` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.edsShriekEtaleComparison` of Stacks 08GV.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.shortExact_edsRestrictPushMayerVietorisComparison` at the
extension by zero the library constructs, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleModuleLowerShriek` with
its adjunction `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction`, so nothing is a
parameter beyond the square itself: the exactness of extension by zero (Stacks 03DJ) is the
theorem `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.preservesFiniteLimits_etaleModuleLowerShriek` with its two
companions, the two sheafification hypotheses of the ambient site are the theorems
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleRingedSite_hasSheafify_addCommGrpCat` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleRingedSite_wEqualsLocallyBijective_addCommGrpCat`, part (1)
of Stacks 08GV is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.shortExact_edsShriekMayerVietoris`, and the surjectivity on the right
is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.epi_edsRestrictPushMayerVietorisComparison`.
declarations.statement:
theorem shortExact_edsRestrictPushMayerVietorisLowerShriek
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2) :
    (ShortComplex.mk
      (biprod.lift ((edsAdjOpen B S hS hsq).unit.app F)
        ((edsAdjEtale B S hS hsq).unit.app F))
      (biprod.desc ((conjugateEquiv ((edsAdjOpen B S hS hsq).comp
            (edsLowerShriekAdjOpen B S hS hsq))
          ((edsAdjInter B S hS hsq).comp (edsLowerShriekAdjInter B S hS hsq))
          (edsShriekOpenComparison B S hS hsq (edsLowerShriekAdjOpen B S hS hsq)
            (edsLowerShriekAdjInter B S hS hsq))).app F)
        (-((conjugateEquiv ((edsAdjEtale B S hS hsq).comp
            (edsLowerShriekAdjEtale B S hS hsq))
          ((edsAdjInter B S hS hsq).comp (edsLowerShriekAdjInter B S hS hsq))
          (edsShriekEtaleComparison B S hS hsq (edsLowerShriekAdjEtale B S hS hsq)
            (edsLowerShriekAdjInter B S hS hsq))).app F)))
      (zero_edsRestrictPushMayerVietorisLowerShriek B S hS hsq F)).ShortExact
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_mem_distTriang_edsDerivedRestrictPushMayerVietorisLowerShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08GW part (2), with nothing assumed and with the canonical triangle.**  Let
`(U ⊆ X, j_V : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary distinguished square of algebraic spaces over a scheme
`S`, let `P = U ×_X V` and write `Rj_{Y,*}((-)|_Y)` for the total right derived functor of
`j_{Y,*}((-)|_Y)`.  Then every object `E` of the unbounded derived category `D(𝒪_X)` sits in a
distinguished triangle

`E ⟶ Rj_{U,*}E|_U ⊕ Rj_{V,*}E|_V ⟶ Rj_{P,*}E|_P ⟶ E[1]`.

**Its maps are the canonical ones, not existentially quantified.**  The first is the pair of
derived units `CategoryTheory.PushforwardMayerVietoris.derivedUnitOfNatTrans` of the units
`F ⟶ j_{Y,*}F|_Y` of the adjunctions `(-)|_Y ⊣ j_{Y,*}` of Stacks 03LU, and the second is the
difference of the derived transformations `CategoryTheory.Functor.rightDerivedNatTrans` of the
two comparisons of part (1) — the conjugates, under `j_{Y!}((-)|_Y) ⊣ j_{Y,*}((-)|_Y)`, of the
extension-by-zero comparisons of Stacks 08GV.  Only the connecting map
`Rj_{P,*}E|_P ⟶ E[1]` is existentially quantified, the library attaching no canonical such map
to an object of `D(𝒪_X)`; the source likewise asserts only that the triangle is distinguished,
and `δ` is existential in Stacks 08GV part (2) as well.

Nothing is a parameter beyond the square: part (1) is the unqualified
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.shortExact_edsRestrictPushMayerVietorisLowerShriek`, the K-injective
resolutions are `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_quasiIso_isKInjective_modules` (Stacks 079P),
and the three derived functors are the chosen ones, which exist by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasRightDerivedFunctor_mapHomotopyCategory_modules`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_mem_distTriang_edsDerivedRestrictPushMayerVietorisLowerShriek
    (E : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2)) :
    ∃ δ, Triangle.mk
        (biprod.lift
          ((derivedUnitOfNatTrans (edsAdjOpen B S hS hsq).unit
            (edsDerivedRestrictPushOpen B S hS hsq)
            (edsTotalRightDerivedUnitOpen B S hS hsq)).app E)
          ((derivedUnitOfNatTrans (edsAdjEtale B S hS hsq).unit
            (edsDerivedRestrictPushEtale B S hS hsq)
            (edsTotalRightDerivedUnitEtale B S hS hsq)).app E))
        (biprod.desc
          ((Functor.rightDerivedNatTrans (edsDerivedRestrictPushOpen B S hS hsq)
            (edsDerivedRestrictPushInter B S hS hsq)
            (edsTotalRightDerivedUnitOpen B S hS hsq)
            (edsTotalRightDerivedUnitInter B S hS hsq)
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
            (Functor.whiskerRight (NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory
              (conjugateEquiv ((edsAdjOpen B S hS hsq).comp
                  (edsLowerShriekAdjOpen B S hS hsq))
                ((edsAdjInter B S hS hsq).comp (edsLowerShriekAdjInter B S hS hsq))
                (edsShriekOpenComparison B S hS hsq (edsLowerShriekAdjOpen B S hS hsq)
                  (edsLowerShriekAdjInter B S hS hsq)))
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) DerivedCategory.Qh)).app E)
          (-((Functor.rightDerivedNatTrans (edsDerivedRestrictPushEtale B S hS hsq)
            (edsDerivedRestrictPushInter B S hS hsq)
            (edsTotalRightDerivedUnitEtale B S hS hsq)
            (edsTotalRightDerivedUnitInter B S hS hsq)
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
            (Functor.whiskerRight (NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory
              (conjugateEquiv ((edsAdjEtale B S hS hsq).comp
                  (edsLowerShriekAdjEtale B S hS hsq))
                ((edsAdjInter B S hS hsq).comp (edsLowerShriekAdjInter B S hS hsq))
                (edsShriekEtaleComparison B S hS hsq (edsLowerShriekAdjEtale B S hS hsq)
                  (edsLowerShriekAdjInter B S hS hsq)))
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) DerivedCategory.Qh)).app E))) δ ∈
      distTriang (DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2))
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRightDerivedFunctor_quasicoherentPushforwardMapDerivedCategory
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08GY], the derived functor.**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be an affine morphism of
algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`.  Then direct image defines a derived functor
`f_* : D(QCoh(𝒪_X)) ⥤ D(QCoh(𝒪_Y))`: the functor induced on the unbounded derived categories by
the exact functor `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasicoherentPushforward` is a total right derived
functor of it.  No resolutions are involved, and the derived functor is computed by applying
`f_*` to a representative complex, which is how the source states it.

The structure map is `CategoryTheory.Functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv`, which exhibits the
induced functor as a lift through the localization `DerivedCategory.Qh`; a lift of a functor that
inverts the quasi-isomorphisms is a right derived functor for the inverse of the lifting
isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRightDerivedFunctor_quasicoherentPushforwardMapDerivedCategory (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsAffineHom B S hS f.hom) :
    letI := preservesFiniteColimitsQuasicoherentPushforwardOfIsAffineHom B S hS f hf
    Functor.IsRightDerivedFunctor
      (quasicoherentPushforward B S hS f
        (pushforwardPreservesQuasicoherence_of_isAffineHom B S hS f hf)).mapDerivedCategory
      (quasicoherentPushforward B S hS f
          (pushforwardPreservesQuasicoherence_of_isAffineHom B S hS f
            hf)).mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (QuasicoherentSheaves.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
declarations.comment: the derived functor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedQuasicoherentComparisonSquareOfIsAffineHom
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08GY], the commuting square.**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be an affine morphism of
algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`, and let `Rf_*` be a total right derived functor of the direct
image of all `𝒪_X`-modules, with derivation unit `α`.  Then the square

`D(QCoh(𝒪_X)) ⟶ D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⟶^{Rf_*} D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`,
`D(QCoh(𝒪_X)) ⟶^{f_*} D(QCoh(𝒪_Y)) ⟶ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`

commutes, its rows being the comparison functor of [Stacks, Tag 08F1] and its left edge the
derived functor of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRightDerivedFunctor_quasicoherentPushforwardMapDerivedCategory`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedQuasicoherentComparisonSquare` with both of its inputs
supplied: right exactness of the quasi-coherent direct image by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.preservesFiniteColimitsQuasicoherentPushforwardOfIsAffineHom`, and that
a complex of quasi-coherent modules computes its derived direct image by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_derivedModulePushforwardUnit_app_of_isQuasicoherentOnSite`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def derivedQuasicoherentComparisonSquareOfIsAffineHom :
    letI := preservesFiniteColimitsQuasicoherentPushforwardOfIsAffineHom B S hS f hf
    (quasicoherentPushforward B S hS f
          (pushforwardPreservesQuasicoherence_of_isAffineHom B S hS f hf)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        quasicoherentDerivedComparisonSchemeUniverse B S hS Y.1 Y.2 ⋙
          (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
            (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
              (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS Y.1 Y.2).O))).ι ≅
      quasicoherentDerivedComparisonSchemeUniverse B S hS X.1 X.2 ⋙
        (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
          (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
            (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O))).ι ⋙
        Rf
declarations.comment: the commuting square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedModulePushforwardCompDerivedCoheratorIso
declarations.doc:
**The derived coherator commutes with the direct image along a flat morphism.**  Let
`f : X ⟶ Y` be a quasi-compact, quasi-separated and flat morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`,
and let `Φ : D(QCoh(𝒪_X)) ⥤ D(QCoh(𝒪_Y))` be the right derived functor of
`f_* : QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.  Then `RQ_Y ∘ Rf_* = Φ ∘ RQ_X`, as a natural isomorphism
`Rf_* ⋙ RQ_Y ≅ RQ_X ⋙ Φ`.

Here `Rf_*` is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedModulePushforward`, `RQ_X` and `RQ_Y` are
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedCoherator`, and `Φ` is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedQuasicoherentPushforward` at the preservation of quasi-coherence of
Stacks 03M9.
declarations.statement:
def derivedModulePushforwardCompDerivedCoheratorIso (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hfqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f.hom) (hfqs : IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f.hom)
    (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f.hom) :
    derivedModulePushforward B S hS f ⋙ derivedCoherator B S hS Y.1 Y.2 ≅
      derivedCoherator B S hS X.1 X.2 ⋙ derivedQuasicoherentPushforward B S hS f
        (pushforwardPreservesQuasicoherence_of_qcqs B S hS f hfqc hfqs)
declarations.comment: RQ_Y ∘ Rf_* = Φ ∘ RQ_X, the source's equality as a natural isomorphism, for a flat, quasi-compact, quasi-separated morphism of algebraic spaces; Stacks 03M9, 03GA and 077V (1) are proved in the library

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.inclusionAdjunctionGlobalSectionsAssociated_of_isAffineSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08H0 (1).**  Let `X` be an affine algebraic space over a scheme `S` and set
`A = Γ(X, 𝒪_X)`.  The functor sending an `𝒪_X`-module `𝓕` to the quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module
associated to the `A`-module `Γ(X, 𝓕)` is a right adjoint of the inclusion
`QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ Mod(𝒪_X)`; that is, it is a coherator of `X` in the sense of Stacks 077V (2).

The proof is the source's: composing the adjunction `(-)^~ ⋙ ι ⊣ Γ(X, -)` of the affine case of
Stacks 01BH (4) with the adjunction `((-)^~)^{-1} ⊣ (-)^~` of the associated-module equivalence
gives `((-)^~)^{-1} ⋙ (-)^~ ⋙ ι ⊣ Γ(X, -) ⋙ (-)^~`, and the left-hand side is `ι` by the counit
of the equivalence.
declarations.comment: part (1): for affine X, F ↦ Γ(X, F)^~ is right adjoint to QCoh(O_X) ⊆ Mod(O_X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.coheratorIsoGlobalSectionsAssociated_of_isAffineSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08H0 (1).**  Let `X` be an affine algebraic space over a scheme `S` and set
`A = Γ(X, 𝒪_X)`.  The coherator `Q_X : Mod(𝒪_X) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_X)` of Stacks 077V (2) is naturally
isomorphic to the functor sending `𝓕` to the quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module associated to the
`A`-module `Γ(X, 𝓕)`.

Both are right adjoints of the inclusion `QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ Mod(𝒪_X)` — the coherator by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.coheratorAdjunction` and the other by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.inclusionAdjunctionGlobalSectionsAssociated_of_isAffineSpace` — and a
right adjoint is unique up to a unique natural isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
def coheratorIsoGlobalSectionsAssociated_of_isAffineSpace :
    coherator B S hS F hF ≅
      affineSpaceGlobalSections B S hS F hF hAffine ⋙
        (affineSpaceAssociatedModuleEquivalence B S hS F hF hAffine).functor
declarations.comment: part (1): for affine X, the coherator Q_X is naturally isomorphic to F ↦ Γ(X, F)^~

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedCoheratorIsoComparisonInv_of_isAffineSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08H0 (3).**  On an affine algebraic space the derived coherator `RQ_X`, restricted
to the complexes of `𝒪_X`-modules with quasi-coherent cohomology, is naturally isomorphic to the
inverse of the comparison functor `i_X : D(QCoh(𝒪_X)) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` of Stacks 08F1.
declarations.statement:
def derivedCoheratorIsoComparisonInv_of_isAffineSpace (hAffine : IsAffineSpace B S hS F) :
    letI := isEquivalence_quasicoherentDerivedComparison_of_isAffineSpace B S hS F hF hAffine
    (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
        (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
          ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
            (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS F hF).O)))).ι ⋙ derivedCoherator B S hS F hF ≅
      (quasicoherentDerivedComparison B S hS F hF).inv
declarations.comment: part (3): for affine X, RQ_X restricted to D_QCoh(O_X) is naturally isomorphic to the inverse of the comparison equivalence D(QCoh(O_X)) → D_QCoh(O_X) of 08F1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedCoheratorIsoDerivedGlobalSectionsAssociated_of_isAffineSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08H0 (2).**  Let `X` be an affine algebraic space over a scheme `S` and set
`A = Γ(X, 𝒪_X)`.  The derived coherator `RQ_X : D(𝒪_X) ⥤ D(QCoh(𝒪_X))` sends an object `E` of
`D(𝒪_X)` to the complex of quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-modules associated to the object `RΓ(X, E)` of
`D(A)`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedCoheratorIsoDerivedGlobalSectionsAssociated_of_isAffineSpace :
    derivedCoherator B S hS F hF ≅
      affineSpaceDerivedGlobalSections B S hS F hF hAffine ⋙
        (affineSpaceAssociatedModuleEquivalence B S hS F hF hAffine).functor.mapDerivedCategory
declarations.comment: part (2): for affine X, RQ_X is naturally isomorphic to E ↦ RΓ(X, E)^~ on the unbounded derived category

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasicoherentDerivedComparison_isEquivalence_of_isAffineHom_diag
declarations.doc:
On a quasi-compact algebraic space with affine diagonal over `ℤ` the comparison functor
`i_X : D(QCoh(𝒪_X)) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` of Stacks 08F1 is an equivalence.
declarations.statement:
theorem quasicoherentDerivedComparison_isEquivalence_of_isAffineHom_diag
    (hXqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.1)
    (hXdiag : IsAffineHom B (⊤_ Scheme.{u}) hZ (diag (viewOverIntegers B S hS hZ X.1))) :
    (quasicoherentDerivedComparison B S hS X.1 X.2).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: equivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_equivalence_functor_eq_and_inverse_eq_derivedCoherator
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a quasi-compact algebraic space with affine diagonal over `ℤ`, `C_X` a coherator
of `X` and `RQ_X` a total right derived functor of it.  Then the comparison functor
`i_X : D(QCoh(𝒪_X)) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` of Stacks 08F1 is an equivalence with quasi-inverse `RQ_X`
restricted to `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`: there is an equivalence whose functor is `i_X` and whose inverse is
`J ⋙ RQ_X`, for `J : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D(𝒪_X)` the inclusion.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_equivalence_functor_eq_and_inverse_eq_derivedCoherator
    (hXqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.1)
    (hXdiag : IsAffineHom B (⊤_ Scheme.{u}) hZ (diag (viewOverIntegers B S hS hZ X.1)))
    (CF : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2 ⥤ QuasicoherentSheaves.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (adjF : (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O))).ι ⊣ CF)
    [CF.Additive]
    (RQ : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (QuasicoherentSheaves.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2))
    (RQUnit : CF.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Q (C := QuasicoherentSheaves.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Q (C := Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) ⋙ RQ)
    [RQ.IsRightDerivedFunctor RQUnit
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))] :
    ∃ e : DerivedCategory (QuasicoherentSheaves.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) ≌
        QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2,
      e.functor = quasicoherentDerivedComparison B S hS X.1 X.2 ∧
        e.inverse =
          (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
            (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
              ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
                (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O)))).ι ⋙ RQ
declarations.comment: equivalence with quasi-inverse RQ_X

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.coversTop_obj_of_preservesTerminal_sheafPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08H2.** Let `u : C ⥤ D` be a continuous functor of sites, giving a morphism of sites
`f : D → C`, and assume that `f⁻¹ = u_s : Sh(C) ⥤ Sh(D)` preserves the final object (as it does
when `u_s` is exact, i.e. when `u` defines a morphism of sites, Stacks 00X1). Then the objects
`u U`, for `U` an object of `C`, cover the final object of `Sh(D)`: for every object `V` of `D`
there is a covering `{V_j → V}` such that every `V_j` admits a morphism `V_j ⟶ u U_j` to the
image of some object `U_j` of `C`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem coversTop_obj_of_preservesTerminal_sheafPullback {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    {D : Type u} [SmallCategory D] (u : C ⥤ D) (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (K : GrothendieckTopology D) [u.IsContinuous J K]
    [PreservesLimit (Functor.empty.{0} (Sheaf J (Type u))) (u.sheafPullback (Type u) J K)] :
    K.CoversTop u.obj
declarations.comment:
For a morphism of sites f : D → C given by u : C ⥤ D, every object V of D has a
covering {V_j → V} such that each V_j admits a morphism V_j ⟶ u(U_j) for some object U_j of C.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.isStrictlyPerfect_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
Let `f : (C, O_C) → (D, O_D)` be a morphism of ringed topoi. If `E` is a strictly perfect
complex of `O_D`-modules, then `f^*E`, the degreewise pullback, is a strictly perfect complex of
`O_C`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStrictlyPerfect_pullbackModules (f : RingedToposHom X Y)
    {E : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)) ℤ}
    (hE : IsStrictlyPerfect (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O) E) :
    IsStrictlyPerfect (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)
      (((f.toModulesHom.pullbackModules).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj E)

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.StrictlyPerfectPullback.pullbackModules_preservesZeroMorphisms
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08H3, the additivity clause.** Pullback of sheaves of modules along a morphism
of ringed topoi preserves zero morphisms, being a left adjoint. This is what lets the functor
be applied degreewise to a complex.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullbackModules_preservesZeroMorphisms :
    (f.pullbackModules).PreservesZeroMorphisms
declarations.comment: additivity of pullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.StrictlyPerfectPullback.isStrictlyPerfect_pullbackModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08H3, the strict-perfectness clause.** The degreewise pullback of a strictly
perfect complex of `O_Y`-modules along a morphism of ringed topoi is a strictly perfect complex
of `O_X`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStrictlyPerfect_pullbackModules
    (E : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{0} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)) ℤ)
    (hE : IsStrictlyPerfect (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O) E) :
    letI := pullbackModules_preservesZeroMorphisms f
    IsStrictlyPerfect (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)
      (((f.pullbackModules).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj E)
declarations.comment: strict perfectness of the pullback complex

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.Hom.isPseudoCoherentFrom_derivedPullback_general
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08H4.** Let `f : (C, O) ⟶ (D, O')` be a morphism of ringed sites, given by a
continuous functor `u : D ⥤ C` whose sheaf pullback `u_s` is exact, and let `E` be an
`m`-pseudo-coherent object of `D(O')`. Then `Lf^* E` is `m`-pseudo-coherent.

No finite limits are asked of either site and `u` need not be left exact. The statement is at
`RingedSite.{u, u, u}`, the universes at which
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.Hom.toRingedToposSiteHom` and the derived pullback `Lf^*` of
Stacks 06YY are defined for a morphism of ringed sites.

Stacks 08H2 (the site-theoretic Sites 7.14.10) makes the objects `u(W)` cover every object of
`C`: each `U` has a covering `{U_i → U}` with maps `U_i → u(W_i)`.
`CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.coversTop_obj_subtype` refines that covering to the `u(W)`
over which `K` carries a strictly perfect approximation. Over such an object the pullback of the
approximation is a derived strictly perfect approximation of `(Lf^* E)|_{u(W)}`, by the cone
argument for the triangulated, bounded-above-preserving `L(f')^*` together with
`L(f')^* P = (f')^* P` on the strictly perfect `P` and Stacks 08H3; it descends along any arrow
into `u(W)` by exactness of restriction, which is what the arrows of that covering supply.
declarations.statement:
theorem Hom.isPseudoCoherentFrom_derivedPullback_general
    (E : DerivedCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (ringedTopos Y).O)))
    (m : ℤ)
    (hE : Y.IsPseudoCoherentFrom E m) :
    X.IsPseudoCoherentFrom ((derivedPullback f.toRingedToposSiteHom).obj E) m

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.hasTorAmplitude_derivedPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08H5.**  The derived pullback along a morphism of ringed topoi preserves Tor
amplitude in a fixed interval.

A degenerate interval `b < a` says that the derived tensor products of `E` with every module
vanish in *every* degree, so in particular `E` has Tor amplitude in the one-point interval
`[i + 1, i + 1]` for whichever degree `i` is being examined, and
`hasTorAmplitude_derivedPullback_of_le` applies there.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasTorAmplitude_derivedPullback
    (T : DerivedTensorProduct Y.toRingedSite) (T' : DerivedTensorProduct X.toRingedSite)
    (E : RingedSite.DerivedModules Y.toRingedSite) (a b : ℤ)
    (hamp : HasTorAmplitude T E a b) :
    HasTorAmplitude T' ((derivedPullback f).obj E) a b

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.Hom.isPerfect_derivedPullback_of_isPerfect
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08H6.** Let `f : (C, O_C) ⟶ (D, O_D)` be a morphism of ringed sites and let `E` be
an object of `D(O_D)`. If `E` is perfect, then `Lf^* E` is perfect in `D(O_C)`.

The morphism of ringed sites is the one of Stacks 00X1: a continuous functor `u : D ⥤ C` whose
`u_s` is exact. Neither site is assumed to have finite limits and `u` is not assumed to preserve
them.

Stacks 08H2 makes the objects `u(W)` cover the final object of `Sh(C)`, and
`CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.coversTop_obj_subtype` refines that covering to the `u(W)`
over which `K` carries a strictly perfect derived model. Over such an object the pullback of the
model is a strictly perfect derived model of `(Lf^* E)|_{u(W)}`
(`hasStrictlyPerfectModel_image`, through the derived localization square
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.Hom.nonempty_derivedPullbackLocalizedIso_of_noFiniteLimits`), and
it descends along any arrow into `u(W)` by exactness of restriction
(`hasStrictlyPerfectModel_of_hom`), which is what the arrows of that covering supply; Stacks
08G6 (1) assembles.
declarations.statement:
theorem Hom.isPerfect_derivedPullback_of_isPerfect
    (E : DerivedCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{0} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (ringedTopos Y).O)))
    (hE : Y.IsPerfect E) :
    X.IsPerfect ((derivedPullback f.toRingedToposSiteHom).obj E)
declarations.comment:
for a morphism of ringed sites in the sense of 00X1, with no finite limits on
  either site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.representedToSchemeZariskiRingedToposHom
declarations.doc:
**`ε : (X_étale, 𝒪_X) ⟶ (X_{0, Zar}, 𝒪_{X_0})` as a morphism of ringed topoi**, for `X = h_U`
the algebraic space represented by an object `U` of the big fppf site over `S` and `X_0` the
scheme underlying `U`.

This is Equation 75.4.0.1 of Stacks Section 75.4, read on the small étale site of the algebraic
space: the composite of the equivalence of that site with the small étale site of `X_0`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.representedEtaleRingedToposHom`) with the comparison
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.toZariskiAbstractRingedToposHom` of the small étale and small
Zariski sites of `X_0`.

Being a morphism of ringed topoi, it carries `ε⁻¹` on sheaves of commutative rings
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.representedZariskiInverseImageCommRing`) and the inverse-image form
`ε⁻¹𝒪_{X_0} ⟶ 𝒪_X` of its structure map
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.representedZariskiStructureSharpInverseImage`), which is what the
canonical map of Stacks 0D0X is built from.
declarations.statement:
public def representedToSchemeZariskiRingedToposHom :
    AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom
      (smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS (representedAlgebraicSpace B S hS U))
      ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U).zariskiRingedTopos
declarations.comment: the morphism ε of the displayed equation, as a morphism of ringed topoi, for the small étale site of an algebraic space represented by a scheme — the same ε as `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.toZariskiAbstractRingedToposHom`, read along the equivalence of that site with the small étale site of the representing scheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.preservesFiniteLimits_associatedModule
declarations.doc:
**The exactness assertion of Stacks 08H8.**  The associated-module functor
`ε^* = (𝓕 ↦ 𝓕^a)` of Stacks 03DU (4) at `τ = étale` is left exact.

Stacks 08H8 deduces this from flatness of `ε`, which is Stacks 0GNA; the criterion is Stacks
04JC, available for the pullback of sheaves of modules along the four-field morphism of ringed
topoi attached to `ε`, and that pullback is `ε^*` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSite.HomGeneral.pullbackModulesToposIsoGeneral`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem preservesFiniteLimits_associatedModule :
    PreservesFiniteLimits (associatedModule B S hS)
declarations.comment:
the exactness assertion: `ε^* : Mod(𝒪_S) → Mod(𝒪_étale)` is left exact, hence
  exact, right exactness being automatic for a left adjoint.  The flatness assertion is carried
  by isFlatMapULift_inverseImageStructureMap; the zero-detection assertion
  `ε^*𝓕 = 0 ⟹ 𝓕 = 0` is not carried here, and is available for a quasi-coherent module as
  isZero_of_isZero_associatedModule

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isZero_of_isZero_associatedModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08H8, the zero-detection assertion, for quasi-coherent modules.**  A quasi-coherent
`𝒪_X`-module `𝓕` whose pullback `ε^*𝓕` along the morphism of ringed sites
`ε : (X_étale, 𝒪) ⟶ (X_Zar, 𝒪_X)` is a zero object is itself a zero object.

The unit of the associated-module adjunction is a monomorphism at `𝓕`, and it factors through
`ε_*ε^*𝓕`, which vanishes with `ε^*𝓕`; so the identity of `𝓕` vanishes.  The source instead
computes the stalk of `ε^*𝓕` at a geometric point as `𝓕_x ⊗_{𝒪_{X, x}} 𝒪_{étale, x̄}` and
appeals to faithful flatness of the strict henselization. For an arbitrary `𝒪_X`-module the
assertion is `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isZero_of_isZero_associatedModule_general`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_of_isZero_associatedModule (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (h : IsZero ((associatedModule B X hX).obj F)) : IsZero F
declarations.comment: the zero-detection assertion `ε^*𝓕 = 0 ⟹ 𝓕 = 0`, for quasi-coherent `𝓕`, by a route needing no exactness. The flatness assertion is `isFlatMapULift_inverseImageStructureMap`, the exactness assertion is `preservesFiniteLimits_associatedModule`, and zero detection for an arbitrary `𝒪_X`-module is `isZero_of_isZero_associatedModule_general`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isFlatMapULift_inverseImageStructureMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0GNA.**  The morphism of ringed sites `ε = id_{small, étale, Zar} : S_étale → S_Zar`
is flat: `𝒪_{S_étale}` is a flat module over `ε⁻¹𝒪_{S_Zar}`, the flatness being asserted for
the structure map `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.inverseImageStructureMap` of `ε` in
inverse-image form.

This is also the first assertion of **Stacks 08H8**, which states exactly that the `ε` of
Equation 75.4.0.1 — `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.toZariskiRingedToposHom`, carrying Stacks
08H7 — is a flat morphism of ringed sites, and cites Descent, Lemma 35.10.1, which is 0GNA,
for it.  The second assertion of 08H8, exactness of `ε^*`, is carried by
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.exactFunctor_pullbackModules_toZariski`.  The third, the
implication `ε^*𝓕 = 0 ⟹ 𝓕 = 0`, is *not* carried by this statement and is not available in
the library; the attribute clause records that scope.
declarations.comment:
the flatness assertion: `ε` is a flat morphism of ringed sites.
  The exactness of `ε^* : Mod(𝒪_X) → Mod(𝒪_étale)` is carried by
  `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.exactFunctor_pullbackModules_toZariski`; the faithfulness
  assertion `ε^*𝓕 = 0 ⟹ 𝓕 = 0` is not carried here and is not in the library

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isRightAdjoint_toZariskiModulePushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08H8, the existence assertion.**  The direct image `ε_*` of sheaves of modules
along `ε = id_{small, étale, Zar} : S_étale → S_Zar` has a left adjoint, i.e. the pullback
`ε^* : Mod(𝒪_S) ⟶ Mod(𝒪_{S_étale})` exists.

The left adjoint is `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.toZariskiModulePullback` and the adjunction
exhibiting it is `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.toZariskiModulePullbackAdjPushforward`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isRightAdjoint_toZariskiModulePushforward :
    (toZariskiModulePushforward B S hS).IsRightAdjoint
declarations.comment:
the existence assertion: the direct image `ε_*` of sheaves of modules along `ε`
  has a left adjoint, i.e. `ε^* : Mod(𝒪_S) ⟶ Mod(𝒪_{S_étale})` exists.  Both functors are
  taken in the sense of Stacks 03D6 for the two-field morphism of ringed topoi of Stacks
  01D3 (2) carrying `ε`, which is the library's spelling of the pair; the left adjoint is
  `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.toZariskiModulePullback`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.exactFunctor_pullbackModules_toZariski
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08H8, the exactness assertion.**  The pullback `ε^*` of sheaves of modules along
`ε = id_{small, étale, Zar} : S_étale → S_Zar` is exact: it preserves finite limits and finite
colimits.

The flatness assertion of the same tag is
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isFlatMapULift_inverseImageStructureMap`, which is Stacks 0GNA;
the remaining assertion, that `ε^*𝓕 = 0` implies `𝓕 = 0`, is not carried here.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exactFunctor_pullbackModules_toZariski :
    exactFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.zariskiRingedTopos.O))
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (ringedTopos B S hS).O))
      (toZariskiModulePullback B S hS)
declarations.comment:
the exactness assertion: `ε^* : Mod(𝒪_S) ⟶ Mod(𝒪_{S_étale})` is exact, for `ε`
  the morphism of ringed topoi of Equation 75.4.0.1 in the two-field shape of Stacks 01D3 (2).
  The flatness assertion is carried by
  `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isFlatMapULift_inverseImageStructureMap`; the implication
  `ε^*𝓕 = 0 ⟹ 𝓕 = 0` is not carried here

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isZero_of_isZero_toZariskiModulePullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08H8, the faithfulness assertion.**  If the pullback `ε^*𝓕` of a sheaf of
`𝒪_S`-modules along `ε = id_{small, étale, Zar} : S_étale → S_Zar` vanishes, then `𝓕` vanishes.

The pullback is the inverse image of Stacks 03D2 followed by extension of scalars along the
structure map, and the two halves are reflected separately.  Extension of scalars reflects the
zero sheaf because the structure map is locally faithfully flat over the comparison presheaf
`(f : V → S) ↦ 𝒪_S(f(V))`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.locallyFaithfullyFlat_imageSectionsRestriction`), and the
inverse image reflects it by
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isZero_of_isZero_inverseImageModules`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isZero_of_isZero_toZariskiModulePullback
    (𝓕 : SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.zariskiRingedTopos.O))
    (h : IsZero ((toZariskiModulePullback B S hS).obj 𝓕)) : IsZero 𝓕
declarations.comment:
the faithfulness assertion: `ε^*𝓕 = 0 ⟹ 𝓕 = 0`, for `ε^*` the pullback of
  sheaves of modules of Stacks 03D6 (2) along the two-field morphism of ringed topoi of
  Stacks 01D3 (2) carrying `ε`.  The flatness assertion is carried by
  `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isFlatMapULift_inverseImageStructureMap`, the exactness
  assertion by `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.exactFunctor_pullbackModules_toZariski` and the
  existence assertion by
  `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isRightAdjoint_toZariskiModulePushforward`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.mayerVietoris_derivedHom_longExactSequence_of_eds_lowerShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08H9, with nothing assumed and with every map of the sequence named.**  Let
`(U ⊆ X, j_V : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary distinguished square of algebraic spaces over a scheme
`S`, let `P = U ×_X V` and write `(-)|_Y` for restriction of modules along `j_Y : Y ⟶ X`.  Then
for all objects `E` and `F` of `D(𝒪_X)` the Mayer–Vietoris sequence

`⋯ ⟶ Ext⁻¹(E|_P, F|_P) ⟶ Hom(E, F) ⟶ Hom(E|_U, F|_U) ⊕ Hom(E|_V, F|_V) ⟶ Hom(E|_P, F|_P) ⟶ ⋯`

is exact at each of its three kinds of spot and in every integer degree, the homomorphism groups
of the restrictions being taken in the derived categories of `U`, of `V` and of `P`.

Every map of the sequence is named; none of the three is quantified over.

* **The restriction map is the restriction map.**  In degree `n` it carries `x : E ⟶ F⟦n⟧` to the
  pair of the actions `CategoryTheory.ShiftedHom.map` of the two derived restrictions on it, so
  neither a choice nor an extension by zero enters it.
* **The second map is the difference of the two restrictions to the intersection.**  It is
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.edsDerivedHomRestrictionOpen` on the first summand minus
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.edsDerivedHomRestrictionEtale` on the second; each of those is the map
  induced by the comparison of the square attached to the corresponding factorization of `j_P`,
  and the two clauses below record that each carries the restriction of a morphism of `D(𝒪_X)` to
  the restriction of that morphism to `P`.
* **The connecting homomorphism is the one of the Mayer–Vietoris triangle.**  The morphism `δ` is
  bound as the third map of the distinguished triangle of part (2) of Stacks 08GV, read at the
  composites of the derived functors, and `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.edsDerivedHomBoundary` is
  composition with that same `δ`, as the third clause below records.

Nothing beyond the square is assumed: the extension-by-zero data is not quantified over but is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleModuleLowerShriek` with its adjunctions
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction`, its exactness is the theorem
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.preservesFiniteLimits_etaleModuleLowerShriek` (Stacks 03DJ) with its two
companions, and the two sheafification hypotheses of the ambient site are discharged by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleRingedSite_hasSheafify_addCommGrpCat` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleRingedSite_wEqualsLocallyBijective_addCommGrpCat`.

This is the one library registration of Tag 08H9, and the elementary distinguished square is its
only binder.
declarations.statement:
theorem mayerVietoris_derivedHom_longExactSequence_of_eds_lowerShriek
    (E F : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2)) :
    ∃ δ : E ⟶ ((etaleModuleLowerShriek B S hS (edsInterHom B S hS hsq)
        (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsInterHom B S hS hsq)
            (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      Triangle.mk
          (biprod.lift
            ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryComp (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS
                  (edsInterHom B S hS hsq) (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq))
                      (etaleModuleLowerShriek B S hS (edsInterHom B S hS hsq)
                        (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq))).inv.app E ≫
              (NatTrans.mapDerivedCategory
                (edsShriekOpenComparison B S hS hsq
                    (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)
                      (isEtale_edsOpenHom B S hS hsq))
                          (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsInterHom B S hS hsq)
                            (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq)))).app E ≫
              (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryComp (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS
                (edsOpenHom B S hS hsq) (isEtale_edsOpenHom B S hS hsq))
                    (etaleModuleLowerShriek B S hS (edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)
                      (isEtale_edsOpenHom B S hS hsq))).hom.app E)
            (-((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryComp (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS
                  (edsInterHom B S hS hsq) (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq))
                      (etaleModuleLowerShriek B S hS (edsInterHom B S hS hsq)
                        (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq))).inv.app E ≫
              (NatTrans.mapDerivedCategory
                (edsShriekEtaleComparison B S hS hsq
                    (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
                      (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq))
                          (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsInterHom B S hS hsq)
                            (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq)))).app E ≫
              (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryComp (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS
                (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq) (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq))
                    (etaleModuleLowerShriek B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
                      (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq))).hom.app E)))
          (biprod.desc
            ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryComp (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS
                  (edsOpenHom B S hS hsq) (isEtale_edsOpenHom B S hS hsq))
                      (etaleModuleLowerShriek B S hS (edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)
                        (isEtale_edsOpenHom B S hS hsq))).inv.app E ≫
              (NatTrans.mapDerivedCategory
                  (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)
                    (isEtale_edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)).counit).app E ≫
              (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryIdIso _).hom.app E)
            ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryComp (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS
                  (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq) (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq))
                      (etaleModuleLowerShriek B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
                        (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq))).inv.app E ≫
              (NatTrans.mapDerivedCategory
                  (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
                    (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)).counit).app E ≫
              (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryIdIso _).hom.app E)) δ ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : E ⟶ F⟦n⟧),
        edsDerivedHomRestrictionOpen B S hS hsq E F n
            (ShiftedHom.map x (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)
              (isEtale_edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory) =
          ShiftedHom.map x (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsInterHom B S hS hsq)
            (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : E ⟶ F⟦n⟧),
        edsDerivedHomRestrictionEtale B S hS hsq E F n
            (ShiftedHom.map x (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
              (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory) =
          ShiftedHom.map x (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsInterHom B S hS hsq)
            (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (z : ((etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsInterHom B S hS hsq)
          (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ⟶
          ((etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsInterHom B S hS hsq)
              (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory.obj F)⟦n⟧)),
        edsDerivedHomBoundary B S hS hsq E F δ n z =
          δ ≫ (((etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS (edsInterHom B S hS hsq)
                  (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq)).shiftedHomMapDerivedCategoryEquiv
                ((etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsInterHom B S hS hsq)
                  (isEtale_edsInterHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E) F n).symm
              z)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫
            (shiftFunctorAdd' (DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2))
              n 1 (n + 1) rfl).inv.app F) ∧
      ∀ n : ℤ,
        Function.Exact
            (fun x : E ⟶ F⟦n⟧ =>
              (ShiftedHom.map x (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)
                (isEtale_edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory,
                ShiftedHom.map x (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
                  (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory))
            (fun w => edsDerivedHomRestrictionOpen B S hS hsq E F n w.1 -
              edsDerivedHomRestrictionEtale B S hS hsq E F n w.2) ∧
          Function.Exact
            (fun w : ((etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)
                (isEtale_edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ⟶
                ((etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)
                    (isEtale_edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory.obj F)⟦n⟧) ×
                ((etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
                    (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ⟶
                    ((etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
                        (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory.obj F)⟦n⟧) =>
              edsDerivedHomRestrictionOpen B S hS hsq E F n w.1 -
                edsDerivedHomRestrictionEtale B S hS hsq E F n w.2)
            (edsDerivedHomBoundary B S hS hsq E F δ n) ∧
          Function.Exact (edsDerivedHomBoundary B S hS hsq E F δ n)
            (fun x : E ⟶ F⟦n + 1⟧ =>
              (ShiftedHom.map x (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)
                (isEtale_edsOpenHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory,
                ShiftedHom.map x (etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)
                  (isEtale_edsEtaleHom B S hS hsq)).mapDerivedCategory))
declarations.comment: the whole tag, and its one library registration: the Mayer-Vietoris sequence of an elementary distinguished square is exact at each of its three kinds of spot and in every integer degree, its first map being the pair of the two derived restrictions of a shifted morphism, its second the difference of the two restrictions to the intersection, and its connecting map that of the triangle of 08GV part (2); the square is the only binder

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_restrictEtaleModuleLowerShriekMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08HA**, on sheaves of modules. Let `j : U ⟶ X` and `j_V : V ⟶ X` be étale morphisms of
algebraic spaces, let `W = V ×_X U` with projections `j_W : W ⟶ V` and `p : W ⟶ U`, and let `F` be
a sheaf of `𝒪_U`-modules. Then the canonical map `j_{W!}(F|_W) ⟶ (j_!F)|_V` is an isomorphism, that
is, `(j_!F)|_V = j_{W!}(F|_W)`, where `j_!` and `j_{W!}` are the extensions by zero
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleModuleLowerShriek`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_restrictEtaleModuleLowerShriekMap :
    IsIso (restrictExtensionByZeroMap B S hS sq hj hjV
      (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS j hj)
      (etaleModuleLowerShriekAdjunction B S hS jW
        (isEtale_of_isPullback B S hS p jW j jV sq.flip hj)))
declarations.comment: on modules, for the constructed extension by zero

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_derivedRestrictEtaleModuleLowerShriekMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08HA.** Let `j : U ⟶ X` and `j_V : V ⟶ X` be étale morphisms of algebraic spaces, let

unbounded derived category of `𝒪_U`-modules. Then the canonical map `j_{W!}(E|_W) ⟶ (j_!E)|_V` is
an isomorphism, that is, `(j_!E)|_V = j_{W!}(E|_W)`, where `j_!` and `j_{W!}` are the derived
functors of the exact extensions by zero `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleModuleLowerShriek`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedRestrictEtaleModuleLowerShriekMap :
    IsIso (derivedRestrictEtaleModuleLowerShriekMap B S hS sq hj hjV)
declarations.comment: for the constructed extension by zero, on any model of the derived categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_glued_object_and_hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08HB.**  Let `(U ⊆ X, j_V : V ⟶ X)` be an elementary distinguished square of
algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`, let `P = U ×_X V` be its intersection and write `(-)|_Y`
for restriction of modules along the étale morphism `j_Y : Y ⟶ X`.  Then an object `A` of
`D(𝒪_U)`, an object `Bo` of `D(𝒪_V)` and an isomorphism `c : A|_P ⟶ Bo|_P` are glued by an
object `F` of `D(𝒪_X)` together with isomorphisms `f : F|_U ⟶ A` and `g : F|_V ⟶ Bo`
satisfying `c = g|_P ∘ f^{-1}|_P`; and moreover, for every object `E` of `D(𝒪_X)` and all
morphisms `a : A ⟶ E|_U` and `b : Bo ⟶ E|_V` with `a|_P = b|_P ∘ c`, there is a morphism
`φ : F ⟶ E` restricting to `a ∘ f` on `U` and to `b ∘ g` on `V`.

The glued object is the source's own, the fibre of
`Rj_{U,*}A ⊕ Rj_{V,*}Bo ⟶ Rj_{P,*}(Bo|_P)`, built in
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_glued_object`; the induced morphism is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_hom_of_glueData_of_isElementaryDistinguishedSquare` at the
canonical extension by zero, whose hypothesis `hc` is in exactly the shape the first conclusion
has.  The compatibility over `P` is written with the identifications
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.edsDerivedRestrictCompOpen` and `…edsDerivedRestrictCompEtale` of the
iterated restrictions with the restriction to `P`, which the source writes silently.

The source's object `B` of `D(𝒪_V)` is written `Bo` here, the letter `B` being the big fppf
site.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_glued_object_and_hom
    (A : DerivedCategory
      (Modules.{u, u} B S hS (edsOpen B S hS hsq).1 (edsOpen B S hS hsq).2))
    (Bo : DerivedCategory
      (Modules.{u, u} B S hS (edsEtale B S hS hsq).1 (edsEtale B S hS hsq).2))
    (c : (edsRestrictFst B S hS hsq).mapDerivedCategory.obj A ≅
      (edsRestrictSnd B S hS hsq).mapDerivedCategory.obj Bo) :
    ∃ (F : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2))
      (f : (edsRestrictOpen B S hS hsq).mapDerivedCategory.obj F ≅ A)
      (g : (edsRestrictEtale B S hS hsq).mapDerivedCategory.obj F ≅ Bo),
      c.hom = (edsRestrictFst B S hS hsq).mapDerivedCategory.map f.inv ≫
          (edsDerivedRestrictCompOpen B S hS hsq).hom.app F ≫
            (edsDerivedRestrictCompEtale B S hS hsq).inv.app F ≫
            (edsRestrictSnd B S hS hsq).mapDerivedCategory.map g.hom ∧
        ∀ (E : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS W.1 W.2))
          (a : A ⟶ (edsRestrictOpen B S hS hsq).mapDerivedCategory.obj E)
          (b : Bo ⟶ (edsRestrictEtale B S hS hsq).mapDerivedCategory.obj E),
          (edsRestrictFst B S hS hsq).mapDerivedCategory.map a ≫
              (edsDerivedRestrictCompOpen B S hS hsq).hom.app E =
            c.hom ≫ (edsRestrictSnd B S hS hsq).mapDerivedCategory.map b ≫
              (edsDerivedRestrictCompEtale B S hS hsq).hom.app E →
          ∃ φ : F ⟶ E,
            (edsRestrictOpen B S hS hsq).mapDerivedCategory.map φ = f.hom ≫ a ∧
              (edsRestrictEtale B S hS hsq).mapDerivedCategory.map φ = g.hom ≫ b
declarations.comment:
both assertions, for an elementary distinguished square (U ⊆ X, j_V : V ⟶ X) of
algebraic spaces over a scheme S with intersection P = U ×_X V and nothing else bound: for an
object A of D(O_U), an object Bo of D(O_V) and an isomorphism c : A|_P ≅ Bo|_P, an object F of
D(O_X) with isomorphisms f : F|_U ≅ A and g : F|_V ≅ Bo satisfying c = g|_P ∘ f⁻¹|_P, and, for
every object E of D(O_X) and all morphisms a : A ⟶ E|_U and b : Bo ⟶ E|_V with
a|_P = b|_P ∘ c, a morphism φ : F ⟶ E whose restriction to U is a ∘ f and whose restriction to
V is b ∘ g. The compatibility over P is written with the identifications edsDerivedRestrictCompOpen
and edsDerivedRestrictCompEtale of the iterated restrictions with the restriction to P

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isFiniteTypeOnSite_associatedModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08HD, the implication (1) ⇒ (2).**  The pullback `ε^*𝓕` along the morphism of
ringed sites `ε : (X_étale, 𝒪) ⟶ (X_Zar, 𝒪_X)` of an `𝒪_X`-module of finite type is of finite
type on the small étale site of `X`.

This is Stacks 03DO at `ε`: the image open of Stacks 03WT factors every object of the small
étale site through an open of `X`, uniquely, so sections generating `𝓕` over an open have
unit images generating `ε^*𝓕` over it.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteTypeOnSite_associatedModule (F : X.Modules)
    (hF : SheafOfModules.IsFiniteTypeOnSite F) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteTypeOnSite ((associatedModule B X hX).obj F)
declarations.comment: the implication (1) ⇒ (2), with finite type in the categorical form of 03DL (5). The converse is `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isFiniteTypeOnSite_of_associatedModule`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isFiniteTypeOnSite_of_associatedModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08HD, the implication (2) ⇒ (1).**  An `𝒪_X`-module whose pullback `ε^*𝓕` along
the morphism of ringed sites `ε : (X_étale, 𝒪) ⟶ (X_Zar, 𝒪_X)` is of finite type on the small
étale site of `X` is itself of finite type, the finite-type condition being in the categorical
form `SheafOfModules.IsFiniteTypeOnSite` of Stacks 03DL (5).

The covering family of opens is the family of *all* opens of `X` carrying finitely many
generating sections, so no choice of covering is recorded: what has to be shown is that those
opens cover, and that is the content of
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.exists_imageOpen_generates`.  Given a point `x` of an open `W`,
the finite-type hypothesis at the object of `W` gives an object of the small étale site whose
image contains `x` and on which `ε^*𝓕` has finitely many generating sections; shrinking it
replaces those by unit images of sections of `𝓕` over its image open, which is contained in
`W` and contains `x`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteTypeOnSite_of_associatedModule (F : X.Modules)
    (h : SheafOfModules.IsFiniteTypeOnSite ((associatedModule B X hX).obj F)) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteTypeOnSite F
declarations.comment: the implication (2) ⇒ (1), with finite type in the categorical form of 03DL (5). The source deduces it from the stalk description of `ε^*`; here it is deduced from the zero-detection assertion of 08H8 for an arbitrary `𝒪_X`-module, `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isZero_of_isZero_associatedModule_general`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.associatedModuleToPseudoCoherent
declarations.doc:
If `ε^*E` is `m`-pseudo-coherent on the small étale site of `S` then `E` is
`m`-pseudo-coherent on the small Zariski site of `S`, `ε` being the comparison of ringed sites and
the derived functor being `CategoryTheory.Functor.mapDerivedCategory` of the associated-module
functor.
declarations.statement:
public theorem associatedModuleToPseudoCoherent
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} S.ringCatSheaf)) (m : ℤ) :
    AssociatedModuleToPseudoCoherent B S hS E m
declarations.comment:
clause (2) ⇒ (1): if `ε^*E` is `m`-pseudo-coherent on the small étale site of
  `S` then `E` is `m`-pseudo-coherent on the small Zariski site of `S`, `ε` being the
  comparison of ringed sites of Stacks 08H7.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.pseudoCoherentIffAssociatedModule
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme, let `E` be an object of `D(𝒪_S)` and let `m` be an integer. Then `E` is
`m`-pseudo-coherent on the small Zariski site of `S` if and only if `ε^*E` is `m`-pseudo-coherent
on the small étale site of `S`, where `ε : (S_étale, 𝒪) ⟶ (S_Zar, 𝒪_S)` is the comparison of
ringed sites.
declarations.statement:
public theorem pseudoCoherentIffAssociatedModule
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} S.ringCatSheaf)) (m : ℤ) :
    PseudoCoherentIffAssociatedModule B S hS E m

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.pseudoCoherentToAssociatedModule_of_slice_exact
declarations.doc:
If `E` is `m`-pseudo-coherent on the small Zariski site of `S` then `ε^*E` is
`m`-pseudo-coherent on the small étale site of `S`, where the derived functor is
`CategoryTheory.Functor.mapDerivedCategory` of the associated-module functor.
declarations.statement:
public theorem pseudoCoherentToAssociatedModule_of_slice_exact
    (E : DerivedCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.zariskiRingedSite.O)))
    (m : ℤ) :
    PseudoCoherentToAssociatedModule B S hS E m
declarations.comment:
clause (1) ⇒ (2) only: if `E` is `m`-pseudo-coherent on the small Zariski site of
  `S` then `ε^*E` is `m`-pseudo-coherent on the small étale site of `S`, `ε` being the comparison
  of Stacks 08H7. Clause (2) ⇒ (1) is
  `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.associatedModuleToPseudoCoherent`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.hasTorAmplitude_derivedPullback_of_hasTorAmplitude
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08HF, clause (1).**  An object `E` of `D(𝒪_S)` has Tor amplitude in `[a, b]` for a
derived tensor product datum `T` on the small Zariski ringed site of `S` **if and only if** its
derived pullback `Lε^*E` along the comparison `ε` of Stacks 08H7, read on the `Type u`-presented
model of the small étale ringed topos, has Tor amplitude in `[a, b]` for a derived tensor product
datum `T'` on the model.  Both data are arbitrary.

Forwards this is Stacks 08H5.  Backwards it is
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.DerivedTensorProduct.hasTorAmplitude_of_hasTorAmplitude_derivedPullback`,
whose two inputs about `ε_model` — that the degreewise pullback of sheaves of modules is exact
and that it detects the zero sheaf — are the two assertions of Stacks 08H8, read on the model in
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.preservesFiniteLimits_pullbackTopos_toZariskiSmallModelHom` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.isZero_of_isZero_pullbackTopos_toZariskiSmallModelHom`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem hasTorAmplitude_derivedPullback_of_hasTorAmplitude
    (T : DerivedTensorProduct S.zariskiRingedTopos.toRingedSite)
    (T' : DerivedTensorProduct (smallModelRingedTopos B S hS).toRingedSite)
    (E : RingedSite.DerivedModules S.zariskiRingedTopos.toRingedSite) (a b : ℤ) :
