declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.trivialExtensionModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LB, part (1).** The *trivial extension* `ℱ'_{c,triv}` of `ℱ` by
`𝒦` attached to `c` and a trivialization `π`: the direct sum `ℱ ⊕ 𝒦`, carried to `X'` by `i_*`,
with the `𝒪_{X'}`-module structure built from the splitting of **Stacks 08LA** and the map `c`,

    r · (m, n) = (r m, r n + c(d r ⊗ m)),

where `d r = r - π^♯(i^♯ r)` is the derivation of the trivialization.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def trivialExtensionModule : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X')
declarations.comment: part (1): the trivial extension `ℱ'_{c,triv} = ℱ ⊕ 𝒦`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.trivialExtensionModule_smul
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LB, part (1).** The `𝒪_{X'}`-module structure of the trivial
extension: a section of `𝒪_{X'}` acts diagonally on `ℱ ⊕ 𝒦` and moves the `ℱ`-coordinate into
the `𝒦`-coordinate through `c` and the derivation of the trivialization. Together with
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.trivialExtensionModule`, whose sections over `U` are
by construction the pairs `ℱ(i^{-1}U) × 𝒦(i^{-1}U)`, this is the whole content of part (1).
declarations.statement:
theorem trivialExtensionModule_smul (U : (Opens X'.carrier)ᵒᵖ)
    (r : (structureSheafRing X').obj.obj U)
    (z : (trivialExtensionModule i π F K c hi).val.obj U) :
    r • z = (r • z.1, r • z.2 +
      extensionPairing i F K c U (trivializationDerivation i π hi.1.1 U r) z.1)
declarations.comment: part (1): the action of `𝒪_{X'}` on `ℱ ⊕ 𝒦`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.trivialExtensionShortComplex_shortExact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LB, part (2).** The trivial extension sits in a short exact
sequence `0 ⟶ i_* 𝒦 ⟶ ℱ'_{c,triv} ⟶ i_* ℱ ⟶ 0` of `𝒪_{X'}`-modules: the inclusion of the
second summand is a kernel of the projection onto the first.
declarations.statement:
theorem trivialExtensionShortComplex_shortExact :
    (trivialExtensionShortComplex i π F K c hi).ShortExact
declarations.comment: part (2): the trivial extension is an extension as in 08L4

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.trivialYonedaExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LB, part (2).** The trivial extension, read as an extension of
`i_* ℱ` by `i_* 𝒦` in the sense of **Stacks 08L4**.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def trivialYonedaExtension :
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.YonedaExtension ((modulePushforward i).obj F)
      ((modulePushforward i).obj K) 0
declarations.comment: part (2): the trivial extension as a Yoneda extension

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.trivialYonedaExtension_action
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LB, part (2').** The canonical map of the trivial extension is the
prescribed one: `c_{ℱ'_{c,triv}} = c`. This is what places `ℱ'_{c,triv}` in the set of
extensions with `c = c_{ℱ'}` that part (4) of the remark puts in bijection with
`Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒦)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem trivialYonedaExtension_action :
    (firstOrderExtensionAction i F K hi (trivialYonedaExtension i π F K c hi)).1 = c
declarations.comment: part (2'): the canonical map of the trivial extension is `c`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.splitRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LB, part (3).** Reading a sheaf of `𝒪_{X'}`-modules as a sheaf of
`𝒪_X`-modules along a trivialization: pushforward along the retraction.

This is the ringed-space form of the source's "use `π^♯ : 𝒪_X ⟶ 𝒪_{X'}` to think of `ℱ'` as an
`𝒪_X`-module". On a single site one would restrict scalars along `π^♯`
(`Stacks.SheafOfModules.restrictScalarsSplitIso`), but here `X` and `X'` carry different sites
`Opens X` and `Opens X'`, so the reindexing of opens along the homeomorphism `π` has to be
carried along with the restriction of scalars — which is exactly what `π_*` does.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev splitRestriction :
    SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X') ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)
declarations.comment: part (3): reading an extension as an `𝒪_X`-module along the trivialization

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.splitExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LB, part (3).** The extension `0 ⟶ i_* 𝒦 ⟶ ℱ' ⟶ i_* ℱ ⟶ 0` of
`𝒪_{X'}`-modules, read as a short complex of `𝒪_X`-modules along the trivialization. Its outer
terms are `𝒦` and `ℱ` themselves, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.splitRestrictionIso`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def splitExtension : ShortComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X))
declarations.comment: part (3): an extension read as a sequence of `𝒪_X`-modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.splitExtension_shortExact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LB, part (3).** An extension across the thickening, read along the
trivialization, is again short exact — which is what makes the class `ξ_{ℱ'}` available.

Pushforward along `π.retraction` is left exact because it is a right adjoint
(`RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePushforward_isRightAdjoint`) and right exact because the
base map of a trivialization is a homeomorphism
(`Stacks.ClosedImmersion.preservesFiniteColimits_modulePushforward_of_isIso_base`), so the
sequence maps across by `CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.ShortExact.map_of_exact`; the outer terms
are then only reindexed by isomorphisms.
declarations.statement: theorem splitExtension_shortExact : (splitExtension i π F K E).ShortExact
declarations.comment: part (3): the sequence read over `𝒪_X` is short exact

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.underlyingExtensionClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LB, part (3).** The class `ξ_{ℱ'} ∈ Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒦)` of an
extension of `ℱ` by `𝒦` across a trivialized first order thickening of ringed spaces: the
trivialization lets the extension be read as an extension of `𝒪_X`-modules, and this is the
class of that extension.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def underlyingExtensionClass
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X))] :
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext F K 1
declarations.comment: part (3): the class `ξ_{ℱ'}` of an extension

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.underlyingExtensionClass_trivialYonedaExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LB, part (5).** The trivial extension maps to the zero class:
`ξ_{ℱ'_{c,triv}} = 0` in `Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒦)`.

Read along the trivialization the sequence `0 ⟶ 𝒦 ⟶ ℱ ⊕ 𝒦 ⟶ ℱ ⟶ 0` splits, because the
derivation `d` kills every scalar pulled back along `π` and so the correction term `c(d r ⊗ m)`
in the action disappears — the projection onto the `𝒦`-summand, which is not `𝒪_{X'}`-linear,
becomes `𝒪_X`-linear. A split short exact sequence has zero class by
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.extClass_eq_zero_of_retraction`.
declarations.statement:
theorem underlyingExtensionClass_trivialYonedaExtension
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X))] :
    underlyingExtensionClass i π hi.1.1 F K (trivialYonedaExtension i π F K c hi) = 0
declarations.comment: part (5): the trivial extension has class `ξ_{ℱ'_{c,triv}} = 0`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.exists_iso_of_underlyingExtensionClass_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LB, part (4).** *Injectivity of `ℱ' ↦ ξ_{ℱ'}` on isomorphism
classes:* two extensions across the thickening with the same canonical map and the same class
`ξ` are isomorphic as extensions, by an isomorphism of their middle terms compatible with both
end terms.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.extClass_eq_of_underlyingExtensionClass_eq`
together with the fact that two short exact sequences with the same class in `Ext¹` are
isomorphic over the identity of both end terms
(`CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.extClass_surjective_and_eq_iff_iso_and_baerSum`).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_iso_of_underlyingExtensionClass_eq
    (E E' : Abelian.YonedaExtension ((modulePushforward i).obj F)
      ((modulePushforward i).obj K) 0)
    (hact : (firstOrderExtensionAction i F K hi E).val =
      (firstOrderExtensionAction i F K hi E').val)
    (hξ : underlyingExtensionClass i π hi.1.1 F K E =
      underlyingExtensionClass i π hi.1.1 F K E') :
    ∃ φ : E.Z.left ≅ E'.Z.left, E.f ≫ φ.hom = E'.f ∧ φ.hom ≫ E'.g = E.g
declarations.comment: part (4): injectivity of `ℱ' ↦ ξ_{ℱ'}` — two extensions as in 08L4 with the same canonical map `c` and the same class `ξ` are isomorphic as extensions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.exists_yonedaExtension_underlyingExtensionClass_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LB, part (4).** *Surjectivity of `ℱ' ↦ ξ_{ℱ'}`:* every class
`η ∈ Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒦)` is the class `ξ_{ℱ'}` of an extension `ℱ'` as in **Stacks 08L4** whose
canonical map is the prescribed `c`.

Realize `η` as an extension of `𝒪_X`-modules and push it forward along the thickening: its
middle term is a direct image, so by **Stacks 08L7** it can be added to the trivial extension
`ℱ'_{c,triv}` of part (1) without changing the canonical map, which is `c` by part (2'). The
class of the sum is `0 + η = η` by part (5) and additivity.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_yonedaExtension_underlyingExtensionClass_eq
    (c : (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨((X)).presheaf, ((X)).IsSheaf⟩).obj
      ((idealSheafPullback i))).obj (F)) ⟶ K) (η : Abelian.Ext.{e} F K 1) :
    ∃ E : Abelian.YonedaExtension ((modulePushforward i).obj F)
        ((modulePushforward i).obj K) 0,
      (firstOrderExtensionAction i F K hi E).val = c ∧
        underlyingExtensionClass i π hi.1.1 F K E = η
declarations.comment: part (4): surjectivity of `ℱ' ↦ ξ_{ℱ'}` — every class in `Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒦)` is the class of an extension as in 08L4 with canonical map `c`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.bijective_underlyingExtensionClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LB, part (4).** `ℱ' ↦ ξ_{ℱ'}` *is a bijection* from the isomorphism
classes of extensions `0 ⟶ i_* 𝒦 ⟶ ℱ' ⟶ i_* ℱ ⟶ 0` as in **Stacks 08L4** with
`c = c_{ℱ'}` onto `Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒦)`.

The isomorphism classes are the elements of
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.extensionClassesWithAction`, i.e. are represented by
their classes in `Ext¹_{𝒪_{X'}}(i_* ℱ, i_* 𝒦)`, and the map is
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.splitRestrictionExtHom`, which on the class of `ℱ'` is
`ξ_{ℱ'}` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.underlyingExtensionClass_eq_splitRestrictionExtHom`.
The two halves of the statement, read on extensions rather than on classes, are
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.exists_yonedaExtension_underlyingExtensionClass_eq` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.exists_iso_of_underlyingExtensionClass_eq`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_underlyingExtensionClass
    (c : (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨((X)).presheaf, ((X)).IsSheaf⟩).obj
      ((idealSheafPullback i))).obj (F)) ⟶ K) :
    Function.Bijective (fun ξ : ↥(extensionClassesWithAction i F K hi c) =>
      splitRestrictionExtHom i π hi.1.1 F K ξ.1)
declarations.comment: part (4): `ℱ' ↦ ξ_{ℱ'}` is a bijection from the isomorphism classes of extensions as in 08L4 with `c = c_{ℱ'}` onto `Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒦)`, the isomorphism classes being represented by their classes in `Ext¹_{𝒪_{X'}}(i_* ℱ, i_* 𝒦)`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.PushoutDescentData.extensionOne
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LC.** The extension over the first thickening produced from an
extension over the second: the pushout `ℱ'₂ ⊔_{𝒦₂} 𝒦₁` carries an `𝒪_{X'}`-module structure,
built by descending the action of `T = 𝒪'₂ ⋉ ℐ₁` twisted by `c₁` along the locally surjective
`q : T ⟶ 𝒪_{X'}`, and sits in a short exact sequence `0 → i_* 𝒦₁ → ℱ'₁ → i_* ℱ → 0` of
`𝒪_{X'}`-modules. Its middle term restricted along `q` is identified with the pushout by
`middleIso`, compatibly with the two maps by `restrictScalars_extInclOne` and
`restrictScalars_extQuotOne`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def extensionOne :
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.YonedaExtension ((modulePushforward i).obj dat.F)
      ((modulePushforward i).obj dat.K₁) 0
declarations.comment: the canonical map on extensions, by pushout along the map of kernel modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.PushoutDescentData.extensionOne_action
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LC.** The canonical map of Tag 08L4 of the extension produced over
the first thickening is the prescribed `c₁`.
declarations.statement:
theorem extensionOne_action :
    (firstOrderExtensionAction i dat.F dat.K₁ hi (dat.extensionOne E₂ hi hE₂)).val = dat.c₁
declarations.comment: the canonical map of the pushed-out extension is c₁

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.PushoutDescentData.underlyingExtensionClass_extensionOne
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LD.** The square of the remark commutes for the extension that
Tag 08LC produces: let `h = SecondThickening.spaceHom` be the morphism of first order
thickenings of `(X, 𝒪_X)` that `h^♯` presents, let both thickenings be trivialized by `π₁` and
`π₂` with `π₁ = h ≫ π₂`, so that `h` is a morphism of *trivialized* thickenings, and let the
square relating `c₁`, `c₂`, `κ` and `ℐ₂ ⟶ ℐ₁` commute. If `ℱ'₂` is an extension as in Tag 08L4
whose canonical map is `c₂`, then the class `ξ` of Tag 08LB of the extension
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.PushoutDescentData.extensionOne` that Tag 08LC produces
from it is the image of `ξ_{ℱ'₂}` under functoriality of `Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, -)` along `κ`.

Both extensions are members of the two sets the square relates: `hE₂` says that the canonical
map of `ℱ'₂` is `c₂`, and `PushoutDescentData.extensionOne_action` says that the canonical map
of the extension produced from it is `c₁`.

The hypothesis `hc` is the remark's commuting square, written with the induced map of ideals
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.thickeningIdealMap`. The field
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.PushoutDescentData.comm` of `dat` is the same square of
the same remark, written on local pure tensors, which is the form the construction of Tag 08LC
consumes; no cross-thickening comparison of the two canonical maps is available to pass between
the two forms, so the square is assumed in both.
declarations.statement:
theorem underlyingExtensionClass_extensionOne
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X))]
    (π₁ : SplitMono i) (π₂ : SplitMono S.hom)
    (hπ : π₁.retraction = S.spaceHom ≫ π₂.retraction)
    (hc : dat.c₂ ≫ dat.kernelMap =
      (Functor.uncurry.obj (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨X.presheaf, X.IsSheaf⟩)).map
        ((thickeningIdealMap i S.hom S.spaceHom S.comp_spaceHom, 𝟙 dat.F) : (_, _) ⟶ (_, _)) ≫
          dat.c₁) :
    underlyingExtensionClass i π₁ hi.1.1 dat.F dat.K₁ (dat.extensionOne E₂ hi hE₂) =
      (underlyingExtensionClass S.hom π₂ S.firstOrder.1.1 dat.F dat.K₂ E₂).comp
        (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ dat.kernelMap) (add_zero 1)
declarations.comment: the square commutes for the extension Tag 08LC produces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.underlyingExtensionClass_eq_of_pushedExtension
declarations.doc:
For a morphism `h : X'₁ ⟶ X'₂` of trivialized first order thickenings of `(X, 𝒪_X)` the square
relating the extension classes commutes: if `ℱ'₁` is the extension that the functoriality of Tag
08LC produces from `ℱ'₂` and `k : 𝒦₂ ⟶ 𝒦₁`, then the class `ξ_{ℱ'₁}` of Tag 08LB is the image of
`ξ_{ℱ'₂}` under functoriality of `Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, -)` along `k`.

The hypotheses `hc`, `hE₂` and `hE₁` say that the two extensions are members of the two sets the
square relates — that their canonical maps of Tag 08L4 are `c₂` and `c₁`, compatibly with `k`.
The identity of classes uses only the map of extensions `w`.
declarations.statement:
theorem underlyingExtensionClass_eq_of_pushedExtension (i₁ : X ⟶ X₁) (i₂ : X ⟶ X₂)
    (h : X₁ ⟶ X₂) (comm : i₁ ≫ h = i₂)
    (hi₁ : IsFirstOrderThickening i₁) (hi₂ : IsFirstOrderThickening i₂)
    (π₁ : SplitMono i₁) (π₂ : SplitMono i₂)
    (hπ : π₁.retraction = h ≫ π₂.retraction)
    (F K₁ K₂ : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) (k : K₂ ⟶ K₁)
    (c₁ : (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨((X)).presheaf, ((X)).IsSheaf⟩).obj
      ((idealSheafPullback i₁))).obj (F)) ⟶ K₁)
    (c₂ : (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨((X)).presheaf, ((X)).IsSheaf⟩).obj
      ((idealSheafPullback i₂))).obj (F)) ⟶ K₂)
    (_hc : c₂ ≫ k = ((Functor.uncurry.obj
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨((X)).presheaf, ((X)).IsSheaf⟩)).map
        (((thickeningIdealMap i₁ i₂ h comm), (𝟙 F)) : (_, _) ⟶ (_, _))) ≫ c₁)
    (E₂ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.YonedaExtension ((modulePushforward i₂).obj F)
      ((modulePushforward i₂).obj K₂) 0)
    (_hE₂ : (firstOrderExtensionAction i₂ F K₂ hi₂ E₂).val = c₂)
    (E₁ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.YonedaExtension ((modulePushforward i₁).obj F)
      ((modulePushforward i₁).obj K₁) 0)
    (_hE₁ : (firstOrderExtensionAction i₁ F K₁ hi₁ E₁).val = c₁)
    (w : PushedExtension i₁ i₂ h comm F K₁ K₂ k E₂ E₁) :
    underlyingExtensionClass i₁ π₁ hi₁.1.1 F K₁ E₁ =
      (underlyingExtensionClass i₂ π₂ hi₂.1.1 F K₂ E₂).comp
        (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ k) (add_zero 1)
declarations.comment: the commutative square relating the two extension classes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.IsComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LE.** A sequence of first order thickenings of `X` is a *complex*
when its induced maps on ideal modules compose to zero.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev IsComplex (S : FirstOrderThickeningSequence.{u}) : Prop
declarations.comment: complex of first order thickenings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.IsShortExact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LE.** A sequence of first order thickenings of `X` is a *short
exact sequence* when `0 ⟶ ℐ₃ ⟶ ℐ₂ ⟶ ℐ₁ ⟶ 0` is short exact as a sequence of
`𝒪_X`-modules.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev IsShortExact (S : FirstOrderThickeningSequence.{u}) : Prop
declarations.comment: short exact sequence of first order thickenings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.FirstOrderThickeningSequence.existsUnique_trivialization_of_isComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LE.** A complex of first order thickenings of `(X, 𝒪_X)` canonically
trivializes its first thickening: the composite `X₁ ⟶ X₃` factors uniquely through
`i₃ : X ⟶ X₃`, and the factor `π : X₁ ⟶ X` is a retraction of `i₁`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_trivialization_of_isComplex (hS : IsComplex S) :
    ∃! π : S.X₁ ⟶ S.X, (S.i₁ ≫ π = 𝟙 S.X) ∧ (π ≫ S.i₃ = S.f₁₂ ≫ S.f₂₃)
declarations.comment: canonical trivialization of a complex

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.boundary_underlyingExtensionClass_eq_obstructionClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LF.** Let `(X, 𝒪_X)` be a ringed space, `ℱ` an `𝒪_X`-module and
`X'₁ ⟶ X'₂ ⟶ X'₃` a complex of first order thickenings of `(X, 𝒪_X)` (Tag 08LE), with ideals
`ℐᵢ`. Let `cᵢ : ℐᵢ ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ ⟶ 𝒦ᵢ` be maps and `0 ⟶ 𝒦₃ ⟶ 𝒦₂ ⟶ 𝒦₁ ⟶ 0` a short exact sequence of
`𝒪_X`-modules for which the two squares of the remark commute. Let `ℱ'₂` be an extension
`0 ⟶ 𝒦₂ ⟶ ℱ'₂ ⟶ ℱ ⟶ 0` as in Tag 08L4 over `X'₂` with `c_{ℱ'₂} = c₂`, and let `ℱ'₁` be the
extension over `X'₁` that the functoriality of Tag 08LC produces from it. That functoriality
carries `ℱ'₂` to an extension as in Tag 08L4 over `X'₁` together with a map of extensions `w`
from `ℱ'₂`, which is `𝒦₂ ⟶ 𝒦₁` on kernels and the identity on `ℱ`; the statement is made for
every extension `ℱ'₁` over `X'₁` receiving such a map, so in particular for the one of Tag 08LC
(which in addition has `c_{ℱ'₁} = c₁`, a property the identity of classes does not use).

Then the boundary map `∂ : Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒦₁) ⟶ Ext²_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒦₃)` of
`0 ⟶ 𝒦₃ ⟶ 𝒦₂ ⟶ 𝒦₁ ⟶ 0` — Yoneda composition with the class of that sequence — sends the class
`ξ_{ℱ'₁}` of Tag 08LB, formed with the canonical splitting `π` of Tag 08LE, to the obstruction
class `o(ℱ, 𝒦₃, c₃)` of Tag 08L8.

The first compatibility square of the remark, relating `c₂`, `c₁` and `𝒦₂ ⟶ 𝒦₁`, is what makes
Tag 08LC applicable; once `ℱ'₁` and `w` are given it is not needed for the identity of classes,
so it is not a hypothesis here. It is a hypothesis of the version for the extension that Tag 08LC
constructs, `boundary_underlyingExtensionClass_extensionOne_eq_obstructionClass`, where it is the
input of that construction; the map `c₁` enters only through that square, so it does not appear
here either.
declarations.statement:
theorem boundary_underlyingExtensionClass_eq_obstructionClass
    (S : FirstOrderThickeningSequence.{u})
    [HasExt (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing S.X))]
    [HasDerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing S.X))]
    (hS : IsComplex S) (F K₁ K₂ K₃ : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing S.X))
    (k₃₂ : K₃ ⟶ K₂) (k₂₁ : K₂ ⟶ K₁) (hk : k₃₂ ≫ k₂₁ = 0)
    (hK : (ShortComplex.mk k₃₂ k₂₁ hk).ShortExact)
    (c₂ : (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨S.X.presheaf, S.X.IsSheaf⟩).obj
      (idealSheafPullback S.i₂)).obj F) ⟶ K₂)
    (c₃ : (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨S.X.presheaf, S.X.IsSheaf⟩).obj
      (idealSheafPullback S.i₃)).obj F) ⟶ K₃)
    (hc₃₂ : c₃ ≫ k₃₂ =
      ((Functor.uncurry.obj
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨S.X.presheaf, S.X.IsSheaf⟩)).map
        (((thickeningIdealMap S.i₂ S.i₃ S.f₂₃ S.comm₂₃), (𝟙 F)) : (_, _) ⟶ (_, _))) ≫ c₂)
    (E₂ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.YonedaExtension ((modulePushforward S.i₂).obj F)
      ((modulePushforward S.i₂).obj K₂) 0)
    (hE₂ : (firstOrderExtensionAction S.i₂ F K₂ S.firstOrder₂ E₂).val = c₂)
    (E₁ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.YonedaExtension ((modulePushforward S.i₁).obj F)
      ((modulePushforward S.i₁).obj K₁) 0)
    (w : PushedExtension S.i₁ S.i₂ S.f₁₂ S.comm₁₂ F K₁ K₂ k₂₁ E₂ E₁) :
    (underlyingExtensionClass S.i₁ (S.trivialization hS) S.firstOrder₁.1.1 F K₁ E₁).comp
        hK.extClass (by decide) =
      obstructionClass S.i₃ S.firstOrder₃ F K₃ c₃

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.boundary_underlyingExtensionClass_extensionOne_eq_obstructionClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LF**, for the extension `ℱ'₁` that Tag 08LC constructs. Let
`X'₁ ⟶ X'₂ ⟶ X'₃` be a complex of first order thickenings of `(X, 𝒪_X)` (Tag 08LE), with
`X'₂` presented on the space of `X'₁` as in Tag 08LC, and let `(𝒦ᵢ, cᵢ)`, a short exact sequence
`0 ⟶ 𝒦₃ ⟶ 𝒦₂ ⟶ 𝒦₁ ⟶ 0` and the two commutative squares be as in the remark. For an extension
`ℱ'₂` over `X'₂` as in Tag 08L4 with `c_{ℱ'₂} = c₂`, let `ℱ'₁` be the extension over `X'₁` that the
functoriality of Tag 08LC produces (`PushoutDescentData.extensionOne`). Then the boundary map
`Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒦₁) ⟶ Ext²_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒦₃)` sends `ξ_{ℱ'₁}`, formed with the canonical splitting of
Tag 08LE, to the obstruction class `o(ℱ, 𝒦₃, c₃)` of Tag 08L8.
declarations.statement:
theorem boundary_underlyingExtensionClass_extensionOne_eq_obstructionClass
    {X₁ : RingedSpace.{u, u}} {i : X ⟶ X₁} (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening i)
    (ST : SecondThickening i) (i₃ : X ⟶ X₃) (hi₃ : IsFirstOrderThickening i₃)
    (f₂₃ : ST.space ⟶ X₃) (comm₂₃ : ST.hom ≫ f₂₃ = i₃)
    (idealMap₂₁ : (modulePullback ST.hom).obj (AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.idealSheaf ST.hom) ⟶
      (modulePullback i).obj (AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.idealSheaf i))
    (idealMap₃₂ : (modulePullback i₃).obj (AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.idealSheaf i₃) ⟶
      (modulePullback ST.hom).obj (AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.idealSheaf ST.hom))
    [HasExt (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X))]
    [HasDerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X))]
    (hS : IsComplex (ST.thickeningSequence hi i₃ hi₃ f₂₃ comm₂₃ idealMap₂₁ idealMap₃₂))
    (F K₁ K₂ K₃ : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X))
    (k₃₂ : K₃ ⟶ K₂) (k₂₁ : K₂ ⟶ K₁) (hk : k₃₂ ≫ k₂₁ = 0)
    (hK : (ShortComplex.mk k₃₂ k₂₁ hk).ShortExact)
    (c₁ : (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨X.presheaf, X.IsSheaf⟩).obj
      (idealSheafPullback i)).obj F) ⟶ K₁)
    (c₂ : (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨X.presheaf, X.IsSheaf⟩).obj
      (idealSheafPullback ST.hom)).obj F) ⟶ K₂)
    (c₃ : (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨X.presheaf, X.IsSheaf⟩).obj
      (idealSheafPullback i₃)).obj F) ⟶ K₃)
    (hc₂₁ : c₂ ≫ k₂₁ =
      ((Functor.uncurry.obj
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨X.presheaf, X.IsSheaf⟩)).map
        (((thickeningIdealMap i ST.hom ST.toSpace ST.comp_toSpace), (𝟙 F)) :
          (_, _) ⟶ (_, _))) ≫ c₁)
    (hc₃₂ : c₃ ≫ k₃₂ =
      ((Functor.uncurry.obj
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨X.presheaf, X.IsSheaf⟩)).map
        (((thickeningIdealMap ST.hom i₃ f₂₃ comm₂₃), (𝟙 F)) : (_, _) ⟶ (_, _))) ≫ c₂)
    (E₂ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.YonedaExtension ((modulePushforward ST.hom).obj F)
      ((modulePushforward ST.hom).obj K₂) 0)
    (hE₂ : (firstOrderExtensionAction ST.hom F K₂ ST.firstOrder E₂).val = c₂) :
    (underlyingExtensionClass i
        ((ST.thickeningSequence hi i₃ hi₃ f₂₃ comm₂₃ idealMap₂₁ idealMap₃₂).trivialization hS)
        hi.1.1 F K₁
        ((PushoutDescentData.ofSquare ST F K₁ K₂ c₁ c₂ k₂₁ hc₂₁).extensionOne E₂ hi hE₂)).comp
        hK.extClass (by decide) =
      obstructionClass i₃ hi₃ F K₃ c₃

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.boundary_underlyingExtensionClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LF.** Let `(X, 𝒪_X)` be a ringed space, `ℱ` an `𝒪_X`-module, and let
`X'₁ ⟶ X'₂ ⟶ X'₃` be a complex of first order thickenings of `(X, 𝒪_X)`, with `π` the canonical
trivialization of `i₁` (Tag 08LE). Let `(𝒦ᵢ, cᵢ)` be pairs with `cᵢ : ℐᵢ ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ ⟶ 𝒦ᵢ` and
let `0 ⟶ 𝒦₃ ⟶ 𝒦₂ ⟶ 𝒦₁ ⟶ 0` be a short exact sequence of `𝒪_X`-modules making the two squares
`_hc₂₁` and `hc₃₂` of the remark commute. Let `ℱ'₂` be an extension as in Tag 08L4 over `X'₂`
with `c_{ℱ'₂} = c₂` and let `ℱ'₁` be the extension over `X'₁` that Tag 08LC produces from it,
exhibited by the map of extensions `w` and the pushout square `hw`.

Then the boundary map `∂ : Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒦₁) ⟶ Ext²_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒦₃)` of
`0 ⟶ 𝒦₃ ⟶ 𝒦₂ ⟶ 𝒦₁ ⟶ 0` — Yoneda composition with the class of that sequence — carries
`ξ_{ℱ'₁}` of Tag 08LB to the obstruction class `o(ℱ, 𝒦₃, c₃)` of Tag 08L8.

The hypothesis `hrestrict` is not derived in this development; see the Scope section of the
module docstring. The hypotheses `_hS`, `_hc₂₁`, `_hE₂` and `_hE₁` are part of the situation of
the remark but are not used: the complex condition enters only through `hπ`, which is what the
canonical trivialization of Tag 08LE supplies, and the canonical maps of `ℱ'₂` and `ℱ'₁` enter
only through `hrestrict` and `w`.
declarations.statement:
theorem boundary_underlyingExtensionClass (S : FirstOrderThickeningSequence.{u})
    [HasExt (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing S.X))]
    [HasDerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing S.X))]
    (_hS : IsComplex S) (π : SplitMono S.i₁)
    (hπ : π.retraction ≫ S.i₃ = S.f₁₂ ≫ S.f₂₃)
    (F K₁ K₂ K₃ : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing S.X))
    (k₃₂ : K₃ ⟶ K₂) (k₂₁ : K₂ ⟶ K₁) (hk : k₃₂ ≫ k₂₁ = 0)
    (hK : (ShortComplex.mk k₃₂ k₂₁ hk).ShortExact)
    (c₁ : (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨((S.X)).presheaf, ((S.X)).IsSheaf⟩).obj
      ((idealSheafPullback S.i₁))).obj (F)) ⟶ K₁)
    (c₂ : (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨((S.X)).presheaf, ((S.X)).IsSheaf⟩).obj
      ((idealSheafPullback S.i₂))).obj (F)) ⟶ K₂)
    (c₃ : (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨((S.X)).presheaf, ((S.X)).IsSheaf⟩).obj
      ((idealSheafPullback S.i₃))).obj (F)) ⟶ K₃)
    (_hc₂₁ : c₂ ≫ k₂₁ =
      ((Functor.uncurry.obj (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
        ⟨((S.X)).presheaf, ((S.X)).IsSheaf⟩)).map
        (((thickeningIdealMap S.i₁ S.i₂ S.f₁₂ S.comm₁₂), (𝟙 F)) : (_, _) ⟶ (_, _))) ≫ c₁)
    (hc₃₂ : c₃ ≫ k₃₂ =
      ((Functor.uncurry.obj (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
        ⟨((S.X)).presheaf, ((S.X)).IsSheaf⟩)).map
        (((thickeningIdealMap S.i₂ S.i₃ S.f₂₃ S.comm₂₃), (𝟙 F)) : (_, _) ⟶ (_, _))) ≫ c₂)
    (E₂ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.YonedaExtension ((modulePushforward S.i₂).obj F)
      ((modulePushforward S.i₂).obj K₂) 0)
    (_hE₂ : (firstOrderExtensionAction S.i₂ F K₂ S.firstOrder₂ E₂).val = c₂)
    (E₁ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.YonedaExtension ((modulePushforward S.i₁).obj F)
      ((modulePushforward S.i₁).obj K₁) 0)
    (_hE₁ : (firstOrderExtensionAction S.i₁ F K₁ S.firstOrder₁ E₁).val = c₁)
    (w : PushedExtension S.i₁ S.i₂ S.f₁₂ S.comm₁₂ F K₁ K₂ k₂₁ E₂ E₁)
    (hw : IsPushout E₂.f ((modulePushforward S.i₂).map k₂₁ ≫
        (thickeningPushforwardComp S.i₁ S.i₂ S.f₁₂ S.comm₁₂).inv.app K₁) w.hom
        ((modulePushforward S.f₁₂).map E₁.f))
    (hrestrict : (firstOrderExtensionAction S.i₃ F K₂ S.firstOrder₃
        (sequenceRestrictedExtension S F K₂ E₂)).val =
      ((Functor.uncurry.obj (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
        ⟨((S.X)).presheaf, ((S.X)).IsSheaf⟩)).map
        (((thickeningIdealMap S.i₂ S.i₃ S.f₂₃ S.comm₂₃), (𝟙 F)) : (_, _) ⟶ (_, _))) ≫ c₂) :
    (underlyingExtensionClass S.i₁ π S.firstOrder₁.1.1 F K₁ E₁).comp hK.extClass (by decide) =
      obstructionClass S.i₃ S.firstOrder₃ F K₃ c₃
declarations.comment: the boundary of the extension class is the obstruction class

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.mapLift_isPrincipalHomogeneous
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LH.** Let `i : X ⟶ X'` be a first-order thickening of ringed spaces
with ideal `ℐ`, let `ℱ'` and `𝒢'` be `𝒪_{X'}`-modules and let `φ : i^* ℱ' ⟶ i^* 𝒢'`. If `φ`
lifts to `X'`, its lifts form a principal homogeneous space under `Hom_{𝒪_X}(i^* ℱ', ℐ𝒢')`:
any two lifts differ by exactly one element of that group.

The difference of two lifts is killed by `𝒢' ⟶ i_* i^* 𝒢'`, so it factors uniquely through
`ℐ𝒢'`, and `infinitesimalHomEquiv` turns that factorization into the translating element.
declarations.statement:
theorem mapLift_isPrincipalHomogeneous (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening i)
    (F' G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X'))
    (φ : (modulePullback i).obj F' ⟶ (modulePullback i).obj G')
    (_hne : Nonempty (MapLift i F' G' φ)) :
    ∀ φ₁ φ₂ : MapLift i F' G' φ,
      ∃! δ : InfinitesimalHom i F' G',
        infinitesimalHomEquiv i hi F' G' δ ≫ infinitesimalι i G' + φ₁.1 = φ₂.1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.exists_addTorsor_mapLift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LH.** Let `i : X ⟶ X'` be a first-order thickening of ringed spaces
with ideal `ℐ`, let `ℱ'` and `𝒢'` be `𝒪_{X'}`-modules, `ℱ = i^* ℱ'`, `𝒢 = i^* 𝒢'`, and let
`φ : ℱ ⟶ 𝒢` be `𝒪_X`-linear. If the set of lifts of `φ` to an `𝒪_{X'}`-linear map
`φ' : ℱ' ⟶ 𝒢'` (those with `i^* φ' = φ`) is nonempty, it is a principal homogeneous space under
`Hom_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, ℐ𝒢')`, where `ℐ𝒢'` is the image of the ideal action `ℐ ⊗ 𝒢' ⟶ 𝒢'` read as an
`𝒪_X`-module: there is a torsor structure in which `δ` acts on a lift `φ'` by adding the
`𝒪_{X'}`-linear map `ℱ' ⟶ ℐ𝒢' ⟶ 𝒢'` corresponding to `δ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_addTorsor_mapLift (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening i)
    (F' G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X'))
    (φ : (modulePullback i).obj F' ⟶ (modulePullback i).obj G')
    (hne : Nonempty (MapLift i F' G' φ)) :
    ∃ t : AddTorsor
        ((modulePullback i).obj F' ⟶ (modulePullback i).obj (Abelian.image (idealAction i G')))
        (MapLift i F' G' φ),
      ∀ (δ : (modulePullback i).obj F' ⟶
          (modulePullback i).obj (Abelian.image (idealAction i G')))
        (φ' : MapLift i F' G' φ),
        (t.vadd δ φ').1 =
          φ'.1 + idealMultipleHomEquiv i hi F' G' δ ≫ Abelian.image.ι (idealAction i G')

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.isFlatOver_iff_baseToInfinitesimal_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LI.** For a strict morphism of first-order thickenings of ringed
spaces and an `𝒪_{X'}`-module `ℱ'` whose restriction `ℱ = i^* ℱ'` is flat over `S`, the module
`ℱ'` is flat over `S'` if and only if the canonical map `f^* 𝒥 ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ ⟶ ℐℱ'` is an
isomorphism.

One direction is `baseToInfinitesimal_isIso_of_isFlatOver`: flatness makes the ideal action
injective, and the map in question is `i^*` of an epimorphism which that injectivity turns into
an isomorphism. For the other, invertibility makes the action of `(f')^* 𝒥` on `ℱ'` a
monomorphism, hence injective on every stalk after base change; the flatness of `ℱ` over `S`
supplies the quotient hypothesis of the square-zero local criterion, and strictness is what
identifies the relevant quotient of `𝒪_{X',x}` with `𝒪_{X,x}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFlatOver_iff_baseToInfinitesimal_isIso (D : MorphismOfThickenings.{u})
    (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening D.i) (ht : IsFirstOrderThickening D.t) (hs : D.IsStrict)
    (F' : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.X'))
    (hF : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f ((modulePullback D.i).obj F')) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f' F' ↔ IsIso (baseToInfinitesimal D F')
declarations.comment: flatness criterion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.baseToSourceIdealTensor_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LI.** Under the hypotheses of the criterion and flatness of `ℱ'`
over `S'`, the reduced canonical ideal map tensored with `ℱ` is an isomorphism: it is an
epimorphism by strictness, and a monomorphism because the composite with the ideal action is
one.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseToSourceIdealTensor_isIso (D : MorphismOfThickenings.{u})
    (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening D.i) (ht : IsFirstOrderThickening D.t) (hs : D.IsStrict)
    (F' : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.X'))
    (hF : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f ((modulePullback D.i).obj F'))
    (hF' : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f' F') :
    IsIso (baseToSourceIdealTensor D F')
declarations.comment: first isomorphism in the final assertion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.sourceIdealActionImage_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LI.** Under the hypotheses of the criterion and flatness of `ℱ'`
over `S'`, the ideal action on the reduced source identifies `i^* ℐ ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ` with the ideal
multiple `ℐℱ'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem sourceIdealActionImage_isIso (D : MorphismOfThickenings.{u})
    (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening D.i) (ht : IsFirstOrderThickening D.t) (hs : D.IsStrict)
    (F' : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.X'))
    (hF : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f ((modulePullback D.i).obj F'))
    (hF' : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f' F') :
    IsIso (sourceIdealActionImage D F')
declarations.comment: second isomorphism in the final assertion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.mapLift_isTorsor_tensor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LJ.** Let `(f, f')` be a morphism of thickenings with `i` a first
order thickening, let `ℱ'` and `𝒢'` be `𝒪_{X'}`-modules, set `ℱ = i^* ℱ'` and `𝒢 = i^* 𝒢'`,
and let `φ : ℱ ⟶ 𝒢` be `𝒪_X`-linear. If `𝒢'` is flat over `S'` and `(f, f')` is strict, the
lifts of `φ` to an `𝒪_{X'}`-linear `φ' : ℱ' ⟶ 𝒢'` form, when nonempty, a principal homogeneous
space under `Hom_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒢 ⊗_{𝒪_X} f^* 𝒥)`, which acts through `infinitesimalTensorIso`: each
`δ` translates a lift to a lift, and any two lifts are translated to one another by exactly one
`δ`.

The group acts because `i^*` is additive and kills a map through `ℐ𝒢'`, which is
`modulePullback_map_add_comp_infinitesimalι`. That the action is simply transitive is **Stacks
08LH**, which gives the same conclusion for `Hom_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, ℐ𝒢')`, transported along **Stacks
08LI**, which identifies `ℐ𝒢'` with `𝒢 ⊗_{𝒪_X} f^* 𝒥`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mapLift_isTorsor_tensor (D : MorphismOfThickenings.{u})
    (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening D.i) (hs : D.IsStrict)
    (F' G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.X'))
    (hG' : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f' G')
    (φ : (modulePullback D.i).obj F' ⟶ (modulePullback D.i).obj G')
    (hne : Nonempty (MapLift D.i F' G' φ)) :
    (∀ (δ : (modulePullback D.i).obj F' ⟶ restrictionTensorBaseIdeal D G')
        (φ₁ : MapLift D.i F' G' φ),
        (modulePullback D.i).map
            (infinitesimalHomEquiv D.i hi F' G'
                  (δ ≫ (infinitesimalTensorIso D hs G' hG').hom) ≫ infinitesimalι D.i G' +
                φ₁.1) =
          φ) ∧
      ∀ φ₁ φ₂ : MapLift D.i F' G' φ,
        ∃! δ : (modulePullback D.i).obj F' ⟶ restrictionTensorBaseIdeal D G',
          infinitesimalHomEquiv D.i hi F' G'
                (δ ≫ (infinitesimalTensorIso D hs G' hG').hom) ≫ infinitesimalι D.i G' + φ₁.1 =
              φ₂.1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.exists_derivedMapLiftingObstruction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LK.** Let `i : (X, 𝒪_X) ⟶ (X', 𝒪_{X'})` be a first order thickening
of ringed spaces with ideal `ℐ`, let `ℱ'` and `𝒢'` be `𝒪_{X'}`-modules and let
`φ : i^* ℱ' ⟶ i^* 𝒢'` be `𝒪_X`-linear. There is a class `o(φ) ∈ Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(Li^* ℱ', ℐ𝒢')`
whose vanishing is necessary and sufficient for `φ` to lift to an `𝒪_{X'}`-linear map
`ℱ' ⟶ 𝒢'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_derivedMapLiftingObstruction (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening i)
    (F' G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X'))
    (φ : (modulePullback i).obj F' ⟶ (modulePullback i).obj G') :
    ∃ o : DerivedCategory.Ext
        ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback i).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F'))
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (infinitesimalPartOnSource i G')) 1,
      (o = 0 ↔ Nonempty (MapLift i F' G' φ))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.mapLiftObstruction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LL.** The obstruction class
`o(φ) ∈ Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒢 ⊗_{𝒪_X} f^* 𝒥)` to lifting an `𝒪_X`-linear `φ : ℱ ⟶ 𝒢` between the
restrictions of two `𝒪_{X'}`-modules flat over `S'`, across a strict morphism of thickenings
whose upper arrow is a first order thickening.

It is the class of **Stacks 08L6** for the two kernel extensions of **Stacks 08LM** and the
pair `(φ, 1 ⊗ φ)`, carried into the source's group along the identification
`idealTensorIsoRestrictionTensorBaseIdeal` of **Stacks 08LI**. Its vanishing criterion is
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.mapLiftObstruction_eq_zero_iff`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def mapLiftObstruction (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening D.i) (hs : D.IsStrict)
    (F' G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.X'))
    (hF' : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f' F')
    (hG' : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f' G')
    (φ : (modulePullback D.i).obj F' ⟶ (modulePullback D.i).obj G') :
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.zExt ((modulePullback D.i).obj F')
      (restrictionTensorBaseIdeal D G') 1
declarations.comment: the obstruction class

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.mapLiftObstruction_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LL.** The vanishing of the obstruction class `o(φ)` is necessary and
sufficient for `φ` to lift to an `𝒪_{X'}`-linear map `φ' : ℱ' ⟶ 𝒢'`, that is one with
`i^* φ' = φ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mapLiftObstruction_eq_zero_iff (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening D.i) (hs : D.IsStrict)
    (F' G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.X'))
    (hF' : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f' F')
    (hG' : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f' G')
    (φ : (modulePullback D.i).obj F' ⟶ (modulePullback D.i).obj G') :
    mapLiftObstruction hi hs F' G' hF' hG' φ = 0 ↔ Nonempty (MapLift D.i F' G' φ)
declarations.comment: the vanishing criterion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.exists_mapLiftObstruction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LL.** Let `(f, f')` be a morphism of thickenings of ringed spaces
whose upper arrow `i : X ⟶ X'` is a first order thickening, let `ℱ'` and `𝒢'` be
`𝒪_{X'}`-modules, put `ℱ = i^* ℱ'` and `𝒢 = i^* 𝒢'`, and let `φ : ℱ ⟶ 𝒢` be `𝒪_X`-linear.
Assume `ℱ'` and `𝒢'` are flat over `S'` and that `(f, f')` is strict. Then there exists

    o(φ) ∈ Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒢 ⊗_{𝒪_X} f^* 𝒥)

whose vanishing is a necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of an `𝒪_{X'}`-linear
map `φ' : ℱ' ⟶ 𝒢'` with `i^* φ' = φ`.

The source asserts existence of the class, not uniqueness, and that is what is stated here; the
class itself is `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.mapLiftObstruction` and its criterion
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.mapLiftObstruction_eq_zero_iff`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_mapLiftObstruction (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening D.i) (hs : D.IsStrict)
    (F' G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.X'))
    (hF' : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f' F')
    (hG' : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f' G')
    (φ : (modulePullback D.i).obj F' ⟶ (modulePullback D.i).obj G') :
    ∃ o : CategoryTheory.Abelian.zExt ((modulePullback D.i).obj F')
        (restrictionTensorBaseIdeal D G') 1,
      (o = 0 ↔ Nonempty (MapLift D.i F' G' φ))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.flatLiftClassDifference_isPrincipalHomogeneous
declarations.doc:
Let `(f, f')` be a strict morphism of first order thickenings of ringed spaces and let `ℱ` be
an `𝒪_X`-module flat over `S`. The isomorphism classes of pairs `(ℱ', α)` of an `𝒪_{X'}`-module
`ℱ'` flat over `S'` and an isomorphism `α : i^* ℱ' ≅ ℱ` form a principal homogeneous space under
`Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, ℐ ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ)`: the difference
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.flatLiftClassDifference` is additive, and for every class
`b` the map `a ↦ d(a, b)` is a bijection onto `Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, ℐ ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ)`. When there is no flat
lift both conditions hold vacuously.
declarations.statement:
theorem flatLiftClassDifference_isPrincipalHomogeneous (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening D.i)
    (ht : IsFirstOrderThickening D.t) (hs : D.IsStrict)
    {F : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.X)} (hF : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f F) :
    (∀ a b c : FlatLiftClass D F,
      flatLiftClassDifference hi hs F a b + flatLiftClassDifference hi hs F b c =
        flatLiftClassDifference hi hs F a c) ∧
      ∀ b : FlatLiftClass D F,
        Function.Bijective fun a : FlatLiftClass D F => flatLiftClassDifference hi hs F a b

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.nonempty_flatLift_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LN.** Let `(f, f')` be a strict morphism of first order thickenings
of ringed spaces and let `ℱ` be an `𝒪_X`-module flat over `S`. There is an `𝒪_{X'}`-module `ℱ'`
flat over `S'` with `i^* ℱ' ≅ ℱ` if and only if the canonical map
`f^* 𝒥 ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ ⟶ ℐ ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ` is an isomorphism and the class
`o(ℱ, ℐ ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ, 1) ∈ Ext²_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, ℐ ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ)` of **Stacks 08L8** is zero.

The pair `(ℱ', α)` of the source is
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.FlatLift`, and the obstruction class is
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.obstructionClass` for the coefficient module
`ℐ ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ` and the normalization `c = 1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_flatLift_iff (D : MorphismOfThickenings.{u})
    [HasExt (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.X))]
    [HasDerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.X))]
    (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening D.i) (ht : IsFirstOrderThickening D.t) (hs : D.IsStrict)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.X))
    (hF : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f F) :
    Nonempty (FlatLift D F) ↔
      IsIso (baseIdealTensorComparison D F) ∧
        obstructionClass D.i hi F (idealTensor D F) (𝟙 (idealTensor D F)) = 0

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CoherentSituation.fiberSquareComparison_isEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08LQ.**  In Situation 08KB, let `f : X ⟶ B` be a morphism of algebraic
spaces over `S` of finite presentation, and let

```
  Z ---i---> Z'
  |          |
  f          a
  v          v
  Y ---b---> Y'
```

be a pushout in the category of schemes over `S` with `Z ⟶ Z'` a thickening and `Z ⟶ Y` affine
(Stacks 07RT). Then the functor on fibre categories
`Coh_{X/B, Y'} ⟶ Coh_{X/B, Y} ×_{Coh_{X/B, Z}} Coh_{X/B, Z'}` is an equivalence.

Here `Coh_{X/B}` is the category of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CoherentSituation.categoryData`
fibred over the schemes over `S` by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.coherentSiteProjection`, and the
functor is `Deformation.Artin.fiberSquareComparison` at its chosen pullbacks, for the square
`f ≫ b = i ≫ a` of schemes over `S`, which commutes by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CoherentSituation.comm_of_isPushout_toScheme`.

The proof follows the source: the map `B(Y') ⟶ B(Y) ×_{B(Z)} B(Z')` is bijective (Stacks 07SY),
which fixes the morphism `Y' ⟶ B` (`fiberSquareComparison_isEquivalence_of_modulesGlueOver`),
and the statement becomes Stacks 08KV for the base change `X ×_B Y' ⟶ Y'`
(`modulesGlueOver_of_isPushout`).
declarations.statement:
theorem fiberSquareComparison_isEquivalence (D : CoherentSituation B S hS)
    {Z Z' Y Y' : BigFppfOver B S hS} (i : Z ⟶ Z') (f : Z ⟶ Y) (a : Z' ⟶ Y') (b : Y ⟶ Y')
    (hi : Stacks.Thickenings.IsThickening ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map i))
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineHom ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map f)]
    (hsq : IsPushout ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map i)
      ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map f) ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map a)
      ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map b)) :
    letI : Category.{u + 1} (CoherentObject D) := D.categoryData.category
    letI : (coherentSiteProjection D.categoryData).IsFibered :=
      D.isFiberedInGroupoids_siteProjection.isFibered
    (Deformation.Artin.fiberSquareComparison (coherentSiteProjection D.categoryData)
      (coherentSiteProjection D.categoryData).chosenPullbacks f i b a
        (comm_of_isPushout_toScheme hsq)).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: MorphismOfTopoi.IsEmbedding
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Definition 7.43.1 (tag 08LU).**

A morphism of topoi `f : E → F` is an *embedding* if its pushforward `f_*` is fully faithful.
declarations.statement: def IsEmbedding (f : MorphismOfTopoi E F) : Prop

declarations.name: IsSubtopos
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Definition 7.43.2 (tag 08LV).**

A strictly full subcategory `E ⊆ Sh(C, J)`, given by the property `P` of its objects, is a
*subtopos* if there is an embedding of topoi `f : Sh(D, K) → Sh(C, J)`, for some site
`(D, K)`, whose pushforward has `E` as its essential image.

Since a subcategory of `Sh(C, J)` cut out by a property of objects is automatically strictly
full and closed under isomorphisms, no further condition on `P` is imposed; the equality
`f_*.essImage = P` already forces it.

The site `(D, K)` is quantified over the same universes as `(C, J)`. This is the case that
occurs in practice — in Stacks 08LY, for instance, `D` is `C` itself carrying a finer
topology — and it keeps the universe parameters of `IsSubtopos` determined by its
arguments.
declarations.statement: def IsSubtopos (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (P : ObjectProperty (Sheaf J (Type w))) : Prop

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sites.Subtopos.MorphismOfTopoi.isEmbedding_overLocalization_iff_isSubterminal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08LW.** Let `E` be a topos and `F` an object of `E` (in the source, a sheaf on a
site `C`), and let `j_F : E/F ⟶ E` be the localization morphism of Stacks 04GZ, given by a right
adjoint `p` of `j_F⁻¹ = toOver F`. Then `j_F` is an embedding of topoi — so that `E/F` is the
subtopos `j_{F,*}(E/F)` of `E` — if and only if `F` is a subobject of the final object of `E`.
declarations.comment:
The localization j_F : E/F ⟶ E is an embedding of topoi, i.e. E/F is a subtopos of
E, if and only if F is a subobject of the final object.

declarations.name: IsOpenSubtopos
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Definition 7.43.4 (tag 08LX).**

A strictly full subcategory `E ⊆ Sh(C, J)`, given by the property `P` of its objects, is an
*open subtopos* if there is a subsheaf `F` of the final object of `Sh(C, J)` such that `E` is
the subtopos `Sh(C, J)/F` of Stacks 08LW, that is, the essential image of the pushforward
`j_{F,*} : Sh(C, J)/F ⥤ Sh(C, J)` of the localization morphism `j_F`. Here `j_{F,*}` is a right
adjoint `p` of the pullback `j_F⁻¹ = toOver F : H ↦ (H × F ⟶ F)`.
declarations.statement:
def IsOpenSubtopos (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (P : ObjectProperty (Sheaf J (Type w))) :
    Prop
declarations.comment:
A strictly full subcategory E of Sh(C) is an open subtopos if there is a subsheaf
F of the final object such that E is the essential image of the pushforward j_{F,*} of the
localization morphism j_F : Sh(C)/F → Sh(C), the right adjoint of H ↦ H × F / F.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sites.Subtopos.isSubtopos_closedComplement
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 7.43.5 (tag 08LY).** Let `(C, J)` be a site and let `F` be a sheaf
of sets on it. The strictly full subcategory `closedComplement F` of `Sh(C, J)`, consisting of
the sheaves `G` for which the projection `F ⨯ G ⟶ F` is an isomorphism, is a subtopos of
`Sh(C, J)`: it is the essential image of the pushforward of an embedding of topoi.

The source assumes `F` to be a subsheaf of the final object, in which case this closed subtopos
is complementary to the open subtopos `Sh(C, J)/F` of Stacks 08LW; the hypothesis is not needed,
as `closedComplement F` depends on `F` only through the objects on which `F` has a section.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSubtopos_closedComplement {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} (F : Sheaf J (Type (max u v))) :
    IsSubtopos J (closedComplement F)

sga.comment: for any topos and open U

declarations.comment:
The full subcategory of sheaves G with F ⨯ G ⟶ F an isomorphism is a subtopos of
Sh(C). Stated for an arbitrary sheaf F, the source's hypothesis that F be a subsheaf of the
final object being unused in its proof.

declarations.name: IsClosedSubtopos
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Definition 7.43.6 (tag 08LZ).**

A strictly full subcategory `E ⊆ Sh(C, J)`, given by the property `P` of its objects, is a
*closed subtopos* if there is a subsheaf `F` of the final object of `Sh(C, J)` — that is, a
sheaf `F` whose map to the terminal object is a monomorphism — such that `E` is the subtopos
`closedComplement F` described in Stacks 08LY.
declarations.statement:
def IsClosedSubtopos (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (P : ObjectProperty (Sheaf J (Type w))) :
    Prop

declarations.name: MorphismOfTopoi.IsClosedImmersion

A morphism of topoi `f : Sh(D, K) → Sh(C, J)` is a *closed immersion* if it is an embedding and

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ClosedRingedImmersion.pushforwardModules_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08M3.** The direct image of sheaves of modules along a closed immersion
of ringed topoi with locally surjective structure map is exact.

Left exactness: the underlying sheaf of sets of the direct image is the direct image of the
underlying sheaf of sets, the latter preserves finite limits because it is a right adjoint, and
the underlying-sheaf functor on sheaves of modules preserves and reflects them. Right exactness:
the direct image is fully faithful with essential image the modules annihilated by the kernel
ideal, hence a left adjoint, hence preserves all colimits.
declarations.statement:
theorem ClosedRingedImmersion.pushforwardModules_exact
    (S : ClosedRingedImmersion.{v, u, v', u', w}) :
    exactFunctor (_root_.SheafOfModules.{w} S.sourceRingSheaf)
      (_root_.SheafOfModules.{w} S.targetRingSheaf) S.hom.pushforwardModules
declarations.comment: exactness

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.PushforwardEssentialImage.essImage_pushforwardModules_iff_of_isClosedImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08M3, the essential-image statement.** Let `i : (Sh(C), O) → (Sh(D), O')` be a
morphism of ringed topoi whose underlying morphism of topoi is a closed immersion and whose
structure map `i^# : O' ⟶ i_*O` is locally surjective, and let `I ⊆ O'` be the sectionwise kernel
of `i^#`. Then a sheaf of `O'`-modules is in the essential image of the direct image
`i_* : Mod(O) ⥤ Mod(O')` exactly when `I` annihilates it.

The forward implication needs neither hypothesis on `i`
(`smul_eq_zero_of_essImage_pushforwardModules`); the reverse one spends local surjectivity in
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.ChangeOfRings.essImage_restrictScalars_of_smul_eq_zero` and the
closed-immersion hypothesis in `essSurj_pushforwardModuleFunctor`.
declarations.statement:
theorem essImage_pushforwardModules_iff_of_isClosedImmersion
    (hfc : MorphismOfTopoi.IsClosedImmersion f) {O' : Sheaf K RingCat.{w}}
    (fSharp : O' ⟶ pushforwardRingSheaf f O) [Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective fSharp]
    (G : SheafOfModules.{w} O') :
    (pushforwardModules f O fSharp).essImage G ↔
      ∀ (X : Dᵒᵖ) (a : O'.obj.obj X), a ∈ RingHom.ker (fSharp.hom.app X).hom →
        ∀ m : G.val.obj X, a • m = 0
declarations.comment: essential_image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ClosedRingedImmersion.pushforwardModules_fullyFaithful
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08M3.** The direct image of sheaves of modules along a closed immersion of ringed
topoi with locally surjective structure map is fully faithful.

The direct image is the Stacks 03D1 direct image followed by restriction of scalars along the
structure map. The first factor is fully faithful because the direct image of sheaves of sets
is, the underlying morphism of topoi being an embedding; the second is fully faithful by
Stacks 0930, the structure map being locally surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforwardModules_fullyFaithful :
    Nonempty S.hom.pushforwardModules.FullyFaithful
declarations.comment: full_faithfulness

declarations.name: Stacks.ToposBridge.essImage_schemeModulesPushforward_iff
declarations.doc:
**The essential-image half of Stacks 08M3 for a closed immersion of schemes.** A sheaf of
`𝒪_X`-modules lies in the essential image of pushforward along a closed immersion `i : Z ⟶ X`
exactly when the sectionwise kernel of the structure map of `i` annihilates it.

This is `Stacks.ToposBridge.essImage_pushforwardModules_iff_of_iso` at the morphism of topoi
presented by `i`, whose closed-immersion and local-surjectivity hypotheses hold for a closed
immersion of schemes, transported along `Stacks.ToposBridge.schemePushforwardModulesIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem essImage_schemeModulesPushforward_iff {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion i] (G : X.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).essImage G ↔
      ∀ (U : (Opens X.carrier)ᵒᵖ) (a : X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U),
        a ∈ RingHom.ker ((toposStructureRingMap i.toLRSHom.toShHom).hom.app U).hom →
          ∀ m : G.val.obj U, a • m = 0
declarations.comment: essential_image, for a closed immersion of schemes

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.FlatSquareZero.isFlat_iff_reduction_isFlat_and_multiplication_mono
declarations.doc:
Flatness over a square-zero thickening is equivalent to flatness of the reduction and
injectivity of the canonical multiplication map from the kernel tensored with the reduction.

Here `i` identifies `I` with the kernel of `f`, `nu` is multiplication
`I ⊗[O'] F' ⟶ F'`, and `q` exhibits `F` as its cokernel.  The last
displayed formula identifies `mu` with the canonical map
`I ⊗[O] F ⟶ F'`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFlat_iff_reduction_isFlat_and_multiplication_mono
    {O' O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w}} (f : O' ⟶ O)
    (hf : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J f.hom)
    (I : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf O))
    (F' : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf O'))
    (F : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf O))
    (i : (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (ringMap f)).obj I ⟶
      SheafOfModules.unit (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf O'))
    (hi_zero : ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (a : I.val.obj U),
      f.hom.app U (show O'.obj.obj U from i.val.app U a) = 0)
    (hi_univ : ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : O'.obj.obj U), f.hom.app U x = 0 →
      ∃! a : I.val.obj U, (show O'.obj.obj U from i.val.app U a) = x)
    (hsq : ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (a b : I.val.obj U),
      (show O'.obj.obj U from i.val.app U a) *
        (show O'.obj.obj U from i.val.app U b) = 0)
    (nu : (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor.{u, v, w, w, w} O').flip.obj F')).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (ringMap f)).obj I) ⟶ F')
    (hnu : ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (a : I.val.obj U) (x : F'.val.obj U),
      nu.val.app U
          (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction.{w, v, w, u} (R :=
              Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
              O')
        (𝟙 (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf O').obj)).unit.app
      (PresheafOfModules.tensorObj ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (ringMap f)).obj I).val
          F'.val)).app U
              (a ⊗ₜ[O'.obj.obj U] x)) =
        (show (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf O').obj.obj U from
          i.val.app U a) • x)
    (q : F' ⟶ (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (ringMap f)).obj F)
    (hnuq : nu ≫ q = 0)
    (hq : IsColimit (CokernelCofork.ofπ q hnuq))
    (mu : (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (ringMap f)).obj
        ((((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor.{u, v, w, w, w} O).flip.obj F)).obj I) ⟶ F')
    (hmu : ∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (a : I.val.obj U) (x : F'.val.obj U),
      mu.val.app U
          (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction.{w, v, w, u} (R :=
              Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
              O)
        (𝟙 (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf O).obj)).unit.app
      (PresheafOfModules.tensorObj I.val F.val)).app U
            (a ⊗ₜ[O.obj.obj U] q.val.app U x)) =
        (show (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf O').obj.obj U from
          i.val.app U a) • x) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat F' ↔
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat F ∧ Mono mu)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat
declarations.doc:
A sheaf of modules is flat when tensoring on the right with it is an exact
endofunctor on sheaves of modules.

This is part (3) of tag 03ER for the native tensor bifunctor, and part (4) just below
is stated in terms of it. `Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsFlat` uses the same native tensor
functor.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsFlat {O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w}}
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{z}]
    [HasWeakSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{z}]
    (F : _root_.SheafOfModules.{z} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf O)) : Prop
declarations.comment: flatness over a morphism of ringed topoi: this predicate for the pullback ring

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.IsFlatOver
declarations.doc:
A sheaf `F` of `O`-modules on `X = (Sh(C), O)` is **flat over** the ringed topos
`Y = (Sh(D), O')` along a morphism of ringed topoi `f : X ⟶ Y` when `F`, regarded as a sheaf of
`f⁻¹O'`-modules by restriction of scalars along the inverse-image form `f⁻¹O' ⟶ O` of the
structure map of `f`, is flat.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev IsFlatOver
    {X : RingedTopos.{v, u, w}} {Y : RingedTopos.{v', u', w'}}
    [X.J.HasSheafCompose (forget RingCat.{w})] [Y.J.HasSheafCompose (forget RingCat.{w'})]
    [X.J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
    [Y.J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w'} RingCat.{w'})]
    [X.J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasWeakSheafify X.J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
    (f : RingedToposHom X Y)
    (F : _root_.SheafOfModules.{w}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)) : Prop
declarations.comment: the definition: a sheaf of modules flat over the target ringed topos

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.IsThickening
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08M7.** A thickening of ringed topoi: the underlying geometric morphism is an
equivalence of topoi, the structure map is locally surjective, and its kernel ideal is locally
nilpotent. This is the hypothesis the source places on the horizontal arrows of a morphism of
thickenings.
declarations.statement: def IsThickening (i : RingedToposHom X Y) : Prop
declarations.comment: the horizontal arrows are thickenings

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.IdealOfThickening
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08M7.** The defining ideal `I = Ker(i^♯) ⊂ O'` of a thickening `i`, presented as a
sheaf of `O'`-modules together with an inclusion into `O'` whose sections are exactly the
sections killed by the structure map.
declarations.statement: structure IdealOfThickening (i : RingedToposHom X Y)
declarations.comment: the defining ideal of a thickening

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.IsThickening.of_firstOrderThickening
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08M7.** A first order thickening of ringed topoi in the sense of Stacks 08MB is a
thickening: its structure map is locally surjective by assumption and its square-zero kernel is
in particular locally nilpotent.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsThickening.of_firstOrderThickening {i : RingedToposHom X Y}
    (h : FirstOrderThickening i) : IsThickening i
declarations.comment: a first order thickening is a thickening

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.IsFirstOrderThickening
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08M7.** A first order thickening of ringed topoi, as a property of a morphism: a
thickening whose kernel ideal is square zero. This is the predicate form of the structure
`Deformation.ToposThickening.FirstOrderThickening` of Stacks 08MB, which in addition names the
ideal.
declarations.statement: def IsFirstOrderThickening (i : RingedToposHom X Y) : Prop
declarations.comment: first order thickening, as a property

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.IsFirstOrderThickening.of_firstOrderThickening
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08M7.** A first order thickening in the sense of Stacks 08MB has the property of
being a first order thickening: its kernel is the square-zero ideal it names.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsFirstOrderThickening.of_firstOrderThickening {i : RingedToposHom X Y}
    (h : FirstOrderThickening i) : IsFirstOrderThickening i
declarations.comment: 08MB implies the property

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.MorphismOfThickenings
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08M7.** A morphism of thickenings of ringed topoi: a commutative square of
morphisms of ringed topoi whose horizontal arrows `i` and `t` are thickenings, together with
their defining ideals `I = Ker(i^♯) ⊂ O'` and `J = Ker(t^♯) ⊂ O_{B'}`.
declarations.statement: structure MorphismOfThickenings
declarations.comment: the commutative square

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.MorphismOfThickenings.firstOrderSurjection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08M7.** The canonical reduction map `(f')^*J ⟶ f^*J` of a morphism of thickenings of
ringed topoi, with the target read as the `O'`-module `i_*f^*t^*J`: the unit of `i^* ⊣ i_*`,
followed by the direct image of the canonical comparison
`Deformation.ToposThickening.MorphismOfThickenings.pullbackComparison` of the two iterated
pullbacks around the square.

The map needs no hypothesis on the square. When the upper arrow is a first order thickening it
is an epimorphism, by
`Deformation.ToposThickening.MorphismOfThickenings.firstOrderSurjection_epi`.

What is proved here is an epimorphism with a unique factorization, and not the source's
assertion, which is an equality `(f')^*J = f^*J` of the two pullbacks. The equality is not
available under the hypotheses of Situation 91.9.1. By
`Deformation.ToposThickening.IsThickening.essImage_pushforwardModules_iff` this map is an
isomorphism exactly when `I` annihilates `(f')^*J`; and what annihilates `(f')^*J` is the ideal
`J·O'` generated by the image of `J` under `(f')^♯`, since a product of two sections of `J` is
zero. So the source's equality amounts to `J·O' = I`, which is the strictness
`Deformation.ToposThickening.MorphismOfThickenings.IsStrict` of Stacks 08M9 — a further
hypothesis that Situation 91.9.1 does not make. The source also identifies the equivalent topoi
of the two thickenings, which this development does not do. (That reading of the source's
equality is a remark, not a formalized equivalence; nothing below depends on it.)

Nothing of the tag is lost by proving the epimorphism instead. The source uses the equality only
to turn the induced map `(f')^*J ⟶ I` into a map `f^*J ⟶ I`, and an epimorphism does exactly
that: it admits at most one such map, and
`Deformation.ToposThickening.MorphismOfThickenings.firstOrderIdealMap` exhibits one, so the
source's map is obtained and is unique.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def firstOrderSurjection :
    (pullbackModules D.f'.toModulesHom).obj D.idealJ.I ⟶ D.reducedPullbackIdeal
declarations.comment: the first order reduction of the pullback of the lower ideal; the two upper topoi share their section universe, as the closed immersion carried by AlgebraicGeometry.ClosedRingedImmersion requires, the two lower ones staying independent

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.MorphismOfThickenings.firstOrderSurjection_epi
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08M7.** When both thickenings are first order the canonical reduction map
`(f')^*J ⟶ f^*J` is surjective: the unit of `i^* ⊣ i_*` is an epimorphism at every module, and
the second factor is the direct image of an isomorphism.

First-orderness of `t` is not consumed: it is what makes `t^*J` the ideal `J` read on `Sh(B)`,
and that identification is built into `reducedPullbackIdeal`.
declarations.statement:
theorem firstOrderSurjection_epi (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening D.i)
    (_ht : IsFirstOrderThickening D.t) : Epi D.firstOrderSurjection
declarations.comment: surjectivity of the first order reduction; the two upper topoi share their section universe, as the closed immersion carried by AlgebraicGeometry.ClosedRingedImmersion requires, the two lower ones staying independent

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.MorphismOfThickenings.firstOrderIdealMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08M7.** When both thickenings are first order the induced map of defining ideals
`(f')^*J ⟶ I` factors uniquely through the canonical reduction `(f')^*J ⟶ f^*J`, giving the
source's map `f^*J ⟶ I`.

The factorization exists because the unit of `i^* ⊣ i_*` at `I` is an isomorphism, `I` being
annihilated by itself; it is unique because the reduction is an epimorphism.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def firstOrderIdealMap (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening D.i)
    (ht : IsFirstOrderThickening D.t) :
    { g : D.reducedPullbackIdeal ⟶ D.idealI.I //
      D.firstOrderSurjection ≫ g = D.idealMap ∧
        ∀ g' : D.reducedPullbackIdeal ⟶ D.idealI.I,
          D.firstOrderSurjection ≫ g' = D.idealMap → g' = g }
declarations.comment: the first order factorization of the induced map of defining ideals; the two upper topoi share their section universe, as the closed immersion carried by AlgebraicGeometry.ClosedRingedImmersion requires, the two lower ones staying independent

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.MorphismOfThickenings.canonicalIdealMap_existsUnique
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08M7.** There is exactly one map of `O'`-modules `(f')^*J ⟶ I` whose composite into
`O'` is the structure map of `f'` applied to the inclusion of `J`.

Existence is the factorisation of
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.existsUnique_factorThrough`: every local section of `(f')^*J`, read in
`O'`, is killed by `i^♯`, hence lies in `I`. Uniqueness is the sectionwise injectivity of
`I ⟶ O'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem canonicalIdealMap_existsUnique :
    ∃! φ : (D.f'.toModulesHom.pullbackModules).obj D.idealJ.I ⟶ D.idealI.I,
      D.IsCanonicalIdealMap φ
declarations.comment: the canonical map of defining ideals

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.MorphismOfThickenings.idealMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08M7.** The induced map of defining ideals `(f')^*J ⟶ I` of a morphism of
thickenings of ringed topoi.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def idealMap : (D.f'.toModulesHom.pullbackModules).obj D.idealJ.I ⟶ D.idealI.I
declarations.comment: the induced map of defining ideals

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.MorphismOfThickenings.idealMap_spec
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08M7.** The induced map of defining ideals has the normalisation that
characterises it.
declarations.statement: theorem idealMap_spec : D.IsCanonicalIdealMap D.idealMap
declarations.comment: the induced map of defining ideals is the normalised one

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.MorphismOfThickenings.homEquiv_idealMap_comp_incl
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08M7.** The induced map of defining ideals, read on the target topos: its adjoint
transpose, composed with the inclusion of `I` into `O'`, is the structure map of `f'` applied to
the inclusion of `J` into `O_{B'}`. This is the source's own description of the map.
declarations.statement:
theorem homEquiv_idealMap_comp_incl :
    (pullbackAdjPushforwardModules D.f').homEquiv D.idealJ.I
        (SheafOfModules.unit ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := X'.J)) X'.O))
        (D.idealMap ≫ D.idealI.incl) =
      D.idealJ.incl ≫ unitStructureMap D.f'
declarations.comment: the induced map of defining ideals is the structure map of `f'` on `J`

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.MorphismOfThickenings.pullbackComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08M7.** The canonical comparison of the two iterated pullbacks around the square:
pulling back along `f'` and then `i` is pulling back along `t` and then `f`.

Each side is a composite of left adjoints, so it is the mate of the corresponding comparison of
iterated direct images, which is
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.pushforwardModulesCompIso`; the two are then joined by the
commutativity of the square, the pullback functor depending on the morphism of ringed topoi
only through its value.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pullbackComparison :
    D.f'.toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⋙ D.i.toModulesHom.pullbackModules ≅
      D.t.toModulesHom.pullbackModules ⋙ D.f.toModulesHom.pullbackModules
declarations.comment: the canonical comparison of the two iterated pullbacks around the square

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.MorphismOfThickenings.IsStrict
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08M9.** A morphism of thickenings of ringed topoi is *strict* when its induced map
of defining ideals `(f')^*J ⟶ I` is surjective, i.e. an epimorphism of sheaves of
`O'`-modules.
declarations.statement: def IsStrict : Prop
declarations.comment: strict morphism of thickenings

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.extensionActionMap
declarations.doc:
The canonical map `I ⊗[O] F → K`, characterized by multiplication by an
ideal section after lifting a section of `F` to the middle module.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def extensionActionMap
    [X.J.HasSheafCompose (forget RingCat.{w})]
    [Y.J.HasSheafCompose (forget RingCat.{w'})]
    [X.J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
    [Y.J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w'} RingCat.{w'})]
    {i : RingedToposHom X Y}
    [Y.J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w'}]
    [HasSheafify Y.J AddCommGrpCat.{w'}]
    [HasWeakSheafify Y.J AddCommGrpCat.{w'}]
    (hi : FirstOrderThickening i)
    {F K : SheafOfModules.{w'}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O))}
    (E : Abelian.YonedaExtension
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        (show Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O ⟶
            Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
              ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O) from
          (sheafCompose Y.J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map i.fSharp)).obj F)
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        (show Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O ⟶
            Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
              ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O) from
          (sheafCompose Y.J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map i.fSharp)).obj K) 0) :
    { c : ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
        ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).obj hi.I).obj F ⟶ K //
      ∀ (U : Y.Cᵒᵖ) (a : hi.I.val.obj U) (x : E.Z.left.val.obj U),
        E.f.val.app U
            (c.val.app U
              (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
                (R := Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor
                  i.toToposHom).obj X.O))
                (𝟙 (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor
                  i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).obj)).unit.app
                (PresheafOfModules.tensorObj hi.I.val F.val)).app U
                (a ⊗ₜ[((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O).obj.obj U]
                  E.g.val.app U x))) =
          (show (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O).obj.obj U from
            hi.incl.val.app U a) • x }
declarations.comment: canonical action map

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.compatibleMap_add_quotientKernel
declarations.doc:
Adding a map which factors through the first quotient and the second kernel preserves
compatibility.
declarations.statement:
theorem compatibleMap_add_quotientKernel
    (D : TwoExtensions i) (c : CompatibleMap D) (α : D.F ⟶ D.L) :
    ∃ d : CompatibleMap D,
      d.hom = c.hom +
        (D.firstExtension.g ≫
          (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
            ((sheafCompose Y.J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map i.fSharp)).map α ≫
          D.secondExtension.f)
declarations.comment: compatible_lifts_torsor

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.compatibleMap_unique_quotientKernel_difference
declarations.doc:
Any two compatible maps differ by a unique map from the first quotient to the second kernel.
Together with closure under those translations, this is the torsor assertion.
declarations.statement:
theorem compatibleMap_unique_quotientKernel_difference
    (D : TwoExtensions i) (c d : CompatibleMap D) :
    ∃! α : D.F ⟶ D.L,
      d.hom = c.hom +
        (D.firstExtension.g ≫
      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        ((sheafCompose Y.J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map i.fSharp)).map α ≫
          D.secondExtension.f)
declarations.comment: compatible_lifts_torsor

registrations.name: idealActionMap_naturality
registrations.comment: ideal_action_compatible

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.obstructionClass
declarations.doc:
The obstruction class in the first Ext group over the quotient structure sheaf. Its
vanishing characterizes lifts of the prescribed end maps.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def obstructionClass
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w'}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))]
    (D : TwoExtensions i) (h : CompatibleActions D) :
    Abelian.Ext D.F D.L 1
declarations.comment: obstruction class

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.obstructionClass_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc:
The obstruction vanishes exactly when the end maps extend to a map of the two
extensions.
declarations.statement:
theorem obstructionClass_eq_zero_iff
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w'}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))]
    (D : TwoExtensions i) (h : CompatibleActions D) :
    obstructionClass D h = 0 ↔
      ∃ φ' : D.firstExtension.Z.left ⟶ D.secondExtension.Z.left,
        IsExtensionLift D φ'
declarations.comment: vanishing criterion

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.fixedActionExtensionClass_torsor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08ME.** If some extension over a first order thickening of ringed topoi induces the
prescribed action `c` of the square-zero ideal, then the isomorphism classes of extensions
inducing `c` form a principal homogeneous space under the first `Ext` group over the quotient
structure sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem fixedActionExtensionClass_torsor
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w'}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))]
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w'} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))]
    (hi : FirstOrderThickening i)
    (F K : SheafOfModules.{w'}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))
    (c : ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
      ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).obj hi.I).obj F ⟶ K)
    (h : Nonempty (FixedActionExtensionClass.{_, _, _, _, _, _, e} hi F K c)) :
    Nonempty (AddTorsor (Abelian.Ext F K 1)
      (FixedActionExtensionClass.{_, _, _, _, _, _, e} hi F K c))

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.exists_addTorsor_fixedActionExtensionIsoClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08ME.** Let `i` be a first order thickening of ringed topoi, `F`, `K` modules over
the quotient structure sheaf and `c : I ⊗ F ⟶ K` linear. If there is an extension
`0 → K → F' → F → 0` of `O'`-modules with `c_{F'} = c`, then the set of isomorphism classes of
these extensions is a principal homogeneous space under `Ext¹_O(F, K)`: there is a torsor
structure in which `a` sends the class of `F'₁` to the class of `F'₂` exactly when the
`Ext¹_{O'}` class of `F'₂` is the Baer sum of that of `F'₁` with the image of `a`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_addTorsor_fixedActionExtensionIsoClass
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w'}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))]
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w'} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))]
    (hi : FirstOrderThickening i)
    (F K : SheafOfModules.{w'}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))
    (c : ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
      ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).obj hi.I).obj F ⟶ K)
    (h : Nonempty (FixedActionExtension hi F K c)) :
    ∃ T : AddTorsor (Abelian.Ext.{e} F K 1) (FixedActionExtensionIsoClass hi F K c),
      ∀ (a : Abelian.Ext.{e} F K 1) (E E' : FixedActionExtension hi F K c),
        (T.vadd a ⟦E⟧ = ⟦E'⟧) ↔
          extensionClass F K E'.1 =
            (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (structureRingMap i)).mapExtAddHom F K 1 a +
              extensionClass F K E.1

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.existenceObstructionClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08MF.** The obstruction to the existence of an extension over a first order
thickening of ringed topoi inducing a prescribed action `c` of the square-zero ideal: a class in
the second `Ext` group over the quotient structure sheaf.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def existenceObstructionClass
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w'}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))]
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w'} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))]
    (hi : FirstOrderThickening i)
    (F K : SheafOfModules.{w'}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))
    (c : ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
      ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).obj hi.I).obj F ⟶ K) :
    Abelian.Ext F K 2
declarations.comment: obstruction class

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.existenceObstructionClass_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08MF.** The obstruction class vanishes exactly when there is an extension of `F` by
`K` over the first order thickening whose canonical action of the square-zero ideal is `c`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existenceObstructionClass_eq_zero_iff
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w'}
