      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))]
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w'} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))]
    (hi : FirstOrderThickening i)
    (F K : SheafOfModules.{w'}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))
    (c : ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
      ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).obj hi.I).obj F ⟶ K) :
    existenceObstructionClass hi F K c = 0 ↔
      ∃ E : Abelian.YonedaExtension
        ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
          (structureRingMap i)).obj F)
        ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
          (structureRingMap i)).obj K) 0,
        (extensionActionMap hi E).1 = c
declarations.comment: vanishing criterion

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.Trivialization
declarations.doc:
A retraction of a morphism of ringed topoi: a morphism in the reverse direction whose
composite direct-image functor is identified with the identity, compatibly with the
structure-sheaf map.
declarations.statement: structure Trivialization (i : RingedToposHom X Y)
declarations.comment: trivial_first_order_thickening_and_trivialization

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.IsTrivial
declarations.doc: A morphism of ringed topoi is trivial if it admits a trivialization.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsTrivial (i : RingedToposHom X Y) : Prop
declarations.comment: trivial_first_order_thickening_and_trivialization

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.TrivializedThickening.moduleEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08MG.** The category of trivialized first order thickenings of a ringed topos
`(Sh(C), O)` is equivalent to the category of `O`-modules: a module goes to the square-zero
extension `O ⊕ M`, and a trivialized thickening goes to its ideal.

There is no `ᵒᵖ` on the module side because the Hom of
`Deformation.ToposThickening.TrivializedThickening O` runs in the algebraic direction, a
morphism `T ⟶ S` being a morphism `A_T ⟶ A_S` of sheaves of rings, so that this category is the
opposite of the source's category of trivialized thickenings (whose morphisms are morphisms of
ringed topoi, Stacks 08MK) and `M ↦ O ⊕ M` is covariant. The ringed space form of this remark,
`AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.trivializedThickeningEquivalence` (**Stacks 08L9**),
keeps the geometric Hom and so *does* carry an `ᵒᵖ`; the two statements agree. See the
"## Variance" section of this module.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def moduleEquivalence :
    SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf O) ≌ TrivializedThickening O
declarations.comment: trivialized first order thickenings are the O-modules; morphisms of thickenings run in the algebraic direction (A_T ⟶ A_S of sheaves of rings, the opposite of the source's ringed-topos morphisms of Stacks 08MK), so the module side carries no ᵒᵖ; stated at a single universe (site C : Type u with Category.{u} C, sheaves valued in Type u), which is the source's own setting since the Stacks Project fixes one universe throughout

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.trivializationOfSplitting
declarations.doc:
A splitting of the structure sheaf of a first order thickening determines a trivialization
whose structure map is the given section.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def trivializationOfSplitting (i : RingedToposHom X Y)
    (_hi : FirstOrderThickening i)
    (split : X.O ⟶ (inverseImageCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj Y.O)
    (split_comp : split ≫ i.fSharpInverseImage = 𝟙 X.O) :
    { π : Trivialization i //
      ∃ α : pushforwardCommRingFunctor π.retraction.toToposHom ≅
          inverseImageCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom,
        π.retraction.fSharp ≫ α.hom.app Y.O = split }
declarations.comment: splitting_determines_trivialization

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.splittingFromTrivialization
declarations.doc:
A trivialization splits the structure map of a first order thickening. The natural
equivalence identifies the ring sheaf with the square-zero extension of its quotient by its
kernel.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def splittingFromTrivialization (i : RingedToposHom X Y)
    (hi : FirstOrderThickening i) (π : Trivialization i) :
    Σ' split : ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O).obj ⟶ Y.O.obj,
      Σ' hs : SplitMono split,
        { _e : PresheafTrivialSquareZeroEquiv Y.O.obj
            ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O).obj
            i.fSharp.hom split // hs.retraction = i.fSharp.hom }
declarations.comment: splitting_from_trivialization

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.TrivializedThickening
declarations.doc:
A trivialized first order thickening of the ringed topos `(Sh(C), O)`, presented on the
site `C`: a sheaf of commutative rings `A` with a surjection onto `O` whose kernel has square
zero, together with a chosen splitting of that surjection.
declarations.statement: structure TrivializedThickening (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
declarations.comment: the category of trivialized first order thickenings: objects

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.TrivializedThickening.Hom
declarations.doc:
A morphism of trivialized first order thickenings: a morphism of the structure sheaves
compatible with both the surjections and the trivializations.

This runs in the algebraic direction, that of `h^♯`. The source's morphism of trivialized
thickenings is a morphism of ringed topoi `h : (Sh(D₁), O'₁) ⟶ (Sh(D₂), O'₂)` over
`(Sh(C), O)` (Stacks 08MK), so a `Hom T S` here is such an `h` with `T` the *target* of `h` and
`S` its source, and this category is the opposite of the source's. See the "## Variance"
section of this module.
declarations.statement: structure Hom (T S : TrivializedThickening O)
declarations.comment: the category of trivialized first order thickenings: morphisms, in the algebraic direction A_T ⟶ A_S (the opposite of the source's ringed-topos morphisms of Stacks 08MK)

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.trivializedThickeningOfTrivialization
declarations.doc:
A trivialization of a first order thickening of ringed topoi exhibits the thickening as an
object of the category of trivialized first order thickenings of `(Sh(D), i_*O)`, which is the
ringed topos `(Sh(C), O)` read through the equivalence of underlying topoi.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def trivializedThickeningOfTrivialization (i : RingedToposHom X Y)
    (hi : FirstOrderThickening i) (π : Trivialization i) :
    TrivializedThickening ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)
declarations.comment: a trivialized thickening is an object of the category; the target ringed topos is at a single universe, forced by Deformation.ToposThickening.TrivializedThickening, whose category is declared over a site C : Type u with Category.{u} C and sheaves valued in Type u — the source's own setting, since the Stacks Project fixes one universe throughout

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.TrivializedThickening.exists_thickening_trivialization_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08MG, clause (4), for the source's objects.** Every object of the category of
trivialized first order thickenings of `(Sh(C), O)` is, up to isomorphism, the trivialized
thickening of a first order thickening of ringed topoi `(Sh(C), O) ⟶ (Sh(C), A)` together with
a trivialization of it. With
`Deformation.ToposThickening.trivializedThickeningOfTrivialization` in the other direction this
identifies the objects of the two presentations, so that
`Deformation.ToposThickening.TrivializedThickening.moduleEquivalence` reads as the source's
sentence about the source's objects: the category of trivialized first order thickenings of
`(Sh(C), O)` is equivalent to the category of `O`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_thickening_trivialization_iso :
    ∃ (hi : FirstOrderThickening T.toRingedToposHom) (π : Trivialization T.toRingedToposHom),
      Nonempty (trivializedThickeningOfTrivialization T.toRingedToposHom hi π ≅
        (baseIsoFunctor (pushforwardIdIso O).symm).obj T)
declarations.comment: clause (4) for the source's objects: every object of the category of trivialized first order thickenings of (Sh(C), O) is the trivialized thickening of a first order thickening of ringed topoi (Sh(C), O) ⟶ (Sh(C), A) with a trivialization of it, up to the isomorphism of objects supplied here and the equivalence of categories Deformation.ToposThickening.TrivializedThickening.baseIsoEquivalence that reads the base through the comparison of the direct image along the identity morphism of topoi with the identity functor; together with Deformation.ToposThickening.trivializedThickeningOfTrivialization in the other direction this identifies the objects of the two presentations, which is what makes Deformation.ToposThickening.TrivializedThickening.moduleEquivalence the source's sentence about the source's objects; the thickening is presented on the site of the base, which loses nothing because the direct image of a first order thickening is an equivalence of topoi, and at a single universe, the Stacks Project's own convention

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.trivialExtension_bijective_underlyingExtensionClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08MI.** Let `i : (Sh(C), O) ⟶ (Sh(D), O')` be a first order thickening of ringed
topoi with square-zero ideal `I`, and `π` a trivialization of it. Let `F`, `K` be `O`-modules and
`c : I ⊗_O F ⟶ K` a map.

* The trivial extension `F'_{c,triv} = F ⊕ K` (`trivialExtensionModule`, `trivialExtension`)
  carries the `O'`-module structure `r · (m, k) = (q r · m, q r · k + c(d r ⊗ m))` built from
  the splitting `O' = O ⊕ I` of `π` and from `c`, and it is an extension
  `0 ⟶ K ⟶ F'_{c,triv} ⟶ F ⟶ 0` as in Stacks 08MB with `c_{F'_{c,triv}} = c`.
* The class `ξ_{F'} ∈ Ext¹_O(F, K)` of an extension `F'`, obtained by reading `F'` as an
  `O`-module through `π^♯` (`underlyingExtensionClass`), only depends on the class of `F'`
  (through `splitRestrictionExtHom`), and `F' ↦ ξ_{F'}` is a bijection from the isomorphism
  classes of extensions with `c_{F'} = c` onto `Ext¹_O(F, K)`. The isomorphism classes are
  represented by their classes in `Ext¹_{O'}(F, K)` (`FixedActionExtensionClass`); the bijection is
  also stated on extensions: every class is `ξ_{F'}` of an extension with `c_{F'} = c`, and two
  such extensions with the same `ξ` are isomorphic as extensions.
* The trivial extension maps to the zero class.
declarations.statement:
theorem trivialExtension_bijective_underlyingExtensionClass
    (c : ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
      ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).obj hi.I).obj F ⟶ K) :
    (∀ (U : Y.Cᵒᵖ) (r : (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O).obj.obj U)
        (z : (trivialExtensionModule hi π F K c).val.obj U),
        r • z = (structureApp i U r • z.1, structureApp i U r • z.2 +
          extensionPairing hi F K c U (trivializationDerivation hi π U r) z.1)) ∧
      (extensionActionMap hi (trivialExtension hi π F K c)).1 = c ∧
      (∀ E : Abelian.YonedaExtension
          ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
            (show Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O ⟶
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O) from
    (sheafCompose Y.J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map i.fSharp)).obj F)
          ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
            (show Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O ⟶
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O) from
    (sheafCompose Y.J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map i.fSharp)).obj K) 0,
        underlyingExtensionClass i hi π F K E =
          splitRestrictionExtHom hi π F K (extensionClass F K E)) ∧
      Function.Bijective (fun ξ : FixedActionExtensionClass.{_, _, _, _, _, _, e} hi F K c =>
        splitRestrictionExtHom hi π F K ξ.1) ∧
      (∀ η : Abelian.Ext F K 1, ∃ E : Abelian.YonedaExtension
          ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
            (show Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O ⟶
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O) from
    (sheafCompose Y.J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map i.fSharp)).obj F)
          ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
            (show Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O ⟶
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O) from
    (sheafCompose Y.J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map i.fSharp)).obj K) 0,
        (extensionActionMap hi E).1 = c ∧ underlyingExtensionClass i hi π F K E = η) ∧
      (∀ E E' : Abelian.YonedaExtension
          ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
            (show Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O ⟶
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O) from
    (sheafCompose Y.J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map i.fSharp)).obj F)
          ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
            (show Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O ⟶
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O) from
    (sheafCompose Y.J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map i.fSharp)).obj K) 0,
        (extensionActionMap hi E).1 = c → (extensionActionMap hi E').1 = c →
        underlyingExtensionClass i hi π F K E = underlyingExtensionClass i hi π F K E' →
        ∃ φ : E.Z.left ≅ E'.Z.left, E.f ≫ φ.hom = E'.f ∧ φ.hom ≫ E'.g = E.g) ∧
      underlyingExtensionClass i hi π F K (trivialExtension hi π F K c) = 0

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.MorphismOfFirstOrderThickenings.PushoutExtensionData.extensionOne
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08MJ.** The extension over the first thickening produced from an
extension over the second: the pushout `F'₂ ⊔_{K₂} K₁` carries an `O'₁`-module structure, built
by descending the action of `T = O'₂ ⋉ I₁` twisted by `c₁` along the locally surjective
`q : T ⟶ O'₁`, and sits in a short exact sequence `0 → K₁ → F'₂ ⊔_{K₂} K₁ → F → 0` of
`O'₁`-modules. Its middle term restricted along `q` is identified with the pushout by
`middleIso`, compatibly with the two maps by `restrictScalars_extInclOne` and
`restrictScalars_extQuotOne`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def extensionOne :
    Abelian.YonedaExtension
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (structureRingMap i)).obj dat.F)
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (structureRingMap i)).obj dat.K₁) 0
declarations.comment: the canonical map on extensions, by pushout along the map of kernel modules

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.MorphismOfFirstOrderThickenings.PushoutExtensionData.extensionOne_actionMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08MJ.** The canonical action map of the extension produced over the
first thickening is the prescribed `c₁`.
declarations.statement:
theorem extensionOne_actionMap :
    (extensionActionMap D.first (dat.extensionOne E₂ hE₂)).1 = dat.c₁
declarations.comment: the action map of the pushed-out extension is c₁

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.underlyingExtensionClass_eq_comp_mk₀
declarations.doc:
If `h` is a morphism of trivialized first order thickenings of `(Sh(C), O)` and an extension
`F'₂` of `F` by `K₂` over the second thickening maps to an extension `F'₁` of `F` by `K₁` over
the first, inducing `κ : K₂ ⟶ K₁` on the kernels and the identity on `F`, then the class
`ξ_{F'₁}` is the image of `ξ_{F'₂}` under the map `Ext¹_O(F, K₂) ⟶ Ext¹_O(F, K₁)` given by
functoriality of `Ext` in `κ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem underlyingExtensionClass_eq_comp_mk₀
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w'}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor ι).obj X.O)))]
    (h : O₂ ⟶ O₁) (hh : h ≫ s₁ = s₂)
    (hπ : splittingRingHom (homOn ι s₁) hi₁ π₁ =
      splittingRingHom (homOn ι s₂) hi₂ π₂ ≫ morphismRingHom h)
    (F K₁ K₂ : SheafOfModules.{w'}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor ι).obj X.O)))
    (κ : K₂ ⟶ K₁)
    (E₂ : Abelian.YonedaExtension
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (structureRingHom s₂)).obj F)
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (structureRingHom s₂)).obj K₂) 0)
    (E₁ : Abelian.YonedaExtension
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (structureRingHom s₁)).obj F)
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (structureRingHom s₁)).obj K₁) 0)
    (φ : E₂.Z.left ⟶
      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (morphismRingHom h)).obj E₁.Z.left)
    (hφf : E₂.f ≫ φ = (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (structureRingHom s₂)).map κ ≫
      (presentationCompIso s₁ s₂ h hh K₁).hom ≫
        (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (morphismRingHom h)).map E₁.f)
    (hφg : φ ≫ (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (morphismRingHom h)).map E₁.g =
      E₂.g ≫ (presentationCompIso s₁ s₂ h hh F).hom) :
    underlyingExtensionClass (homOn ι s₁) hi₁ π₁ F K₁ E₁ =
      (underlyingExtensionClass (homOn ι s₂) hi₂ π₂ F K₂ E₂).comp
        (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ κ) (add_zero 1)
declarations.comment:
the commutative square: the extension class of the image extension is the image
of the extension class under functoriality of `Ext` in the map of kernel modules

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.FirstOrderThickeningSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08ML.** A sequence of morphisms of first order thickenings of a ringed topos
`X`: three first order thickenings `i₁`, `i₂`, `i₃` of `X`, with their defining ideals, and two
composable morphisms `f₁₂`, `f₂₃` between them lying over the identity of `X`.
declarations.statement: structure FirstOrderThickeningSequence
declarations.comment: the sequence of morphisms of first order thickenings being classified

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.FirstOrderThickeningSequence.IsComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08ML.** A sequence of morphisms of first order thickenings of a ringed topos is a
*complex* when the induced maps of its defining ideals compose to zero, so that
`I₃ ⟶ I₂ ⟶ I₁` is a complex of modules.
declarations.statement: def IsComplex : Prop
declarations.comment: paragraph (1), the definition: the complex condition on the ideal maps

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.FirstOrderThickeningSequence.IsShortExactOnBase
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08ML.** A sequence of morphisms of first order thickenings of a ringed topos
`(Sh(C), O)` is a *short exact sequence* when the induced maps of defining ideals form a short
exact sequence `0 ⟶ I₃ ⟶ I₂ ⟶ I₁ ⟶ 0` of `O`-modules: the composite `I₃ ⟶ I₁` is zero, the
map `I₃ ⟶ I₂` is a monomorphism, the map `I₂ ⟶ I₁` is an epimorphism, and the sequence is
exact in the middle. Each ideal is read as an `O`-module through its pullback `iₖ^*Iₖ`.
declarations.statement: def IsShortExactOnBase : Prop
declarations.comment:
paragraph (2): the short exact sequence `0 → I₃ → I₂ → I₁ → 0` of `O`-modules,
each ideal `Iₖ` read as the `O`-module `iₖ^*Iₖ = Iₖ/Iₖ²`

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.FirstOrderThickeningComplex.fSharp₃_comp_splitting
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08ML.** For a complex of first order thickenings, the composition
`(Sh(D₁), O'₁) ⟶ (Sh(D₃), O'₃)` factors through `(Sh(C), O) ⟶ (Sh(D₃), O'₃)`: on structure
sheaves, the composite `O'₃ ⟶ O'₁` is `O'₃ ⟶ O ⟶ O'₁`.
declarations.statement: theorem fSharp₃_comp_splitting : S.fSharp₃ ≫ S.splitting hS = S.whole.hSharp
declarations.comment: the composition D₁ ⟶ D₃ factors through the base

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.FirstOrderThickeningComplex.trivialization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08ML.** The canonical trivialization `π : (Sh(D₁), O'₁) ⟶ (Sh(C), O)` of the
smallest thickening of a complex of first order thickenings.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def trivialization : Trivialization i
declarations.comment: the canonical trivialization of the smallest thickening

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.FirstOrderThickeningComplex.isTrivial
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08ML.** The smallest thickening of a complex of first order thickenings is a
trivial first order thickening of the base.
declarations.statement: theorem isTrivial (S : FirstOrderThickeningComplex i) (hS : S.IsComplex) : IsTrivial i
declarations.comment: the smallest thickening of a complex is trivial

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.FirstOrderThickeningSequence.i₃_fSharp_comp_splitting
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08ML.** For a complex of first order thickenings, the composition
`(Sh(D₁), O'₁) ⟶ (Sh(D₃), O'₃)` factors through `(Sh(C), O) ⟶ (Sh(D₃), O'₃)`: on structure
sheaves, the composite `O'₃ ⟶ O'₁` is `O'₃ ⟶ O ⟶ O'₁`, the second map being the canonical map
carried to the topos of the third thickening.
declarations.statement:
theorem i₃_fSharp_comp_splitting (hS : S.IsComplex) :
    S.i₃.fSharp ≫ S.baseIso.inv ≫ (pushforwardCommRingFunctor S.f₂₃.toToposHom).map
        ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor S.f₁₂.toToposHom).map (S.splitting hS)) =
      S.wholeSharp
declarations.comment: the composition D₁ ⟶ D₃ factors through the base

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.FirstOrderThickeningSequence.trivialization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08ML.** The canonical trivialization `π : (Sh(D₁), O'₁) ⟶ (Sh(C), O)` of the
smallest thickening of a complex of first order thickenings.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def trivialization (hS : S.IsComplex) : Trivialization S.i₁
declarations.comment: the canonical trivialization of the smallest thickening

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.FirstOrderThickeningSequence.isTrivial
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08ML.** The smallest thickening of a complex of first order thickenings is a
trivial first order thickening of the base.
declarations.statement: theorem isTrivial (hS : S.IsComplex) : IsTrivial S.i₁
declarations.comment: the smallest thickening of a complex is trivial

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.FirstOrderThickeningComplex.boundary_underlyingExtensionClass
declarations.doc:
Let `(Sh(C), O)` be a ringed topos, `F` an `O`-module, and let `O'₃ ⟶ O'₂ ⟶ O'₁` be a
complex of first order thickenings of `(Sh(C), O)` presented on one site, with `π` a
trivialization of `O'₁`. Let `(Kₖ, cₖ)` be pairs with `cₖ : Iₖ ⊗_O F ⟶ Kₖ` and let
`0 ⟶ K₃ ⟶ K₂ ⟶ K₁ ⟶ 0` be a short exact sequence of `O`-modules making the two squares `_hc₂₁`
and `hc₃₂` of the remark commute. Let `F'₂` be an extension as in Stacks 08MB over `O'₂` with
`c_{F'₂} = c₂` and let `F'₁` be the extension over `O'₁` that Stacks 08MJ produces from it.

Then the boundary map `∂ : Ext¹_O(F, K₁) ⟶ Ext²_O(F, K₃)` of `0 ⟶ K₃ ⟶ K₂ ⟶ K₁ ⟶ 0` — Yoneda
composition with the class of that sequence — carries the class `ξ_{F'₁}` of Stacks 08MI to the
obstruction class `o(F, K₃, c₃)` of Stacks 08MF, for comparison data `Q₃`, `E₃`, `presentation`,
`w`, `hw` and `χ` at the third thickening.
declarations.statement:
theorem boundary_underlyingExtensionClass (_hS : S.IsComplex) (π : Trivialization i)
    (F K₁ K₂ K₃ : SheafOfModules.{w'} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (baseRing i)))
    (c₁ : ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor.{u', v', w', w', w'}
      (baseRing i)).obj S.lower.first.I).obj F ⟶ K₁)
    (c₂ : ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor.{u', v', w', w', w'}
      (baseRing i)).obj S.lower.second.I).obj F ⟶ K₂)
    (c₃ : ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor.{u', v', w', w', w'}
      (baseRing i)).obj S.third.I).obj F ⟶ K₃)
    (k₃₂ : K₃ ⟶ K₂) (k₂₁ : K₂ ⟶ K₁) (hk : k₃₂ ≫ k₂₁ = 0)
    (hK : (ShortComplex.mk k₃₂ k₂₁ hk).ShortExact)
    (_hc₂₁ : c₂ ≫ k₂₁ = ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor.{u', v', w', w', w'}
      (baseRing i)).map S.idealMap₂₁).app F ≫ c₁)
    (hc₃₂ : c₃ ≫ k₃₂ = ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor.{u', v', w', w', w'}
      (baseRing i)).map S.idealMap₃₂).app F ≫ c₂)
    (E₂ : Abelian.YonedaExtension ((structureRestrict (reshapeHom i S.lower.O₂
        S.lower.fSharp₂)).obj F)
      ((structureRestrict (reshapeHom i S.lower.O₂ S.lower.fSharp₂)).obj K₂) 0)
    (_hE₂ : (extensionActionMap S.lower.second E₂).1 = c₂)
    (E₁ : Abelian.YonedaExtension ((structureRestrict i).obj F)
      ((structureRestrict i).obj K₁) 0)
    (_hE₁ : (extensionActionMap S.lower.first E₁).1 = c₁)
    {Q₃ : SheafOfModules.{w'} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (baseRing i))}
    {E₃ : Abelian.YonedaExtension ((structureRestrict S.thirdHom).obj F)
      ((structureRestrict S.thirdHom).obj Q₃) 0}
    (presentation : MonoActionPresentation S.third E₃) (w : Q₃ ⟶ K₂)
    (hw : (extensionActionMap S.third E₃).1 ≫ w =
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor.{u', v', w', w', w'}
        (baseRing i)).map S.idealMap₃₂).app F ≫ c₂)
    (χ : E₃.Z.left ⟶
      (structureRestrict S.thirdHom).obj ((splitRestriction i S.lower.first π).obj E₁.Z.left))
    (hχf : E₃.f ≫ χ = (structureRestrict S.thirdHom).map (w ≫ k₂₁) ≫
      (structureRestrict S.thirdHom).map (splitExtension i S.lower.first π F K₁ E₁).f)
    (hχg : χ ≫ (structureRestrict S.thirdHom).map
      (splitExtension i S.lower.first π F K₁ E₁).g = E₃.g) :
    (underlyingExtensionClass i S.lower.first π F K₁ E₁).comp hK.extClass (by decide) =
      existenceObstructionClass S.third F K₃ c₃
declarations.comment: the claim: the boundary of the extension class is the obstruction class

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.FirstOrderThickeningComplex.boundary_underlyingExtensionClass_eq_obstructionClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08MM.** Let `(Sh(C), O)` be a ringed topos, `F` an `O`-module and
`O'₃ ⟶ O'₂ ⟶ O'₁` a complex of first order thickenings of `(Sh(C), O)` (Stacks 08ML), presented
on one site. Let `cₖ : Iₖ ⊗_O F ⟶ Kₖ` be maps and `0 ⟶ K₃ ⟶ K₂ ⟶ K₁ ⟶ 0` a short exact sequence
of `O`-modules for which the second square `hc₃₂` of the remark commutes. Let `F'₂` be an
extension `0 ⟶ K₂ ⟶ F'₂ ⟶ F ⟶ 0` over `O'₂` as in Stacks 08MB with `c_{F'₂} = c₂`, and let
`F'₁` be the extension over `O'₁` that the functoriality of Stacks 08MJ produces from it. That
functoriality carries `F'₂` to an extension of `F` by `K₁` over `O'₁` together with a map of
extensions `u` from `F'₂`, which is `K₂ ⟶ K₁` on kernel modules and the identity on `F`; the
statement is made for every extension `F'₁` receiving such a map, so in particular for the one
of Stacks 08MJ (`boundary_underlyingExtensionClass_extensionOne_eq_obstructionClass`).

Then the boundary map `∂ : Ext¹_O(F, K₁) ⟶ Ext²_O(F, K₃)` of `0 ⟶ K₃ ⟶ K₂ ⟶ K₁ ⟶ 0` — Yoneda
composition with the class of that sequence — sends the class `ξ_{F'₁}` of Stacks 08MI, formed
with the canonical splitting `π = S.trivialization hS` of Stacks 08ML, to the obstruction class
`o(F, K₃, c₃)` of Stacks 08MF.

The map `c₁` and the first compatibility square of the remark are what make Stacks 08MJ
applicable; once `F'₁` and `u` are given they are not needed for the identity of classes, so they
are not hypotheses here. They are hypotheses of the version for the extension that Stacks 08MJ
constructs.
declarations.statement:
theorem boundary_underlyingExtensionClass_eq_obstructionClass
    (F K₁ K₂ K₃ : SheafOfModules.{w'} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (baseRing i)))
    (k₃₂ : K₃ ⟶ K₂) (k₂₁ : K₂ ⟶ K₁) (hk : k₃₂ ≫ k₂₁ = 0)
    (hK : (ShortComplex.mk k₃₂ k₂₁ hk).ShortExact)
    (c₂ : ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor (baseRing i)).obj S.lower.second.I).obj F ⟶
      K₂)
    (c₃ : ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor (baseRing i)).obj S.third.I).obj F ⟶ K₃)
    (hc₃₂ : c₃ ≫ k₃₂ =
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor (baseRing i)).map S.idealMap₃₂).app F ≫ c₂)
    (E₂ : Abelian.YonedaExtension
      ((structureRestrict (reshapeHom i S.lower.O₂ S.lower.fSharp₂)).obj F)
      ((structureRestrict (reshapeHom i S.lower.O₂ S.lower.fSharp₂)).obj K₂) 0)
    (hE₂ : (extensionActionMap S.lower.second E₂).1 = c₂)
    (E₁ : Abelian.YonedaExtension ((structureRestrict i).obj F)
      ((structureRestrict i).obj K₁) 0)
    (u : E₂.Z.left ⟶ (S.lower.restrictedExtension E₁).Z.left)
    (hu : E₂.f ≫ u =
      (structureRestrict (reshapeHom i S.lower.O₂ S.lower.fSharp₂)).map k₂₁ ≫
        (S.lower.restrictedExtension E₁).f)
    (hug : u ≫ (S.lower.restrictedExtension E₁).g = E₂.g) :
    (underlyingExtensionClass i S.lower.first (S.trivialization hS) F K₁ E₁).comp hK.extClass
        (by decide) =
      existenceObstructionClass S.third F K₃ c₃

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.FirstOrderThickeningComplex.boundary_underlyingExtensionClass_extensionOne_eq_obstructionClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08MM**, for the extension `F'₁` that Stacks 08MJ constructs. Let
`(Sh(C), O)` be a ringed topos, `F` an `O`-module and `O'₃ ⟶ O'₂ ⟶ O'₁` a complex of first order
thickenings of `(Sh(C), O)` (Stacks 08ML), presented on one site. Let `(Kₖ, cₖ)`,
`k = 1, 2, 3`, be pairs of an `O`-module `Kₖ` and a map `cₖ : Iₖ ⊗_O F ⟶ Kₖ`, and let
`0 ⟶ K₃ ⟶ K₂ ⟶ K₁ ⟶ 0` be a short exact sequence of `O`-modules making the two squares `hc₂₁`
and `hc₃₂` of the remark commute. Let `F'₂` be an extension `0 ⟶ K₂ ⟶ F'₂ ⟶ F ⟶ 0` of
`O'₂`-modules as in Stacks 08MB with `c_{F'₂} = c₂`, and let `F'₁` be the extension of
`O'₁`-modules that the functoriality of Stacks 08MJ produces from it
(`MorphismOfFirstOrderThickenings.PushoutExtensionData.extensionOne`, built on the data
`(F, K₁, K₂, c₁, c₂, K₂ ⟶ K₁)` and the first square).

Then the boundary map `∂ : Ext¹_O(F, K₁) ⟶ Ext²_O(F, K₃)` of `0 ⟶ K₃ ⟶ K₂ ⟶ K₁ ⟶ 0` sends the
class `ξ_{F'₁}` of Stacks 08MI, formed with the canonical splitting `π = S.trivialization hS` of
Stacks 08ML, to the obstruction class `o(F, K₃, c₃)` of Stacks 08MF.
declarations.statement:
theorem boundary_underlyingExtensionClass_extensionOne_eq_obstructionClass
    (F K₁ K₂ K₃ :
      SheafOfModules.{max v₂ u₂} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (baseRing i)))
    (c₁ : ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor (baseRing i)).obj S.lower.first.I).obj F ⟶
      K₁)
    (c₂ : ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor (baseRing i)).obj S.lower.second.I).obj F ⟶
      K₂)
    (c₃ : ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor (baseRing i)).obj S.third.I).obj F ⟶ K₃)
    (k₃₂ : K₃ ⟶ K₂) (k₂₁ : K₂ ⟶ K₁) (hk : k₃₂ ≫ k₂₁ = 0)
    (hK : (ShortComplex.mk k₃₂ k₂₁ hk).ShortExact)
    (hc₂₁ : c₂ ≫ k₂₁ =
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor (baseRing i)).map S.idealMap₂₁).app F ≫ c₁)
    (hc₃₂ : c₃ ≫ k₃₂ =
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor (baseRing i)).map S.idealMap₃₂).app F ≫ c₂)
    (E₂ : Abelian.YonedaExtension
      ((structureRestrict (reshapeHom i S.lower.O₂ S.lower.fSharp₂)).obj F)
      ((structureRestrict (reshapeHom i S.lower.O₂ S.lower.fSharp₂)).obj K₂) 0)
    (hE₂ : (extensionActionMap S.lower.second E₂).1 = c₂) :
    (underlyingExtensionClass i S.lower.first (S.trivialization hS) F K₁
        ((S.lower.pushoutDataOfPushout c₂ c₁ k₂₁ hc₂₁).extensionOne E₂ hE₂)).comp
        hK.extClass (by decide) =
      existenceObstructionClass S.third F K₃ c₃

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.moduleMapLift_torsor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08MP.** If a map of pullbacks across a first order thickening has a lift, then its
lifts form a principal homogeneous space under the maps from the pullback of `F'` to the descent of
the ideal product `I·G'`, with translation given by adding the corresponding map into `I·G'`
followed by its inclusion into `G'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleMapLift_torsor (hi : FirstOrderThickening i)
    (F' G' : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))
    (φ : (i.toRingedToposModulesHom.pullbackModules).obj F' ⟶
      (i.toRingedToposModulesHom.pullbackModules).obj G')
    (h : Nonempty (ModuleMapLift F' G' φ)) :
    ∃ t : AddTorsor
        ((i.toRingedToposModulesHom.pullbackModules).obj F' ⟶
          (idealProductModule hi G').val)
        (ModuleMapLift F' G' φ),
      ∀ (α : (i.toRingedToposModulesHom.pullbackModules).obj F' ⟶ (idealProductModule hi G').val)
        (c : ModuleMapLift F' G' φ),
        (t.vadd α c).val = c.val +
          idealProductHomEquiv hi F' G' α ≫ (idealProductSubmodule hi G').ι

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.isFlat_iff_isIso_canonicalMap_of_isStrict
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08MQ.** Let `(f, f')` be a morphism of first order thickenings of ringed topoi as in
Situation 08M7, let `ℱ'` be an `O'`-module and set `ℱ = i^*ℱ'`. Assume that `ℱ` is flat over
`O_ℬ` and that `(f, f')` is a strict morphism of thickenings (Definition 08M9). Then the
following are equivalent:

1. `ℱ'` is flat over `O_{ℬ'}`, and
2. the canonical map `f^*𝒥 ⊗_O ℱ ⟶ I·ℱ'` is an isomorphism.

Moreover, in this case the maps `f^*𝒥 ⊗_O ℱ ⟶ I ⊗_O ℱ ⟶ I·ℱ'` are isomorphisms.

How the source's objects are read:

* the square is `Deformation.ToposThickening.MorphismOfThickenings.ofFirstOrderThickenings`,
  built from the first order thickenings `hi` and `ht` and the commutativity `comm`;
* `O`-modules live on the thickened topos as `i_*O`-modules, as throughout this tree, and
  `ℱ = i^*ℱ'` is presented by the short exact sequence `0 ⟶ I·ℱ' ⟶ ℱ' ⟶ ℱ ⟶ 0` given by `q`,
  `hq` and `hqex` (the form `Deformation.ToposThickening.HasFlatLift` uses); the statement holds
  for every such presentation;
* "`ℱ` flat over `O_ℬ`" is `Deformation.ToposThickening.IsFlatOverBase`, and "`ℱ'` flat over
  `O_{ℬ'}`" is flatness of `Deformation.ToposThickening.baseModule`, that is, over `f⁻¹O_{ℬ'}`,
  which is the definition the source's proof opens with;
* strictness is `Deformation.ToposThickening.MorphismOfThickenings.IsStrict`, Definition 08M9;
* the canonical map is `Deformation.ToposThickening.canonicalMap`, the composite of
  `Deformation.ToposThickening.canonicalFirstFactor` (`f^*𝒥 ⊗_O ℱ ⟶ I ⊗_O ℱ`) and
  `Deformation.ToposThickening.canonicalSecondFactor` (`I ⊗_O ℱ ⟶ I·ℱ'`). Its source is written
  `f⁻¹𝒥 ⊗_{f⁻¹O_ℬ} ℱ`, which the source's proof identifies with `f^*𝒥 ⊗_O ℱ` ("observe that
  `f^*𝒥 ⊗_O ℱ = f⁻¹𝒥 ⊗_{f⁻¹O_ℬ} ℱ`"; in this tree
  `Stacks.FlatChangeOfRings.cancelExtendScalarsTensorSheafIso'`), and the composite is read
  over `f⁻¹O_{ℬ'}`, the ring over which both factors are linear; being an isomorphism does not
  depend on that reading.

The proof is the source's: strictness gives `ℱ = ℱ'/(f⁻¹𝒥)ℱ'`, and the equivalence is the
flatness criterion of Stacks 08M4 for the square-zero extension `f⁻¹O_{ℬ'} ⟶ f⁻¹O_ℬ`; see
`Deformation.ToposThickening.isFlat_iff_isIso_canonicalMap`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFlat_iff_isIso_canonicalMap_of_isStrict
    (i : RingedToposHom X X') (t : RingedToposHom S S') (f : RingedToposHom X S)
    (f' : RingedToposHom X' S') (hi : FirstOrderThickening i) (ht : FirstOrderThickening t)
    (comm : f'.comp i = t.comp f)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{w}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))
    (F' : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X'.O))
    (q : F' ⟶ (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (ringMap i.fSharp)).obj F)
    (hq : (idealProductSubmodule hi F').ι ≫ q = 0)
    (hqex : (ShortComplex.mk (idealProductSubmodule hi F').ι q hq).ShortExact)
    (hstrict : (MorphismOfThickenings.ofFirstOrderThickenings i t f f' hi ht comm).IsStrict)
    (hF : IsFlatOverBase i f F) :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat (baseModule f' F') ↔
        IsIso (canonicalMap i t f f' hi ht comm F F' q hq hqex)) ∧
      (IsIso (canonicalMap i t f f' hi ht comm F F' q hq hqex) →
        IsIso (canonicalFirstFactor i t f f' hi ht comm F) ∧
          IsIso (canonicalSecondFactor i hi F F' q hq hqex))

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.exists_addTorsor_moduleMapLift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08MR.** Let `(f, f')` be a strict morphism of first order thickenings of ringed
topoi as in Situation 08M7, let `ℱ'` and `𝒢'` be `O'`-modules with `𝒢'` flat over `O_{ℬ'}`, set
`ℱ = i^*ℱ'` and `𝒢 = i^*𝒢'`, and let `φ : ℱ ⟶ 𝒢` be a map of `O`-modules. If `φ` has at least
one lift to an `O'`-linear map `φ' : ℱ' ⟶ 𝒢'`, then its lifts form a principal homogeneous set
under `Hom_O(ℱ, 𝒢 ⊗_O f^*J)`.

The action is the one of the source's proof, "combine Lemmas 08MP and 08MQ": an element
`α : ℱ ⟶ 𝒢 ⊗_O f^*J` sends a lift `φ'` to `φ' + ι ∘ α`, where `ι ∘ α : ℱ' ⟶ 𝒢'` is the
`O'`-linear map corresponding to `α` followed by the symmetry `𝒢 ⊗_O f^*J ≅ f^*J ⊗_O 𝒢`, the
canonical identification `f^*J ⊗_O 𝒢 ≅ I·𝒢'` of Stacks 08MQ
(`Deformation.ToposThickening.idealProductTensorIso`) and the inclusion `I·𝒢' ⊂ 𝒢'`.
Concretely, `α` composed with those identifications is a map into the descent of `I·𝒢'`, which
`Deformation.ToposThickening.idealProductHomEquiv` (the adjunction `i^* ⊣ i_*`) reads as a map
`ℱ' ⟶ I·𝒢'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_addTorsor_moduleMapLift
    (F' : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X'.O))
    (hstrict : (MorphismOfThickenings.ofFirstOrderThickenings i t f f' hi ht comm).IsStrict)
    (hG : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (ringMap f'.fSharpInverseImage)).obj G'))
    (φ : (pullbackModules i.toRingedToposModulesHom).obj F' ⟶
      (pullbackModules i.toRingedToposModulesHom).obj G')
    (hne : Nonempty (ModuleMapLift F' G' φ)) :
    ∃ T : AddTorsor
        ((pullbackModules i.toRingedToposModulesHom).obj F' ⟶
          ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor.{u, v, w, w, w} X.O).flip.obj
              (basePullbackIdeal t f ht)).obj
            ((pullbackModules i.toRingedToposModulesHom).obj G'))
        (ModuleMapLift F' G' φ),
      ∀ (α : (pullbackModules i.toRingedToposModulesHom).obj F' ⟶
          ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor.{u, v, w, w, w} X.O).flip.obj
              (basePullbackIdeal t f ht)).obj
            ((pullbackModules i.toRingedToposModulesHom).obj G'))
        (φ' : ModuleMapLift F' G' φ),
        (T.vadd α φ').val = φ'.val +
          idealProductHomEquiv hi F' G'
              (α ≫ ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.FlatSquareZero.tensorLeftIsoTensorRight X.O
                  (basePullbackIdeal t f ht)).app
                  ((pullbackModules i.toRingedToposModulesHom).obj G')).inv ≫
                (idealProductTensorIso i t f f' hi ht comm G' hstrict hG).hom) ≫
            (idealProductSubmodule hi G').ι
declarations.comment: The whole statement, under exactly the source's hypotheses (Situation 08M7, strict morphism, G' flat over O_{B'}), with the action of the source pinned: α sends φ' to φ' + ι ∘ α, read in I·G' through the canonical isomorphism of 08MQ.

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.moduleMapObstruction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08MS.** There is a class `o(φ)` in `Ext¹_O(Li^*F', I·G')` whose vanishing is
necessary and sufficient for the `O`-linear map `φ : i^*F' ⟶ i^*G'` to be the pullback of an
`O'`-linear map `F' ⟶ G'`.

The class is the connecting class of the sequence `0 ⟶ I·G' ⟶ G' ⟶ i_*i^*G' ⟶ 0` on the adjoint
transpose of `φ`, read across `Li^* ⊣ Ri_*`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def moduleMapObstruction :
    { o : DerivedCategory.Ext
        (d.functor.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)) 0).obj F'))
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{w} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := X.J)) X.O)) 0).obj
            (idealProductModule hi G').val) 1 //
      o = 0 ↔ Nonempty (ModuleMapLift F' G' φ) }

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.moduleMapObstructionClass
declarations.doc: **Stacks 08MS.** The obstruction class `o(φ) ∈ Ext¹_O(Li^*F', I·G')` itself.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev moduleMapObstructionClass :
    DerivedCategory.Ext
      (d.functor.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)) 0).obj F'))
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{w} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := X.J)) X.O)) 0).obj
          (idealProductModule hi G').val) 1

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.moduleMapObstructionClass_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc: **Stacks 08MS.** The obstruction class vanishes exactly when `φ` lifts.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleMapObstructionClass_eq_zero_iff :
    moduleMapObstructionClass hi d F' G' φ = 0 ↔ Nonempty (ModuleMapLift F' G' φ)

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.moduleMapLiftObstruction_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08MS.** Let `i : (Sh(C), O) ⟶ (Sh(D), O')` be a first order thickening of ringed
topoi, let `F'`, `G'` be `O'`-modules and let `φ : i^*F' ⟶ i^*G'` be `O`-linear. The element
`o(φ) ∈ Ext¹_O(Li^*F', I·G')` vanishes if and only if `φ` lifts to an `O'`-linear map
`φ' : F' ⟶ G'`, i.e. one with `i^*φ' = φ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleMapLiftObstruction_eq_zero_iff (hi : FirstOrderThickening i)
    (F' G' : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))
    (φ : (i.toRingedToposModulesHom.pullbackModules).obj F' ⟶
      (i.toRingedToposModulesHom.pullbackModules).obj G') :
    moduleMapLiftObstruction hi F' G' φ = 0 ↔ Nonempty (ModuleMapLift F' G' φ)

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.relativeModuleMapObstructionClass_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08MT.** Let `(f, f')` be a strict morphism of first order thickenings of ringed
topoi as in Situation 08M7, let `ℱ'` and `𝒢'` be `O'`-modules flat over `O_{ℬ'}`, set
`ℱ = i^*ℱ'` and `𝒢 = i^*𝒢'`, and let `φ : ℱ ⟶ 𝒢` be an `O`-linear map. The element
`o(φ) ∈ Ext¹_O(ℱ, 𝒢 ⊗_O f^*𝒥)` of `Deformation.ToposThickening.relativeModuleMapObstructionClass`
vanishes if and only if `φ` lifts to an `O'`-linear map `φ' : ℱ' ⟶ 𝒢'`.

The class vanishes exactly when the pulled-back sequence it is the class of splits after `i^*`;
a splitting descends to one before `i^*`, the unit of the adjunction being invertible on a direct
image, and a splitting of the pulled-back sequence is a factorization of the transpose of `φ`
through `𝒢' ⟶ i_*𝒢`, which is a lift of `φ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeModuleMapObstructionClass_eq_zero_iff
    (F' G' : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X'.O))
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))]
    (hstrict : (MorphismOfThickenings.ofFirstOrderThickenings i t f f' hi ht comm).IsStrict)
    (hF : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        ((sheafCompose X'.J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).map
          f'.fSharpInverseImage)).obj F'))
    (hG : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        ((sheafCompose X'.J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).map
          f'.fSharpInverseImage)).obj G'))
    (φ : (pullbackModules i.toRingedToposModulesHom).obj F' ⟶
      (pullbackModules i.toRingedToposModulesHom).obj G') :
    relativeModuleMapObstructionClass.{_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, e} i t f f' hi ht comm F' G'
        hstrict hF hG φ = 0 ↔
      Nonempty (ModuleMapLift F' G' φ)

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.nonempty_addTorsor_flatLiftClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08MU.** Let `(f, f')` be a strict morphism of first order thickenings of ringed
topoi as in Situation 08M7 and let `ℱ` be an `O`-module flat over `O_ℬ`. If `ℱ` has at least one
lift to an `O'`-module flat over `O_{ℬ'}`, then the isomorphism classes of such lifts form a
principal homogeneous set under `Ext¹_O(ℱ, I ⊗_O ℱ)`.

The proof is the source's: Stacks 08MQ makes the canonical map `f^*J ⊗ ℱ ⟶ I ⊗ ℱ` an
isomorphism, which identifies the lifts with the extensions of `ℱ` by `I ⊗_O ℱ` whose action map
is the identity (`Deformation.ToposThickening.isFlatLiftClassCorrespondence`), and those form a
principal homogeneous set by Stacks 08ME (through
`Deformation.ToposThickening.flatLiftClass_torsor`). The same statement with the action of the
source's proof made explicit is `Deformation.ToposThickening.exists_addTorsor_flatLiftClass`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_addTorsor_flatLiftClass
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))]
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X'.O))]
    (hstrict : (MorphismOfThickenings.ofFirstOrderThickenings i t f f' hi ht comm).IsStrict)
    (hflat : IsFlatOverBase i f F) (hne : Nonempty (FlatLift i f' hi F)) :
    Nonempty (AddTorsor
      (Abelian.Ext.{e} F
        (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor.{u', v', w, w, w}
          ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).obj hi.I).obj F) 1)
      (FlatLiftClass i f' hi F))

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.exists_addTorsor_flatLiftClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08MU.** Let `(f, f')` be a strict morphism of first order thickenings of ringed
topoi as in Situation 08M7 and let `ℱ` be an `O`-module flat over `O_ℬ`. If there is a pair
`(ℱ', α)` consisting of an `O'`-module `ℱ'` flat over `O_{ℬ'}` and an isomorphism
`α : i^*ℱ' ≅ ℱ`, then the isomorphism classes of such pairs form a principal homogeneous set
under `Ext¹_O(ℱ, I ⊗_O ℱ)`.

The action is the one of the source's proof. A pair `(ℱ', α)` gives the extension
`0 ⟶ I ⊗_O ℱ ⟶ ℱ' ⟶ ℱ ⟶ 0` of `O'`-modules whose first map is the canonical map
`I ⊗_O ℱ ≅ I·ℱ' ⊂ ℱ'` (`Deformation.ToposThickening.FlatLift.fixedActionExtension`; the canonical
map is an isomorphism onto `I·ℱ'` by Stacks 08MQ), and `a ∈ Ext¹_O(ℱ, I ⊗_O ℱ)` sends the class
of `(ℱ', α)` to the class of `(𝒢', β)` exactly when the `Ext¹_{O'}` class of the extension of
`𝒢'` is that of `ℱ'` plus the image of `a`, which is the action of Stacks 08ME.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_addTorsor_flatLiftClass (i : RingedToposHom X X') (t : RingedToposHom S S')
    (f : RingedToposHom X S) (f' : RingedToposHom X' S') (hi : FirstOrderThickening i)
    (ht : FirstOrderThickening t) (comm : f'.comp i = t.comp f)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{w}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))]
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X'.O))]
    (hstrict : (MorphismOfThickenings.ofFirstOrderThickenings i t f f' hi ht comm).IsStrict)
    (hflat : IsFlatOverBase i f F) (hne : Nonempty (FlatLift i f' hi F)) :
    ∃ T : AddTorsor
        (Abelian.Ext.{e} F
          (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
            ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).flip.obj F).obj hi.I) 1)
        (FlatLiftClass i f' hi F),
      ∀ (a : Abelian.Ext.{e} F
          (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
            ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).flip.obj F).obj hi.I) 1)
        (A B : FlatLift i f' hi F),
        T.vadd a (Quotient.mk (flatLiftSetoid i f' hi F) A) =
            Quotient.mk (flatLiftSetoid i f' hi F) B ↔
          extensionClass F
              (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
                ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).flip.obj F).obj hi.I)
              (B.fixedActionExtension i t f f' hi ht comm F
                ((isStrictPullbackIdealMap_iff_isStrict i t f f' hi ht comm).mpr hstrict)
                (isFlat_reducedBaseModule_of_isFlatOverBase i t f f' hi ht comm F hflat)) =
            (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (structureRingMap i)).mapExtAddHom F
                (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
                  ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).flip.obj F).obj hi.I) 1 a +
              extensionClass F
                (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
                  ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).flip.obj F).obj hi.I)
                (A.fixedActionExtension i t f f' hi ht comm F
                  ((isStrictPullbackIdealMap_iff_isStrict i t f f' hi ht comm).mpr hstrict)
                  (isFlat_reducedBaseModule_of_isFlatOverBase i t f f' hi ht comm F hflat))

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.hasFlatLift_iff_isIso_and_obstruction_eq_zero'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08MV, unconditionally.** Let `(f, f')` be a morphism of first order thickenings of
ringed topoi as in Situation 08M7, strict, and let `ℱ` be an `O`-module flat over `O_ℬ`. Then
`ℱ` has a lift to an `O'`-module flat over `O_{ℬ'}` if and only if the canonical map
`f^*J ⊗ ℱ ⟶ I ⊗ ℱ` is an isomorphism and the obstruction class `o(ℱ, I ⊗_O ℱ, 1)` of
Stacks 08MF vanishes.

This is `Deformation.ToposThickening.hasFlatLift_iff_isIso_and_obstruction_eq_zero` with its
`Deformation.ToposThickening.IsFlatLiftCorrespondence` hypothesis supplied by
`Deformation.ToposThickening.isFlatLiftCorrespondence`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFlatLift_iff_isIso_and_obstruction_eq_zero'
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))]
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X'.O))]
    (hstrict : (MorphismOfThickenings.ofFirstOrderThickenings i t f f' hi ht comm).IsStrict)
    (hflat : IsFlatOverBase i f F) :
    HasFlatLift i f' hi F ↔
      IsIso (idealTensorComparison i t f f' hi ht comm F) ∧
        existenceObstructionClass hi F
            (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor
                i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).flip.obj F).obj hi.I)
            (𝟙 (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor
                i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).flip.obj F).obj
              hi.I)) = 0
declarations.comment: in Situation 08M7, for a strict morphism and F flat over O_B

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CommSq.isPullback_iff_exact_and_mono_f
declarations.doc:
A commutative square in an abelian category is cartesian if and only if the associated
sequence `0 ⟶ X₁ ⟶ X₂ ⊞ X₃ ⟶ X₄` is exact, where the first map is `biprod.lift fst snd` and
the second is `biprod.desc f (-g)`.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CommSq.isPushout_iff_exact_and_epi_g
declarations.doc:
A commutative square in an abelian category is cocartesian if and only if the associated
sequence `X₁ ⟶ X₂ ⊞ X₃ ⟶ X₄ ⟶ 0` is exact, where the first map is `biprod.lift f (-g)` and
the second is `biprod.desc inl inr`.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CommSq.IsPullback.epi_to_isPushout
declarations.statement:
lemma IsPullback.epi_to_isPushout (hP : IsPullback g f k h) [Epi k] :
    IsPushout g f k h ∧ Epi f

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CommSq.IsPushout.mono_to_isPullback
declarations.statement:
lemma IsPushout.mono_to_isPullback (hP : IsPushout g f k h) [Mono g] :
    IsPullback g f k h ∧ Mono h

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.Exact.exact_kernelShortComplex
declarations.doc:
If the first row of a commutative ladder in an abelian category is exact and the first map
of the second row is a monomorphism, then the induced short complex
`kernel α ⟶ kernel β ⟶ kernel γ` is exact.
declarations.statement:
lemma Exact.exact_kernelShortComplex (hS : S.Exact) [Mono k] :
    (S.kernelShortComplex comm₁ comm₂).Exact

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.Exact.exact_cokernelShortComplex
declarations.doc:
If the second row of a commutative ladder in an abelian category is exact and the second
map of the first row is an epimorphism, then the induced short complex
`cokernel α ⟶ cokernel β ⟶ cokernel γ` is exact.
declarations.statement:
lemma Exact.exact_cokernelShortComplex (hT : T.Exact) [Epi g] :
    (T.cokernelShortComplex comm₁ comm₂).Exact

declarations.name: AlgebraicTopology.homotopyEquivalences_forget_iff_quasiIso_forget₂_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08NA**.
Let `A` be a ring and let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of simplicial `A`-algebras which is surjective
in each degree. Then the underlying morphism of simplicial sets is a homotopy equivalence if and
only if the induced morphism `s(X) ⟶ s(Y)` of the chain complexes associated to the underlying
simplicial `A`-modules is a quasi-isomorphism. Applied to the augmentation `X(B) ⟶ B` of the
standard resolution of a commutative `A`-algebra `B` by the polynomial algebras `A[A[⋯[B]⋯]]`,
whose underlying augmentation of simplicial sets is a homotopy equivalence, this says that `B` is
the only nonzero homology group of the complex of `A`-modules associated to `X(B)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem homotopyEquivalences_forget_iff_quasiIso_forget₂_of_surjective {A : Type u}
    [CommRing A] {X Y : SimplicialObject (AlgCat.{v} A)} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : ∀ n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ, Function.Surjective (f.app n).hom) :
    SimplicialObject.homotopyEquivalences (Type v)
        (Functor.whiskerRight f (forget (AlgCat.{v} A))) ↔
      QuasiIso ((alternatingFaceMapComplex (ModuleCat.{v} A)).map
        (Functor.whiskerRight f (forget₂ (AlgCat.{v} A) (ModuleCat.{v} A))))
