declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Comonad.exists_augmented_standardResolution
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08NC**.
Let `G` be a comonad on a category `A`, with counit `G.ε : G ⟶ 𝟭 A` and comultiplication
`G.δ : G ⟶ G ⋙ G`. The iterates `Z (n + 1)` of `G`, with `Z 0 = 𝟭 A`, carry faces
`d n j : Z (n + 1) ⟶ Z n` and degeneracies `s n j : Z (n + 1) ⟶ Z (n + 2)` for `0 ≤ j ≤ n`,
obtained by whiskering `G.ε`, resp. `G.δ`, into the `j`-th factor `G` counted from the left in the
composite `Z (n + 1) = G ∘ ⋯ ∘ G`, and these are the faces and degeneracies of a simplicial object
of the category `A ⥤ A` of endofunctors of `A`, augmented over the constant simplicial object `𝟭 A`
by `ε₀ = d 0 0 = G.ε`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_augmented_standardResolution {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A]
    (G : Comonad A) :
    ∃ (Z : ℕ → (A ⥤ A)) (hZ : ∀ n : ℕ, Z (n + 1) = Z n ⋙ (G : A ⥤ A))
      (d : ∀ n : ℕ, Fin (n + 1) → (Z (n + 1) ⟶ Z n))
      (s : ∀ n : ℕ, Fin (n + 1) → (Z (n + 1) ⟶ Z (n + 2))),
      Z 0 = 𝟭 A ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, d n 0 = eqToHom (hZ n) ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft (Z n) G.ε) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)),
        d (n + 1) j.succ =
          eqToHom (hZ (n + 1)) ≫ Functor.whiskerRight (d n j) (G : A ⥤ A) ≫
            eqToHom (hZ n).symm) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        s n 0 = eqToHom (hZ n) ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft (Z n) G.δ ≫
          Functor.whiskerRight (eqToHom (hZ n).symm) (G : A ⥤ A) ≫ eqToHom (hZ (n + 1)).symm) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)),
        s (n + 1) j.succ =
          eqToHom (hZ (n + 1)) ≫ Functor.whiskerRight (s n j) (G : A ⥤ A) ≫
            eqToHom (hZ (n + 2)).symm) ∧
      ∃ (X : SimplicialObject.Augmented (A ⥤ A))
        (h : ∀ n : ℕ, X.left.obj (op ⦋n⦌) = Z (n + 1)) (hX : X.right = Z 0),
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 2)),
          X.left.δ j = eqToHom (h (n + 1)) ≫ d (n + 1) j ≫ eqToHom (h n).symm) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)),
          X.left.σ j = eqToHom (h n) ≫ s n j ≫ eqToHom (h (n + 1)).symm) ∧
        X.hom.app (op ⦋0⦌) = eqToHom (h 0) ≫ d 0 0 ≫ eqToHom hX.symm

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.exists_homotopyInverse_whiskered_standardResolution
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08ND**.
Let `V : A ⥤ S` have a left adjoint `U : S ⥤ A`, and let `X` be the standard resolution: the
augmented simplicial object of `A ⥤ A` with terms the iterates `Z (n + 1)` of the comonad
`U ∘ V`, faces and degeneracies `d`, `s` whiskering its counit, resp. its comultiplication,
into the `j`-th factor, point `Z 0 = 𝟭 A` and augmentation `ε₀ = d 0 0`. Then the whiskered
augmentations `1_V ⋆ ε : V ∘ X ⟶ V` and `ε ⋆ 1_U : X ∘ U ⟶ U` are homotopy equivalences: each
admits a morphism `r` in the other direction such that both composites with it are homotopic to
the identities, homotopic meaning related by the equivalence relation generated by the existence
of a simplicial homotopy.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_homotopyInverse_whiskered_standardResolution
    {A : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} A] {S : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} S]
    {U : S ⥤ A} {V : A ⥤ S} (adj : U ⊣ V)
    (Z : ℕ → (A ⥤ A)) (hZ : ∀ n : ℕ, Z (n + 1) = Z n ⋙ (adj.toComonad : A ⥤ A))
    (d : ∀ n : ℕ, Fin (n + 1) → (Z (n + 1) ⟶ Z n))
    (s : ∀ n : ℕ, Fin (n + 1) → (Z (n + 1) ⟶ Z (n + 2)))
    (hZ₀ : Z 0 = 𝟭 A)
    (hd₀ : ∀ n : ℕ, d n 0 = eqToHom (hZ n) ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft (Z n) adj.toComonad.ε)
    (hd : ∀ (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)), d (n + 1) j.succ =
      eqToHom (hZ (n + 1)) ≫ Functor.whiskerRight (d n j) (adj.toComonad : A ⥤ A) ≫
        eqToHom (hZ n).symm)
    (hs₀ : ∀ n : ℕ, s n 0 = eqToHom (hZ n) ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft (Z n) adj.toComonad.δ ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (eqToHom (hZ n).symm) (adj.toComonad : A ⥤ A) ≫
        eqToHom (hZ (n + 1)).symm)
    (hs : ∀ (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)), s (n + 1) j.succ =
      eqToHom (hZ (n + 1)) ≫ Functor.whiskerRight (s n j) (adj.toComonad : A ⥤ A) ≫
        eqToHom (hZ (n + 2)).symm)
    (X : SimplicialObject.Augmented (A ⥤ A))
    (h : ∀ n : ℕ, X.left.obj (Opposite.op ⦋n⦌) = Z (n + 1)) (hX : X.right = Z 0)
    (hδ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 2)),
      X.left.δ j = eqToHom (h (n + 1)) ≫ d (n + 1) j ≫ eqToHom (h n).symm)
    (hσ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)),
      X.left.σ j = eqToHom (h n) ≫ s n j ≫ eqToHom (h (n + 1)).symm)
    (hε : X.hom.app (Opposite.op ⦋0⦌) = eqToHom (h 0) ≫ d 0 0 ≫ eqToHom hX.symm)
    (a : X.left ⋙ (Functor.whiskeringRight A A S).obj V ⟶
      (Functor.const SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ).obj (X.right ⋙ V))
    (ha : ∀ n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ, a.app n = Functor.whiskerRight (X.hom.app n) V)
    (b : X.left ⋙ (Functor.whiskeringLeft S A A).obj U ⟶
      (Functor.const SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ).obj (U ⋙ X.right))
    (hb : ∀ n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ, b.app n = Functor.whiskerLeft U (X.hom.app n)) :
    (∃ r : (Functor.const SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ).obj (X.right ⋙ V) ⟶
        X.left ⋙ (Functor.whiskeringRight A A S).obj V,
      Relation.EqvGen (fun f g => Nonempty (SimplicialObject.Homotopy f g)) (a ≫ r) (𝟙 _) ∧
      Relation.EqvGen (fun f g => Nonempty (SimplicialObject.Homotopy f g)) (r ≫ a) (𝟙 _)) ∧
    (∃ r : (Functor.const SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ).obj (U ⋙ X.right) ⟶
        X.left ⋙ (Functor.whiskeringLeft S A A).obj U,
      Relation.EqvGen (fun f g => Nonempty (SimplicialObject.Homotopy f g)) (b ≫ r) (𝟙 _) ∧
      Relation.EqvGen (fun f g => Nonempty (SimplicialObject.Homotopy f g)) (r ≫ b) (𝟙 _))

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.exists_homotopyInverse_whiskered_standardResolution
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08NE**.
Let `A` be a ring, let `Alg_A` be the category of commutative `A`-algebras, let
`U : Sets → Alg_A` be the polynomial-algebra functor `E ↦ A[E]` (`MvPolynomial E A`) and `V` the
forgetful functor, and let `X` be the standard resolution of the comonad `Y = U ∘ V`
(Stacks 08NA): the augmented simplicial object of `Fun(Alg_A, Alg_A)` with terms the iterates
`Xₙ = Y^{n+1}`, so that `Xₙ(B) = A[A[⋯[B]⋯]]` with `n + 1` brackets, faces `Godement.face`,
degeneracies `Godement.degeneracy`, point `𝟭` and augmentation `d⁰₀` (for instance
`CommAlgCat.standardEndofunctor`). Then, by Lemma 08ND:

* the whiskered augmentation `1_V ⋆ ε : V ∘ X ⟶ V` is a homotopy equivalence whose homotopy
  inverse is, in degree `n`, the map of sets `b ↦ [⋯[b]⋯]` (`n + 1` brackets), given by the family
  `ρ`; evaluated at a commutative `A`-algebra `B`, this is the homotopy equivalence of underlying
  simplicial sets of `X(B) ⟶ B`, for any ring map `A → B`;
* the whiskered augmentation `ε ⋆ 1_U : X ∘ U ⟶ U` is a homotopy equivalence of simplicial objects
  of `Fun(Sets, Alg_A)` whose homotopy inverse is, in degree `n`, the `A`-algebra map
  `∑ a_{e₁,…,e_p} [e₁]⋯[e_p] ↦ ∑ a_{e₁,…,e_p} [⋯[e₁]⋯]⋯[⋯[e_p]⋯]`, sending a variable `[e]` of
  `A[E]` to `[⋯[e]⋯]` (`n + 2` brackets) in `Xₙ(A[E])`, given by the family `τ`; evaluated at a
  set `E`, this is the homotopy equivalence of simplicial rings `X(A[E]) ⟶ A[E]`.

In both clauses both composites with the inverse are homotopic to the identity, homotopic meaning
related by the equivalence relation generated by the existence of a simplicial homotopy.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_homotopyInverse_whiskered_standardResolution (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (X : SimplicialObject.Augmented (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A ⥤ CommAlgCat.{max u v} A))
    (h : ∀ n : ℕ, X.left.obj (op ⦋n⦌) = (polynomialComonad.{u, v} A).toFunctor.iterate (n + 1))
    (hX : X.right = 𝟭 (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A))
    (hδ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 2)), X.left.δ j =
      eqToHom (h (n + 1)) ≫ Godement.face (polynomialComonad.{u, v} A).ε (n + 1) j ≫
        eqToHom (h n).symm)
    (hσ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)), X.left.σ j =
      eqToHom (h n) ≫ Godement.degeneracy (polynomialComonad.{u, v} A).δ n j ≫
        eqToHom (h (n + 1)).symm)
    (hε : X.hom.app (op ⦋0⦌) =
      eqToHom (h 0) ≫ Godement.face (polynomialComonad.{u, v} A).ε 0 0 ≫ eqToHom hX.symm)
    (a : X.left ⋙ (Functor.whiskeringRight (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A) (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A)
        (Type (max u v))).obj (forget (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A)) ⟶
      (Functor.const SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ).obj (X.right ⋙ forget (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A)))
    (ha : ∀ n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ,
      a.app n = Functor.whiskerRight (X.hom.app n) (forget (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A)))
    (b : X.left ⋙ (Functor.whiskeringLeft (Type (max u v)) (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A)
        (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A)).obj (free.{u, v} A) ⟶
      (Functor.const SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ).obj (free.{u, v} A ⋙ X.right))
    (hb : ∀ n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ, b.app n = Functor.whiskerLeft (free.{u, v} A) (X.hom.app n))
    (ρ : ∀ n : ℕ, forget (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A) ⟶
      (polynomialComonad.{u, v} A).toFunctor.iterate (n + 1) ⋙ forget (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A))
    (hρ₀ : ∀ (B : CommAlgCat.{max u v} A) (x : B),
      (ρ 0).app B x = (MvPolynomial.X x : MvPolynomial B A))
    (hρ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (B : CommAlgCat.{max u v} A) (x : B),
      (ρ (n + 1)).app B x = (MvPolynomial.X ((ρ n).app B x) :
        MvPolynomial (((polynomialComonad.{u, v} A).toFunctor.iterate (n + 1)).obj B) A))
    (τ : ∀ n : ℕ, free.{u, v} A ⟶
      free.{u, v} A ⋙ (polynomialComonad.{u, v} A).toFunctor.iterate (n + 1))
    (hτ₀ : ∀ (E : Type (max u v)) (e : E),
      ((τ 0).app E).hom (MvPolynomial.X e) =
        (MvPolynomial.X (MvPolynomial.X e : MvPolynomial E A) :
          MvPolynomial (MvPolynomial E A) A))
    (hτ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Type (max u v)) (e : E),
      ((τ (n + 1)).app E).hom (MvPolynomial.X e) =
        (MvPolynomial.X (((τ n).app E).hom (MvPolynomial.X e)) : MvPolynomial
          (((polynomialComonad.{u, v} A).toFunctor.iterate (n + 1)).obj
            ((free.{u, v} A).obj E)) A)) :
    (∃ r : (Functor.const SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ).obj (X.right ⋙ forget (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A)) ⟶
        X.left ⋙ (Functor.whiskeringRight (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A) (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A)
          (Type (max u v))).obj (forget (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A)),
      (∀ n : ℕ, r.app (op ⦋n⦌) =
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun F => F ⋙ forget (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A)) hX) ≫ ρ n ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg (fun F => F ⋙ forget (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A)) (h n)).symm) ∧
      Relation.EqvGen (fun f g => Nonempty (SimplicialObject.Homotopy f g)) (a ≫ r) (𝟙 _) ∧
      Relation.EqvGen (fun f g => Nonempty (SimplicialObject.Homotopy f g)) (r ≫ a) (𝟙 _)) ∧
    (∃ r : (Functor.const SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ).obj (free.{u, v} A ⋙ X.right) ⟶
        X.left ⋙ (Functor.whiskeringLeft (Type (max u v)) (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A)
          (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A)).obj (free.{u, v} A),
      (∀ n : ℕ, r.app (op ⦋n⦌) =
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun F => free.{u, v} A ⋙ F) hX) ≫ τ n ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg (fun F => free.{u, v} A ⋙ F) (h n)).symm) ∧
      Relation.EqvGen (fun f g => Nonempty (SimplicialObject.Homotopy f g)) (b ≫ r) (𝟙 _) ∧
      Relation.EqvGen (fun f g => Nonempty (SimplicialObject.Homotopy f g)) (r ≫ b) (𝟙 _))
declarations.comment:
both claims, for the polynomial-algebra adjunction on commutative algebras, with
the degree-`n` inverses `b ↦ [⋯[b]⋯]` and `[e] ↦ [⋯[e]⋯]`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.IsFibered.exists_amelioration
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 4.33.14 / 08NF.** Let `F : X ⥤ Y` be a 1-morphism of fibred categories over
`C`, with structure functors `p : X ⥤ C` and `q : Y ⥤ C`. Then there exist a fibred
category `(X', p'')` over `C` and three 1-morphisms of fibred categories over `C`

  `u : X ⥤ X'`, `v : X' ⥤ Y`, `w : X' ⥤ X`,

with `F = u ⋙ v` such that
1. `u` is fully faithful;
2. `w` is left adjoint to `u`; and
3. `v` exhibits `X'` as a fibred category over `Y` (`v.IsFibered`), the structure functor of
   `X'` over `C` factoring as `p'' = v ⋙ q`.

The witness category `X'` is stated in the universe `max u₁ u₂ u₃ v₁ v₂ v₃` so as to
accommodate the explicit construction, in which an object carries a morphism of `Y` (living
in the hom universe `v₃`). It is the amelioration `Amelioration p q F hFq` of `F`, moved
into that universe by `exists_amelioration_uliftHom`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Functor.IsFibered.exists_amelioration
    {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C]
    {X : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} X]
    {Y : Type u₃} [Category.{v₃} Y]
    (p : X ⥤ C) (q : Y ⥤ C) [p.IsFibered] [q.IsFibered]
    (F : X ⥤ Y) (hF : Functor.IsFibredOneMorphism p q F) :
    ∃ (X' : Type (max u₁ u₂ u₃ v₁ v₂ v₃)) (_ : Category.{max v₁ v₂ v₃} X')
      (p'' : X' ⥤ C) (_ : p''.IsFibered)
      (u : X ⥤ X') (v : X' ⥤ Y) (w : X' ⥤ X),
        -- the three functors are 1-morphisms of fibred categories over C
        Functor.IsFibredOneMorphism p p'' u ∧
        Functor.IsFibredOneMorphism p'' q v ∧
        Functor.IsFibredOneMorphism p'' p w ∧
        -- F factors as u ⋙ v
        F = u ⋙ v ∧
        -- the structure functor of X' over C factors through Y as p'' = v ⋙ q
        p'' = v ⋙ q ∧
        -- (1) u is fully faithful
        Nonempty u.FullyFaithful ∧
        -- (2) w is left adjoint to u
        Nonempty (w ⊣ u) ∧
        -- (3) v exhibits X' as a fibred category over Y
        v.IsFibered

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.nonempty_adjunction_preservesFiniteLimits_isRightAdjoint_and_iso_sheafPushforwardCocontinuous
declarations.statement:
public theorem
  nonempty_adjunction_preservesFiniteLimits_isRightAdjoint_and_iso_sheafPushforwardCocontinuous
    {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D] (A : Type u₃) [Category.{v₃} A]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (K : GrothendieckTopology D) {G : C ⥤ D} {W : D ⥤ C} (adj : W ⊣ G)
    [G.IsContinuous J K] [HasWeakSheafify K A] :
    -- (1)(a) `g_!` is the sheafification of `w^p`
    Nonempty
        (sheafToPresheaf J A ⋙ (Functor.whiskeringLeft Dᵒᵖ Cᵒᵖ A).obj W.op ⋙ presheafToSheaf K A ⊣
          G.sheafPushforwardContinuous A J K) ∧
      -- (1)(b) `g_!` is exact
      (∀ [HasFiniteLimits A] [PreservesFiniteLimits (presheafToSheaf K A)],
        PreservesFiniteLimits
          (sheafToPresheaf J A ⋙
            (Functor.whiskeringLeft Dᵒᵖ Cᵒᵖ A).obj W.op ⋙ presheafToSheaf K A)) ∧
      -- (2) if `w` is continuous, then `g_!` has a left adjoint
      (∀ [W.IsContinuous K J] [HasWeakSheafify J A] [∀ F : Dᵒᵖ ⥤ A, W.op.HasLeftKanExtension F],
        (sheafToPresheaf J A ⋙
            (Functor.whiskeringLeft Dᵒᵖ Cᵒᵖ A).obj W.op ⋙ presheafToSheaf K A).IsRightAdjoint) ∧
      -- (3) if `w` is cocontinuous, then `g⁻¹ = h_*`
      (∀ [W.IsCocontinuous K J] [∀ F : Dᵒᵖ ⥤ A, W.op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension F],
        Nonempty (G.sheafPushforwardContinuous A J K ≅ W.sheafPushforwardCocontinuous A K J))
declarations.comment: Lower shriek of a continuous functor which has a left adjoint.

declarations.name: RingFibreProduct.finiteType_of_pullback_pi
declarations.doc:
Stacks Tag 08NI: in a cartesian square formed from finite products of surjective maps of
finite type algebras over a Noetherian ring, the lower right corner is of finite type.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finiteType_of_pullback_pi
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {I : Type*} [Finite I]
    {A B : I → Type*}
    [∀ i, CommRing (A i)] [∀ i, CommRing (B i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra R (A i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (B i)]
    {Q : Type*} [CommRing Q] [Algebra R Q]
    {P : Type*} [CommRing P] [Algebra R P]
    (φ : ∀ i, A i →ₐ[R] B i) (ψ : ∀ i, Q →ₐ[R] B i)
    (toA : P →ₐ[R] ∀ i, A i) (toQ : P →ₐ[R] Q)
    (e : P ≃ₐ[R]
      AlgHom.pullback
        (AlgHom.pi (fun i ↦ (φ i).comp (Pi.evalAlgHom R A i)))
        (AlgHom.pi ψ))
    (_he : ∀ p, (e p : (∀ i, A i) × Q) = (toA p, toQ p))
    (hφ : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (φ i))
    (hψ : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (ψ i))
    (hA : ∀ i, Algebra.FiniteType R (A i))
    (_hB : ∀ i, Algebra.FiniteType R (B i))
    (hQ : Algebra.FiniteType R Q) :
    Algebra.FiniteType R P

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Over.preservesPointwiseRightKanExtensions_forget_inclusion_succ_op
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08NJ**.
For a category `C` and an object `X : C`, the forgetful functor `Over.forget X : C/X ⥤ C` commutes
with the coskeleton functors `cosk_m` for `m ≥ 1`: it carries a pointwise right Kan extension along
`(Δ_{≤m} ⊆ Δ)ᵒᵖ` of an `m`-truncated simplicial object of `C/X`, with its structure map, to one of
the underlying `m`-truncated simplicial object of `C`. Hence `cosk_m U` computed in `C/X` is
computed in `C`, the comparison being the whiskering of the structure map.
declarations.comment: stated as preservation of the pointwise right Kan extensions along `(Δ_{≤m} ⊆ Δ)ᵒᵖ`, which is what "cosk_m computed in C/X is computed in C" says with the comparison map pinned; the source's finite limits in `C` are not needed

declarations.name: SSet.trivialKanFibrations
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08NL**.
The class of *trivial Kan fibrations*: the morphisms `f : X ⟶ Y` of simplicial sets having the
right lifting property with respect to every boundary inclusion `∂Δ[n].ι : ∂Δ[n] ⟶ Δ[n]`, that
is, such that `X₀ → Y₀` is surjective and, for `n ≥ 1`, every commutative square with
`∂Δ[n] ⟶ X` on top and `Δ[n] ⟶ Y` at the bottom has a diagonal filler `Δ[n] ⟶ X`.
declarations.statement: public def trivialKanFibrations : MorphismProperty SSet.{u}
declarations.comment: the two clauses `X₀ → Y₀` surjective and lifting for `n ≥ 1` are the single right lifting property against all boundary inclusions, the case `n = 0` being the surjectivity since `∂Δ[0] = ⊥`

declarations.name: SSet.trivialKanFibrations_eq_rlp_monomorphisms
declarations.doc:
**A trivial Kan fibration lifts against any degreewise injective map.** For a trivial Kan
fibration `f : X ⟶ Y` of simplicial sets, every solid commutative square

```
Z --b--> X
|        |
v        v
W --a--> Y
```

with `Z ⟶ W` a monomorphism, i.e. injective in every degree, admits a diagonal `W ⟶ X`
making both triangles commute; conversely such a morphism `f` is a trivial Kan fibration,
the boundary inclusions being monomorphisms. Equivalently, the trivial Kan fibrations are
precisely the right lifting class of the monomorphisms of simplicial sets.
declarations.statement:
public theorem trivialKanFibrations_eq_rlp_monomorphisms :
    trivialKanFibrations.{u} = (monomorphisms SSet.{u}).rlp
declarations.comment: stated as the equality of morphism properties; the source's containment `≤` is the content, the reverse being `antitone_rlp` on `I_le_monomorphisms`, and "`Z → W` termwise injective" is `monomorphisms SSet`

declarations.name: SSet.trivialKanFibrations_isStableUnderBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08NN**.
Trivial Kan fibrations are stable under arbitrary base change. This is the general base-change
closure of a right lifting class, applied to the boundary-inclusion definition above.
declarations.statement:
public instance trivialKanFibrations_isStableUnderBaseChange :
    trivialKanFibrations.{u}.IsStableUnderBaseChange

declarations.name: SSet.trivialKanFibrations_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08NP**.
The composition of two trivial Kan fibrations is a trivial Kan fibration.

declarations.name: SSet.trivialKanFibrations_limit_π_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08NQ**.
Let `⋯ → U² → U¹ → U⁰` be a tower of simplicial sets, encoded as a functor `F : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ SSet`, and
let `U = limₜ Uᵗ` be its levelwise inverse limit. If every transition map `Uᵗ⁺¹ ⟶ Uᵗ` is a trivial
Kan fibration, then the projection `π⁰ : U ⟶ U⁰` is a trivial Kan fibration.

declarations.name: SSet.isStableUnderProductsOfShape_trivialKanFibrations
declarations.doc:
**A product of trivial Kan fibrations is a trivial Kan fibration.** If `f i : X i ⟶ Y i` is
a family of trivial Kan fibrations of simplicial sets, that is, of morphisms having the right
lifting property with respect to every boundary inclusion `∂Δ[n].ι`, then so is the induced
morphism `∏ X i ⟶ ∏ Y i` between any products of the `X i` and of the `Y i`.
declarations.statement:
public instance isStableUnderProductsOfShape_trivialKanFibrations (J : Type w) :
    trivialKanFibrations.{u}.IsStableUnderProductsOfShape J
declarations.comment: stability under products is stated for arbitrary product cones, as `IsStableUnderProductsOfShape` for the class of Tag 08NL; the source's `∏ X_i → ∏ Y_i` is the case of `Limits.Pi.map`, and the index type is in an arbitrary universe where the source says "a set"

declarations.name: SSet.trivialKanFibrations_isHomotopyEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08NS**.
A trivial Kan fibration `f : X ⟶ Y` of simplicial sets — one with the right lifting property
against every boundary inclusion `∂Δ[n] ↪ Δ[n]` — is a homotopy equivalence: there is a
`g : Y ⟶ X` with `f ≫ g` homotopic to `𝟙 X` and `g ≫ f` homotopic to `𝟙 Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem trivialKanFibrations_isHomotopyEquiv
    {X Y : SSet.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : trivialKanFibrations f) :
    ∃ g : Y ⟶ X,
      Nonempty (Homotopy (f ≫ g) (𝟙 X)) ∧
      Nonempty (Homotopy (g ≫ f) (𝟙 Y))

registrations.name: SSet.modelCategoryQuillen.fibration_iff
registrations.comment: Kan fibration: right lifting property against the horn inclusions `J`

registrations.name: SSet.modelCategoryQuillen.J
registrations.comment: Kan fibration: `J`, the horn inclusions `Λ[n+1, i] ⟶ Δ[n+1]`

registrations.name: SSet.KanComplex
registrations.comment: Kan complex: `S ⟶ ⊤_ SSet` is a Kan fibration

declarations.name: SSet.modelCategoryQuillen.isStableUnderBaseChange_fibrations
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08NV**.
Kan fibrations of simplicial sets are stable under arbitrary base change. Under
`fibrations_eq`, they are a right lifting class, and every right lifting class has this closure
property.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isStableUnderBaseChange_fibrations :
    (fibrations SSet.{u}).IsStableUnderBaseChange

declarations.name: SSet.hasLiftingProperty_horn_ι_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08NW**.
The composition of two Kan fibrations is a Kan fibration: if `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` are
morphisms of simplicial sets each having the right lifting property with respect to all horn
inclusions, then so does `f ≫ g`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem hasLiftingProperty_horn_ι_comp {X Y Z : SSet.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z}
    (hf : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 2)), HasLiftingProperty Λ[n + 1, i].ι f)
    (hg : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 2)), HasLiftingProperty Λ[n + 1, i].ι g) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 2)), HasLiftingProperty Λ[n + 1, i].ι (f ≫ g)
declarations.comment: the source's lifting condition, one horn inclusion `Λ[n + 1, i].ι` of Tag 08NU at a time; the same statement for the bundled predicate `HomotopicalAlgebra.Fibration` of the Quillen model structure on `SSet` is upstream's multiplicativity of `fibrations SSet`

declarations.name: SSet.fibration_limit_π_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08NX**.
Let `F : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ SSet` be a tower `⋯ → U² → U¹ → U⁰` of simplicial sets each of whose transition
morphisms `Uᵗ⁺¹ ⟶ Uᵗ` is a Kan fibration. Then the canonical projection
`limit F ⟶ U⁰ = F.obj (op 0)` from the inverse limit to the bottom term is a Kan fibration.
declarations.statement:
theorem fibration_limit_π_zero (F : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ SSet)
    (hF : ∀ t : ℕ, Fibration (F.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ t)).op)) :
    Fibration (limit.π F (Opposite.op 0))
declarations.comment: Kan fibrations are Mathlib's fibrations for the Quillen model structure on `SSet`, whose generating family `J` is the horn inclusions of Tag 08NU

declarations.name: SSet.modelCategoryQuillen.isStableUnderProductsOfShape_fibrations
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08NY**.
A product of Kan fibrations is a Kan fibration: if `f i : X i ⟶ Y i` is a family of morphisms of
simplicial sets each having the right lifting property with respect to all horn inclusions, then so
does the induced morphism `∏ X i ⟶ ∏ Y i` between any products of the `X i` and the `Y i`.
declarations.statement:
public instance isStableUnderProductsOfShape_fibrations (J : Type w) :
    (fibrations SSet.{u}).IsStableUnderProductsOfShape J
declarations.comment: Kan fibrations are Mathlib's fibrations for the Quillen model structure on `SSet`, whose generating family `J` is the horn inclusions of Tag 08NU; stability under products is stated for arbitrary product cones, the source's `∏ X_i → ∏ Y_i` being the case of `Limits.Pi.map`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialObject.kanComplex_forget
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08NZ**.
Let `X` be a simplicial group. Then the underlying simplicial set of `X` is a Kan complex.
declarations.statement:
theorem kanComplex_forget (X : SimplicialObject GrpCat.{u}) :
    KanComplex (X ⋙ forget GrpCat)
declarations.comment: a simplicial group is Mathlib's `SimplicialObject GrpCat`, and its underlying simplicial set is `X ⋙ forget GrpCat`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialObject.fibration_whiskerRight_forget_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08P0**.
A termwise surjective homomorphism of simplicial groups is a Kan fibration: if `f : X ⟶ Y` is a
morphism of simplicial groups such that `X_n → Y_n` is surjective for every `n`, then the induced
morphism of underlying simplicial sets has the right lifting property with respect to all horn
inclusions.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fibration_whiskerRight_forget_of_surjective
    {X Y : SimplicialObject AddGrpCat.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : ∀ n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ, Function.Surjective (f.app n).hom) :
    Fibration (Functor.whiskerRight f (forget AddGrpCat.{u}))
declarations.comment: stated for simplicial groups written additively, commutativity being unused by the source's argument (which reduces to Tag 08NZ, a statement about simplicial groups); the source's simplicial abelian groups are the case of `Functor.whiskerRight f (forget₂ AddCommGrpCat AddGrpCat)`, whose conclusion is the same term by `rfl`. Kan fibrations are Mathlib's fibrations for the Quillen model structure on `SSet`, whose generating family `J` is the horn inclusions of Tag 08NU

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialObject.trivialKanFibrations_whiskerRight_forget_of_surjective_of_quasiIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08P1**.
If `f : X ⟶ Y` is a
morphism of simplicial abelian groups such that `X_n → Y_n` is surjective for every `n` and such
that `s(X) → s(Y)` is a quasi-isomorphism of associated chain complexes, then the induced
morphism of underlying simplicial sets has the right lifting property with respect to all boundary
inclusions `∂Δ[n].ι : ∂Δ[n] ⟶ Δ[n]`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem trivialKanFibrations_whiskerRight_forget_of_surjective_of_quasiIso
    {X Y : SimplicialObject AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : ∀ n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ, Function.Surjective (f.app n).hom)
    [QuasiIso ((alternatingFaceMapComplex AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map f)] :
    SSet.trivialKanFibrations (Functor.whiskerRight f (forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}))
declarations.comment: trivial Kan fibrations are the class `SSet.trivialKanFibrations` of Tag 08NL, the right lifting class of the boundary inclusions, the source's surjectivity of `X₀ → Y₀` being its case `n = 0`; the associated chain complex is `s`, Mathlib's `alternatingFaceMapComplex`, the hypothesis being equivalent to the one for the normalized complex `N` by Tag 019C

declarations.name: AlgebraicTopology.quasiIso_alternatingFaceMapComplex_map_of_homotopyEquivalences_forget
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08P2**.
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of simplicial
abelian groups whose underlying morphism of simplicial sets `X ⋙ forget ⟶ Y ⋙ forget` is a
homotopy equivalence, i.e. admits a morphism of simplicial sets back whose two composites with
it are homotopic to the identities ([Stacks, Tag 019N]). Then the induced morphism
`s(X) ⟶ s(Y)` of Moore complexes is a quasi-isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem quasiIso_alternatingFaceMapComplex_map_of_homotopyEquivalences_forget
    {X Y : SimplicialObject AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : SimplicialObject.homotopyEquivalences (Type u)
      (Functor.whiskerRight f (forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}))) :
    QuasiIso ((alternatingFaceMapComplex AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map f)
declarations.comment: the homotopy equivalence is asked of the underlying simplicial sets, `SimplicialObject.homotopyEquivalences (Type u)` (Tag 019N at `C = Type u`) applied to `Functor.whiskerRight f (forget AddCommGrpCat)`; the associated chain complex is `s`, Mathlib's `alternatingFaceMapComplex`, so that the conclusion is verbatim the hypothesis of 08P1, the version for the normalized complex `N` being equivalent to it by Tag 019C

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.LowerShriek.lowerShriek_comp_forget_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08P3 (1), compatibility with underlying sheaves.** When `G` has a left adjoint,
lower shriek on abelian sheaves agrees naturally, on underlying sheaves of sets, with lower
shriek on sheaves of sets.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def lowerShriek_comp_forget_iso [G.IsRightAdjoint] :
    Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback G AddCommGrpCat.{max u₂ v₂} J K ⋙
          sheafCompose K (forget AddCommGrpCat.{max u₂ v₂}) ≅
        sheafCompose J (forget AddCommGrpCat.{max u₂ v₂}) ⋙
        Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback G (Type (max u₂ v₂)) J K
declarations.comment: part (1), compatibility with underlying sheaves of sets

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.LowerShriek.lowerShriek_iso_sheafPullbackCocontinuous
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08P3 (2), the lower shriek.** If the left adjoint `W` is cocontinuous, lower
shriek along `G` is naturally isomorphic to the inverse-image functor associated to `W`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def lowerShriek_iso_sheafPullbackCocontinuous [G.IsRightAdjoint]
    [W.IsCocontinuous K J] (adj : W ⊣ G) :
    Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback G AddCommGrpCat.{max u₂ v₂} J K ≅
      W.sheafPullbackCocontinuous AddCommGrpCat.{max u₂ v₂} K J
declarations.comment: part (2), lower shriek equals inverse image

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.LowerShriek.sheafPushforwardContinuous_iso_sheafPushforwardCocontinuous
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08P3 (2), the inverse image.** If the left adjoint `W` is cocontinuous, inverse
image along `G` is naturally isomorphic to the direct-image functor associated to `W`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def sheafPushforwardContinuous_iso_sheafPushforwardCocontinuous [W.IsLeftAdjoint]
    [W.IsCocontinuous K J] (adj : W ⊣ G) :
    G.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{max u₂ v₂} J K ≅
      W.sheafPushforwardCocontinuous AddCommGrpCat.{max u₂ v₂} K J
declarations.comment: part (2), inverse image equals direct image

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.LowerShriek.lowerShriek_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08P3 (1), exactness.** The lower-shriek functor on abelian sheaves associated to
`G` is exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem lowerShriek_exact [G.IsRightAdjoint] :
    exactFunctor (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{max u₂ v₂}) (Sheaf K AddCommGrpCat.{max u₂ v₂})
      (Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback G AddCommGrpCat.{max u₂ v₂} J K)
declarations.comment: part (1), exactness

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.ExtensionByZero.extensionByZeroCompToSheafIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08P4.** Extension by zero commutes with forgetting the module structure: the
square formed by extension by zero for modules, extension by zero for abelian sheaves and the
two forgetful functors commutes up to natural isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def extensionByZeroCompToSheafIso :
    SheafOfModules.pullback.{u}
        (F := Over.forget U) (S := R.over U) (R := R)
        (𝟙 (R.over U)) ⋙ SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} R ≅
      SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} (R.over U) ⋙
        Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
          (Over.forget U) AddCommGrpCat.{u} (J.over U) J

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.FibredCategorySituation.totalRingedTopos
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08P8, the inverse-image structure sheaf.** The total ringed topos, with

declarations.statement: def totalRingedTopos : RingedTopos.{vC, uC, max w uD vD uC vC}

declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08P8, the morphism of ringed topoi.** The projection as a morphism of ringed

declarations.doc:
A ringed site `(D, O_D)` together with a fibred category `p : C ⥤ D` over its underlying

declarations.statement: structure FibredCategorySituation
declarations.comment: standing data

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.FibredCategorySituation.inducedProjection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08P8, the associated morphism of topoi.** The morphism of topoi
`π : Sh(C) ⟶ Sh(D)` canonically associated to the fibred projection: its inverse image is
restriction along `p.op`, which is left exact because restriction is computed on underlying
presheaves, where it is precomposition.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def inducedProjection : ProjectionData s
declarations.comment: associated morphism of topoi

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.FibredCategorySituation.commRingRingedProjection
declarations.doc:
The projection of a fibred category as a morphism of ringed topoi; its structure map is the
unit of the adjunction `π⁻¹ ⊣ π_*` on sheaves of commutative rings.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def commRingRingedProjection :
    AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom s.totalRingedTopos s.baseRingedTopos
declarations.comment: morphism of ringed topoi

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.localizedProjectionSection
declarations.doc: The canonical localized projection has a section whose inverse image is its direct image.
declarations.statement: public noncomputable def localizedProjectionSection : LocalizedProjectionSection s U

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.MorphismSituation.ringedToposDiagram
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PA.** The canonical commutative triangle of ringed topoi associated to a
1-morphism of fibred categories over a ringed site: the three morphisms of topoi of Stacks 06NW,
each pinned by the identification of its inverse image with restriction and of its direct image
with the right Kan extension, the morphism of ringed topoi `g` whose inverse-image structure map
is the identification `g⁻¹O_C ≅ O_{C'}`, and the 2-isomorphism `π_* ∘ g_* ≅ (π')_*` exhibited as
the mate of the comparison of inverse images.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def ringedToposDiagram : S.RingedToposDiagram
declarations.comment: canonical commutative triangle of ringed topoi

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.MorphismSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PA, standing data.** A ringed site `(D, O_D)`, two fibred categories over its
underlying site, and a 1-morphism of fibred categories between them.
declarations.statement: structure MorphismSituation.{a₀, a₁, a₂, b₀, b₁, b₂, c}
declarations.comment: standing data

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.MorphismSituation.compatibleLocalizedSection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PB.** The localized projections of a 1-morphism of fibred categories admit a
common section: a morphism of topoi `σ' : Sh(D/V) ⟶ Sh(C'/U')` with `π'_{U'} ∘ σ' = id` and
`(σ')^{-1} = π'_{U',*}`, whose composite `σ = g' ∘ σ'` satisfies `π_U ∘ σ = id` and
`σ^{-1} = π_{U,*}`.
declarations.statement: def compatibleLocalizedSection : CompatibleLocalizedSection S U'

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.MorphismSituation.abelianInverseImage_isRightAdjoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PC, part (1) for abelian sheaves.** The inverse image of abelian sheaves along `g`
admits a left adjoint `g_!^{Ab}`. The left adjoint is the sheafification of the left Kan extension
along `u.op`, so the only hypothesis is that abelian groups can be sheafified on the target
site.
declarations.statement:
instance abelianInverseImage_isRightAdjoint
    [HasWeakSheafify S.totalTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max w u₀ u₁ u₂ v₀ v₁ v₂}] :
    S.abelianInverseImage.IsRightAdjoint
declarations.comment: part (1), abelian sheaves

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.MorphismSituation.isIso_derivedModuleLowerShriekForgetComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PC, part (4).** In Situation 08PA the canonical comparison of Stacks 07AE

`Lg_!^{Ab} ∘ forget ⟶ forget ∘ Lg_!`

of functors `D(O_{C'}) ⥤ D(C)` (`derivedModuleLowerShriekForgetComparison`) is an isomorphism:
the derived lower shriek on sheaves of modules commutes with forgetting the module structure.

`Lg_!^{Ab} ∘ forget` is a left derived functor of `g_!^{Ab} ∘ forget` on the homotopy category
of `Mod(O_{C'})` (`isLeftDerivedFunctor_derivedForgetAbelianLowerShriek`), hence of
`forget ∘ g_!`, the degreewise comparison being invertible by part (2)
(`isIso_moduleLowerShriekForgetComparison`); and the lift of a comparison between two left derived
functors of the same functor is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedModuleLowerShriekForgetComparison :
    IsIso S.derivedModuleLowerShriekForgetComparison
declarations.comment: part (4): the canonical comparison `Lg_!^{Ab} ∘ forget ⟶ forget ∘ Lg_!` is an isomorphism

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.MorphismSituation.moduleDiagramInverseImage_isRightAdjoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PC, part (1) for sheaves of modules.** The inverse image of sheaves of modules
along the `g` of a commutative triangle of ringed topoi over the situation admits a left adjoint
`g_!`. The inverse image is the one of Stacks 03D2 followed by extension of scalars along `g♯`;
the first factor is a right adjoint because `g⁻¹` is restriction along the continuous functor
`u`, and the second because `g♯` is an isomorphism, which the triangle records.
declarations.statement:
instance moduleDiagramInverseImage_isRightAdjoint (D : S.RingedToposDiagram) :
    (D.gRinged.toModulesHom.pullbackModules).IsRightAdjoint
declarations.comment: part (1), modules

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.MorphismSituation.moduleDiagramInverseImage_isRightAdjointUnconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PC, part (1), for sheaves of modules, with no sheafification hypothesis.** The
inverse image `g^*` of sheaves of modules along the `g` of any commutative triangle of ringed
topoi over Situation 08PA has a left adjoint `g_!`. This is
`MorphismSituation.moduleDiagramInverseImage_isRightAdjoint` with its sheafification hypotheses
discharged: at the situation's universe of sections both inherited sites are essentially
small.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleDiagramInverseImage_isRightAdjointUnconditional (D : S.RingedToposDiagram) :
    (D.gRinged.toModulesHom.pullbackModules).IsRightAdjoint
declarations.comment: part (1), modules: `g^*` has a left adjoint `g_!`

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.MorphismSituation.abelianInverseImage_isRightAdjointUnconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PC, part (1), for abelian sheaves, with no sheafification hypothesis.** The
inverse image `g^{-1}` of abelian sheaves has a left adjoint `g_!^{Ab}`. This is
`MorphismSituation.abelianInverseImage_isRightAdjoint` with its sheafification hypothesis
discharged.
declarations.statement:
theorem abelianInverseImage_isRightAdjointUnconditional :
    S.abelianInverseImage.IsRightAdjoint
declarations.comment: part (1), abelian sheaves: `g^{-1}` has a left adjoint `g_!^{Ab}`

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.MorphismSituation.isIso_moduleLowerShriekForgetComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PC, part (2).** In Situation 08PA the canonical comparison of Stacks 0798

`g_!^{Ab} ∘ forget ⟶ forget ∘ g_!`

(`MorphismSituation.moduleLowerShriekForgetComparison`, the transformation adjoint to the
forgotten unit of `g_! ⊣ g^*`, for the structure sheaf `O_{C'} = (π')^{-1} O_D` of the
situation) is an isomorphism: lower shriek on sheaves of modules commutes with forgetting the
module structure.

The comparison is an isomorphism for the structure sheaf `u⁻¹O_C` of `C'`
(`isIso_lowerShriekForgetComparison_structureMap`, which is where Stacks 08PB enters), and the
structure sheaf of Situation 08PA is isomorphic to it through the structure map
`MorphismSituation.moduleStructureMap`, built from the invertible `g♯`; the comparison along an
isomorphic structure map is the same comparison up to restriction of scalars
(`Stacks.SheafOfModules.isIso_lowerShriekForgetComparison_of_restrictScalars`).
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_moduleLowerShriekForgetComparison :
    IsIso S.moduleLowerShriekForgetComparison
declarations.comment: part (2): the canonical comparison `g_!^{Ab} ∘ forget ⟶ forget ∘ g_!` is an isomorphism

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.MorphismSituation.derivedAbelianLowerShriekAdjunctionUnconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PC part (3) for abelian sheaves, the adjunction.** The unbounded left derived
lower-shriek functor `Lg_!^{Ab} : D(Ab(C')) ⥤ D(Ab(C))` is left adjoint to `g^{-1}` on the
unbounded derived categories. This is `MorphismSituation.derivedAbelianLowerShriekAdjunction`
with its acyclicity input supplied by `abelianLowerShriekAcyclic`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedAbelianLowerShriekAdjunctionUnconditional :
    S.derivedAbelianLowerShriek ⊣ S.derivedAbelianInverseImage
declarations.comment: part (3), abelian sheaves: the adjunction Lg_!^Ab ⊣ g^-1

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.MorphismSituation.hasPointwiseLeftDerivedModuleLowerShriekUnconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PC part (3) for sheaves of modules, existence.** Degreewise `g_!`, followed by the
localization of the homotopy category of `Mod(O_C)`, has a pointwise left derived functor along
the localization of the homotopy category of `Mod(O_{C'})`; that is, `Lg_! : D(O_{C'}) ⥤ D(O_C)`
exists. This is `MorphismSituation.hasPointwiseLeftDerivedModuleLowerShriek` with the acyclicity
statement of Stacks 07AC supplied by `moduleLowerShriekAcyclic`.
declarations.statement:
instance hasPointwiseLeftDerivedModuleLowerShriekUnconditional :
    (S.moduleLowerShriekOnHomotopy ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh).HasPointwiseLeftDerivedFunctor
      S.moduleSourceQuasiIso
declarations.comment: part (3), modules: existence of `Lg_! : D(O_{C'}) ⥤ D(O_C)`

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.MorphismSituation.derivedModuleLowerShriekAdjunctionUnconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PC part (3) for sheaves of modules, the adjunction.** The unbounded left derived
lower-shriek functor `Lg_! : D(O_{C'}) ⥤ D(O_C)` is left adjoint to `g^* = g^{-1}` on the
unbounded derived categories. This is `MorphismSituation.derivedModuleLowerShriekAdjunction`
(Stacks 09T5) with the acyclicity statement of Stacks 07AC supplied by
`moduleLowerShriekAcyclic`; nothing beyond Situation 08PA is assumed.
declarations.statement:
def derivedModuleLowerShriekAdjunctionUnconditional :
    S.derivedModuleLowerShriek ⊣ S.derivedModuleInverseImage
declarations.comment: part (3), modules: the adjunction `Lg_! ⊣ g^*`

registrations.name: hasPointwiseLeftDerivedFunctor_abelianLowerShriekOnHomotopy
registrations.comment: part (3), abelian sheaves: existence of Lg_!^Ab

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.MorphismSituation.derivedAbelianLowerShriekCompIso'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PD, the identification `Lπ'_! = Lπ_! ∘ Lg_!`**, for every situation of
Stacks 08PA. The three derived lower-shriek functors are left adjoint to the three derived
restrictions, by Stacks 07AC at the three discharged acyclicity statements, and restriction to the
source fibred category is restriction to the target followed by restriction along the
1-morphism; so this is uniqueness of left adjoints applied to
`derivedAbelianInverseImageCompIso`.
declarations.comment: the identification Lπ'_! = Lπ_! ∘ Lg_!

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.MorphismSituation.canonicalDerivedLowerShriekMap'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PD, the canonical map**, for every situation of Stacks 08PA. Let `F` be an abelian
sheaf on `C`, let `F'` be an abelian sheaf on `C'` and let `t : F' ⟶ g⁻¹F` be a map of abelian
sheaves. The canonical map `Lπ'_!(F') ⟶ Lπ_!(F)` is the identification `Lπ'_! = Lπ_! ∘ Lg_!`
followed by `Lπ_!` applied to the composite of the comparison `Lg_!(F') ⟶ g_!F'` with the adjoint
`g_!F' ⟶ F` of `t`.
declarations.statement:
def canonicalDerivedLowerShriekMap'
    (F : Sheaf S.totalTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max w u₀ u₁ u₂ v₀ v₁ v₂})
    (F' : Sheaf S.sourceTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max w u₀ u₁ u₂ v₀ v₁ v₂})
    (t : F' ⟶ S.abelianInverseImage.obj F) :
    S.derivedSourceAbelianLowerShriek.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (Sheaf S.sourceTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max w u₀ u₁ u₂ v₀ v₁ v₂}) 0).obj F') ⟶
      S.derivedTotalAbelianLowerShriek.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (Sheaf S.totalTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max w u₀ u₁ u₂ v₀ v₁ v₂}) 0).obj F)
declarations.comment: canonical map

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.MorphismSituation.derivedAbelianLowerShriekCompIso
declarations.doc:
**The identification `Lπ'_! = Lπ_! ∘ Lg_!`**, the isomorphism of left adjoints induced by
`derivedAbelianInverseImageCompIso`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedAbelianLowerShriekCompIso (h : S.AbelianLowerShriekAcyclic)
    (hp : S.TotalAbelianLowerShriekAcyclic) (hp' : S.SourceAbelianLowerShriekAcyclic) :
    S.derivedAbelianLowerShriek ⋙ S.derivedTotalAbelianLowerShriek ≅
      S.derivedSourceAbelianLowerShriek
declarations.comment: the identification Lπ'_! = Lπ_! ∘ Lg_!

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.MorphismSituation.canonicalDerivedLowerShriekMap
declarations.doc:
**The canonical map.** Let `F` be an abelian sheaf on `C`, let `F'` be an abelian sheaf on `C'`
and let `t : F' ⟶ g⁻¹F` be a map of abelian sheaves. The canonical map `Lπ'_!(F') ⟶ Lπ_!(F)` is the
identification `Lπ'_! = Lπ_! ∘ Lg_!` followed by `Lπ_!` applied to the composite of the comparison
`Lg_!(F') ⟶ g_!F'` with the adjoint `g_!F' ⟶ F` of `t`.
declarations.statement:
def canonicalDerivedLowerShriekMap (h : S.AbelianLowerShriekAcyclic)
    (hp : S.TotalAbelianLowerShriekAcyclic) (hp' : S.SourceAbelianLowerShriekAcyclic)
    (F : Sheaf S.totalTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max w u₀ u₁ u₂ v₀ v₁ v₂})
    (F' : Sheaf S.sourceTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max w u₀ u₁ u₂ v₀ v₁ v₂})
    (t : F' ⟶ S.abelianInverseImage.obj F) :
    S.derivedSourceAbelianLowerShriek.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (Sheaf S.sourceTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max w u₀ u₁ u₂ v₀ v₁ v₂}) 0).obj F') ⟶
      S.derivedTotalAbelianLowerShriek.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (Sheaf S.totalTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max w u₀ u₁ u₂ v₀ v₁ v₂}) 0).obj F)
declarations.comment: canonical map

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.fiberwiseColimitFormula
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PE.** The lower shriek of an abelian sheaf along the projection of a fibred
category is the sheaf associated to the presheaf of fibrewise colimits, with restriction maps
induced by the chosen cartesian lifts.
declarations.statement:
def fiberwiseColimitFormula
    [HasWeakSheafify s.base.J AddCommGrpCat.{max w uD vD uC vC}] :
    FiberwiseColimitFormula s

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.categoryHomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PF.** The `n`th homology group of an abelian-group-valued presheaf on a small
category is the value of the `n`th left derived functor of `colim`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev categoryHomology {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    (F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}) (n : ℕ) : AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}
declarations.comment: homology_of_a_category

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.abelianLowerShriekColimitIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PF.** The established inverse image along the point, left adjoint to
restriction, is canonically the colimit functor.
declarations.comment: lower_shriek_colimit

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.abelianLowerShriekColimitIso_unit
declarations.doc: **Stacks 08PF.** The abelian comparison preserves the canonical unit.
declarations.statement:
theorem abelianLowerShriekColimitIso_unit
    (F : Sheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial C) AddCommGrpCat.{max w (u + 1) v}) :
    ((Functor.star C).sheafAdjunctionContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{max w (u + 1) v}
      (GrothendieckTopology.trivial C)
      (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 1}))).unit.app F ≫
      ((Functor.star C).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{max w (u + 1) v}
        (GrothendieckTopology.trivial C)
        (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 1}))).map
          ((abelianLowerShriekColimitIso.{w} C).hom.app F) =
    (abelianLowerShriekColimitAdjunction.{w} C).unit.app F
declarations.comment: lower_shriek_colimit

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.abelianLowerShriekColimit_evalIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PF.** At each object, the colimit presentation evaluated at the point is the
colimit of the underlying presheaf.
declarations.statement:
def abelianLowerShriekColimit_evalIso
    (F : Sheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial C) AddCommGrpCat.{max w (u + 1) v}) :
    ((abelianColimitLowerShriek.{w} C).obj F).obj.obj
      (op (Discrete.mk PUnit.unit)) ≅ colimit F.obj
declarations.comment: lower_shriek_colimit

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.abelianLowerShriekColimit_unit_cocone
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PF.** At each object, the unit of the colimit presentation is the canonical
map into the colimit of the underlying presheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem abelianLowerShriekColimit_unit_cocone
    (F : Sheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial C) AddCommGrpCat.{max w (u + 1) v}) (U : C) :
    ((abelianLowerShriekColimitAdjunction.{w} C).unit.app F).hom.app (op U) ≫
      (abelianLowerShriekColimit_evalIso.{w} C F).hom =
      colimit.ι F.obj (op U)
declarations.comment: lower_shriek_colimit

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.ModuleValued.moduleLowerShriekColimitIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PF.** The established lower shriek on module-valued sheaves is naturally the
colimit functor, rather than merely another left adjoint to point restriction.
declarations.statement:
def moduleLowerShriekColimitIso :
    (Functor.star s.C).sheafPullback (ModuleCat.{max w (u + 1) v} s.B)
      (GrothendieckTopology.trivial s.C)
      (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 1})) ≅
      moduleColimitLowerShriek s
declarations.comment: lower_shriek_colimit

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.ModuleValued.moduleLowerShriekColimitIso_unit
declarations.doc: **Stacks 08PF.** The module comparison preserves the canonical unit.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleLowerShriekColimitIso_unit
    (F : Sheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial s.C) (ModuleCat.{max w (u + 1) v} s.B)) :
    ((Functor.star s.C).sheafAdjunctionContinuous (ModuleCat.{max w (u + 1) v} s.B)
      (GrothendieckTopology.trivial s.C)
      (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 1}))).unit.app F ≫
      ((Functor.star s.C).sheafPushforwardContinuous (ModuleCat.{max w (u + 1) v} s.B)
        (GrothendieckTopology.trivial s.C)
        (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 1}))).map
          ((moduleLowerShriekColimitIso s).hom.app F) =
    (moduleLowerShriekColimitAdjunction s).unit.app F
declarations.comment: lower_shriek_colimit

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.ModuleValued.moduleLowerShriekColimit_evalIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PF.** At each object, the colimit presentation evaluated at the point is the
colimit of the underlying presheaf of modules.
declarations.statement:
def moduleLowerShriekColimit_evalIso
    (F : Sheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial s.C) (ModuleCat.{max w (u + 1) v} s.B)) :
    ((moduleColimitLowerShriek s).obj F).obj.obj
      (op (Discrete.mk PUnit.unit)) ≅ colimit F.obj
declarations.comment: lower_shriek_colimit

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.ModuleValued.moduleLowerShriekColimit_unit_cocone
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PF.** At each object, the unit of the colimit presentation is the canonical map
into the colimit of the underlying presheaf of modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleLowerShriekColimit_unit_cocone
    (F : Sheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial s.C) (ModuleCat.{max w (u + 1) v} s.B)) (U : s.C) :
    ((moduleLowerShriekColimitAdjunction s).unit.app F).hom.app (op U) ≫
      (moduleLowerShriekColimit_evalIso s F).hom =
      colimit.ι F.obj (op U)
declarations.comment: lower_shriek_colimit

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.pointFunctor_isContinuous
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PF, point morphism (continuity).** The unique functor to the one-object
category is continuous when both categories carry the chaotic topology.
declarations.statement:
instance pointFunctor_isContinuous (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] :
    (Functor.star C).IsContinuous
    (GrothendieckTopology.trivial C)
    (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 1}))
declarations.comment: point_morphism

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.pointFunctor_isCocontinuous
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PF, point morphism (cocontinuity).** The unique functor to the one-object
category is cocontinuous when both categories carry the chaotic topology.
declarations.statement:
instance pointFunctor_isCocontinuous (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] :
    (Functor.star C).IsCocontinuous
    (GrothendieckTopology.trivial C)
    (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 1}))
declarations.comment: point_morphism

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.pointMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PF, point morphism.** A category with the chaotic topology has a canonical
morphism from its sheaf topos to the point topos, induced by the unique functor to the
one-object category.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pointMorphism (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] :
    MorphismOfTopoi
      (Sheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial C) (Type (max w u v)))
      (Sheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 1}))
        (Type (max w u v)))
declarations.comment: point_morphism

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.pointMorphism_inverseImage
declarations.doc: The inverse image of the point morphism is restriction along the point functor.
declarations.statement:
theorem pointMorphism_inverseImage (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] :
    (pointMorphism C).inverseImage =
      (Functor.star C).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (max w u v))
        (GrothendieckTopology.trivial C)
        (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 1}))
declarations.comment: point_morphism

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.pointMorphism_pushforward
declarations.doc:
The direct image of the point morphism is the right Kan extension along the point
functor.
declarations.statement:
theorem pointMorphism_pushforward (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] :
    (pointMorphism C).pushforward =
      (Functor.star C).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous (Type (max w u v))
        (GrothendieckTopology.trivial C)
        (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 1}))
declarations.comment: point_morphism

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.pointMorphism_adjunction
declarations.doc:
The adjunction of the point morphism is the canonical adjunction between restriction
and the cocontinuous pushforward along the point functor.
declarations.statement:
theorem pointMorphism_adjunction (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] :
    (pointMorphism C).adj =
      (Functor.star C).sheafAdjunctionCocontinuous (Type (max w u v))
        (GrothendieckTopology.trivial C)
        (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 1}))
declarations.comment: point_morphism

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.pointFunctor_isFibered
declarations.doc:
The projection of any category to the one-object category is a fibred category: every
morphism of the base is an identity, and an identity lifts to an identity, which is strongly
cartesian because it is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
instance pointFunctor_isFibered (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] :
    (Functor.star C).IsFibered
declarations.comment: ringed_point

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.RingedPointSituation
declarations.doc: A category with its chaotic topology and a ring on the point.
declarations.statement: structure RingedPointSituation
declarations.comment: ringed_point

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.RingedPointSituation.fibredSituation
declarations.doc:

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.RingedPointSituation.topology_eq_trivial

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.categoryHomologyReplacementIso
declarations.doc:
The homology of the simplicial replacement complex of an abelian-group-valued presheaf
computes the left derived functors of the colimit, that is the homology groups `H_n(C, F)`: the
component at `F` of `Stacks.CategoryHomology.categoryHomologyReplacementNatIso`.
declarations.statement:
def categoryHomologyReplacementIso (F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}) (n : ℕ) :
    categoryHomology.{u, v} F n ≅ (simplicialReplacementComplex F).homology n
declarations.comment: derived_colimits

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.representableReplacementComplex_homology_isZero
declarations.doc:
The simplicial replacement complex of the extension by zero of the
constant integer sheaf from the slice site over `U` has vanishing homology in every positive
degree.
declarations.statement:
theorem representableReplacementComplex_homology_isZero (U : C) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    IsZero
      ((simplicialReplacementComplex
        ((sheafToPresheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial C) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (integerExtensionByZero U))).homology n)
declarations.comment: representable_acyclic

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.overSimplexEquiv
declarations.doc:
A string in the slice category is a string in `C` together with a map
from its right endpoint to `U`.
declarations.comment: representable_contractible

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.overSimplexEquiv_forget
declarations.doc: The simplex comparison preserves the underlying string of arrows.
declarations.statement:
theorem overSimplexEquiv_forget (n : ℕ)
    (a : Σ x : ComposableArrows C n, x.right ⟶ U) :
    overSimplexEquiv U n a ⋙ Over.forget U = a.1
declarations.comment: representable_contractible

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.overSimplexEquiv_last
declarations.doc: The last object of the compared simplex has the prescribed arrow to `U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem overSimplexEquiv_last (n : ℕ)
    (a : Σ x : ComposableArrows C n, x.right ⟶ U) :
    HEq ((overSimplexEquiv U n a).obj (Fin.last n)).hom a.2
declarations.comment: representable_contractible

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.integerExtensionByZero_iso_freeYoneda
declarations.doc:
On a chaotic site, extension by zero of the constant integer sheaf is the
free abelian presheaf represented by `U`.
declarations.statement:
def integerExtensionByZero_iso_freeYoneda :
    (sheafToPresheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial C) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        (integerExtensionByZero U) ≅
      ((yoneda.obj U) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)
declarations.comment: representable_contractible

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.representableReplacementComplexIsoFreeNerve
declarations.doc:
The simplicial replacement complex of the extension by zero of the constant integer sheaf is
isomorphic to the free abelian chain complex on the nerve of the category over `U`.
declarations.statement:
def representableReplacementComplexIsoFreeNerve :
    simplicialReplacementComplex
        ((sheafToPresheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial C) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (integerExtensionByZero U)) ≅
      (AlgebraicTopology.alternatingFaceMapComplex _).obj
        (((SimplicialObject.whiskering (Type u) AddCommGrpCat).obj
          AddCommGrpCat.free).obj (nerve (Over U)))
declarations.comment: representable_contractible

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.representableReplacementComplexIsoFreeNerve_generator
declarations.doc:
The chain-complex comparison takes the generator indexed by a string and
an arrow to `U` to the corresponding simplex of the slice category.
declarations.statement:
theorem representableReplacementComplexIsoFreeNerve_generator
    (n : ℕ) (x : ComposableArrows C n) (f : x.right ⟶ U) :
    (representableReplacementComplexIsoFreeNerve U).hom.f n
      ((@DirectSum.of (ComposableArrows C n)
        (fun y => ((sheafToPresheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial C)
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (integerExtensionByZero U)).obj (op y.right))
        _ (Classical.decEq _) x)
        (((integerExtensionByZero_iso_freeYoneda U).inv.app (op x.right))
          (FreeAbelianGroup.of f))) =
      FreeAbelianGroup.of (overSimplexEquiv U n ⟨x, f⟩)
declarations.comment: representable_contractible

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.nerveOver_homotopyEquivalent_point
declarations.doc:
The nerve of the category over `U`, the simplicial set of strings of arrows ending in an arrow
to `U`, is homotopy equivalent to a point.
declarations.statement:
theorem nerveOver_homotopyEquivalent_point :
    ∃ f : nerve (Over U) ⟶ (Functor.const SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ).obj PUnit.{u + 1},
      (SimplicialObject.homotopyEquivalences (Type u)) f
declarations.comment: representable_contractible

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.simplicialReplacementComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PG, the simplicial replacement complex.** The chain complex whose degree-`n`
term is `⊕_(Uₙ → ⋯ → U₀) F(U₀)` and whose differential is the alternating sum of the face
maps.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev simplicialReplacementComplex
    (F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v}) : ChainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{max u v} ℕ
declarations.comment: simplicial_replacement_complex

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.simplicialReplacementHomologyDeltaFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08PG (delta-functor).** Homology of the simplicial replacement,
with the natural connecting maps of degreewise short exact sequences, is a homological
delta-functor.  Its functor in degree `n` is exactly homology in degree `n`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def simplicialReplacementHomologyDeltaFunctor :
    { D : HomologicalDeltaFunctor
        (Sheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial C) AddCommGrpCat.{v})
        AddCommGrpCat.{max u v} //
      ∀ n, D.functor n = chaoticSheafReplacementComplexFunctor (C := C) ⋙
        HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{max u v} (ComplexShape.down ℕ) n }
declarations.comment: delta_functor

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.map_homologyFunctor_map_canonicalDerivedLowerShriekMap'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PH, the canonical maps on homology come from Remark 08PD.** Let `f : C' ⥤ C` be a
functor between small categories, give both categories their chaotic topologies and view them,
with `f`, as the situation of Stacks 08PA over the point (`functorSituation`). Let `F` be an
abelian presheaf on `C`, `F'` an abelian presheaf on `C'` and `t : F' ⟶ f⁻¹F`. Under the
identifications `H_n(C, F) = L_nπ_!F` and `H_n(C', F') = L_nπ'_!F'` (`totalHomologyIso` and
`sourceHomologyIso`: `H^{-n}` of the derived lower shriek to the point, read through the sections
over the point), the map `H^{-n}` of the canonical map `Lπ'_!F' ⟶ Lπ_!F` of Remark 08PD is the
canonical map `H_n(C', F') ⟶ H_n(C, F)` built from the chain map `K(F') ⟶ K(F)` on projective
resolutions (`categoryHomologyMap`).
declarations.statement:
theorem map_homologyFunctor_map_canonicalDerivedLowerShriekMap'
    (F : Sheaf (functorSituation.{w} C C' f B).totalTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max w u u'}) (F' :
        Sheaf (functorSituation.{w} C C' f B).sourceTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max w u u'})
    (t : F' ⟶ (functorSituation.{w} C C' f B).abelianInverseImage.obj F) (n : ℕ) :
    (pointSheafEquiv.{max u u'} AddCommGrpCat.{max w u u'}
        (K := (functorSituation.{w} C C' f B).base.J) rfl).functor.map
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Sheaf (functorSituation.{w} C C' f B).base.J
        AddCommGrpCat.{max w u u'}) (-(n : ℤ))).map ((functorSituation.{w} C C' f
            B).canonicalDerivedLowerShriekMap' F F' t)) =
      (sourceHomologyIso f B F' n).hom ≫
        categoryHomologyMap.{u, u', w} f (t.hom : F'.obj ⟶ f.op ⋙ F.obj) n ≫
        (totalHomologyIso f B F n).inv
declarations.comment: the maps of Remark 08PD are the canonical maps on homology

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.map_homologyFunctor_map_canonicalDerivedLowerShriekMap'_eq_homologyMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PH: the maps of Remark 08PD come from the chain map `K_•(F') ⟶ K_•(F)`.** Let
`f : C' ⥤ C` be a functor between small categories with their chaotic topologies, viewed with the
point and a ring `B` as the situation of Stacks 08PA (`functorSituation`). Let `F` be an abelian
sheaf on `C`, `F'` one on `C'` and `t : F' ⟶ g⁻¹F`. Identify `H_n(C, F) = L_nπ_!F` and
`H_n(C', F') = L_nπ'_!F'` (`totalHomologyIso`, `sourceHomologyIso`) and compute homology by the
simplicial replacements of Stacks 08PG (`categoryHomologyReplacementIso`). Then `H^{-n}` of the
canonical map `Lπ'_!F' ⟶ Lπ_!F` of Remark 08PD is the map induced on homology by the chain map
`K_•(F') ⟶ K_•(F)`, `(U'_n → … → U'_0, s') ↦ (f(U'_n) → … → f(U'_0), t(s'))`
(`replacementChainMap`).
declarations.statement:
theorem map_homologyFunctor_map_canonicalDerivedLowerShriekMap'_eq_homologyMap
    (F : Sheaf (functorSituation.{w} C C' f B).totalTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max w u u'}) (F' :
        Sheaf (functorSituation.{w} C C' f B).sourceTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max w u u'})
    (t : F' ⟶ (functorSituation.{w} C C' f B).abelianInverseImage.obj F) (n : ℕ) :
    (pointSheafEquiv.{max u u'} AddCommGrpCat.{max w u u'}
        (K := (functorSituation.{w} C C' f B).base.J) rfl).functor.map
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Sheaf (functorSituation.{w} C C' f B).base.J
        AddCommGrpCat.{max w u u'}) (-(n : ℤ))).map ((functorSituation.{w} C C' f
            B).canonicalDerivedLowerShriekMap' F F' t)) =
      (sourceHomologyIso f B F' n ≪≫ categoryHomologyReplacementIso.{u', max u w} F'.obj n).hom ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (replacementChainMap.{u, u', w} f (t.hom : F'.obj ⟶ f.op ⋙ F.obj)) n ≫
        (totalHomologyIso f B F n ≪≫ categoryHomologyReplacementIso.{u, max u' w} F.obj n).inv
declarations.comment: the maps of Remark 08PD come from the displayed chain map K(F') → K(F)

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.replacementChainMap_homologyMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PH, the identification of the homology map.** Under the comparison of Stacks 08PG
between the homology of a category and the homology of its simplicial replacement, the explicit
chain map `K_•(F') ⟶ K_•(F)` induced by a functor `f : C' ⥤ C` and a morphism `t : F' ⟶ f⁻¹F`
induces the canonical map `Stacks.CategoryHomology.categoryHomologyMap`.

The coefficient half is the naturality of the 08PG comparison; the index half is
`homologyMapAux_homologyMap`, which rests on the canonical map being a morphism of homological
δ-functors.
declarations.statement:
theorem replacementChainMap_homologyMap (f : C' ⥤ C)
    {F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u u' v}} {F' : C'ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u u' v}}
    (t : F' ⟶ f.op ⋙ F) (n : ℕ) :
    (categoryHomologyReplacementIso.{u', max u v} F' n).hom ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (replacementChainMap f t) n =
      categoryHomologyMap f t n ≫ (categoryHomologyReplacementIso.{u, max u' v} F n).hom
declarations.comment: the displayed chain map on homology

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.categoryHomologyMapData
declarations.doc:
The canonical maps on the homology of a category induced by an indexing functor and a
coefficient morphism, together with their invariance under natural isomorphisms of indexing
functors.
declarations.statement:
def categoryHomologyMapData (F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u u' v})
    (F' : C'ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u u' v}) (n : ℕ) : CategoryHomologyMapData F F' n
declarations.comment: homology_map

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.categoryHomologyMap
declarations.doc:
The canonical map on homology induced by a functor `f : C' ⥤ C` and a
morphism `t : F' ⟶ f.op ⋙ F` to the inverse-image presheaf, computed on projective resolutions.
It is the map that Remark 08PD produces on `H_n(C, F) = L_nπ_!F`, by
`Stacks.ChaoticSite.map_homologyFunctor_map_canonicalDerivedLowerShriekMap'`.
declarations.comment: homology_map

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.categoryHomologyMap_iso
declarations.doc:
Naturally isomorphic functors induce the same map on category homology when the coefficient
morphisms agree under the induced reindexing isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem categoryHomologyMap_iso (f g : C' ⥤ C) (e : f ≅ g)
    {F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u u' v}} {F' : C'ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u u' v}}
    (t : F' ⟶ f.op ⋙ F) (s : F' ⟶ g.op ⋙ F)
    (h : t = s ≫ Functor.whiskerRight (NatTrans.op e.hom) F) (n : ℕ) :
    categoryHomologyMap f t n = categoryHomologyMap g s n
declarations.comment: homology_map

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.categoryHomologyMap_id
declarations.doc:
The canonical map associated with the identity functor and the identity
coefficient morphism is the identity on homology.
declarations.statement:
theorem categoryHomologyMap_id {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    (F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}) (n : ℕ) :
    categoryHomologyMap (𝟭 C) (𝟙 F) n = 𝟙 _
declarations.comment: homology_map

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.categoryHomologyMap_comp
declarations.doc:
Canonical homology maps compose under successive functors and coefficient
morphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem categoryHomologyMap_comp {C : Type u} {C' : Type u'} {C'' : Type u''} [SmallCategory C]
    [SmallCategory C'] [SmallCategory C''] (f : C' ⥤ C) (g : C'' ⥤ C')
    {F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u u' u'' v}} {F' : C'ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u u' u'' v}}
    {F'' : C''ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u u' u'' v}} (t : F' ⟶ f.op ⋙ F) (s : F'' ⟶ g.op ⋙ F')
    (n : ℕ) :
    categoryHomologyMap.{u, u'', max u' v} (g ⋙ f) (s ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft g.op t) n =
      categoryHomologyMap.{u', u'', max u v} g s n ≫
        categoryHomologyMap.{u, u', max u'' v} f t n
declarations.comment: homology_map

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.replacementChainMap
declarations.doc:
The map of simplicial replacement complexes `K_•(F') ⟶ K_•(F)` induced by a functor
`f : C' ⥤ C` and a morphism `t : F' ⟶ f.op ⋙ F` of abelian presheaves.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def replacementChainMap (f : C' ⥤ C)
    {F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u u' v}} {F' : C'ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u u' v}}
    (t : F' ⟶ f.op ⋙ F) :
    simplicialReplacementComplex F' ⟶ simplicialReplacementComplex F
declarations.comment: the displayed chain map

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryHomology.replacementChainMap_on_summand
declarations.doc:
On the summand indexed by a string of arrows of `C'`, the chain map
`Stacks.CategoryHomology.replacementChainMap` applies `f` to that string and the coefficient
morphism `t` at its right endpoint.
declarations.statement:
theorem replacementChainMap_on_summand (f : C' ⥤ C)
    {F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u u' v}} {F' : C'ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u u' v}}
    (t : F' ⟶ f.op ⋙ F) (n : ℕ)
    (x : ComposableArrows C' n) (s : F'.obj (op x.right)) :
    ((replacementChainMap f t).f n).hom (replacementSummand F' n x s) =
      replacementSummand F n ((f.mapComposableArrows n).obj x)
        ((t.app (op x.right)).hom s)
declarations.comment: the displayed chain map on summands

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.fiberHomologyPresheafFunctor
declarations.doc:
**The presheaf of fibre homology.** The presheaf `L_{n,p}(F)` on the base whose value at `V` is
the homology `H_n(C_V, F|_{C_V})` of the fibre at `V`, with restriction maps given by the chosen
pullback functors and restriction of `F` along the chosen cartesian lifts, and regarded as a
functor of the coefficient presheaf `F`.
declarations.comment: the presheaf of fibre homology

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.fiberHomologyPresheaf_obj
declarations.doc:
**The values of the presheaf of fibre homology.** Its value at `V` is the homology
`H_n(C_V, F|_{C_V})` of the fibre at `V`.
declarations.statement:
lemma fiberHomologyPresheaf_obj (F : s.Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max w uD vD uC}) (n : ℕ)
    (V : s.base.Cᵒᵖ) :
    (fiberHomologyPresheaf s F n).obj V =
      CategoryHomology.categoryHomology.{uC, max w uD vD uC}
        ((Functor.Fiber.fiberInclusion (p := s.p) (S := V.unop)).op ⋙ F) n
declarations.comment: the values of the presheaf of fibre homology

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.fiberHomologyPresheaf_map
declarations.doc:
**The restriction maps of the presheaf of fibre homology.** The restriction map along
`h : V' ⟶ V` is the map on homology of Stacks 08PH attached to the chosen pullback functor `h^*`
and to restriction of `F` along the chosen cartesian lifts of `h`.
declarations.statement:
lemma fiberHomologyPresheaf_map (F : s.Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max w uD vD uC}) (n : ℕ)
    {V V' : s.base.C} (h : V' ⟶ V) :
    (fiberHomologyPresheaf s F n).map h.op =
      CategoryHomology.categoryHomologyMap.{uC, uC, max w uD vD uC}
        ((Functor.chosenPullbacks s.p).pullbackFunctor h) (fiberCartesianRestriction s F h) n
declarations.comment: the restriction maps of the presheaf of fibre homology

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.fiberHomologyPresheafFunctor_map_app
declarations.doc:
**Functoriality of the presheaf of fibre homology in the coefficients.** The map induced by
`α : F ⟶ G` is the map on homology of Stacks 08PH attached to the identity functor of the fibre and
to `α` restricted to it.
declarations.statement:
lemma fiberHomologyPresheafFunctor_map_app {F G : s.Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max w uD vD uC}}
    (α : F ⟶ G) (n : ℕ) (V : s.base.Cᵒᵖ) :
    ((fiberHomologyPresheafFunctor s n).map α).app V =
      CategoryHomology.categoryHomologyMap.{uC, uC, max w uD vD uC} (𝟭 (s.p.Fiber V.unop))
        (Functor.whiskerLeft (Functor.Fiber.fiberInclusion (p := s.p) (S := V.unop)).op α) n
declarations.comment: functoriality of the presheaf of fibre homology in the coefficients

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.fiberHomologySheaf
declarations.doc:
**The sheaf `L_n(F)` of fibre homology.** The abelian sheaf on the base associated to the
presheaf of fibre homology.
declarations.comment: the sheaf of fibre homology

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.fiberHomologySheaf_sheafify
declarations.doc:
Sheafifying the coefficients on the total category does not change the
associated sheaf of fibre homology.
declarations.statement:
theorem fiberHomologySheaf_sheafify
    [HasWeakSheafify s.base.J AddCommGrpCat.{max w uD vD uC}]
    [HasWeakSheafify s.topology AddCommGrpCat.{max w uD vD uC}]
    (F : s.Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max w uD vD uC}) (n : ℕ) :
    IsIso ((presheafToSheaf s.base.J AddCommGrpCat.{max w uD vD uC}).map
      ((fiberHomologyPresheafFunctor s n).map
        ((sheafificationAdjunction s.topology AddCommGrpCat.{max w uD vD uC}).unit.app F)))

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.fiberHomologySheafSheafifyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PI.** The sheaf `L_n(F)` of fibre homology is unchanged when the coefficient
presheaf is replaced by its sheafification on the total category: the canonical map
`L_n(F) ⟶ L_n(F^#)` of `fiberHomologySheaf_sheafify` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
def fiberHomologySheafSheafifyIso
    [HasWeakSheafify s.base.J AddCommGrpCat.{max w uD vD uC}]
    [HasWeakSheafify s.topology AddCommGrpCat.{max w uD vD uC}]
    (F : s.Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max w uD vD uC}) (n : ℕ) :
    fiberHomologySheaf s F n ≅
      fiberHomologySheaf s
        ((sheafToPresheaf s.topology AddCommGrpCat.{max w uD vD uC}).obj
          ((presheafToSheaf s.topology AddCommGrpCat.{max w uD vD uC}).obj F)) n
declarations.comment: the sheaf of fibre homology is unchanged by sheafifying the coefficients

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.FibredCategorySituation.derivedLowerShriekHomologyIsoFiberHomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08PJ.** Let `p : C ⥤ D` be a fibred category over a ringed site `D`, with `C` carrying
the inherited topology and `π` the induced morphism of topoi (Stacks 08P8). For every `n ≥ 0`,
the functor `F ↦ L_n π_!(F) = H^{-n}(Lπ_! F)` on abelian sheaves on `C` is the functor
`F ↦ L_n(F)` of Stacks 08PI, the sheaf on `D` associated to the presheaf
`V ↦ H_n(C_V, F|_{C_V})`, naturally in `F`.

Here `Lπ_!` is the left derived functor whose existence is Stacks 07AC
(`hasPointwiseLeftDerivedFunctor_abelianLowerShriekOnHomotopy`), and the two acyclicity inputs of
the comparison `derivedLowerShriekHomologyIso` are proved for every fibred situation:
`abelianLowerShriekAcyclic` and `abelianLowerShriekGeneratorsAcyclic`.

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.MorphismSituation.derivedAbelianLowerShriekHomologyObjIsoFiberHomologySheaf
declarations.doc:
For an abelian sheaf `F'` on the source, `L_n g_!(F')` is the sheaf on the total category
associated to the presheaf `U ↦ H_n(I_U, F'_U)`. This takes as hypotheses the acyclicity
conditions `h` for `g_!` and `h''` for `g''_!` and the cover acyclicity `hcov` of the
amelioration.
declarations.statement:
def derivedAbelianLowerShriekHomologyObjIsoFiberHomologySheaf
    (h : S.AbelianLowerShriekAcyclic)
    (h'' : (amelioratedSituation S).AbelianLowerShriekAcyclic)
    (hcov : (amelioratedSituation S).UliftFreeCoverLowerShriekAcyclic) (n : ℕ)
    (F' : Sheaf S.sourceTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max w u₀ u₁ u₂ v₀ v₁ v₂}) :
    (S.derivedAbelianLowerShriekHomology n).obj F' ≅
      fiberHomologySheaf (amelioratedSituation S)
        ((amelioratedLowerShriek S).obj F').obj n
declarations.comment: L_n g_!(F') is the sheaf of H_n(I_U, F'_U); assumes 07AC and cover acyclicity

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.FibredCategory.MorphismSituation.derivedAbelianLowerShriekHomologyObjIsoFiberHomologySheaf_unconditional
declarations.doc:
For an abelian sheaf `F'` on the source, `L_n g_!(F')` is the sheaf on the total category
associated to the presheaf `U ↦ H_n(I_U, F'_U)`, where `I_U` is the fibre over `U` of the
amelioration of `u`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedAbelianLowerShriekHomologyObjIsoFiberHomologySheaf_unconditional (n : ℕ)
    (F' : Sheaf S.sourceTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max w u₀ u₁ u₂ v₀ v₁ v₂}) :
    (S.derivedAbelianLowerShriekHomology n).obj F' ≅
      fiberHomologySheaf (amelioratedSituation S)
        ((amelioratedLowerShriek S).obj F').obj n
declarations.comment: L_n g_!(F') is the sheaf of H_n(I_U, F'_U)

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.standardResolution
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08PM.** The standard resolution of the commutative `A`-algebra `B`,
augmented to `B`. Its degree `n` term is the `(n + 1)`-fold iteration of `C ↦ A[C]`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def standardResolution (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (B : CommAlgCat.{max u v} A) : SimplicialObject.Augmented (CommAlgCat.{max u v} A)

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.cotangentSimplicialModule
declarations.doc: The canonical simplicial `B`-module `Ω[P•⁄A] ⊗[P•] B`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cotangentSimplicialModule (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (B : CommAlgCat.{max u v} A) : CotangentSimplicialModuleData A B
declarations.comment: the simplicial module

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.cotangentComplex
declarations.doc: The cotangent complex `L_{B/A}` associated to the standard resolution.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cotangentComplex (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (B : CommAlgCat.{max u v} A) : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} B) ℤ
declarations.comment: the associated complex

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.existsSliceStandardEndofunctor
declarations.doc:
The comonad of the lifted adjunction has a standard augmented simplicial
endofunctor in the category of algebras over `B`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsSliceStandardEndofunctor :
    ∃ X : SimplicialObject.Augmented (Over B ⥤ Over B),
      IsSliceStandardEndofunctor A B X
declarations.comment: the standard endofunctor in the slice

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.sliceStandardResolution_iso
declarations.doc:
Every standard simplicial endofunctor arising from the slice adjunction, evaluated on
the identity of `B`, gives the ordinary augmented standard resolution of `B`.
declarations.statement:
theorem sliceStandardResolution_iso
    (X : SimplicialObject.Augmented (Over B ⥤ Over B))
