declarations.statement: def towerFirstTerm : PresheafOfModules.{u + 1} (towerConstantRingSheaf A B C).obj
declarations.comment: the first term g₁⁻¹Ω₁ ⊗_{B̲} C̲ of the sequence

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.towerSections_formallySmooth
declarations.doc:
**The sections of `𝒪₂` are formally smooth over the sections of `𝒪₁`.** Over the tower
`(P → B, Q → C)` the map is the universe lift of `P → Q`, and `Q` is a polynomial algebra over
`P` by the first condition on a polynomial tower, hence formally smooth over `P`; formal
smoothness survives the universe lift by `RingHom.FormallySmooth.ulift`. This is the hypothesis
`Algebra.FormallySmooth` that `CommAlgCat.towerDifferential_shortExact_extendScalars` needs at
the object `W` of `C_{C/B/A}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem towerSections_formallySmooth (W : (polynomialTowerSite A B C)ᵒᵖ) :
    letI := ((towerLeftToRight A B C).app W).hom.toAlgebra
    Algebra.FormallySmooth ((towerLeftRingPresheaf A B C).obj W)
      ((towerRightRingPresheaf A B C).obj W)
declarations.comment: the sections of 𝒪₂ are formally smooth over the sections of 𝒪₁: the formal smoothness input of the objectwise differential sequence

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.towerSections_isPushout
declarations.doc:
**The pushout square of a polynomial tower survives the universe lift.** The sections of
`𝒪₃` over the tower `(P → B, Q → C)` are `Q ⊗_P B`, so the square `P → B`, `P → Q`, `B → Q ⊗_P B`,
`Q → Q ⊗_P B` of the tower is a pushout square of rings; `Algebra.IsPushout.ulift_tensorProduct`
transports that to the universe lifts, which is the form in which the sections of the three
structure sheaves carry it. This is the hypothesis `Algebra.IsPushout` that
`KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquiv` needs in order to identify `Ω_{𝒪₃/B̲}` with
`𝒪₃ ⊗_{𝒪₂} Ω_{𝒪₂/𝒪₁}` on sections.
declarations.statement:
theorem towerSections_isPushout (W : (polynomialTowerSite A B C)ᵒᵖ) :
    Algebra.IsPushout (ULift.{u + 1} ↑(towerLeftAlgebra W.unop.unop.obj)) (ULift.{u + 1} B)
      (ULift.{u + 1} ↑(towerRightAlgebra W.unop.unop.obj))
      (ULift.{u + 1} ↑(towerBaseChangeAlgebra W.unop.unop.obj))
declarations.comment: the pushout square of the tower on the universe-lifted sections: the input that identifies the third term of the objectwise sequence

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.towerFirstSequenceMap
declarations.doc:
**The first map `g₁⁻¹Ω₁ ⊗_{B̲} C̲ ⟶ g₂⁻¹Ω₂` of the sequence of Tag 08QU.** Both source and
target are base changes of presheaves of relative differentials, so by the change-of-rings
adjunction of Tag 03CU and the universal property of the presheaf of differentials the map is
the same datum as `CommAlgCat.towerFirstDerivation`, namely `c ⊗ b ⊗ d p ↦ c·b ⊗ d p`.
declarations.statement: def towerFirstSequenceMap : towerFirstTerm A B C ⟶ towerSecondTerm A B C
declarations.comment: the first map g₁⁻¹Ω₁ ⊗_{B̲} C̲ ⟶ g₂⁻¹Ω₂ of the sequence

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.towerSecondSequenceMap
declarations.doc:
**The second map `g₂⁻¹Ω₂ ⟶ g₃⁻¹Ω₃` of the sequence of Tag 08QU**, the datum of
`CommAlgCat.towerSecondDerivation` under the change-of-rings adjunction of Tag 03CU and the
universal property of the presheaf of differentials: `c ⊗ d q ↦ c ⊗ d(1 ⊗ q)`.
declarations.statement: def towerSecondSequenceMap : towerSecondTerm A B C ⟶ towerThirdTerm A B C
declarations.comment: the second map g₂⁻¹Ω₂ ⟶ g₃⁻¹Ω₃ of the sequence

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.towerSequenceMap_comp
declarations.doc:
**The composite of the two maps of the sequence of Tag 08QU vanishes.** By the universal
properties the composite is the map attached to the derivation `p ↦ 1 ⊗ d(1 ⊗ image of p)` of
`𝒪₁` with values in `g₃⁻¹Ω₃`, and that derivation is zero: by the pushout square on sections
(`CommAlgCat.towerRightToPushout_app_towerLeftToRight`) the image of `p` in `𝒪₃` comes from
`B̲`, and `d` kills the image of the base sheaf of rings.
declarations.statement:
theorem towerSequenceMap_comp :
    towerFirstSequenceMap A B C ≫ towerSecondSequenceMap A B C = 0
declarations.comment: the two maps of the sequence compose to zero

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.towerShortComplex
declarations.doc:
**The sequence of Tag 08QU as a short complex of sheaves of `C̲`-modules on `C_{C/B/A}`**,
the image of `CommAlgCat.towerShortComplexPresheaf` under the equivalence
`CommAlgCat.towerPresheafToSheaf`: every presheaf on the chaotic site is a sheaf.
declarations.statement: def towerShortComplex : ShortComplex (SheafOfModules.{u + 1} (towerConstantRingSheaf A B C))
declarations.comment: the sequence 0 ⟶ g₁⁻¹Ω₁ ⊗_{B̲} C̲ ⟶ g₂⁻¹Ω₂ ⟶ g₃⁻¹Ω₃ ⟶ 0 of sheaves of C̲-modules on C_{C/B/A}; its short exactness is not asserted here

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.towerShortComplexPresheaf_shortExact_obj
declarations.doc:
**The sequence of Tag 08QU is short exact over every object of `C_{C/B/A}`.** Over the
polynomial tower `(P → B, Q → C)`, with `T = Q ⊗_P B` and every ring replaced by its universe
lift, the three modules of sections are `C̲(W) ⊗_{B̲(W)} (B̲(W) ⊗_P Ω_{P/A})`, `C̲(W) ⊗_Q Ω_{Q/A}`
and `C̲(W) ⊗_T Ω_{T/B}`, and the sequence they form is the split sequence of
`CommAlgCat.towerDifferential_shortExact_extendScalars` for the tower `A → P → Q` base changed
along the augmentation `Q → C̲(W)`. The middle terms agree on the nose
(`CommAlgCat.towerSecondTerm_obj`); the first terms are identified by cancelling the base change
twice through `C̲(W) ⊗_P Ω_{P/A}`, and the third ones by
`KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquiv`, available because
`CommAlgCat.towerSections_isPushout` makes `T` the pushout of `B ← P → Q`. Both squares are
checked on the generators `1 ⊗ 1 ⊗ d p` and `1 ⊗ d q`, where the two maps of the sequence are
computed by the change-of-rings adjunction of Tag 03CU.
declarations.statement:
theorem towerShortComplexPresheaf_shortExact_obj (W : (polynomialTowerSite A B C)ᵒᵖ) :
    ((towerShortComplexPresheaf A B C).map
      (PresheafOfModules.evaluation (towerConstantRingSheaf A B C).obj W)).ShortExact
declarations.comment: the sequence of sections over a polynomial tower is short exact: the objectwise form of the short exactness

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.towerShortComplex_shortExact
declarations.doc:
**Tag 08QU: the sequence of sheaves of `C̲`-modules on `C_{C/B/A}`
`0 → g₁⁻¹Ω₁ ⊗_{B̲} C̲ → g₂⁻¹Ω₂ → g₃⁻¹Ω₃ → 0` is short exact.** By
`CommAlgCat.towerShortComplex_shortExact_of_objectwise` this is the objectwise statement
`CommAlgCat.towerShortComplexPresheaf_shortExact_obj`: a short complex of presheaves of
`C̲`-modules on the chaotic site `C_{C/B/A}` is short exact as soon as its sequence of sections
over every polynomial tower is, and there the sequence is the split differential sequence of
Algebra, Lemma 10.138.9 for `A → P → Q` base changed along the augmentation `Q → C̲`.
declarations.statement: theorem towerShortComplex_shortExact : (towerShortComplex A B C).ShortExact
declarations.comment: the sequence of sheaves of C-modules on C_{C/B/A} is short exact

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.leftDerivedColimitThirdInverseImageZeroIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08QV, in degree zero.** With notation as in Tag 08QT, suppose `C = B[E]` is a
polynomial algebra over `B`. Then `π_!(g₃^{-1}ℱ) = π_{3,!}ℱ` for every abelian presheaf `ℱ` on
the small model of the restricted site `C_{C/B}`: both sides are the sections of `ℱ` at the
identity augmentation `C → C`.
declarations.statement:
def leftDerivedColimitThirdInverseImageZeroIso
    (hε : SSet.trivialKanFibrations (Functor.whiskerRight ε (forget (CommAlgCat.{u} A))))
    (F : (smallBoundedPolynomialSite B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C) μ)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    ((colim : ((smallBoundedPolynomialTowerSite A B C κ μ)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ⥤
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).leftDerived 0).obj
        ((smallTowerThirdInverseImage A B C κ μ).obj F) ≅
      colimit F
declarations.comment: the degree-zero half of `Lπ_!(g₃^{-1}ℱ) = Lπ_{3,!}ℱ = π_{3,!}ℱ`, read at the small models of the footnote-restricted sites of Tag 08QT, with `π_!` the colimit over the index category of Tag 08PF and `κ`, `μ` the bounds on the two layers of variables; the vanishing in positive degrees is `CommAlgCat.isZero_leftDerivedColimitThirdInverseImage_succ`

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isZero_leftDerivedColimitThirdInverseImage_succ
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08QV, in positive degrees.** With notation as in Tag 08QT, suppose `C = B[E]` is a
polynomial algebra over `B`. Then `L_nπ_!(g₃^{-1}ℱ) = 0` for `n > 0`: the simplicial abelian
group `(g₃^{-1}ℱ)(U_•)` is constant.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_leftDerivedColimitThirdInverseImage_succ
    (hε : SSet.trivialKanFibrations (Functor.whiskerRight ε (forget (CommAlgCat.{u} A))))
    (F : (smallBoundedPolynomialSite B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C) μ)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (n : ℕ) :
    IsZero (((colim : ((smallBoundedPolynomialTowerSite A B C κ μ)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ⥤
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).leftDerived (n + 1)).obj
      ((smallTowerThirdInverseImage A B C κ μ).obj F))
declarations.comment: the positive-degree half of `Lπ_!(g₃^{-1}ℱ) = Lπ_{3,!}ℱ = π_{3,!}ℱ`, read at the small models of the footnote-restricted sites of Tag 08QT: `Lπ_!(g₃^{-1}ℱ)` is concentrated in degree zero, where it is `π_{3,!}ℱ` by `CommAlgCat.leftDerivedColimitThirdInverseImageZeroIso`

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.polynomialTowerDerivedColimitThirdInverseImageIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08QV, the first equality `Lπ_!(g₃^{-1}ℱ) = Lπ_{3,!}ℱ`, at the sites themselves.**
With notation as in Tag 08QT, suppose `C = B[E]` is a polynomial algebra over `B`. Then

`Lπ_!(g₃^{-1}ℱ) = Lπ_{3,!}ℱ`

in `D(Ab)`, for every abelian sheaf `ℱ` on `C_{C/B}` -- the abelian presheaves being the abelian
sheaves, the topology being chaotic.

Both sides are the extended Moore complex of `ℱ(u₃(U_•))` for the cosimplicial object `U_•` of the
towers `(P_n → B, P_n[E] → C)`: on the left by the criterion of Tag 08Q9 applied to `U_•` on
`C_{C/B/A}`, on the right by that criterion applied to the constant cosimplicial object at the
identity augmentation `C → C` on `C_{C/B}`, which `u₃(U_•)` is. No hypothesis on a resolution
survives: the resolution of `B` over `A` is the standard one of Tag 08PM, whose terms are
polynomial algebras and whose augmentation is a trivial Kan fibration by Tag 08QI.
declarations.statement:
def polynomialTowerDerivedColimitThirdInverseImageIso
    (F : (polynomialSite B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C))ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    (totalDerivedColimit' (polynomialTowerSite A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          ((HomologicalComplex.single ((polynomialTowerSite A B C)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj ((towerThirdInverseImage A B C).obj F))) ≅
      (totalDerivedColimit' (polynomialSite B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          ((HomologicalComplex.single
            ((polynomialSite B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C))ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj F))
declarations.comment: the first equality `Lπ_!(g₃^{-1}ℱ) = Lπ_{3,!}ℱ` in `D(Ab)`, at the sites of Tag 08QT and Tag 08PR themselves -- `CommAlgCat.polynomialTowerSite` and `CommAlgCat.polynomialSite B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C)`, not restrictions of them -- with `Lπ_!` and `Lπ_{3,!}` the total left derived functors of the colimits over the index categories of Tag 08PF and the coefficients at the universe `u + 1` of the sites' objects. The second equality `Lπ_{3,!}ℱ = π_{3,!}ℱ` is `CommAlgCat.polynomialSiteDerivedColimitThirdIso`

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.polynomialSiteDerivedColimitThirdIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08QV, the second equality `Lπ_{3,!}ℱ = π_{3,!}ℱ`, at the site `C_{C/B}` itself.**
With notation as in Tag 08QT, suppose `C = B[E]` is a polynomial algebra over `B`. Then

`Lπ_{3,!}ℱ = π_{3,!}ℱ`

in `D(Ab)`, for every abelian sheaf `ℱ` on `C_{C/B}`: the left side is the complex concentrated in
degree zero on `π_{3,!}ℱ`, the colimit of `ℱ` over the index category of Tag 08PF.

This is where `C = B[E]` is used on `C_{C/B}` itself: it makes the identity augmentation `C → C`
an object of that site, and that object is initial there, so `π_{3,!}` is an evaluation and hence
exact.
declarations.statement:
def polynomialSiteDerivedColimitThirdIso
    (F : (polynomialSite B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C))ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    (totalDerivedColimit' (polynomialSite B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          ((HomologicalComplex.single
            ((polynomialSite B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C))ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj F)) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        ((HomologicalComplex.single AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj
          (colimit F))
declarations.comment: the second equality `Lπ_{3,!}ℱ = π_{3,!}ℱ` in `D(Ab)`, at the site `C_{C/B}` of Tag 08PR itself -- `CommAlgCat.polynomialSite B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C)`, not a restriction of it -- with `Lπ_{3,!}` the total left derived functor of the colimit over its index category and `π_{3,!}ℱ` that colimit, as in Tag 08PF. The first equality `Lπ_!(g₃^{-1}ℱ) = Lπ_{3,!}ℱ` is `CommAlgCat.polynomialTowerDerivedColimitThirdInverseImageIso`

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.derivedLowerShriek_comp_inverseImage_polynomialTower
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08QW.** With notation as in Tag 08QT, `Lg_{i,!} ∘ g_i⁻¹ = id` for
`i = 1, 2, 3`, and hence also `Lπ_! ∘ g_i⁻¹ = Lπ_{i,!}` for `i = 1, 2, 3`.

Here `g₁`, `g₂`, `g₃` are the morphisms of topoi from `C_{C/B/A}` to `C_{B/A}`, `C_{C/A}` and
`C_{C/B}` induced by `u₁`, `u₂`, `u₃`, and `π`, `π₁`, `π₂`, `π₃` the projections of the four sites
to the point; all four sites carry the chaotic topology. The statement is about abelian sheaves on
the unbounded derived categories, for *every* left derived functor of each lower shriek and
*every* derived functor of each inverse image, so it does not depend on choices. The six parts
are `CommAlgCat.derivedLowerShriekFirstInverseImageIso`,
`CommAlgCat.derivedLowerShriekSecondInverseImageIso`,
`CommAlgCat.derivedLowerShriekThirdInverseImageIso`,
`CommAlgCat.derivedLowerShriekProjectionFirstIso`,
`CommAlgCat.derivedLowerShriekProjectionSecondIso` and
`CommAlgCat.derivedLowerShriekProjectionThirdIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedLowerShriek_comp_inverseImage_polynomialTower :
    (∀ (L : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (polynomialTowerTopology A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⥤
          DerivedCategory
            (Sheaf (polynomialTopology A (towerBaseAlgebra A B)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
      (α : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
        ((polynomialTowerFirst A B C).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (polynomialTowerTopology A B C)
          (polynomialTopology A (towerBaseAlgebra A B))).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
      [L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor α (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
        (Sheaf (polynomialTowerTopology A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
      (G : DerivedCategory
          (Sheaf (polynomialTopology A (towerBaseAlgebra A B)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⥤
          DerivedCategory (Sheaf (polynomialTowerTopology A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
      (_ : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ G ≅
        ((polynomialTowerFirst A B C).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (polynomialTowerTopology A B C)
          (polynomialTopology A (towerBaseAlgebra A B))).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh),
      Nonempty (G ⋙ L ≅ 𝟭 _)) ∧
    (∀ (L : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (polynomialTowerTopology A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⥤
          DerivedCategory
            (Sheaf (polynomialTopology A (towerTotalAlgebra A C)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
      (α : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
        ((polynomialTowerSecond A B C).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (polynomialTowerTopology A B C)
          (polynomialTopology A (towerTotalAlgebra A C))).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
      [L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor α (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
        (Sheaf (polynomialTowerTopology A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
      (G : DerivedCategory
          (Sheaf (polynomialTopology A (towerTotalAlgebra A C)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⥤
          DerivedCategory (Sheaf (polynomialTowerTopology A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
      (_ : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ G ≅
        ((polynomialTowerSecond A B C).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (polynomialTowerTopology A B C)
          (polynomialTopology A (towerTotalAlgebra A C))).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh),
      Nonempty (G ⋙ L ≅ 𝟭 _)) ∧
    (∀ (L : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (polynomialTowerTopology A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⥤
          DerivedCategory
            (Sheaf (polynomialTopology B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
      (α : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
        ((polynomialTowerThird A B C).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (polynomialTowerTopology A B C)
          (polynomialTopology B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C))).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
      [L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor α (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
        (Sheaf (polynomialTowerTopology A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
      (G : DerivedCategory
          (Sheaf (polynomialTopology B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⥤
          DerivedCategory (Sheaf (polynomialTowerTopology A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
      (_ : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ G ≅
        ((polynomialTowerThird A B C).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (polynomialTowerTopology A B C)
          (polynomialTopology B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C))).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh),
      Nonempty (G ⋙ L ≅ 𝟭 _)) ∧
    (∀ (G : DerivedCategory
          (Sheaf (polynomialTopology A (towerBaseAlgebra A B)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⥤
          DerivedCategory (Sheaf (polynomialTowerTopology A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
      (_ : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ G ≅
        ((polynomialTowerFirst A B C).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (polynomialTowerTopology A B C)
          (polynomialTopology A (towerBaseAlgebra A B))).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
      (L : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (polynomialTowerTopology A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⥤
          DerivedCategory
            (Sheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 2})) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
      (α : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
        ((Functor.star (polynomialTowerSite A B C)).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (polynomialTowerTopology A B C)
          (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 2}))).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
      [L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor α (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
        (Sheaf (polynomialTowerTopology A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
      (L' : DerivedCategory
          (Sheaf (polynomialTopology A (towerBaseAlgebra A B)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⥤
          DerivedCategory
            (Sheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 2})) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
      (α' : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L' ⟶
        ((Functor.star (polynomialSite A (towerBaseAlgebra A B))).sheafPullback
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (polynomialTopology A (towerBaseAlgebra A B))
          (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 2}))).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
      [L'.IsLeftDerivedFunctor α' (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
        (Sheaf (polynomialTopology A (towerBaseAlgebra A B)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ))],
      Nonempty (G ⋙ L ≅ L')) ∧
    (∀ (G : DerivedCategory
          (Sheaf (polynomialTopology A (towerTotalAlgebra A C)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⥤
          DerivedCategory (Sheaf (polynomialTowerTopology A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
      (_ : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ G ≅
        ((polynomialTowerSecond A B C).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (polynomialTowerTopology A B C)
          (polynomialTopology A (towerTotalAlgebra A C))).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
      (L : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (polynomialTowerTopology A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⥤
          DerivedCategory
            (Sheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 2})) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
      (α : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
        ((Functor.star (polynomialTowerSite A B C)).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (polynomialTowerTopology A B C)
          (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 2}))).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
      [L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor α (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
        (Sheaf (polynomialTowerTopology A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
      (L' : DerivedCategory
          (Sheaf (polynomialTopology A (towerTotalAlgebra A C)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⥤
          DerivedCategory
            (Sheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 2})) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
      (α' : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L' ⟶
        ((Functor.star (polynomialSite A (towerTotalAlgebra A C))).sheafPullback
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (polynomialTopology A (towerTotalAlgebra A C))
          (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 2}))).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
      [L'.IsLeftDerivedFunctor α' (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
        (Sheaf (polynomialTopology A (towerTotalAlgebra A C)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ))],
      Nonempty (G ⋙ L ≅ L')) ∧
    (∀ (G : DerivedCategory
          (Sheaf (polynomialTopology B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⥤
          DerivedCategory (Sheaf (polynomialTowerTopology A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
      (_ : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ G ≅
        ((polynomialTowerThird A B C).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (polynomialTowerTopology A B C)
          (polynomialTopology B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C))).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
      (L : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (polynomialTowerTopology A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⥤
          DerivedCategory
            (Sheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 2})) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
      (α : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶
        ((Functor.star (polynomialTowerSite A B C)).sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (polynomialTowerTopology A B C)
          (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 2}))).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
      [L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor α (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
        (Sheaf (polynomialTowerTopology A B C) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
      (L' : DerivedCategory
          (Sheaf (polynomialTopology B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⥤
          DerivedCategory
            (Sheaf (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 2})) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
      (α' : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L' ⟶
        ((Functor.star (polynomialSite B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C))).sheafPullback
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (polynomialTopology B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C))
          (GrothendieckTopology.trivial (Discrete PUnit.{u + 2}))).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
      [L'.IsLeftDerivedFunctor α' (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
        (Sheaf (polynomialTopology B (towerRelativeAlgebra B C)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ))],
      Nonempty (G ⋙ L ≅ L'))

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.exists_distTriang_fundamentalVertex_of_isResolution
declarations.doc:
**The fundamental triangle of the cotangent complex.** Let `A → B → C` be ring maps. Then there
is a distinguished triangle

`L_{B/A} ⊗^𝐋_B C ⟶ L_{C/A} ⟶ L_{C/B} ⟶ (L_{B/A} ⊗^𝐋_B C)[1]`

in `D(C)`, on the three vertices of the display of Tag 08QS.

Two hypotheses the source does not have are carried: `B → C` is injective, as in Tag 08SD, and the
base-changed resolution `Q̄_• = Q_• ⊗_{P_•} B` of Tag 08SD is a resolution of `C` over `B` — its
terms are polynomial algebras over `B` and its augmentation to `C` is a trivial Kan fibration on
underlying simplicial sets.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_distTriang_fundamentalVertex_of_isResolution
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] [Algebra B C] [IsScalarTower A B C]
    (hf : Function.Injective (algebraMap B C))
    (hP : ∀ n, IsPolynomialAlgebra B
      ((baseChangedStandardResolution A (towerHom A B C)).left.obj n))
    (hε : SSet.trivialKanFibrations (Functor.whiskerRight
      (baseChangedStandardResolution A (towerHom A B C)).hom (forget (CommAlgCat.{u} B)))) :
    ∃ (α : fundamentalVertex₁.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} A B C ⟶ fundamentalVertex₂.{u, u, u + 1} A C)
      (β : fundamentalVertex₂.{u, u, u + 1} A C ⟶ fundamentalVertex₃.{u, u, u + 1} B C)
      (δ : fundamentalVertex₃.{u, u, u + 1} B C ⟶
        (fundamentalVertex₁.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} A B C)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk α β δ ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} C))
declarations.comment: the triangle on the three vertices of the display of Tag 08QS, under TWO carried hypotheses the source lacks: `B → C` injective, as in Tag 08SD, whose removal needs the product decomposition of Tag 08SC; and the key fact of Tag 08SD, that the base-changed resolution Q_bullet ⊗_{P_bullet} B is a resolution of C over B, which rests on Tag 08RX. Neither tag is proved in this library

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.productFundamentalTriangle_distinguished
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08QX, and the distinguishedness asserted by the display of Tag 08QS.**
Let `A → B → C` be ring maps. Then

`L_{B/A} ⊗^𝐋_B C ⟶ L_{C/A} ⟶ L_{C/B} ⟶ (L_{B/A} ⊗^𝐋_B C)[1]`

is a distinguished triangle in `D(C)`, on the three vertices of the display of
[Stacks, Tag 08QS], with the display's own first two morphisms
`CommAlgCat.fundamentalMor₁` and `CommAlgCat.fundamentalMor₂` — the two functoriality maps of
[Stacks, Tag 08PN] for the two commutative squares of the tower — and with
`CommAlgCat.productFundamentalMor₃` for its third.

The display of Tag 08QS is written as a triangle, and what makes it one is exactly this
statement, so the display's distinguishedness clause is registered here as well: the three
objects and the three arrows of the display are named by
`CommAlgCat.fundamentalVertex₁`, `CommAlgCat.fundamentalVertex₂`,
`CommAlgCat.fundamentalVertex₃`, `CommAlgCat.fundamentalMor₁`, `CommAlgCat.fundamentalMor₂` and
`CommAlgCat.productFundamentalMor₃`, and that they form a triangle at all is Proposition 08QX.

The proof is the one of [Stacks, Remark 08SD]: the triangle for `A → B → B × C`, where the map
is the split injection `b ↦ (b, f b)`, base changed along the flat projection `B × C → C`.
declarations.statement:
theorem productFundamentalTriangle_distinguished :
    Triangle.mk (fundamentalMor₁.{u} A B C) (fundamentalMor₂.{u} A B C)
        (productFundamentalMor₃ A B C) ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} C))
declarations.comment: the proposition: for ring maps `A → B → C` the display of Tag 08QS is a distinguished triangle in `D(C)`, on the display's own three vertices and with the display's own three morphisms. The third of them is `CommAlgCat.productFundamentalMor₃`

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.quasiIso_midCotangentComplexMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08QZ.** Let `A → A' → B` be ring maps such that `B = B ⊗_A^𝐋 A'`, which is to say
that `Tor_i^A(A', B)` vanishes for `i > 0` and the canonical map `A' ⊗_A B → B`,
`a' ⊗ x ↦ a' · x`, is bijective. Then the canonical map `L_{B/A} ⟶ L_{B/A'}` of Tag 08PN,
`CommAlgCat.midCotangentComplexMap`, is a quasi-isomorphism.

This is the special case `B' = B` of Stacks 08QQ,
`CommAlgCat.quasiIso_cotangentExtendScalarsMooreMap`: the square of the tower has the identity of
`B` for its vertical map, so `B ⊗_A^𝐋 A' = B'` is the hypothesis of the tag, and the base-change
map `L_{B/A} ⊗_B B' ⟶ L_{B'/A'}` of 08QQ is, under
`CommAlgCat.midCotangentMooreMap_eq`, the functoriality map `L_{B/A} ⟶ L_{B/A'}`. Remark 08QI,
which 08QQ carried as a hypothesis, is `CommAlgCat.cotangentComputedByEveryResolution`, so
nothing beyond the tag's own hypothesis is assumed.
declarations.statement:
theorem quasiIso_midCotangentComplexMap
    (hTor : RingTheory.TorIndependence.TorIndependent A A' (B : Type u))
    (hφ : Function.Bijective
      (baseChangeUnit (B' := midAlgebra A' B) (AlgHom.id A (B : Type u)))) :
    QuasiIso (midCotangentComplexMap A' B)
declarations.comment: on the cotangent complexes: under the tag's own hypothesis B = B ⊗_A^𝐋 A' -- Tor independence of A' and B over A, and bijectivity of A' ⊗_A B → B -- the canonical map L_{B/A} ⟶ L_{B/A'} of Tag 08PN is a quasi-isomorphism

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isIso_Q_map_midCotangentComplexMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08QZ in the derived category.** Under the tag's hypothesis `B = B ⊗_A^𝐋 A'` the
canonical map `L_{B/A} ⟶ L_{B/A'}` of Tag 08PN becomes an isomorphism in `D(B)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_Q_map_midCotangentComplexMap
    (hTor : RingTheory.TorIndependence.TorIndependent A A' (B : Type u))
    (hφ : Function.Bijective
      (baseChangeUnit (B' := midAlgebra A' B) (AlgHom.id A (B : Type u)))) :
    IsIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map (midCotangentComplexMap A' B))
declarations.comment: the lemma as the invertibility in D(B) of the canonical map of Tag 08PN: under the tag's own hypothesis B = B ⊗_A^𝐋 A', the image of L_{B/A} ⟶ L_{B/A'} under the localization D(B) is invertible

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.midCotangentComplexDerivedIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08QZ: `L_{B/A} = L_{B/A'}` in `D(B)`.** Let `A → A' → B` be ring maps such that
`B = B ⊗_A^𝐋 A'` — that is, `Tor_i^A(A', B) = 0` for `i > 0` and `A' ⊗_A B → B` is bijective.
Then the cotangent complexes of `B` over `A` and over `A'` are isomorphic in `D(B)`, by the
canonical map `CommAlgCat.midCotangentComplexMap` of Tag 08PN.

This is the conclusion the source states. The degreewise form,
`CommAlgCat.midCotangentComplexHomologyIso`, is a separate statement proved directly from the two
resolutions; an isomorphism of cohomology in each degree does not by itself produce an
isomorphism in `D(B)`, and the comparison here is the canonical one.

This is the whole of the tag: the hypothesis is the source's, written out, and the conclusion is
the source's, an isomorphism in `D(B)` along the canonical map.
declarations.statement:
def midCotangentComplexDerivedIso
    (hTor : RingTheory.TorIndependence.TorIndependent A A' (B : Type u))
    (hφ : Function.Bijective
      (baseChangeUnit (B' := midAlgebra A' B) (AlgHom.id A (B : Type u)))) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cotangentComplex.{u, u} A B) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cotangentComplex.{u, u} A' (midAlgebra A' B))

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.midBaseChangeOverDifferentialsIso
declarations.doc:
**`i^*Ω_{𝒪/A} = u^{-1}(i^*Ω_{𝒪/A'})`, the step of Stacks 08QZ that the proof turns on.**
For a tower of ring maps `A → A' → B`, the functor sending an `A`-algebra `P` augmented to `B` to
`Ω_{P/A} ⊗_P B` is the composite of the base-change functor `(P → B) ↦ (A' ⊗_A P → B)` of
Stacks 08QN with the functor sending an `A'`-algebra `Q` augmented to `B` to `Ω_{Q/A'} ⊗_Q B`:
```
Ω_{P/A} ⊗_P B = Ω_{(A' ⊗_A P)/A'} ⊗_{A' ⊗_A P} B ,
```
naturally in `(P → B)`. Each component is Stacks 00RV base changed along the augmentation,
`Stacks.KaehlerDifferential.augmentationBaseChangeEquiv`, and naturality holds because both
composites send the pure differential `1 ⊗ d p` to `1 ⊗ d(1 ⊗ p)` — the pure differentials
generate, by `CommAlgCat.overDifferentials_hom_ext`.

The source's `C_{B/A}` is the full subcategory of the polynomial algebras, so the comparison of
abelian sheaves it asks for is the restriction of this isomorphism along that inclusion; nothing
below uses that `P` is a polynomial algebra.
declarations.comment: the step the proof turns on: the sheaf (P → B) ↦ Ω_{P/A} ⊗_P B on C_{B/A} is the pullback along u : (P → B) ↦ (A' ⊗_A P → B) of the sheaf (Q → B) ↦ Ω_{Q/A'} ⊗_Q B on C_{B/A'}, stated on all augmented algebras rather than only the polynomial ones. The passage from here to L_{B/A} = L_{B/A'} is `CommAlgCat.midCotangentComplexHomologyIso`

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.midCotangentComplexHomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08QZ: `L_{B/A} = L_{B/A'}`.** Let `A → A' → B` be ring maps such that
`B = B ⊗_A^𝐋 A'`, which is to say that `Tor_i^A(A', B)` vanishes for `i > 0` and the canonical
map `A' ⊗_A B → B`, `a' ⊗ x ↦ a' · x`, is bijective. Then the cotangent complexes of `B` over
`A` and of `B` over `A'` have the same cohomology in every degree, as `B`-modules.

The proof is the source's. The cohomology of `L_{B/A}` in degree `-n` is the degree `n` homology
of the complex of `Ω_{P_•/A} ⊗_{P_•} B` for the standard resolution `P_•` of `B` over `A`
(Tag 08PN, `CommAlgCat.cotangentComplexHomologyMooreIso`); that simplicial module is
`Ω_{(A' ⊗_A P_•)/A'} ⊗_{A' ⊗_A P_•} B` by the comparison of
`CommAlgCat.midBaseChangeOverDifferentialsIso`, which is the step of Stacks 08QZ that the
source's proof turns on; and `A' ⊗_A P_•` and the standard resolution of `B` over `A'` are two
resolutions of `B` over `A'`, so Tag 08PT computes the same `L_nπ_!(Ω_{𝒪/A'} ⊗_𝒪 B̲)` from both
(`CommAlgCat.resolutionModuleLeftDerivedCotangentHomologyIso`).

The hypothesis enters exactly once, and only through the first half of the proof of Stacks 08QP:
`CommAlgCat.isResolution_augmentationBaseChange` turns it into the statement that
`A' ⊗_A P_• ⟶ B` is a resolution of `B` over `A'`, which is what Tag 08PT needs of the
base-changed resolution. Both halves are used there: Tor independence makes
`s(P_•) ⊗_A A'` compute `B ⊗_A^𝐋 A'`, and bijectivity of `A' ⊗_A B → B` identifies its
degree-zero homology with `B`.

The conclusion here is degreewise, not an isomorphism in `D(B)`: the module half of Tag 08PS,
`CommAlgCat.smallResolutionModuleLeftDerivedLowerShriekNatIso`, identifies the degree `n`
functor `(Lπ_!)_n` with the degree `n` homology of the Moore complex, so the two resolutions of
`B` over `A'` are compared one degree at a time. The source's isomorphism in `D(B)` is
`CommAlgCat.midCotangentComplexDerivedIso` of
`StacksFrontier/Cotangent/PolynomialAlgebraSiteBaseChangeDerived.lean`, which carries the same
hypotheses and is not deduced from this statement — degreewise isomorphisms do not give one in
`D(B)`.
declarations.statement:
def midCotangentComplexHomologyIso
    (hTor : RingTheory.TorIndependence.TorIndependent A A' (B : Type u))
    (hφ : Function.Bijective
      (baseChangeUnit (B' := midAlgebra A' B) (AlgHom.id A (B : Type u))))
    (n : ℕ) :
    (cotangentComplex.{u, u} A B).homology (-(n : ℤ)) ≅
      (cotangentComplex.{u, u} A' (midAlgebra A' B)).homology (-(n : ℤ))
declarations.comment: the cohomology of L_{B/A} and of L_{B/A'} agrees in every degree, as B-modules, under the tag's own hypothesis B = B ⊗_A^𝐋 A' — Tor independence of A' and B over A, and bijectivity of A' ⊗_A B → B. Degreewise rather than in D(B), because the module half of Tag 08PS, which is what compares the two resolutions of B over A', is itself a statement about (Lπ_!)_n and H_n. The tag's own conclusion, an isomorphism in D(B) along the canonical map of Tag 08PN, is `CommAlgCat.midCotangentComplexDerivedIso`

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isZero_cotangentComplex_of_derivedTensor_self
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08R0.** Let `A → B` be a ring map such that `B = B ⊗_A^𝐋 B`, that is,
`Tor_i^A(B, B) = 0` for `i > 0` and the multiplication map `B ⊗_A B → B` is bijective. Then
`L_{B/A} = 0` in `D(B)`.

By [Stacks, Tag 08QZ] for the tower `A → B → B` (`CommAlgCat.midCotangentComplexHomologyIso`),
the cohomology of `L_{B/A}` in each degree `≤ 0` is that of `L_{B/B}`, which vanishes
(`CommAlgCat.isZero_cotangentComplex_self`); in positive degrees `L_{B/A}` is itself zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cotangentComplex_of_derivedTensor_self (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (B : CommAlgCat.{u} A)
    (hTor : RingTheory.TorIndependence.TorIndependent A B B)
    (hmul : Function.Bijective
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' (S := (B : Type u)) A)) :
    Limits.IsZero (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cotangentComplex.{u, u} A B))

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_of_torIndependent_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08R1].** Let `A → B` be a ring map such that `Tor^A_i(B, B) = 0` for `i > 0`
and such that `L_{B/(B ⊗_A B)} = 0`. Then `L_{B/A} = 0` in `D(B)`.

This is `CommAlgCat.isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_of_torIndependent` at the distinguished
triangle of the tower `B → B ⊗_A B → B` that Proposition 08QX,
`CommAlgCat.productFundamentalTriangle_distinguished`, provides.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_of_torIndependent_unconditional
    (hTor : RingTheory.TorIndependence.TorIndependent A B (B : Type u))
    (hCot : IsZero (fundamentalVertex₃.{u, u} (B ⊗[A] B) B)) :
    IsZero (cotangentComplexDerived.{u, u} A (CommAlgCat.of A B))
declarations.comment: the lemma in full: `Tor^A_i(B, B) = 0` for `i > 0` (`hTor`) and `L_{B/(B ⊗_A B)} = 0` (`hCot`) give `L_{B/A} = 0` in `D(B)`. The distinguished triangle of the tower `B → B ⊗_A B → B` is Proposition 08QX, `CommAlgCat.productFundamentalTriangle_distinguished`, which holds for arbitrary ring maps and so covers the surjective multiplication `B ⊗_A B → B`. `hTor` is consumed by Stacks 08QQ (`CommAlgCat.derivedCotangentComplexBaseChangeIso`) in identifying the first vertex of the triangle with `L_{B/A}`, and `hCot` is the vanishing of its third vertex. The `B ⊗_A B`-algebra structure on `B` is the multiplication map, `CommAlgCat.diagonalAlgebra`

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_of_flat_of_bijective
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08R2] item (2).** Let `A → B` be a flat epimorphism of rings. Then
`L_{B/A} = 0` in `D(B)`.

The epimorphism condition is bijectivity of `b ↦ b ⊗ 1 : B → B ⊗_A B`, which is item (3) of
`CommRingCat.epi_tfae`; see the module docstring. Flatness gives `Tor^A_i(B, B) = 0` for `i > 0`,
so `CommAlgCat.cotangentComplexDerived_iso_fundamentalVertex₁_diagonal` identifies `L_{B/A}` with
`L_{(B ⊗_A B)/B} ⊗^𝐋_{(B ⊗_A B)} B`; and `L_{(B ⊗_A B)/B}` vanishes because the structure map
`B → B ⊗_A B` is an isomorphism. No cotangent triangle is used.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_of_flat_of_bijective [Module.Flat A B]
    (h : Function.Bijective (algebraMap B (B ⊗[A] B))) :
    IsZero (cotangentComplexDerived.{u, u} A (CommAlgCat.of A B))
declarations.comment: item (2) of the lemma, a flat epimorphism of rings: `Module.Flat A B` together with bijectivity of `b ↦ b ⊗ 1 : B → B ⊗_A B`, which is item (3) of `CommRingCat.epi_tfae` (Stacks 04VN, proved in this library) and is therefore exactly the source's epimorphism condition. NOTHING is carried: no instance of Proposition 08QX is assumed. Both hypotheses are load-bearing — flatness gives the Tor independence that `CommAlgCat.cotangentComplexDerived_iso_fundamentalVertex₁_diagonal` consumes, and the epimorphism condition is what makes `L_{(B ⊗_A B)/B}` vanish

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_of_isLocalization
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08R2] item (3).** Let `S ⊂ A` be a multiplicative subset and let
`B = S⁻¹A`. Then `L_{B/A} = 0` in `D(B)`.

A localization is flat and an epimorphism, so this is item (2),
`CommAlgCat.isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_of_flat_of_bijective`, through
`CommAlgCat.isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_localization`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_of_isLocalization (S : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization S B] :
    IsZero (cotangentComplexDerived.{u, u} A (CommAlgCat.of A B))
declarations.comment: item (3) of the lemma, `B = S⁻¹A` for a multiplicative subset `S ⊂ A`, read as `IsLocalization S B`. NOTHING is carried: the source derives it from item (2), and so does this proof, through `CommAlgCat.isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_localization`, a localization being flat and an epimorphism. The localization hypothesis is load-bearing, being the only source of both

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_of_unramified_of_flat
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08R2] item (4).** Let `A → B` be unramified and flat. Then `L_{B/A} = 0` in
`D(B)`.

Unramified is Mathlib's `Algebra.Unramified`, formally unramified and of finite type, which is
the source's definition (Stacks 00UT, through 00UU). A flat unramified algebra is weakly étale,
`Algebra.WeaklyEtale.of_formallyUnramified_of_flat`, so this is item (1).
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_of_unramified_of_flat [Algebra.Unramified A B]
    [Module.Flat A B] :
    IsZero (cotangentComplexDerived.{u, u} A (CommAlgCat.of A B))
declarations.comment: item (4) of the lemma, `A → B` unramified and flat: `Algebra.Unramified A B` (formally unramified and of finite type, which is Stacks 00UT by Stacks 00UU) together with `Module.Flat A B`. NOTHING is carried: the source derives it from item (1), and so does this proof — flatness and unramifiedness make the multiplication `B ⊗_A B → B` a localization at an idempotent, hence flat (`Algebra.WeaklyEtale.of_formallyUnramified_of_flat`), and item (1) is `CommAlgCat.isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_of_weaklyEtale_unconditional`, whose triangle is Proposition 08QX. Both hypotheses are load-bearing

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_of_isHenselization_atPrime
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08R2] items (7) and (8).** Let `A` be a ring, `𝔭 ⊂ A` a prime, and let
`A_𝔭 → B` be a henselization of the local ring `A_𝔭` of `A` with residue field a prescribed
extension `κ(𝔭) ⊆ L`. Then `L_{B/A} = 0` in `D(B)`.

At `L = κ(𝔭)` this is item (7), a henselization of a local ring of `A`, and at `L = κ(𝔭)^sep`
it is item (8), a strict henselization. The fundamental triangle of `A → A_𝔭 → B`
(Proposition 08QX) has first vertex `L_{A_𝔭/A} ⊗^𝐋 B = 0` by item (3) and third vertex
`L_{B/A_𝔭} = 0` by the local case
`IsLocalRing.IsHenselization.isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_unconditional`, so its middle vertex
`L_{B/A}` vanishes.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_of_isHenselization_atPrime (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime]
    (L : Type v) [Field L] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)) L]
    [IsLocalRing B] [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) B]
    [IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime p) B]
    [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization (Localization.AtPrime p) L B] :
    IsZero (cotangentComplexDerived.{u, u} A (CommAlgCat.of A B))
declarations.comment: items (7) and (8) of the lemma, at once, for an ARBITRARY ring `A`: `B` a henselization (`L = κ(𝔭)`, item (7)) or a strict henselization (`L = κ(𝔭)^sep`, item (8)) of the local ring `A_𝔭 = Localization.AtPrime 𝔭` of `A`, read as `IsLocalRing.IsHenselization` (Stacks 04GQ) with the `A`-algebra structure on `B` the composite `A → A_𝔭 → B`. NOTHING is carried: the triangle of `A → A_𝔭 → B` is Proposition 08QX, `CommAlgCat.exists_distTriang_fundamentalVertex`; its first vertex vanishes by item (3) and its third by `IsLocalRing.IsHenselization.isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_unconditional`, which is the source's route through items (5) and (6) over the local ring

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_of_weaklyEtale_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08R2] item (1).** Let `A → B` be weakly étale: `A → B` flat and the
multiplication map `B ⊗_A B → B` flat. Then `L_{B/A} = 0` in `D(B)`.

This is `CommAlgCat.isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_of_weaklyEtale` at the distinguished triangle
of the tower `B → B ⊗_A B → B` that Proposition 08QX provides.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_of_weaklyEtale_unconditional [Algebra.WeaklyEtale A B] :
    IsZero (cotangentComplexDerived.{u, u} A (CommAlgCat.of A B))
declarations.comment: item (1) of the lemma, `A → B` weakly étale — `Module.Flat A B` together with flatness of the multiplication map `B ⊗_A B → B`, which is Mathlib's `Algebra.WeaklyEtale`. NOTHING is carried: the distinguished triangle of the tower `B → B ⊗_A B → B` is Proposition 08QX, `CommAlgCat.productFundamentalTriangle_distinguished`. Weak étaleness is NOT dead: `Module.Flat A B` supplies the Tor-independence hypothesis of Stacks 08R1, and flatness of the multiplication map supplies the vanishing of `L_{B/(B ⊗_A B)}` through item (2)

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_of_etale_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08R2] item (5).** If `A → B` is étale then `L_{B/A} = 0` in `D(B)`.

An étale algebra is weakly étale, so this is the instance of item (1).
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_of_etale_unconditional [Algebra.Etale A B] :
    IsZero (cotangentComplexDerived.{u, u} A (CommAlgCat.of A B))
declarations.comment: item (5) of the lemma, `A → B` étale, obtained as the instance of item (1) along Mathlib's instance `Algebra.Etale → Algebra.WeaklyEtale`. NOTHING is carried, as in item (1). Étaleness is load-bearing, being the only source of the two flatness facts item (1) consumes

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.cotangentComplex_isZero_of_filtered_colimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08R2, filtered colimits.** If every map of a filtered system of ring
maps has vanishing relative cotangent complex, so has the map induced on the colimits.
declarations.statement:
theorem cotangentComplex_isZero_of_filtered_colimit
    {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J]
    (A B : J ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (f : A ⟶ B)
    (h : ∀ i : J,
      letI : Algebra (A.obj i) (B.obj i) := (f.app i).hom.toAlgebra
      IsZero (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (cotangentComplex (A.obj i) (CommAlgCat.of (A.obj i) (B.obj i))))) :
    letI : Algebra (colimit A : CommRingCat.{u}) (colimit B : CommRingCat.{u}) :=
      (colim.map f).hom.toAlgebra
    IsZero (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (cotangentComplex (colimit A : CommRingCat.{u})
        (CommAlgCat.of (colimit A : CommRingCat.{u})
          (colimit B : CommRingCat.{u}))))
declarations.comment: item (6) of the lemma, `A → B` a filtered colimit of ring maps for which the cotangent complex vanishes: a filtered system `f : A ⟶ B` of ring maps in `CommRingCat` with `L_{B_i/A_i} = 0` at every stage gives `L_{colim B/colim A} = 0`. NOTHING is carried; the source's route through Stacks 08S9 is followed (the cotangent complexes form a colimit cocone, `CommAlgCat.isColimit_cotangentComplexAbCocone`), after replacing the filtered index category by a cofinal directed order

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.IsHenselization.isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08R2] items (7) and (8).** Let `(R, 𝔪, κ)` be a local ring and let `R → Rh` be
a henselization of `R` with residue field a prescribed extension `κ ⊆ L` of its residue field.
Then `L_{Rh/R} = 0` in `D(Rh)`.

At `L = κ` this is item (7), the henselization `R → R^h`, and at `L = κ^sep` a separable
algebraic closure it is item (8), a strict henselization `R → R^{sh}`. This is
`IsLocalRing.IsHenselization.isZero_cotangentComplexDerived` with its family of diagonal
triangles supplied by `CommAlgCat.hasEtaleDiagonalTriangle`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_unconditional {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (L : Type v) [Field L] [Algebra (ResidueField R) L] {Rh : Type u} [CommRing Rh]
    [IsLocalRing Rh] [Algebra R Rh] [IsHenselization R L Rh] :
    IsZero (cotangentComplexDerived.{u, u} R (CommAlgCat.of R Rh))
declarations.comment: items (7) and (8) of the lemma, at once: `L_{R^h/R} = 0` and `L_{R^{sh}/R} = 0` for `R → Rh` a henselization of the local ring `R` with residue field the prescribed extension `κ ⊆ L` (`IsLocalRing.IsHenselization`, Stacks 04GQ), item (7) being the case `L = κ` and item (8) the case `L = κ^sep`. NOTHING is carried: item (5) needs the distinguished triangle of the diagonal tower `P → P ⊗_R P → P` of every étale stage, and that is Proposition 08QX, `CommAlgCat.productFundamentalTriangle_distinguished`, through `CommAlgCat.hasEtaleDiagonalTriangle`, so it applies at every étale stage of the colimit presentation even though the index category is produced inside the proof. The source's own route is followed: items (5) and (6), the latter being `CommAlgCat.cotangentComplex_isZero_of_filtered_colimit`. The henselization hypothesis is load-bearing through `IsLocalRing.IsHenselization.ind_etale`, which supplies the presentation of `Rh` as a filtered colimit of étale `R`-algebras

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isIso_fundamentalMor₁_of_isZero_fundamentalVertex₃
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08R3.** Let `A → B → C` be ring maps such that `L_{C/B} = 0`. Then
`L_{C/A} = L_{B/A} ⊗^𝐋_B C`: precisely, the first morphism `CommAlgCat.fundamentalMor₁` of the
fundamental triangle, `L_{B/A} ⊗^𝐋_B C ⟶ L_{C/A}` in `D(C)`, is an isomorphism.

Here `L_{C/B} = 0` is `IsZero (CommAlgCat.fundamentalVertex₃ B C)`, the vanishing in `D(C)` of the
cotangent complex of `B → C`. The three rings `A`, `B`, `C` are taken in one universe `Type u`,
as for the triangle of [Stacks, Tag 08QX].

The proof is the source's: the fundamental triangle
`CommAlgCat.productFundamentalTriangle_distinguished` (Proposition 08QX) is distinguished, and a
distinguished triangle with vanishing third vertex has invertible first morphism
(`CommAlgCat.isIso_of_isZero_fundamentalVertex₃`).
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_fundamentalMor₁_of_isZero_fundamentalVertex₃
    (h : IsZero (fundamentalVertex₃.{u, u, u + 1} B C)) :
    IsIso (fundamentalMor₁.{u} A B C)
declarations.comment: the lemma for arbitrary ring maps `A → B → C` with `A`, `B`, `C` in one universe: if `L_{C/B} = 0` in `D(C)` (`IsZero (CommAlgCat.fundamentalVertex₃ B C)`, the cotangent complex of `B → C`), then the first morphism `CommAlgCat.fundamentalMor₁ : L_{B/A} ⊗^𝐋_B C ⟶ L_{C/A}` of the fundamental triangle is an isomorphism, i.e. `L_{C/A} = L_{B/A} ⊗^𝐋_B C`. Proved from the distinguished triangle of Proposition 08QX, `CommAlgCat.productFundamentalTriangle_distinguished`

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.nonempty_fundamentalVertex₁_iso_fundamentalVertex₂_of_isZero_fundamentalVertex₃
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08R3**, as an isomorphism. Let `A → B → C` be ring maps such that
`L_{C/B} = 0`. Then `L_{C/A} = L_{B/A} ⊗^𝐋_B C`, read as an isomorphism
`L_{B/A} ⊗^𝐋_B C ≅ L_{C/A}` in `D(C)` between the first and second vertices of the fundamental
triangle. The rings `A`, `B`, `C` are taken in one universe `Type u`. The isomorphism is the first
morphism of the distinguished triangle of [Stacks, Tag 08QX],
`CommAlgCat.productFundamentalTriangle_distinguished`; see
`CommAlgCat.isIso_fundamentalMor₁_of_isZero_fundamentalVertex₃`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_fundamentalVertex₁_iso_fundamentalVertex₂_of_isZero_fundamentalVertex₃
    (h : IsZero (fundamentalVertex₃.{u, u, u + 1} B C)) :
    Nonempty (fundamentalVertex₁.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} A B C ≅
      fundamentalVertex₂.{u, u, u + 1} A C)
declarations.comment: the lemma for arbitrary ring maps `A → B → C` with `A`, `B`, `C` in one universe: if `L_{C/B} = 0` in `D(C)`, then `L_{C/A} = L_{B/A} ⊗^𝐋_B C`, read as an isomorphism `CommAlgCat.fundamentalVertex₁ A B C ≅ CommAlgCat.fundamentalVertex₂ A C` in `D(C)`. Proved from the distinguished triangle of Proposition 08QX, `CommAlgCat.productFundamentalTriangle_distinguished`

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.nonempty_cotangentComplexDerived_iso_kaehlerDifferential_of_smooth_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08R5]**, in existence form: for a smooth ring map `A → B`,
`L_{B/A} = Ω[B⁄A][0]` in `D(B)`. This is also the covering declaration of the section
**[Stacks, Tag 08R4]**, whose one result is Lemma 08R5.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_cotangentComplexDerived_iso_kaehlerDifferential_of_smooth_unconditional
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra.Smooth A B] :
    Nonempty (cotangentComplexDerived.{u, u} A (CommAlgCat.of A B) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) 0).obj
        (ModuleCat.of B (KaehlerDifferential A B)))
declarations.comment: the SECTION tag `\section{Smooth ring maps}`, covered by its lemma 08R5, stated here in full. The remark opening the section introduces `weakly quasi-regular` surjections `C → B` (kernel `I` with `I/I²` flat over `B` and `Tor_*^C(B, B)` the exterior algebra on `I/I²`) to say what a generalization of Lemma 08R2 from étale to smooth maps would look at; the source then says `For the moment we just stick to smooth ring maps`, so that remark states no result and introduces nothing the section uses

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.cotangentComplexDerivedIsoKaehlerDifferentialOfSmoothUnconditional
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08R5].** For a smooth ring map `A → B`, the identification
`L_{B/A} ≅ Ω[B⁄A][0]` in `D(B)` of the cotangent complex with the module of Kähler
differentials placed in cohomological degree `0`. This is
`CommAlgCat.cotangentComplexDerivedIsoKaehlerDifferentialOfSmooth` with Proposition 08QX
supplied by `CommAlgCat.hasFundamentalTriangle`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cotangentComplexDerivedIsoKaehlerDifferentialOfSmoothUnconditional
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra.Smooth A B] :
    cotangentComplexDerived.{u, u} A (CommAlgCat.of A B) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) 0).obj
        (ModuleCat.of B (KaehlerDifferential A B))
declarations.comment: the lemma in full and as data: for a SMOOTH ring map `A → B` (`Algebra.Smooth A B`, formally smooth and of finite presentation, as in Stacks), the isomorphism `L_{B/A} ≅ Ω[B⁄A][0]` in `D(B)`. No hypothesis beyond smoothness: the fundamental triangle used along the proof is Tag 08QX, `CommAlgCat.productFundamentalTriangle_distinguished`, and the reduction to the standard smooth case is Lemma 00TA through `Algebra.Smooth.exists_span_eq_top_isStandardSmooth` with the localization step of Lemma 08R3, as in the source's proof

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.polynomialAugmentationModuleHom
declarations.doc:
The augmentation `𝒪 → B̲`, read as a map of sheaves of `𝒪`-modules: the target is `B̲` with
its `𝒪`-module structure obtained by restriction of scalars along the augmentation, and the map is
the one sending the unit section of `𝒪` to the unit section of `B̲`.
declarations.statement:
def polynomialAugmentationModuleHom :
    SheafOfModules.unit (polynomialStructureRingSheaf A B) ⟶
      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (polynomialAugmentationRingHom A B)).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit (polynomialConstantRingSheaf A B))
declarations.comment: the augmentation O → B of sheaves of O-modules

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.polynomialAugmentationIdeal
declarations.doc:
The augmentation ideal `𝒥 = ker(𝒪 → B̲)` on the site `C_{B/A}`, a sheaf of `𝒪`-modules. Its
inclusion `𝒥 ⊂ 𝒪` is `CategoryTheory.Limits.kernel.ι`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev polynomialAugmentationIdeal :
    SheafOfModules.{u + 1} (polynomialStructureRingSheaf A B)
declarations.comment: the defining ideal J = ker(O → B)

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isZero_polynomialSiteDerivedLowerShriek_ideal
declarations.doc:
**`Lπ_!(𝒥) = 0` in `D(A)`**, the first assertion of Remark 08R7, at the site `C_{B/A}`
itself, for the augmentation ideal `𝒥 = ker(𝒪 → B̲)` read as a sheaf of `A`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_polynomialSiteDerivedLowerShriek_ideal :
    IsZero ((polynomialSiteModuleDerivedLowerShriek A B (ULift.{u + 1} A)).obj
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj
        (polynomialSiteIdealSheaf A B))))
declarations.comment: Lπ_!(𝒥) = 0 for 𝒥 = ker(𝒪 → B̲), in D(A), at the site C_{B/A} of Tag 08PR itself, with Lπ_! the total left derived functor of the colimit over the site (the π_! of Tag 08PF) and the coefficients at the universe of the site's objects

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.polynomialSiteDerivedLowerShriekCotangentIdealComplexIso
declarations.doc: **`Lπ_!(Ω) = Lπ_!(𝒥 → Ω)`** in `D(A)`, induced by the inclusion `Ω → (𝒥 → Ω)`.
declarations.statement:
def polynomialSiteDerivedLowerShriekCotangentIdealComplexIso :
    (polynomialSiteModuleDerivedLowerShriek A B (ULift.{u + 1} A)).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj
          (polynomialSiteCotangentSheafOverBase A B))) ≅
      (polynomialSiteModuleDerivedLowerShriek A B (ULift.{u + 1} A)).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (polynomialSiteIdealComplex A B))
declarations.comment: Lπ_!(𝒥 → Ω) = Lπ_!(Ω) in D(A), at the site C_{B/A} of Tag 08PR itself, as the isomorphism induced by the inclusion Ω → (𝒥 → Ω) of the degree-zero term

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.polynomialSiteDerivedLowerShriekIdealComplexIso
declarations.doc:
**`Lπ_!(𝒥 → Ω) = L_{B/A}` in `D(A)`**, Remark 08R7, at the site `C_{B/A}` itself: the
two-term complex `𝒥 → Ω` of sheaves of `A`-modules, in degrees `-1, 0`, has `Lπ_!` the cotangent
complex of Tag 08PN.
declarations.statement:
def polynomialSiteDerivedLowerShriekIdealComplexIso :
    (polynomialSiteModuleDerivedLowerShriek A B (ULift.{u + 1} A)).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (polynomialSiteIdealComplex A B)) ≅
      cotangentComplexOverBase A B
declarations.comment: Lπ_!(𝒥 → Ω) = Lπ_!(Ω) = L_{B/A} in D(A), at the site C_{B/A} of Tag 08PR itself, for the two-term complex 𝒥 → Ω in degrees -1, 0, Ω = Ω_{𝒪/A} ⊗_𝒪 B̲, the identification being the inverse of the one induced by Ω → (𝒥 → Ω) followed by Tag 08PU

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.idealComplexToCotangentComplex
declarations.doc:
**The map (08R8) of Remark 08R7**: for an object `U = (P → B)` of `C_{B/A}`, with
`J = ker(P → B)`, the map `(J → Ω_{P/A} ⊗_P B) ⟶ L_{B/A}` in `D(A)`. It is the canonical map
`K(U) ⟶ Lπ_!(K)` of Tag 08Q6 for the two-term complex `K = (𝒥 → Ω)`, followed by
`Lπ_!(𝒥 → Ω) = L_{B/A}`; the two-term complex `J → Ω_{P/A} ⊗_P B` of `A`-modules is the value of
`𝒥 → Ω` at `U`.
declarations.statement:
def idealComplexToCotangentComplex (U : polynomialSite A B) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.doubleNegOneZero
        ((liftModuleFunctor A).map ((polynomialSiteIdealToCotangent A B).app (op U)))) ⟶
      cotangentComplexOverBase A B
declarations.comment: the map (08R8): (J → Ω_{P/A} ⊗_P B) → L_{B/A} in D(A) for every object U = (P → B) of C_{B/A}, J = ker(P → B), as the canonical map of Tag 08Q6 followed by Lπ_!(𝒥 → Ω) = L_{B/A}

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isZero_polynomialSiteConormalHomology_zero
declarations.doc:
**`H₀(C_{B/A}, 𝒥/𝒥²) = 0`**, Remark 08R7, at the site `C_{B/A}` itself:
`H⁰(Lπ_!(𝒥/𝒥²)) = 0` for `𝒥/𝒥² = 𝒥 ⊗_𝒪 B̲ = Tor₀^𝒪(𝒥, B̲)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_polynomialSiteConormalHomology_zero :
    IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ 0).obj
      (polynomialSiteDerivedLowerShriekConormal A B))
declarations.comment: H_0(C_{B/A}, 𝒥/𝒥²) = 0, read as H⁰(Lπ_!(𝒥/𝒥²)) = 0 in D(B) at the site C_{B/A} of Tag 08PR itself, for the B̲-module 𝒥/𝒥² = Tor₀^𝒪(𝒥, B̲) = 𝒥 ⊗_𝒪 B̲

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isZero_polynomialSiteConormalHomology_one
declarations.doc:
**`H₁(C_{B/A}, 𝒥/𝒥²) = 0`**, Remark 08R7, at the site `C_{B/A}` itself:
`H⁻¹(Lπ_!(𝒥/𝒥²)) = 0` for `𝒥/𝒥² = 𝒥 ⊗_𝒪 B̲ = Tor₀^𝒪(𝒥, B̲)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_polynomialSiteConormalHomology_one :
    IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ (-1)).obj
      (polynomialSiteDerivedLowerShriekConormal A B))
declarations.comment: H_1(C_{B/A}, 𝒥/𝒥²) = 0, read as H⁻¹(Lπ_!(𝒥/𝒥²)) = 0 in D(B) at the site C_{B/A} of Tag 08PR itself, for the B̲-module 𝒥/𝒥² = Tor₀^𝒪(𝒥, B̲) = 𝒥 ⊗_𝒪 B̲

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.polynomialSiteTruncGEConormalComplexIso
declarations.doc:
**`τ_{≥ -1} Lπ_!(𝒥/𝒥² → Ω) = τ_{≥ -1} L_{B/A}` in `D(B)`**, Remark 08R7, at the site
`C_{B/A}` itself, for the two-term complex `𝒥/𝒥² → Ω` in degrees `-1, 0`.
declarations.statement:
def polynomialSiteTruncGEConormalComplexIso :
    (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE (-1)).obj
        ((polynomialSiteModuleDerivedLowerShriek A B (ULift.{u + 1} (B : Type u))).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (polynomialSiteConormalComplex A B))) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE (-1)).obj (cotangentComplexLift A B)
declarations.comment: τ_{≥-1} Lπ_!(𝒥/𝒥² → Ω) = τ_{≥-1} L_{B/A} in D(B), at the site C_{B/A} of Tag 08PR itself, for the two-term complex 𝒥/𝒥² → Ω of B̲-modules in degrees -1, 0, 𝒥/𝒥² = Tor₀^𝒪(𝒥, B̲) = 𝒥 ⊗_𝒪 B̲, the identification being induced by Ω → (𝒥/𝒥² → Ω) and Tag 08PU

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.conormalComplexToTruncGECotangentComplex
declarations.doc:
**The map (08R9) of Remark 08R7**: for an object `U = (P → B)` of `C_{B/A}`, with
`J = ker(P → B)`, the map `(J/J² → Ω_{P/A} ⊗_P B) ⟶ τ_{≥ -1} L_{B/A}` in `D(B)`. Its domain is the
value at `U` of the two-term complex `𝒥/𝒥² → Ω`, whose degree `-1` term is `B ⊗_P J`, which is
`J/J²` whenever `P → B` is surjective (`Algebra.Extension.tensorKerEquivCotangent`). The map is
the canonical map `K(U) ⟶ Lπ_!(K)` of Tag 08Q6 for `K = (𝒥/𝒥² → Ω)`, followed by the truncation
and by `τ_{≥ -1} Lπ_!(𝒥/𝒥² → Ω) = τ_{≥ -1} L_{B/A}`.
declarations.statement:
def conormalComplexToTruncGECotangentComplex (U : polynomialSite A B) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.doubleNegOneZero
        ((liftModuleFunctor (B : Type u)).map
          ((polynomialSiteConormalToCotangent A B).app (op U)))) ⟶
      (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE (-1)).obj (cotangentComplexLift A B)
declarations.comment: the map (08R9): (J/J² → Ω_{P/A} ⊗_P B) → τ_{≥-1} L_{B/A} in D(B) for every object U = (P → B) of C_{B/A}, the degree -1 term being the sections B ⊗_P J of 𝒥/𝒥² = 𝒥 ⊗_𝒪 B̲, which are J/J² for surjective P → B, as the canonical map of Tag 08Q6 followed by τ_{≥-1} Lπ_!(𝒥/𝒥² → Ω) = τ_{≥-1} L_{B/A}

declarations.name: Algebra.Extension.naiveComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08R9 (the source of the displayed map).**

The naive cotangent complex `NL(P → B) : J/J² ⟶ Ω[P⁄A] ⊗[P] B` of a presentation, in
cohomological degrees `-1` and `0`.
declarations.statement: public noncomputable def naiveComplex : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} S) ℤ
declarations.comment:
the source complex (J/J² → Ω_{P/A} ⊗_P B) of the displayed map, for a
presentation P → B, in cohomological degrees -1 and 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Cotangent.comparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08R9.** The comparison map

`(J/J² → Ω_{P/A} ⊗_P B) ⟶ τ_{≥ -1} L_{B/A}`

in `D(B)`, at an object `U = (P → B)` of `C_{B/A}` with kernel `J`. It is the evaluation at `U`
of the two-term complex `𝒥/𝒥² → Ω` of Remark 08R7, followed by the identification
`τ_{≥ -1} Lπ_!(𝒥/𝒥² → Ω) = τ_{≥ -1} L_{B/A}` of that remark, both read on the standard
resolution.
declarations.statement:
def comparison (E : Algebra.Extension.{max u v} A ↥B)
    (hP : Algebra.IsPolynomialAlgebra A E.Ring) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.obj (Algebra.Extension.naiveComplex E) ⟶
      (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE (-1)).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cotangentComplex A B))
declarations.comment: the displayed map (J/J² → Ω_{P/A} ⊗_P B) → τ_{≥ -1} L_{B/A} in D(B), at an object (P → B) of C_{B/A}, with the source the two-term complex Algebra.Extension.naiveComplex of that object and the target the degree ≥ -1 truncation of the cotangent complex of Tag 08PN

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.cotangentComplex_isZero_homology_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08RA.** The degree-zero homology of the cotangent complex of a
surjective ring map vanishes: it is the module of Kähler differentials, which is zero.
declarations.statement:
public theorem cotangentComplex_isZero_homology_zero (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (B : CommAlgCat.{max u v} A) (h : Function.Surjective (algebraMap A B)) :
    IsZero ((cotangentComplex A B).homology 0)
declarations.comment: the degree-zero conclusion H⁰(L_{B/A}) = 0

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.cotangentComplex_homologyNegOneIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08RA.** For a surjective ring map `A → B` with kernel `I`, the
degree `-1` homology of the cotangent complex `L_{B/A}` is the conormal module `I/I²`. The
isomorphism is the connecting homomorphism of the short exact sequence
`0 → I/I² → J•/J•² → Ω[P•⁄A] ⊗[P•] B → 0` of simplicial modules, which is the sequence used in
the Stacks proof.
declarations.comment:
the degree-minus-one conclusion H⁻¹(L_{B/A}) = I/I², with I/I² the conormal
module of the presentation A → B, the isomorphism being the connecting homomorphism of the
short exact sequence 0 → I/I² → J•/J•² → Ω[P•⁄A] ⊗[P•] B → 0 of the Stacks proof

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.cotangentComplexHomologyNegOneIsoComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08RA.** For a surjective ring map `A → B` with kernel `I`, the
identification `H^{-1}(L_{B/A}) ≅ I/I²` *induced by the comparison map of Tag 08R9 at the object
`(A → B)` of `C_{B/A}`* — which is the identification the source's statement names.

Read from right to left it is: the conormal module `I/I²` is the degree `-1` cohomology of the
two-term complex `NL(A → B)`, that cohomology is carried into `H^{-1}(τ_{≥ -1} L_{B/A})` by the
comparison map, and `τ_{≥ -1}` changes no cohomology in degree `-1`.
declarations.comment:
the degree-minus-one conclusion H⁻¹(L_{B/A}) = I/I², with the isomorphism the one
induced by the comparison map of Tag 08R9 at the object (A → B) of C_{B/A}, which is the
identification the source's statement names

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.cotangentComplexHomologyZeroIsoNaive
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08RB, degree zero.** The degree-zero cohomology of the cotangent complex `L_{B/A}`
agrees with the degree-zero cohomology of the naive cotangent complex `NL_{B/A}`; both are
`Ω[B⁄A]`, by the augmentation of the standard resolution on one side and by
`Algebra.Extension.toKaehler` on the other.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cotangentComplexHomologyZeroIsoNaive :
    (cotangentComplex A B).homology 0 ≅ ModuleCat.of ↥B (naiveHomologyZero A B)
declarations.comment: degree zero: H⁰(L_{B/A}) = H⁰(NL_{B/A})

declarations.name: Stacks.Cotangent.isIso_comparisonAtNaive
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08RB.** For a ring map `A → B`, the canonical map
`c : NL_{B/A} → τ_{≥ -1} L_{B/A}` of Tag 08R9 at the canonical presentation `A[B] → B` is an
isomorphism in `D(B)`: the truncation `τ_{≥ -1} L_{B/A}` is canonically quasi-isomorphic to the
naive cotangent complex.
declarations.statement: theorem isIso_comparisonAtNaive : IsIso (comparisonAtNaive A B)
declarations.comment: the canonical map c : NL_{B/A} → τ_{≥ -1} L_{B/A} of Tag 08R9, at the canonical presentation A[B] → B, is an isomorphism in D(B)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cotangent.naiveComparisonIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08RB.** The isomorphism `NL_{B/A} ≅ τ_{≥ -1} L_{B/A}` in `D(B)`, with the naive
cotangent complex the two-term complex `I/I² → Ω_{A[B]/A} ⊗_{A[B]} B` of the canonical
presentation; its underlying map is the canonical map `c` of Tag 08R9.
declarations.statement:
def naiveComparisonIso :
    DerivedCategory.Q.obj (Algebra.Extension.naiveComplex (conormalExtension A B (op ⦋0⦌))) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE (-1)).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cotangentComplex A B))
declarations.comment: the isomorphism NL_{B/A} ≅ τ_{≥ -1} L_{B/A} in D(B) whose underlying map is the canonical map c of Tag 08R9

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.isZero_leftDerivedColim_symmetricPowerDiagram_of_lt
declarations.doc:
Let `C` be a small category with the chaotic topology, let `B` be a commutative ring and let
`F` be a `B̲`-module on `C` — that is, a diagram `F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat B`, every presheaf being
a sheaf for the chaotic topology — which is flat, meaning that every module of sections is flat.
Assume `C` carries a cosimplicial object `U_•` which is a point resolution, as in Tag 08Q9, and
that `H_0(C, F) = 0`. Then `H_l(C, Sym^k_{B̲}(F)) = 0` for every `l < k`.

Here `H_l(C, -) = L_lπ_!` is the `l`th left derived functor of the colimit over `Cᵒᵖ`, as in
Tag 08PF, read at linear coefficients.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_leftDerivedColim_symmetricPowerDiagram_of_lt
    (C : Type u) [SmallCategory C] (B : Type u) [CommRing B]
    (U : CosimplicialObject C) (hU : IsPointResolution U)
    (F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} B) (hF : ∀ X, Module.Flat B (F.obj X))
    (h₀ : IsZero (((colim : (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} B) ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} B).leftDerived 0).obj F))
    (k l : ℕ) (hl : l < k) :
    IsZero (((colim : (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} B) ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} B).leftDerived l).obj
      (symmetricPowerDiagram C B F k))
declarations.comment: No hypothesis beyond the source statement: C is any small category, H_l(C, -) is L_l of the colimit over Cᵒᵖ at linear coefficients, which is Tag 08PF's definition of the homology of a category, the B-module F on the chaotic site is the diagram F, flat means that every module of sections is flat, Sym^k is the sectionwise symmetric power, U is a point resolution as in Tag 08Q9, and the induction on k over the Koszul resolution is carried out in full for every k. The Künneth input of the source proof, the Eilenberg-Zilber comparison of Tag 08QD, is replaced by the weaker vanishing statement `StacksDraft.SimplicialTensor.isZero_homology_tensor_of_lt`, which is proved here.

declarations.name: MvPolynomial.tor_map_variableIdeal_pow_succ_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Tag 08RE.** Let `P = A[E]` be a polynomial ring and let `I` be the ideal generated by its
variables.  For any `P`-module on which `I` acts as zero -- equivalently, for any module over
the coefficient ring, pulled back along the augmentation -- the inclusion `I ^ (n + 1) ⊆ I ^ n`
induces the zero map on `Tor_i^P` in every degree.
declarations.statement:
theorem tor_map_variableIdeal_pow_succ_eq_zero
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (E : Type v) (i n : ℕ)
    (M : ModuleCat.{max u v} (MvPolynomial E A))
    (hM : ∀ r ∈ (Ideal.span (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : E → MvPolynomial E A)) :
        Ideal (MvPolynomial E A)), ∀ m : M, r • m = 0) :
    ((Tor (ModuleCat.{max u v} (MvPolynomial E A)) i).obj M).map
        (ModuleCat.ofHom
          (Submodule.inclusion
            (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ n) :
              (Ideal.span (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : E → MvPolynomial E A)) ^ (n + 1) :
                  Ideal (MvPolynomial E A)) ≤
                Ideal.span (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X : E → MvPolynomial E A)) ^ n))) = 0

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.quillenSpectralSequence_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08RF (Quillen spectral sequence).** Let `A → B` be a surjective ring map and
`Ω = Ω_{𝒪/A} ⊗_𝒪 B̲` on the polynomial site `C_{B/A}`.  Then

* there is a cohomological spectral sequence of `B`-modules `(E_r)_{r ≥ 1}`, with `d_r` of
  bidegree `(r, -r + 1)`, first page `E₁^{p,q} ≅ H_{-p-q}(C_{B/A}, Sym^p_{B̲}(Ω))` (and `0` for
  `p < 0`), converging to `Tor^A_{-p-q}(B, B)`: it has an infinity page at every bidegree, and
  each `Tor^A_{-n}(B, B)` carries a finite decreasing filtration with
  `E_∞^{p, n - p} ≅ F^p/F^{p+1}`; and
* `H_i(C_{B/A}, Sym^k_{B̲}(Ω)) = 0` for `i < k`.

The first conjunct is `CommAlgCat.QuillenSpectralSequenceData A B` inhabited, the datum being
`CommAlgCat.quillenSpectralSequenceDataOfSurjective`; the second is stated on the same entries
`CommAlgCat.symmetricPowerSiteHomology` the first page is identified with.
declarations.statement:
theorem quillenSpectralSequence_of_surjective
    (h : Function.Surjective (algebraMap A (B : Type u))) :
    Nonempty (QuillenSpectralSequenceData A B) ∧
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (i : ℤ), i < k → IsZero (symmetricPowerSiteHomology A B k i)
declarations.comment: whole theorem, for a surjective A → B: the spectral sequence exists as a CohomologicalSpectralSequence of B-modules starting at page 1, so d_r has bidegree (r, -r + 1) by definition of that type; its first page is identified with E₁^{p,q} = H_{-p-q}(C_{B/A}, Sym^p_{B̲}(Ω)) (pageOneIso, zero for p < 0 by pageOne_isZero); it converges to Tor^A_{-p-q}(B, B) in the sense of SpectralSequence.AbutsTo: an infinity page at every bidegree and, on each Tor^A_{-n}(B, B), a finite decreasing filtration whose graded pieces are the infinity-page terms. The second conjunct is the final vanishing H_i(C_{B/A}, Sym^k_{B̲}(Ω)) = 0 for i < k. H_i(C_{B/A}, -) is L_i colim over the opposite of the small model of the polynomial site (Tag 08PF), extended by zero to i < 0; Tor^A_i(B, B) is the i-th left derived functor of B ⊗_A - at B. The sequence is that of the filtered complex C = Ō(U_•) on the standard point resolution, filtered by τ^{≤ -p}(𝒦^p(U_•)), whose cohomology is Lπ_!(Ō) = B ⊗^L_A B; every input (𝒦ⁿ/𝒦ⁿ⁺¹ = Sym^n(Ω), the footnote vanishing H_i(C_{B/A}, 𝒦ⁿ) = 0 for i < n via Tags 08RE, 068F, 08QJ, 08Q2) is proved.

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isZero_lowerShriekZero_polynomialCotangentSheaf_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08RF**, the final vanishing in the case `k = 1`. For a surjective ring map `A → B`
the zeroth homology of the sheaf of base-changed differentials on the polynomial site vanishes,
because it is `H⁰(L_{B/A}) = Ω[B⁄A]` and `Ω[B⁄A] = 0` for a surjection.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_lowerShriekZero_polynomialCotangentSheaf_of_surjective
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap A ↥B)) :
    IsZero ((Stacks.ChaoticSite.pointSections.{u, u + 1, u} AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
      (((Stacks.ChaoticSite.abelianPointLowerShriek
            (smallBoundedPolynomialSite A B
              (standardResolutionVarCardinal A B))).leftDerived 0).obj
        (smallPolynomialCotangentSheaf A B (standardResolutionVarCardinal A B))))
declarations.comment: the final vanishing H_i(C_{B/A}, Symᵏ(Ω)) = 0 for i < k, in the case k = 1, where Sym¹(Ω) = Ω: for a surjective A → B the sections at the point of L₀π_!(Ω_{𝒪/A} ⊗_𝒪 B̲) vanish. As in Tag 08PU, Lπ_! is read degreewise at abelian coefficients on the small model of the footnote-restricted site. The same vanishing for every k, at linear coefficients, is CommAlgCat.isZero_leftDerivedColim_symmetricPower_polynomialCotangent_of_surjective

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isZero_leftDerivedColim_symmetricPower_polynomialCotangent_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08RF, the final vanishing, for every `k`.** For a surjective ring map `A → B` and
the sheaf `Ω = Ω_{𝒪/A} ⊗_𝒪 B̲` on the polynomial site `C_{B/A}`,

`H_i(C_{B/A}, Symᵏ_{B̲}(Ω)) = 0` for `i < k`.

The source's proof: `Ω` is flat and `H₀(C_{B/A}, Ω) = π_!(Ω) = Ω_{B/A} = 0` because `A → B` is
surjective, and Tag 08RD gives the vanishing from those two facts.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_leftDerivedColim_symmetricPower_polynomialCotangent_of_surjective
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap A (B : Type u))) (k l : ℕ) (hl : l < k) :
    IsZero (((colim :
          ((smallBoundedPolynomialSite A B (standardResolutionVarCardinal A B))ᵒᵖ ⥤
            ModuleCat.{u} B) ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} B).leftDerived l).obj
      (Stacks.ChaoticSite.symmetricPowerDiagram
        (smallBoundedPolynomialSite A B (standardResolutionVarCardinal A B)) (B : Type u)
        (smallPolynomialCotangentModulePresheaf A B (standardResolutionVarCardinal A B)) k))
declarations.comment: the final vanishing H_i(C_{B/A}, Symᵏ_{B̲}(Ω)) = 0 for i < k, for EVERY k, where Symᵏ is the sectionwise symmetric power, which is the sheaf symmetric power because the topology of C_{B/A} is chaotic. H_i(C_{B/A}, -) is L_i of the colimit over the opposite of the small model of the footnote-restricted site at linear coefficients, which is Tag 08PF's definition of the homology of a category. The proof is the source's: Ω is a flat B̲-module because each Ω[P⁄A] is free over P, π_!(Ω) = Ω_{B/A} = 0 for a surjective A → B, and Tag 08RD turns those into the vanishing. No hypothesis beyond the source's surjectivity of A → B

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.pageOneDisplay_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08RG**, the `E₁`-page display, for a surjective ring map `A → B` with kernel `I`:
every entry of the displayed array

```
B
0
0   I/I²
0   H^{-2}(L_{B/A})
0   H^{-3}(L_{B/A})   ∧²(I/I²)
0   H^{-4}(L_{B/A})   H_3(C_{B/A}, Sym²(Ω))
0   H^{-5}(L_{B/A})   H_4(C_{B/A}, Sym²(Ω))   ∧³(I/I²)
```

is the module the remark displays there.  The array is `E₁^{p,q} = H_{-p-q}(C_{B/A}, Sym^p(Ω))`
of Theorem 08RF, `p` along the columns and `q` down the rows from `q = 0`, so the six conjuncts
below are, in order:

* the entries strictly below the antidiagonal `p + q = 0` vanish — those are the positions the
  display leaves blank beyond the triangle, where the homological degree `-p - q` is negative;
* the entries strictly above the diagonal `-p - q = p` vanish — the blanks inside the triangle,
  by the final clause of Theorem 08RF;
* the top entry of the column `p = 0` is `B`;
* the rest of the column `p = 0` vanishes — together with the previous two conjuncts this is the
  column `B, 0, 0, …` the display opens with;
* the column `p = 1` is `H^{-i}(L_{B/A})` in homological degree `i`, which at `i = 1`, the
  position `(1, -2)`, is the `I/I²` of the third row by the remark's opening clause;
* the diagonal entry at `(p, -2p)` is `∧^p_B(I/I²)`, by the remark's second clause.

The entries strictly inside the triangle with `p ≥ 2` — `H_3(C_{B/A}, Sym²(Ω))` and
`H_4(C_{B/A}, Sym²(Ω))` in the display — are left as they stand, exactly as the remark leaves
them.

"With horizontal differential" is Theorem 08RF's own clause that `d_r` has bidegree
`(r, -r + 1)`, at `r = 1`; it holds by definition of `CohomologicalSpectralSequence _ 1`, which
is the type of `CommAlgCat.QuillenSpectralSequenceData.sequence`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pageOneDisplay_of_surjective (h : Function.Surjective (algebraMap A (B : Type u))) :
    (∀ (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ), 0 < (p : ℤ) + q → IsZero (pageOneDisplayEntry A B p q)) ∧
      (∀ (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ), -(p : ℤ) - q < p → IsZero (pageOneDisplayEntry A B p q)) ∧
      Nonempty (pageOneDisplayEntry A B 0 0 ≅ ModuleCat.of (B : Type u) (B : Type u)) ∧
      (∀ q : ℤ, q < 0 → IsZero (pageOneDisplayEntry A B 0 q)) ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, Nonempty (pageOneDisplayEntry A B 1 (-1 - (i : ℤ)) ≅
          (cotangentComplex.{u, u} A B).homology (-(i : ℤ)))) ∧
      (∀ p : ℕ, Nonempty (pageOneDisplayEntry A B p (-2 * (p : ℤ)) ≅
          ModuleCat.of (B : Type u)
            (⋀[(B : Type u)]^p (surjectionExtension.{u, u} A B h).Cotangent)))
declarations.comment: the E₁-page display, for a surjective A → B with I = ker(A → B): every entry of the displayed array is identified. The array is E₁^{p,q} = H_{-p-q}(C_{B/A}, Sym^p_{B̲}(Ω)), which is Theorem 08RF's own identification of the first page, read here as the ℕ × ℤ-indexed family CommAlgCat.pageOneDisplayEntry with p along the columns and q down the rows from q = 0; H_i(C_{B/A}, -) = L_i colim over the opposite of the small model of the footnote-restricted site at linear coefficients is Tag 08PF's definition of the homology of a category, and Sym^p_{B̲} is the sectionwise symmetric power, which is the sheaf symmetric power because the topology of C_{B/A} is chaotic.
