declarations.statement:
theorem fundamentalTriangle_of_injective (hf : Function.Injective (algebraMap B C)) :
    (∀ n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ,
      letI : Algebra ((standardResolution A (CommAlgCat.of A B)).left.obj n)
          ((standardResolution A (CommAlgCat.of A C)).left.obj n) :=
        (((standardResolutionFunctor A).map (towerHom A B C)).left.app n).hom.toAlgebra
      IsPolynomialAlgebra ((standardResolution A (CommAlgCat.of A B)).left.obj n)
        (CommAlgCat.of ((standardResolution A (CommAlgCat.of A B)).left.obj n)
          ((standardResolution A (CommAlgCat.of A C)).left.obj n))) ∧
    @IsResolution ↥(CommAlgCat.of A B) (CommAlgCat.of A B).commRing
      ↥(algebraOver (towerHom A B C)) (algebraOver (towerHom A B C)).commRing
      (algebraOver (towerHom A B C)).algebra
      (baseChangedStandardResolution A (towerHom A B C)).left
      (baseChangedStandardResolution A (towerHom A B C)).hom ∧
    (cotangentDifferentialComplexes A (towerHom A B C)).ShortExact ∧
    Nonempty (cotangentTriangle A (towerHom A B C)
        (show Function.Injective (towerHom A B C).hom from hf) ≅
      Triangle.mk (fundamentalMor₁.{u} A B C) (fundamentalMor₂.{u} A B C)
        (fundamentalMor₃ A B C hf)) ∧
    Triangle.mk (fundamentalMor₁.{u} A B C) (fundamentalMor₂.{u} A B C)
        (fundamentalMor₃ A B C hf) ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} C))
declarations.comment: the first paragraph of the remark, for `A → B → C` with `B → C` injective: `Q_n` is polynomial over `P_n`; `Q̄_• = Q_• ⊗_{P_•} B` is a resolution of `C` over `B`; the sequence of differentials is short exact; and its triangle is the fundamental triangle, with the canonical first two morphisms, on the vertices `L_{B/A} ⊗^𝐋_B C`, `L_{C/A}`, `L_{C/B}`

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.fundamentalTriangle_of_productDescent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Remark 08SD, second paragraph.** Let `A → B → C` be arbitrary ring maps.
Then `B → B × C`, `b ↦ (b, f b)`, is injective, so the first paragraph gives the fundamental
triangle of `A → B → B × C`; its base change along the flat ring map `B × C → C` is a
distinguished triangle in `D(C)`, and by Tag 08SC it is isomorphic to the fundamental triangle
`L_{B/A} ⊗^𝐋_B C → L_{C/A} → L_{C/B} → (L_{B/A} ⊗^𝐋_B C)[1]` with its canonical first two
morphisms, which is therefore distinguished.
declarations.statement:
theorem fundamentalTriangle_of_productDescent :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap B (B × C)) ∧
    productDescentTriangle A B C ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} C)) ∧
    Nonempty (productDescentTriangle A B C ≅
      Triangle.mk (fundamentalMor₁.{u} A B C) (fundamentalMor₂.{u} A B C)
        (productFundamentalMor₃ A B C)) ∧
    Triangle.mk (fundamentalMor₁.{u} A B C) (fundamentalMor₂.{u} A B C)
        (productFundamentalMor₃ A B C) ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} C))
declarations.comment: the second paragraph of the remark, for arbitrary `A → B → C`: `B → B × C` is injective, the base change along the flat `B × C → C` of the fundamental triangle of `A → B → B × C` is distinguished in `D(C)` and, by Tag 08SC, isomorphic to the fundamental triangle of `A → B → C` with its canonical first two morphisms

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.exists_distinguished_derivedBaseChange_cotangentTriangle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08SD, with the derived base change as first vertex.**

For an injective map `f : B ⟶ C` of `A`-algebras there is a distinguished triangle in
`D(ModuleCat C)`
`L_{B/A} ⊗ᴸ_B C → L_{C/A} → (third vertex of CommAlgCat.cotangentTriangle) → (L_{B/A} ⊗ᴸ_B C)[1]`
whose first vertex is literally the derived base change of `L_{B/A}` along `f`, whose second
vertex is `L_{C/A}` and whose third vertex is the third vertex of
`CommAlgCat.cotangentTriangle`, the complex of the base-changed relative differentials.

This statement leaves the third vertex as the complex of base-changed relative differentials. Its
identification with `L_{C/B}`, and the passage to arbitrary `A → B → C` through `B × C` and Tag
08SC, are the two paragraphs of Remark 08SD stated whole in
`StacksFrontier/Cotangent/Triangle/BaseChangedResolutionTriangle.lean`:
`CommAlgCat.fundamentalTriangle_of_injective` and
`CommAlgCat.fundamentalTriangle_of_productDescent`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_distinguished_derivedBaseChange_cotangentTriangle (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    {B C : CommAlgCat.{max u v} A} [HasDerivedCategory.{wB} (ModuleCat.{max u v} B)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wC} (ModuleCat.{max u v} C)]
    (f : B ⟶ C) (hf : Function.Injective f.hom) :
    ∃ (α : (CochainComplex.DerivedExtensionScalars.derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral
            f.hom.toRingHom).functor.obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cotangentComplex.{u, v} A B)) ⟶
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cotangentComplex.{u, v} A C))
      (β : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cotangentComplex.{u, v} A C) ⟶
        (cotangentTriangle A f hf).obj₃)
      (δ : (cotangentTriangle A f hf).obj₃ ⟶
        ((CochainComplex.DerivedExtensionScalars.derivedExtensionScalarsGeneral
            f.hom.toRingHom).functor.obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cotangentComplex.{u, v} A B)))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk α β δ ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} C))
declarations.comment: differential_sequence triangle, derived first vertex

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.standardResolutionDifferentialSequence
declarations.doc: The specific canonical differential short complex for `A → B → C`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def standardResolutionDifferentialSequence
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] {B C : CommAlgCat.{max u v} A} (f : B ⟶ C) :
    DifferentialSequenceData A f
declarations.comment: differential_sequence construction

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.standardResolution_differentials_shortExact
declarations.doc: The canonical differential complex is short exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem standardResolution_differentials_shortExact
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] {B C : CommAlgCat.{max u v} A} (f : B ⟶ C)
    (hf : Function.Injective f.hom) :
    (standardResolutionDifferentialSequence A f).complex.ShortExact
declarations.comment: differential_sequence

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.standardResolution_differentials_firstMap
declarations.doc: The first map sends a differential to the differential of its image.
declarations.statement:
theorem standardResolution_differentials_firstMap
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] {B C : CommAlgCat.{max u v} A} (f : B ⟶ C)
    (n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ) (p : (standardResolution A B).left.obj n) :
    let D := standardResolutionDifferentialSequence A f
    ((D.firstIso.inv.app n) ≫ (D.complex.f.app n) ≫ (D.secondIso.hom.app n))
      ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[B] cotangentTermDifferential A B n p) =
      cotangentTermDifferential A C n
        (((standardResolutionFunctor A).map f).left.app n p)
declarations.comment: differential_sequence first map

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.standardResolution_differentials_secondMap
declarations.doc: The second map is the canonical map to base-changed relative differentials.
declarations.statement:
theorem standardResolution_differentials_secondMap
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] {B C : CommAlgCat.{max u v} A} (f : B ⟶ C)
    (n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ) (q : (standardResolution A C).left.obj n) :
    let D := standardResolutionDifferentialSequence A f
    let R := baseChangedStandardResolution A f
    let T := R.left.obj n
    letI : Algebra T C := ((R.hom.app n).hom.toRingHom).toAlgebra
    ((D.secondIso.inv.app n) ≫ (D.complex.g.app n) ≫ (D.thirdIso n).hom)
      (cotangentTermDifferential A C n q) =
      ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[T] KaehlerDifferential.D B T (D.toBaseChange n q))
declarations.comment: differential_sequence second map

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.standardResolution_differentials_third_naturality
declarations.doc: The identification of the third term respects every simplicial map.
declarations.statement:
theorem standardResolution_differentials_third_naturality
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] {B C : CommAlgCat.{max u v} A} (f : B ⟶ C)
    {i j : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ} (h : i ⟶ j)
    (t : (baseChangedStandardResolution A f).left.obj
      i) :
    let D := standardResolutionDifferentialSequence A f
    let R := baseChangedStandardResolution A f
    let Ti := R.left.obj i
    let Tj := R.left.obj j
    letI : Algebra Ti C := ((R.hom.app i).hom.toRingHom).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra Tj C := ((R.hom.app j).hom.toRingHom).toAlgebra
    ((D.thirdIso i).inv ≫ D.complex.X₃.map h ≫ (D.thirdIso j).hom)
      ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[Ti] KaehlerDifferential.D B Ti t) =
      ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[Tj] KaehlerDifferential.D B Tj (R.left.map h t))
declarations.comment: differential_sequence naturality

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.standardResolution_differentials_pushout
declarations.doc: The map to the base-changed resolution is its canonical pushout leg.
declarations.statement:
theorem standardResolution_differentials_pushout
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] {B C : CommAlgCat.{max u v} A} (f : B ⟶ C)
    (n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ) :
    let D := standardResolutionDifferentialSequence A f
    let R := baseChangedStandardResolution A f
    CategoryTheory.IsPushout
      (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (((standardResolutionFunctor A).map f).left.app n).hom.toRingHom)
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (standardResolutionAugmentationHom A B n))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (D.toBaseChange n))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (R.left.obj n)))
declarations.comment: differential_sequence base change

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.standardResolution_differentials_toBaseChange_naturality
declarations.doc: The pushout leg is simplicially natural.
declarations.statement:
theorem standardResolution_differentials_toBaseChange_naturality
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] {B C : CommAlgCat.{max u v} A} (f : B ⟶ C)
    {i j : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ} (h : i ⟶ j)
    (q : (standardResolution A C).left.obj i) :
    let D := standardResolutionDifferentialSequence A f
    let R := baseChangedStandardResolution A f
    R.left.map h (D.toBaseChange i q) =
      D.toBaseChange j ((standardResolution A C).left.map h q)
declarations.comment: differential_sequence base change naturality

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.standardResolution_differentials_toBaseChange_augmentation
declarations.doc: The pushout leg is compatible with augmentation to `C`.
declarations.statement:
theorem standardResolution_differentials_toBaseChange_augmentation
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] {B C : CommAlgCat.{max u v} A} (f : B ⟶ C)
    (n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ) :
    let D := standardResolutionDifferentialSequence A f
    let R := baseChangedStandardResolution A f
    ((R.hom.app n).hom.toRingHom).comp (D.toBaseChange n) =
      standardResolutionAugmentationHom A C n
declarations.comment: differential_sequence augmentation

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.cotangentDifferentialComplexes_shortExact
declarations.doc:
For an injective map `f : B ⟶ C` of `A`-algebras, the differential short complex of cochain
complexes of `C`-modules is short exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem cotangentDifferentialComplexes_shortExact (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    {B C : CommAlgCat.{max u v} A} (f : B ⟶ C) (hf : Function.Injective f.hom) :
    (cotangentDifferentialComplexes A f).ShortExact
declarations.comment: differential_sequence complexes

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.cotangentTriangle
declarations.doc:
The triangle in `D(ModuleCat C)` attached to the differential short exact sequence of the
standard resolutions of `A → B → C`, for `f : B ⟶ C` injective.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cotangentTriangle (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    {B C : CommAlgCat.{max u v} A} [HasDerivedCategory.{t} (ModuleCat.{max u v} C)]
    (f : B ⟶ C) (hf : Function.Injective f.hom) :
    Triangle (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} C))
declarations.comment: differential_sequence triangle

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.cotangentTriangle_distinguished
declarations.doc: The triangle attached to the differential sequence is distinguished.
declarations.statement:
theorem cotangentTriangle_distinguished (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    {B C : CommAlgCat.{max u v} A} [HasDerivedCategory.{t} (ModuleCat.{max u v} C)]
    (f : B ⟶ C) (hf : Function.Injective f.hom) :
    cotangentTriangle A f hf ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} C))
declarations.comment: differential_sequence triangle distinguished

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.relativeBaseChangeLeg
declarations.doc:
**The canonical map `R_• ⟶ R̄_•`** of Remark 08SE: degreewise the pushout leg out of the
standard resolution of `C` over `B`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def relativeBaseChangeLeg (f : B ⟶ C) :
    (standardResolution ↥B (algebraOver f)).left ⟶ (relativeBaseChange f).left
declarations.comment: the first arrow of the comparison, R_bullet ⟶ R_bullet ⊗_{S_bullet} B

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.standardResolutionSquareMap_baseRingSquare_comm
declarations.doc:
**The commutative diagram of Remark 08SE.** The square

```
Q_•  ⟶  R_•
 ↑        ↑
P_•  ⟶  S_•
```

commutes, the vertical maps being the functoriality of the standard resolution in the algebra and
the horizontal ones the change of base ring from `A` to `B`.
declarations.statement:
theorem standardResolutionSquareMap_baseRingSquare_comm (f : B ⟶ C) (n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ) :
    (standardResolutionSquareMap.{u, u, u} (baseRingSquareTop f) n).comp
        ((((standardResolutionFunctor.{u, u} A).map f).left.app n).hom.toRingHom) =
      ((((standardResolutionFunctor.{u, u} ↥B).map (overBase f)).left.app n).hom.toRingHom).comp
        (standardResolutionSquareMap.{u, u, u} (baseRingSquareBot B) n)
declarations.comment: the commutative diagram of standard resolutions from which the canonical map Q_bullet ⊗_{P_bullet} B ⟶ R_bullet ⊗_{S_bullet} B is obtained

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.baseChangedComparison
declarations.doc:
**The canonical map `Q̄_• ⟶ R̄_•`** of Remark 08SE, obtained from the commutative diagram of
standard resolutions by the pushout property of `Q̄_•`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def baseChangedComparison (f : B ⟶ C) :
    (baseChangedStandardResolution A f).left ⟶ (relativeBaseChange f).left
declarations.comment: the canonical map Q_bullet ⊗_{P_bullet} B ⟶ R_bullet ⊗_{S_bullet} B obtained from the commutative diagram

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.baseChangedStandardResolution_isPolynomialAlgebra
declarations.doc:
**Every term of the base-changed standard resolution `Q̄_• = Q_• ⊗_{P_•} B` is a polynomial
algebra over `B`, when `B → C` is injective.**

This is the elementary half of the "key fact" of Tag 08SD. Injectivity enters through the
polynomiality of Tag 08SD, `CommAlgCat.standardResolution_isPolynomialAlgebra`, which presents
`Q_n` as a polynomial algebra over `P_n`; the base change of that presentation along the
augmentation `P_n → B` presents `Q̄_n` as a polynomial algebra over `B` on the same variables.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChangedStandardResolution_isPolynomialAlgebra (f : B ⟶ C)
    (hf : Function.Injective f.hom) (n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ) :
    IsPolynomialAlgebra ↥B ((baseChangedStandardResolution A f).left.obj n)
declarations.comment: the degreewise polynomiality of a base-changed standard resolution, applied in the remark both to Q_bullet ⊗_{P_bullet} B and to R_bullet ⊗_{S_bullet} B; this is where the injectivity of B → C is used

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.relativeBaseChange_isPolynomialAlgebra
declarations.doc:
**Every term of `R̄_• = R_• ⊗_{S_•} B` is a polynomial algebra over `B`**, when `B → C` is
injective: the functoriality map `S_• → R_•` presents `R_n` as a polynomial algebra over `S_n`, so
this is `CommAlgCat.baseChangedStandardResolution_isPolynomialAlgebra` at the base ring `B`.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeBaseChange_isPolynomialAlgebra (f : B ⟶ C) (hf : Function.Injective f.hom)
    (n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ) :
    IsPolynomialAlgebra ↥B ((relativeBaseChange f).left.obj n)
declarations.comment: R_bullet ⊗_{S_bullet} B is a simplicial polynomial algebra over B, because B → C is injective

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.relativeBaseChangeCotangentLeg
declarations.doc:
**The first arrow of the comparison of Remark 08SE**, the map
`L_{C/B} = Ω[R_•⁄B] ⊗_{R_•} C ⟶ Ω[R̄_•⁄B] ⊗_{R̄_•} C` induced by `R_• ⟶ R̄_•`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def relativeBaseChangeCotangentLeg (f : B ⟶ C) :
    cotangentComplex ↥B (algebraOver f) ⟶
      augmentedCotangentCochainComplex (relativeBaseChange f).hom
declarations.comment: the induced map L_{C/B} = Omega[R_bullet/B] ⊗ C ⟶ Omega[R_bullet ⊗_{S_bullet} B / B] ⊗ C

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.baseChangedCotangentComparison
declarations.doc:
**The second arrow of the comparison of Remark 08SE**, the map
`Ω[Q̄_•⁄B] ⊗_{Q̄_•} C ⟶ Ω[R̄_•⁄B] ⊗_{R̄_•} C` induced by `Q̄_• ⟶ R̄_•`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def baseChangedCotangentComparison (f : B ⟶ C) :
    augmentedCotangentCochainComplex (baseChangedStandardResolution A f).hom ⟶
      augmentedCotangentCochainComplex (relativeBaseChange f).hom
declarations.comment: the induced map Omega[Q_bullet ⊗_{P_bullet} B / B] ⊗ C ⟶ Omega[R_bullet ⊗_{S_bullet} B / B] ⊗ C

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isResolution_relativeBaseChange_of_injective
declarations.doc:
**`R̄_• = R_• ⊗_{S_•} B` is a resolution of `C` over `B`** when `B → C` is injective: each
`R̄_n` is a polynomial algebra over `B` and the augmentation `R̄_• → C` is a trivial Kan
fibration. `R̄_•` is the base-changed standard resolution at the base ring `B` and the map
`CommAlgCat.overBase f`, so this is
`CommAlgCat.isResolution_baseChangedStandardResolution_of_injective` there.
declarations.statement:
theorem isResolution_relativeBaseChange_of_injective (f : B ⟶ C)
    (hf : Function.Injective f.hom) :
    @IsResolution ↥B B.commRing ↥(relativeBaseChange f).right
      (relativeBaseChange f).right.commRing (relativeBaseChange f).right.algebra
      (relativeBaseChange f).left (relativeBaseChange f).hom
declarations.comment: R_bullet ⊗_{S_bullet} B is a simplicial polynomial algebra over B and R_bullet ⊗_{S_bullet} B → C is a resolution, for B → C injective

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isIso_q_relativeBaseChangeCotangentLeg_of_injective
declarations.doc:
**The first map of Remark 08SE is a quasi-isomorphism**:
`L_{C/B} = Ω[R_•⁄B] ⊗_{R_•} C ⟶ Ω[R̄_•⁄B] ⊗_{R̄_•} C` becomes an isomorphism in `D(C)` for
`B → C` injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_q_relativeBaseChangeCotangentLeg_of_injective (f : B ⟶ C)
    (hf : Function.Injective f.hom) :
    IsIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map (relativeBaseChangeCotangentLeg f))
declarations.comment: the map L_{C/B} = Omega[R_bullet/B] ⊗ C ⟶ Omega[R_bullet ⊗_{S_bullet} B / B] ⊗ C is a quasi-isomorphism, for B → C injective

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isIso_q_baseChangedCotangentComparison_of_injective
declarations.doc:
**The second map of Remark 08SE is a quasi-isomorphism**:
`Ω[Q̄_•⁄B] ⊗_{Q̄_•} C ⟶ Ω[R̄_•⁄B] ⊗_{R̄_•} C` becomes an isomorphism in `D(C)` for `B → C`
injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_q_baseChangedCotangentComparison_of_injective (f : B ⟶ C)
    (hf : Function.Injective f.hom) :
    IsIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map (baseChangedCotangentComparison f))
declarations.comment: the map Omega[Q_bullet ⊗_{P_bullet} B / B] ⊗ C ⟶ Omega[R_bullet ⊗_{S_bullet} B / B] ⊗ C is a quasi-isomorphism, for B → C injective

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.baseChangedCotangentComplexIsoOfInjective_hom_comp
declarations.doc:
**The identification of Remark 08SE is the second map composed with the inverse of the
first**: followed by the first map it is the second.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChangedCotangentComplexIsoOfInjective_hom_comp (f : B ⟶ C)
    (hf : Function.Injective f.hom) :
    (baseChangedCotangentComplexIsoOfInjective f hf).hom ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (relativeBaseChangeCotangentLeg f) =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (baseChangedCotangentComparison f)
declarations.comment: the identification composed with the first map of the comparison is the second, for B → C injective

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.eq_baseChangedCotangentComplexIsoOfInjective
declarations.doc:
**The identification of Remark 08SE is canonical**: it is the only isomorphism
`Ω[Q̄_•⁄B] ⊗_{Q̄_•} C ≅ L_{C/B}` in `D(C)` whose composite with the first map of the comparison is
the second.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_baseChangedCotangentComplexIsoOfInjective (f : B ⟶ C)
    (hf : Function.Injective f.hom)
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (augmentedCotangentCochainComplex (baseChangedStandardResolution A f).hom) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cotangentComplex ↥B (algebraOver f)))
    (he : e.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (relativeBaseChangeCotangentLeg f) =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (baseChangedCotangentComparison f)) :
    e = baseChangedCotangentComplexIsoOfInjective f hf
declarations.comment: uniqueness of the identification: every isomorphism whose composite with the first map of the comparison is the second equals it, for B → C injective

registrations.name: CommAlgCat.baseChangedCotangentComplexIsoOfInjective
registrations.comment: the canonical identification of Omega[Q_bullet ⊗_{P_bullet} B / B] ⊗ C with L_{C/B} = Omega[R_bullet/B] ⊗ C in D(C), for B → C injective: the second map of the comparison followed by the inverse of the first

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.nonempty_cotangentComplexDerivedBaseChange_iso_localization_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08SF].** Let `A → B` be a ring map and let `S ⊆ A` and `T ⊆ B` be
multiplicative subsets such that `S` maps into `T`. Then

`L_{T⁻¹B/S⁻¹A} = L_{B/A} ⊗^𝐋_B T⁻¹B`

in `D(T⁻¹B)`.

This is `CommAlgCat.nonempty_cotangentComplexDerivedBaseChange_iso_localization` applied to the
distinguished triangle of the tower `A → B → T⁻¹B` from Proposition 08QX,
`CommAlgCat.exists_distTriang_fundamentalVertex`. Every other input is proved as well:
`L_{T⁻¹B/B} = 0` is `CommAlgCat.isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_localization`, and
`L_{T⁻¹B/A} ≅ L_{T⁻¹B/S⁻¹A}` is
`CommAlgCat.nonempty_cotangentComplexDerived_iso_localizationBase`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_cotangentComplexDerivedBaseChange_iso_localization_unconditional
    (hST : ∀ s ∈ S, algebraMap A B s ∈ T) :
    Nonempty (cotangentComplexDerivedBaseChange.{u, u} A (CommAlgCat.of A B) B' ≅
      cotangentComplexDerived.{u, u} A' (CommAlgCat.of A' B'))
declarations.comment: the lemma in full, with NOTHING carried. The distinguished fundamental triangle of the tower `A → B → T⁻¹B` is Proposition 08QX, `CommAlgCat.productFundamentalTriangle_distinguished`. Everything else is proved outright too: `L_{T⁻¹B/B} = 0` is `isZero_cotangentComplexDerived_localization` from Tag 08R2 item (2), and `L_{T⁻¹B/A} ≅ L_{T⁻¹B/S⁻¹A}` is `nonempty_cotangentComplexDerived_iso_localizationBase` from Tag 08QQ at the identity base change, at the localization square. The source's equality is read as an isomorphism in D(T⁻¹B) without naming the arrow, as Tag 08R3 and Tag 08QQ do, no canonical arrow being available to pin. All four rings are in a single universe, which is the generality of Tag 08QQ

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.nonempty_extendScalars_cotangentComplex_iso_localization
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 08SF], with the base change read degreewise.** Let `A → B` be a ring map and
let `S ⊆ A` and `T ⊆ B` be multiplicative subsets such that `S` maps into `T`. Then

`L_{T⁻¹B/S⁻¹A} = L_{B/A} ⊗_B T⁻¹B`

in `D(T⁻¹B)`, where the right-hand side is the *degreewise* extension of scalars along
`B → T⁻¹B` — which is the tensor product the source writes.

This is `CommAlgCat.nonempty_cotangentComplexDerivedBaseChange_iso_localization_unconditional`
composed with the identification of the derived base change of `L_{B/A}` with the degreewise
one, `CommAlgCat.nonempty_derivedExtensionScalars_cotangentComplex_iso`. That identification
needs no hypothesis on `B → T⁻¹B`: `L_{B/A}` is a complex of free `B`-modules vanishing in
positive degrees, so it already computes its own derived base change.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_extendScalars_cotangentComplex_iso_localization
    (hST : ∀ s ∈ S, algebraMap A B s ∈ T) :
    Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cotangentComplex A' (CommAlgCat.of A' B')) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((CochainComplex.extendScalarsLarge.{0, u, u}
        (algebraMap B B')).obj (cotangentComplex A (CommAlgCat.of A B))))
declarations.comment: the lemma in full, with NOTHING carried, reading the source's `⊗_B T⁻¹B` as the DEGREEWISE extension of scalars along `B → T⁻¹B` — which is the tensor product the source writes, the derived reading being `nonempty_cotangentComplexDerivedBaseChange_iso_localization_unconditional`. The two differ only by `nonempty_derivedExtensionScalars_cotangentComplex_iso`, which identifies the derived base change of `L_{B/A}` with the degreewise one and assumes nothing of `B → T⁻¹B`, `L_{B/A}` being a complex of free `B`-modules vanishing in positive degrees. The source's equality is read as an isomorphism in D(T⁻¹B) without naming the arrow, as Tag 08R3 and Tag 08QQ do, no canonical arrow being available to pin. All four rings are in a single universe, which is the generality of Tag 08QQ

declarations.name: Stacks.ChaoticSite.nonempty_linearEquiv_leftDerivedColim_symmetricPowerDiagram
declarations.doc:
Let `C` be a small category with the chaotic topology, let `B` be a
commutative ring and let `F` be a flat `B̲`-module on `C` — a diagram `F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat B`,
every presheaf being a sheaf for the chaotic topology, flat meaning that every module of
sections is flat — with `H_0(C, F) = 0`, and let `U_•` be a cosimplicial object of `C` which is a
point resolution as in Tag 08Q9. Then

`H_k(C, Sym^k_{B̲}(F)) ≅ ∧^k_B(H_1(C, F))`

for every `k`, where `H_l(C, -) = L_lπ_!` is the `l`th left derived functor of the colimit over
`Cᵒᵖ` read at linear coefficients, which is the definition of the homology of a category in
Tag 08PF.

No hypothesis is placed on `B`: in particular `2` need not be invertible.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_linearEquiv_leftDerivedColim_symmetricPowerDiagram
    (C : Type u) [SmallCategory C] (B : Type u) [CommRing B]
    (U : CosimplicialObject C) (hU : IsPointResolution U)
    (F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} B) (hF : ∀ X, Module.Flat B (F.obj X))
    (h₀ : IsZero (((colim : (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} B) ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} B).leftDerived 0).obj F))
    (k : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (↥(((colim : (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} B) ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} B).leftDerived k).obj
        (symmetricPowerDiagram C B F k)) ≃ₗ[B]
      ⋀[B]^k ↥(((colim : (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} B) ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} B).leftDerived 1).obj F))
declarations.comment: H_k(C, Sym^k_{B̲}(F)) = ∧^k_B(H_1(C, F)) over an arbitrary commutative ring B, with no invertibility hypothesis on 2: C is any small category with the chaotic topology, H_l(C, -) is L_l of the colimit over Cᵒᵖ at linear coefficients, which is Tag 08PF's definition of the homology of a category, the flat B-module F on the chaotic site is the diagram F, flat meaning that every module of sections is flat, Sym^k is the sectionwise symmetric power, and U is a point resolution as in Tag 08Q9. The remark's own route through the sign-twisted S_k-coinvariants of H_1(C, F)^{⊗ k} is a proof erratum: that intermediate step is FALSE for the coefficient ring ℤ, which is the theorem Stacks.ChaoticSite.not_quillenSignedCoinvariants_int, refuted at the polynomial site of the surjection ℤ[x] → ℤ with k = 2. The proof here is Illusie's and Quillen's décalage, run at the Moore complex of F(U_•) over the relative Koszul resolution of Sym^k by the acyclic terms ∧^p W ⊗ Sym^{k-p} D attached to the reduced décalage D and W = ker(D → F(U_•)).

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.nonempty_cotangentComplex_retraction_iso_single_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08SI.** Let `B` be a polynomial algebra over `A` with an augmentation
`B → A`, and let `I` be its kernel. Then `L_{A/B}` is isomorphic in `D(A)` to `I/I²` placed in
cohomological degree `-1`.

This is `CommAlgCat.nonempty_cotangentComplex_retraction_iso_single` with the fundamental
triangle of the tower `A → B → A` supplied by `CommAlgCat.hasFundamentalTriangleAt`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_cotangentComplex_retraction_iso_single_unconditional
    (hB : Algebra.IsPolynomialAlgebra A B) :
    Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cotangentComplex B (CommAlgCat.of B A)) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} ↥(CommAlgCat.of B A)) (-1)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of ↥(CommAlgCat.of B A)
          (surjectionExtension B (CommAlgCat.of B A)
            (surjective_algebraMap_of_isScalarTower_self A B)).Cotangent))
declarations.comment: the lemma for a general base ring A and a general polynomial algebra B over it with an augmentation B → A (the letters A and B are swapped relative to the source): the source's map Z[x_1,...,x_n] -> Z sending every x_i to 0 is the case A = Z, B = Z[x_1,...,x_n], spelled out as `CommAlgCat.nonempty_cotangentComplex_mvPolynomial_int_iso_single`, which also proves that the kernel of that map is the source's ideal I = (x_1,...,x_n); I/I^2 is the conormal module of the augmentation. NOTHING is carried: the triangle the source's proof invokes is Proposition 08QX for the tower A -> B -> A, `CommAlgCat.productFundamentalTriangle_distinguished`, which holds for arbitrary ring maps — the triangle of Tag 08SD needs the middle map injective, whereas the augmentation B → A is surjective, so it is the proposition and not Tag 08SD that applies

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.nonempty_cotangentComplex_iso_single_of_isKoszulRegular_sequence_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08SJ.** Let `R → S` be a surjective map of commutative rings whose
kernel `I` is generated by a Koszul-regular sequence `f₁, …, f_r ∈ R`. Then `L_{S/R}` is
isomorphic in `D(S)` to the conormal module `I/I²` placed in cohomological degree `-1`.

This is `CommAlgCat.nonempty_cotangentComplex_iso_single_of_isKoszulRegular_sequence` with the
fundamental triangles of the towers `R → P → R` supplied by
`CommAlgCat.hasFundamentalTriangleAt`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_cotangentComplex_iso_single_of_isKoszulRegular_sequence_unconditional
    (h : Function.Surjective (algebraMap R (S : Type u)))
    {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → R) (hf : Koszul.IsKoszulRegular f)
    (hI : RingHom.ker (algebraMap R (S : Type u)) = Ideal.span (Set.range f)) :
    Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cotangentComplex R S) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} (S : Type u)) (-1)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of (S : Type u) (surjectionExtension R S h).Cotangent))
declarations.comment: the full statement, under exactly the source's hypotheses: for a surjective ring map R -> S whose kernel I is generated by a Koszul-regular sequence f_1,...,f_r (Tag 062E (3), `Koszul.IsKoszulRegular`), L_{S/R} is isomorphic in D(S) to I/I^2 placed in cohomological degree -1. I/I^2 is the conormal module of the surjection, as the cotangent module of the corresponding algebra extension. The fundamental triangle of the towers R -> P -> R used by the proof is Proposition 08QX, `CommAlgCat.productFundamentalTriangle_distinguished`, read through `CommAlgCat.hasFundamentalTriangleAt`

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.nonempty_cotangentComplex_iso_single_of_isKoszulRegular_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08SK.** Let `A → B` be a surjective map of commutative rings whose
kernel `I` is a Koszul-regular ideal, Tag 07CV (2). Then `L_{B/A}` is quasi-isomorphic to
`I/I²[1]`, that is, isomorphic in `D(B)` to the conormal module `I/I²` placed in cohomological
degree `-1`.

The proof is the source's: locally on `Spec(A)` the ideal `I` is generated by a Koszul-regular
sequence, so [Stacks, Tag 08SJ] at the localizations `A_g → B_g` and the localization lemma
[Stacks, Tag 08SF] give `H^i(L_{B/A}) = 0` for `i ≤ -2`, whence the identification with
`I/I²[1]`. It is `CommAlgCat.nonempty_cotangentComplex_iso_single_of_isKoszulRegular` with its two
inputs supplied by `CommAlgCat.hasLocalizedCotangentComplexAt` (Tag 08SF) and
`CommAlgCat.hasFundamentalTriangleAt` (Proposition 08QX), so the hypotheses are the source's
own two.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_cotangentComplex_iso_single_of_isKoszulRegular_unconditional
    (h : Function.Surjective (algebraMap A (B : Type u)))
    (hI : Ideal.IsKoszulRegular (RingHom.ker (algebraMap A (B : Type u)))) :
    Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cotangentComplex A B) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} (B : Type u)) (-1)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of (B : Type u) (surjectionExtension A B h).Cotangent))
declarations.comment: the lemma in full: A -> B surjective with kernel I a Koszul-regular ideal (Tag 07CV (2), `Ideal.IsKoszulRegular`: at every prime containing I, some principal localization A_g has I A_g generated by a Koszul-regular sequence). The conclusion is an isomorphism in D(B) between L_{B/A} (the cotangent complex of the standard resolution, Tag 08PN) and I/I^2 placed in cohomological degree -1, that is I/I^2[1]; I/I^2 is the conormal module of the surjection, as the cotangent module of the corresponding algebra extension. NOTHING is carried: the hypotheses are the source's two. The localization lemma Tag 08SF is proved at every principal localization A_g -> B_g by `CommAlgCat.hasLocalizedCotangentComplexAt`, from `CommAlgCat.nonempty_extendScalars_cotangentComplex_iso_localization`; Proposition 08QX at the towers A_g -> P -> A_g that Tag 08SJ uses is `CommAlgCat.hasFundamentalTriangleAt`, from `CommAlgCat.productFundamentalTriangle_distinguished`. Everything else is proved outright: the Koszul cover generates the unit ideal, the localized map is surjective with kernel the localized ideal, Tag 08SJ at it, the flatness of B -> B_g, and the Zariski descent of the vanishing of H^i(L_{B/A}) for i <= -2

declarations.name: CommAlgCat.isPerfect_and_hasTorAmplitude_cotangentComplexDerived_of_isLCI
declarations.doc:
If `A → B` is a local complete intersection map, then the cotangent complex `L_{B/A}` is a
perfect object of `D(B)` with Tor amplitude in `[-1, 0]`.

Choose a finite polynomial presentation `P = A[x₁, …, x_n] → B`. The
naive complex `NL(P → B) = (J/J² → ⨁ B dxᵢ)` consists of finite projective modules, by Tag 08RK,
`CommAlgCat.isPerfect_and_hasTorAmplitude_cotangentComplexDerived_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection`;
and `L_{B/A}` is isomorphic to it in `D(B)`
(`CommAlgCat.cotangentComplexDerivedIsoNaiveComplexOfIsLocalCompleteIntersection`): by Tag 08RB
`NL(P → B) ≅ τ_{≥ -1} L_{B/A}`, and by the fundamental triangle 08QS of `A → P → B` together with
Tags 08QH and 08SK, `H^i(L_{B/A}) = 0` for `i ≤ -2`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_and_hasTorAmplitude_cotangentComplexDerived_of_isLCI
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (B : CommAlgCat.{u} A)
    (hlci : RingHom.IsLocalCompleteIntersection (algebraMap A ↥B)) :
    StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect (cotangentComplexDerived.{u, u} A B) ∧
      StacksDraft.TorAmplitude.HasTorAmplitudeCanonical ↥B
        (cotangentComplexDerived.{u, u} A B) (-1) 0
declarations.comment: the full proposition: if A → B is a local complete intersection (RingHom.IsLocalCompleteIntersection, Tag 07D0), then L_{B/A} is a perfect object of D(B) (Tag 0657 (1)) with Tor amplitude in [-1, 0] (Tag 0652 (1), canonical derived tensor product). The isomorphism of L_{B/A} with the naive complex of a finite polynomial presentation is constructed here from Tag 08RB (Stacks.Cotangent.naiveComparisonIso), the fundamental triangle of A → P → B (Proposition 08QX), Tag 08QH and Tag 08SK

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.SquareZeroExtensionProblem.CompatibleExtension
declarations.doc:
A solution of a square-zero extension problem.

The map `toB` and its kernel give the exact upper row
`0 → N → B' → B → 0`; `kernelEquiv` supplies the displayed identification
with `N`, and `map_I` says that the left square is the prescribed map `c`.
declarations.statement: public structure CompatibleExtension (S : SquareZeroExtensionProblem)
declarations.comment: the same extension problem diagram

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.SquareZeroExtensionProblem.isoFittingMapEquiv
declarations.doc:
The automorphisms of a solution of a square-zero extension problem which induce the identity
on `B` and on `N` are exactly the maps filling the diagram comparing the problem with itself.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def isoFittingMapEquiv (X : S.CompatibleExtension.{w}) :
    CompatibleExtension.Iso X X ≃ (comparisonDiagram X X).FittingMap
declarations.comment: automorphisms are the fitting maps of the self-comparison diagram

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.SquareZeroExtensionProblem.automorphismsExtEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08SP**, part (3). For a solution `B'` of a square-zero extension problem, the
automorphisms of `B'` inducing the identity on `B` and on `N` are canonically
`Ext⁰_B(L_{B/A}, N)`.

The equivalence carries the identity automorphism to `0` and composition to addition, so it is
an isomorphism of groups, and the class attached to `f` is the one whose associated differential
map sends `d (b' mod N)` to `f(b') - b'`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def automorphismsExtEquiv (X : S.CompatibleExtension.{w}) :
    {e : CompatibleExtension.Iso X X ≃ S.cotangentExt 0 //
      e (CompatibleExtension.Iso.refl X) = 0 ∧
      (∀ f g : CompatibleExtension.Iso X X, e (f.trans g) = e f + e g) ∧
      ∀ (f : CompatibleExtension.Iso X X) (b' : X.B'),
        ((X.kernelEquiv (S.cotangentExtZeroToHom (e f)
            (KaehlerDifferential.D S.A S.B (X.toB b'))) :
          RingHom.ker X.toB.toRingHom) : X.B') = f.toAlgEquiv b' - b'}
declarations.comment: automorphisms

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.SquareZeroExtensionProblem.cotangentObstructionClass_eq_zero_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08SP**, part (1). The class `ξ ∈ Ext²_B(L_{B/A}, N)` vanishes if and only if the
square-zero extension problem has a solution.
declarations.statement:
theorem cotangentObstructionClass_eq_zero_iff :
    S.cotangentObstructionClass = 0 ↔ Nonempty (S.CompatibleExtension.{u})
declarations.comment: (1): there is a class in Ext²_B(L_{B/A}, N) whose vanishing is necessary and sufficient for the existence of a solution

declarations.name: Stacks.Deformation.SquareZeroExtensionProblem.isomorphismClassesCotangentTorsor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08SP**, part (2). If the square-zero extension problem has a solution, its set of
isomorphism classes of solutions is a principal homogeneous space under `Ext¹_B(L_{B/A}, N)`.

The action is that of Tag 08S7 under `Ext¹_B(NL_{B/A}, N)`, read through the identification
`Ext¹_B(NL_{B/A}, N) = Ext¹_B(L_{B/A}, N)` of `cotangentExtOneEquiv`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def isomorphismClassesCotangentTorsor
    (h : Nonempty (S.CompatibleExtension.{w})) :
    AddTorsor (S.cotangentExt 1)
      (CompatibleExtension.IsomorphismClasses.{u₁, u₂, max u₂ v, u₄, w} S)
declarations.comment: (2): if a solution exists, the isomorphism classes of solutions form a principal homogeneous space under Ext¹_B(L_{B/A}, N)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.standardResolution
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08SR.** The standard resolution of a morphism `A ⟶ B` of sheaves of commutative
rings is the augmentation obtained by evaluating the free-forgetful standard resolution at the
`A`-algebra `B`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def standardResolution {A B : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v w}} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    SimplicialObject.Augmented (Under A)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.cotangentSimplicialModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08SS.** The canonical simplicial sheaf of `B`-modules `Ω_{P_•/A} ⊗_{P_•} B` of the
standard resolution.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def cotangentSimplicialModule : CotangentSimplicialModuleData J f
declarations.comment: the simplicial module

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.cotangentComplex
declarations.doc: **Stacks 08SS.** The cotangent complex of a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def cotangentComplex : CochainComplex (targetModules J B) ℤ
declarations.comment: the associated complex

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.cotangentComplexDerived
declarations.doc: **Stacks 08SS.** The cotangent complex regarded as an object of the derived category.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev cotangentComplexDerived [HasDerivedCategory.{t} (targetModules J B)] :
    DerivedCategory (targetModules J B)
declarations.comment: the derived object

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.cotangentComplex_isZero_pos
declarations.doc: **Stacks 08SS.** The cotangent complex is zero in positive cohomological degrees.
declarations.statement:
theorem cotangentComplex_isZero_pos (m : ℤ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    IsZero ((cotangentComplex J f).X m)
declarations.comment: the positive-degree terms

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.cotangentComplex_d
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08SS.** The differential is the alternating sum of the face maps, transported
through the canonical degree isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem cotangentComplex_d (n : ℕ) :
    (cotangentComplex J f).d (-((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-(n : ℤ)) =
      (cotangentComplex_degreeIso J f (n + 1)).hom ≫
        AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingFaceMapComplex.objD
          (cotangentSimplicialModule J f).object n ≫
      (cotangentComplex_degreeIso J f n).inv
declarations.comment: the differential

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.cotangentComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08SU.** The cotangent complex `L_f = L_{𝒪_C/f⁻¹𝒪_D}` of a morphism of ringed
topoi `(f, f♯) : (Sh(C), 𝒪_C) ⟶ (Sh(D), 𝒪_D)`: the cotangent complex of the inverse-image
form `f⁻¹𝒪_D ⟶ 𝒪_C` of its structure map.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cotangentComplex :
    CochainComplex (Sheaf.targetModules.{u, v, w} X.J X.O) ℤ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.cotangentComplexDerived
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08SU.** The cotangent complex of a morphism of ringed topoi, regarded as an object
of the derived category of sheaves of `𝒪_C`-modules.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev cotangentComplexDerived
    [HasDerivedCategory.{t} (Sheaf.targetModules.{u, v, w} X.J X.O)] :
    DerivedCategory (Sheaf.targetModules.{u, v, w} X.J X.O)
declarations.comment: the derived object

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.inverseImageCotangentComplexIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08SV.** The inverse image of the cotangent complex of a homomorphism of sheaves of
commutative rings along a morphism of topoi is the cotangent complex of its inverse image:
`f⁻¹L_{B/A} = L_{f⁻¹B/f⁻¹A}`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def inverseImageCotangentComplexIso :
    ((inverseImageTargetModules.{u, v, w, u', v', w'} J K f).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (cotangentComplex.{u', v', w'} K a) ≅
      cotangentComplex.{u, v, w} J (f.inverseImageRing.map a)
declarations.comment:
for an arbitrary morphism of topoi, with the object, arrow and section universes
of the two sites independent

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.sectionwiseCotangentCohomology
declarations.doc:
**The sectionwise cotangent cohomology presheaf** `U ↦ H^i(L_{B(U)/A(U)})`: the cotangent
cohomology groups of the ring maps on sections, with the maps induced by the restriction
squares as restriction maps.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def sectionwiseCotangentCohomology (i : ℤ) : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w}
declarations.comment: the presheaf U ↦ H^i(L_{B(U)/A(U)}); not its sheafification

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.cohomologySheafification
declarations.doc:
For a homomorphism `A ⟶ B` of sheaves of commutative rings on a site, the cohomology sheaf
`H^i(L_{B/A})` of the cotangent complex is the sheaf associated to the presheaf
`U ↦ H^i(L_{B(U)/A(U)})` formed from the cotangent complexes of the ring maps on sections.

The presheaf is `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.sectionwiseCotangentCohomology`, whose sections over `U`
are `H^i(L_{B(U)/A(U)})` by `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.sectionwiseCotangentCohomology_obj` and whose
restriction maps are those of the restriction squares; the sheafification is taken in abelian
sheaves, and `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.cohomologySheafIso` is the same identification before the
module structure over `B` is forgotten. The identification is the canonical one: it comes from
`CategoryTheory.Sheaf.sectionwiseComplexIso`, which by
`CategoryTheory.Sheaf.sectionwiseComplexIso_hom_unit` is induced by the canonical comparison maps
`L_{B(U)/A(U)} ⟶ L_{B/A}(U)` of Remark 08SX.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cohomologySheafification (i : ℤ) :
    (presheafToSheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w}).obj (sectionwiseCotangentCohomology J f i) ≅
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf.{u, v, max u v w} B)).obj
        ((cotangentComplex J f).homology i)
declarations.comment: the whole lemma: the sheaf associated to the presheaf U ↦ H^i(L_{B(U)/A(U)}) is H^i(L_{B/A}), by the canonical identification — `sectionwiseComplexIso`, which `sectionwiseComplexIso_hom_unit` shows is induced by the comparison maps L_{B(U)/A(U)} ⟶ L_{B/A}(U) of Remark 08SX. CARRIES NOTHING beyond the ambient variables: arbitrary site, arbitrary Grothendieck topology, arbitrary homomorphism of sheaves of commutative rings, every i, with the section universe a free parameter. The module-level form, before the structure over B is forgotten, is `cohomologySheafIso`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.sectionsCotangentComplexComparison_restriction_degree
declarations.doc:
In each cohomological degree `j`, the canonical maps `L_{B(U)/A(U)} ⟶ L_{B/A}(U)` commute
with the restriction maps along `g : U ⟶ V`.
declarations.statement:
theorem sectionsCotangentComplexComparison_restriction_degree {U V : Cᵒᵖ} (g : U ⟶ V) (j : ℤ) :
    (sectionsCotangentComplexComparison J f U).f j ≫
        ((cotangentComplex J f).X j).val.map g =
      (CommAlgCat.squareCotangentComplexMap.{max u v w, max u v w, max u v w}
          (sectionsRestrictionSquare J f g)).f j ≫
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (sectionsRestrictionSquare J f g).map).map
          ((sectionsCotangentComplexComparison J f V).f j)
declarations.comment: CLAUSE (2), the compatibility with the restriction maps of the site, in every cohomological degree. Remark 08SX makes three assertions: that for every U there is a canonical map L_{B(U)/A(U)} ⟶ L_{B/A}(U), that these maps are compatible with the restriction maps, and that L_{B/A} is the sheafification of U ↦ L_{B(U)/A(U)}. The first is `sectionsCotangentComplexComparison`, whose attribute records that only that clause is claimed and that this one needs naturality in U of `sectionsComonadLax`, hence of `resolutionSectionsComparison` — which is what is proved here, as `resolutionSectionsComparison_restriction_square`, and propagated to the complex. CARRIES NOTHING beyond the ambient variables of the comparison itself: arbitrary site, arbitrary Grothendieck topology, arbitrary morphism of sheaves of commutative rings, arbitrary g. No sheaf-condition, smallness or site hypothesis is added, because the proof is a variables-to-variables induction over the standard resolution tower. The SHEAFIFICATION clause (3) is not claimed here; it is `sectionwiseComplexIso` of `StacksFrontier/Cotangent/SheavesOfRings/SectionwiseCotangentComplexIso.lean`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.sectionsCotangentComplexComparison
declarations.doc:
The canonical map `L_{B(U)/A(U)} ⟶ L_{B/A}(U)` of complexes of `B(U)`-modules: the comparison
of standard resolutions, base-changed on differentials, pushed through the alternating-face-map
complex and through the reindexing which places simplicial degree `n` in cohomological degree
`-n`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def sectionsCotangentComplexComparison (U : Cᵒᵖ) :
    CommAlgCat.cotangentComplex.{max u v w, max u v w} (A.obj.obj U)
        (sectionsAlgebra J f U) ⟶
      ((moduleSections J f U).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (cotangentComplex J f)
declarations.comment: the canonical map L_{B(U)/A(U)} ⟶ L_{B/A}(U); not the sheafification clause

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.isIso_sheafify_sectionwiseCotangentTermComparison
declarations.doc:
In every degree `j`, the term of the cotangent complex `L_{B/A}` of a homomorphism of sheaves
of rings is the sheafification of the presheaf of `B`-modules `U ↦ L^j_{B(U)/A(U)}` of the terms of
the cotangent complexes of the ring maps on sections, along the canonical maps
`L_{B(U)/A(U)} ⟶ L_{B/A}(U)`: the adjunct of the canonical map out of the sheafification is an
isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_sheafify_sectionwiseCotangentTermComparison (j : ℤ) :
    IsIso ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationHomEquiv.{max u v w}
      (𝟙 (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf.{u, v, max u v w} B).obj)).symm
        (sectionwiseCotangentTermComparison J f j))
declarations.comment: the third assertion, in each degree and in sheaves of B-modules: the degree-j term of L_{B/A} is the sheafification of the presheaf of B-modules U ↦ L^j_{B(U)/A(U)} along the canonical maps of the first assertion

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.sheafifiedSectionwiseCotangentComplexIso
declarations.doc:
The cotangent complex `L_{B/A}` of a homomorphism of sheaves of rings is the sheafification of
the rule `U ↦ L_{B(U)/A(U)}`: the sheafification of the presheaf of complexes of abelian groups
`U ↦ L_{B(U)/A(U)}` is isomorphic to `L_{B/A}`, by the canonical maps followed by the counit of
sheafification.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def sheafifiedSectionwiseCotangentComplexIso :
    ((presheafToSheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w}).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (sectionwiseCotangentPresheafComplex J f) ≅ cotangentComplexAb J f
declarations.comment: the third assertion: L_{B/A} is the sheafification of U ↦ L_{B(U)/A(U)}, the sheafification of the presheaf of complexes of abelian groups U ↦ L_{B(U)/A(U)} being isomorphic to L_{B/A} along the canonical maps of the first assertion; degreewise, in sheaves of B-modules, this is isIso_sheafify_sectionwiseCotangentTermComparison

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.prodCotangentComparison
declarations.doc:
The canonical comparison map `L_{B ⨯ B'/A} ⟶ L_{B/A} ⊕ L_{B'/A}` of complexes of sheaves of
`B ⨯ B'`-modules: the pairing of the two maps of cotangent complexes induced by the two projection
squares, each summand read over `B ⨯ B'` by restriction of scalars along the corresponding
projection.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def prodCotangentComparison :
    cotangentComplex.{u, v, w} J (prodRingHom J f f') ⟶ prodCotangentSum J f f'
declarations.comment: the comparison map

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.prodCotangentComparisonDerived
declarations.doc:
The comparison map `L_{B ⨯ B'/A} ⟶ L_{B/A} ⊕ L_{B'/A}` read in the derived category
`D(B ⨯ B')`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev prodCotangentComparisonDerived
    [HasDerivedCategory.{t} (targetModules.{u, v, w} J (B ⨯ B'))] :
    cotangentComplexDerived.{u, v, w, t} J (prodRingHom J f f') ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj (prodCotangentSum J f f')
declarations.comment: the comparison map in the derived category

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.isIso_prodCotangentComparisonDerived
declarations.doc:
Let `C` be a site and let `A ⟶ B`, `A ⟶ B'` be homomorphisms of sheaves of commutative rings
on `C`. Then the canonical map `L_{B ⨯ B'/A} ⟶ L_{B/A} ⊕ L_{B'/A}`
(`CategoryTheory.Sheaf.prodCotangentComparisonDerived`, the pairing of the maps of cotangent
complexes induced by the two projections) is an isomorphism in `D(B ⨯ B')`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_prodCotangentComparisonDerived
    [HasDerivedCategory.{t} (targetModules.{u, v, w} J (B ⨯ B'))] :
    IsIso (prodCotangentComparisonDerived.{u, v, w, t} J f f')
declarations.comment: the lemma: the canonical map L_{B×B'/A} → L_{B/A} ⊕ L_{B'/A}, the pairing of the maps induced by the two projections, is an isomorphism in D(B×B'), for an arbitrary site and arbitrary homomorphisms A → B, A → B' of sheaves of rings

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.baseChangedCotangentComplexDerivedIso
declarations.doc:
**The first vertex of the triangle of Tag 08SZ is `L_{B/A} ⊗^L_B D`.** The complex
`L_{B/A} ⊗_B D`, the degreewise base change of the cotangent complex of `A ⟶ B`, represents the
derived base change of `L_{B/A}` along `h : B ⟶ D`: the cotangent complex is K-flat with flat
terms, so its derived pullback is computed degreewise (Tag 06YY), and degreewise pullback along
the change of coefficient rings is extension of scalars.
declarations.statement:
def baseChangedCotangentComplexDerivedIso :
    (towerDerivedBaseChange.{u, v, w} J h).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cotangentComplex.{u, v, w} J g)) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj (baseChangedCotangentComplex.{u, v, w} J g h)
declarations.comment:
the first vertex: `L_{B/A} ⊗^L_B D`, the derived pullback along `h : B ⟶ D` of
the cotangent complex, is the class of its degreewise base change, the first vertex of the
triangle of `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.exists_distTriang_towerCotangent`; on any site

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.towerCotangentBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08SZ, the first displayed arrow.** The canonical map
`L_{B/A} ⊗_B D ⟶ L_{D/A}` of complexes of sheaves of `D`-modules: the transpose, along the
extension–restriction adjunction for sheaves of modules, of the `B`-linear map of cotangent
complexes attached to the square `(𝟙 A, h)` of the tower.

The tensor product in the source is the degreewise one, not the derived one; see the module
documentation.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def towerCotangentBaseChange :
    baseChangedCotangentComplex.{u, v, w} J g h ⟶ cotangentComplex.{u, v, w} J (g ≫ h)
declarations.comment: the first displayed arrow L_{B/A} ⊗_B C ⟶ L_{C/A}, with the DEGREEWISE tensor product in place of the derived one — the two agree only once the terms of L_{B/A} are known to be locally free, which is not proved here and for which no derived extension of scalars for sheaves of modules on a site exists in this library. Distinguishedness of the triangle is not claimed by this declaration

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.towerCotangentChangeOfBase
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08SZ, the second displayed arrow.** The canonical
change-of-base-ring map `L_{D/A} ⟶ L_{D/B}` of complexes of sheaves of `D`-modules: the map of
cotangent complexes attached to the square `(g, 𝟙 D)` of the tower. Restriction of scalars along
the identity of `D` is the identity functor, so no identification intervenes between the stated
target and `L_{D/B}`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def towerCotangentChangeOfBase :
    cotangentComplex.{u, v, w} J (g ≫ h) ⟶ cotangentComplex.{u, v, w} J h
declarations.comment: the second displayed arrow L_{C/A} ⟶ L_{C/B}, unconditionally and with no identification intervening. Distinguishedness of the triangle is not claimed by this declaration

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.exists_distTriang_cotangentComplexDerived_of_shortExact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08SZ, under one carried hypothesis.** Let `A ⟶ B ⟶ D` be homomorphisms
of sheaves of commutative rings on a site. Then there is a distinguished triangle

`L_{B/A} ⊗_B D ⟶ L_{D/A} ⟶ L_{D/B} ⟶ (L_{B/A} ⊗_B D)[1]`

in `D(D)` whose first two arrows are the two canonical maps
`CategoryTheory.Sheaf.towerCotangentBaseChange` and
`CategoryTheory.Sheaf.towerCotangentChangeOfBase` constructed above.

The hypothesis carried is the sheaf-level differential short exact sequence of the source's
proof (Tag 08SD): a short complex `S` of cochain complexes of sheaves of `D`-modules that is
short exact (`hS`), whose three terms are the three vertices (`e₁`, `e₂`, `e₃`) and whose two
maps are the two canonical arrows (`hf`, `hg`). The source identifies the third term using
Tag 08SE and reduces to the case of an injective `B ⟶ D` using the isomorphism of Tag 08SY.

The first vertex carries the degreewise, not the derived, tensor product; see the module
documentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_distTriang_cotangentComplexDerived_of_shortExact
    [HasDerivedCategory.{t} (targetModules.{u, v, w} J D)]
    (S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex (targetModules.{u, v, w} J D) ℤ)) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (e₁ : S.X₁ ≅ baseChangedCotangentComplex.{u, v, w} J g h)
    (e₂ : S.X₂ ≅ cotangentComplex.{u, v, w} J (g ≫ h))
    (e₃ : S.X₃ ≅ cotangentComplex.{u, v, w} J h)
    (hf : S.f = e₁.hom ≫ towerCotangentBaseChange.{u, v, w} J g h ≫ e₂.inv)
    (hg : S.g = e₂.hom ≫ towerCotangentChangeOfBase.{u, v, w} J g h ≫ e₃.inv) :
    ∃ δ : cotangentComplexDerived.{u, v, w, t} J h ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (baseChangedCotangentComplex.{u, v, w} J g h))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      Triangle.mk (DerivedCategory.Q.map (towerCotangentBaseChange.{u, v, w} J g h))
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map (towerCotangentChangeOfBase.{u, v, w} J g h)) δ ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory (targetModules.{u, v, w} J D))
declarations.comment: the distinguished triangle, under ONE carried hypothesis the source lacks: the short exact sequence `S`, `hS` realizing the two canonical arrows (`hf`, `hg`) on the three vertices (`e₁`, `e₂`, `e₃`) — the sheaf-level analogue of Tag 08SD, absent from this library, as are Tag 08SE and the ISOMORPHISM of Tag 08SY. The first vertex carries the DEGREEWISE tensor product in place of the derived one

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.exists_distTriang_towerCotangent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08SZ, the fundamental triangle.** Let `A ⟶ B ⟶ D` be homomorphisms of sheaves of
commutative rings on a site. The triangle

`L_{B/A} ⊗_B D ⟶ L_{D/A} ⟶ L_{D/B} ⟶ (L_{B/A} ⊗_B D)[1]`

with first two arrows `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.towerCotangentBaseChange` and
`CategoryTheory.Sheaf.towerCotangentChangeOfBase` is distinguished in `D(D)`; its first vertex
is `L_{B/A} ⊗^L_B D` by `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.baseChangedCotangentComplexDerivedIso`.

This is the argument of the source: the homomorphism `B ⟶ B × D`, `b ↦ (b, h b)`, is injective
on sections, so the triangle of `A ⟶ B ⟶ B × D` is distinguished
(`CategoryTheory.Sheaf.exists_distTriang_towerCotangent_of_injective`), and the exact second
summand functor `Mod(B × D) ⥤ Mod(D)` carries it to the triangle of `A ⟶ B ⟶ D`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_distTriang_towerCotangent
    [HasDerivedCategory.{t} (targetModules.{u, v, w} J D)] :
    ∃ δ : cotangentComplexDerived.{u, v, w, t} J h ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (baseChangedCotangentComplex.{u, v, w} J g h))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      Triangle.mk (DerivedCategory.Q.map (towerCotangentBaseChange.{u, v, w} J g h))
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map (towerCotangentChangeOfBase.{u, v, w} J g h)) δ ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory (targetModules.{u, v, w} J D))

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Sheaf.pointStalkCotangentComplexIso
declarations.doc:
**The stalk of the cotangent complex at a point of a site** (Tag 08T0): the stalk at `Φ` of
`L_{B/A}` is `L_{B_Φ/A_Φ}`, as complexes of `B_Φ`-modules. On germs it is described by
`CategoryTheory.Sheaf.pointStalkCotangentComplexIso_hom_germ`.
declarations.statement:
def pointStalkCotangentComplexIso :
    ((Stacks.sheafModuleFiberOfCommRing Φ B).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (cotangentComplex J f) ≅
      CommAlgCat.cotangentComplex.{max u v w, max u v w} _ (pointStalkAlgebra J Φ f)
declarations.comment:
The point is a point of the site in the sense of Stacks 00Y5 (Mathlib's
GrothendieckTopology.Point), with fibre functor valued in the universe of the sections of A and
B, the single universe of sets of the source. The left-hand side is the stalk at the point of
L_{B/A} as a complex of B_p-modules (Stacks.sheafModuleFiberOfCommRing), the right-hand side is
the cotangent complex of Tag 08PN of the ring map of stalks A_p -> B_p (pointStalkAlgebra). The
instance LocallySmall.{max u v w} C holds for every category C in these universes (Mathlib's
instance locallySmall_of_univLE), so it restricts nothing. On germs the isomorphism is described by
pointStalkCotangentComplexIso_hom_germ.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.cotangentComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08T2.** The cotangent complex `L_{X/Y}` of a morphism of schemes `f : X ⟶ Y`: the
cotangent complex of `f` read as a morphism of the Zariski ringed topoi of `X` and `Y`, a
complex of sheaves of `𝒪_X`-modules.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cotangentComplex :
    CochainComplex
      (Sheaf.targetModules (Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥X) X.zariskiRingedTopos.O) ℤ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.cotangentComplexDerived
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08T2.** The cotangent complex `L_{X/Y}` of a morphism of schemes, regarded as an
object of the derived category of sheaves of `𝒪_X`-modules.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev cotangentComplexDerived
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u} (Sheaf.targetModules (Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥X)
      X.zariskiRingedTopos.O)] :
    DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf.targetModules (Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥X) X.zariskiRingedTopos.O)
declarations.comment: the derived object

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.affineCotangentComparison_spec
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08T3.**

Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of schemes and let `U = Spec B ⊂ X` and `V = Spec A ⊂ Y` be
affine opens with `f(U) ⊂ V`, so that `B = 𝒪_X(U)` and `A = 𝒪_Y(V)`. The map of complexes
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.affineCotangentComparison f hU e : ~(L_{B/A}) ⟶ L_{X/Y}|_U`
satisfies the three assertions of the lemma:

1. it is **the canonical map**: in every degree it is the adjunct, under the universal property
   of `~` (Tag 01I7), of the canonical map `L_{B/A} ⟶ Γ(L_{X/Y}|_U)`,
   `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.gammaCotangentComparison`, which is the map
   `L_{B/A} ⟶ L_{𝒪_X(U)/(f⁻¹𝒪_Y)(U)}` induced by `A ⟶ (f⁻¹𝒪_Y)(U)` followed by the canonical map
   `L_{𝒪_X(U)/(f⁻¹𝒪_Y)(U)} ⟶ L_{X/Y}(U)` of Remark 08SX;
2. it is **an isomorphism in `D(𝒪_U)`**;
3. it is **compatible with restricting to smaller affine opens** `U' ⊂ U` of `X` and `V' ⊂ V` of
   `Y` with `f(U') ⊂ V'`: the square formed by the canonical maps for `(U, V)` and `(U', V')`
   and the two restriction maps commutes.
declarations.statement:
theorem affineCotangentComparison_spec [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (Spec Γ(X, U)).Modules] :
    (∀ j : ℤ, (tilde.adjunction (R := Γ(X, U))).homEquiv _ _
        ((affineCotangentComparison f hU e).f j) = (gammaCotangentComparison f hU e).f j) ∧
    IsIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map (affineCotangentComparison f hU e)) ∧
    ∀ {U' : X.Opens} (hU' : IsAffineOpen U') {V' : Y.Opens} (e' : U' ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V')
      (hUle : U' ≤ U) (hVle : V' ≤ V),
      affineCotangentComparison f hU e ≫
          Stacks.AffineCotangentSheaf.restrictedCotangentRestriction f hU hU' hUle =
        Stacks.AffineCotangentSheaf.tildeCotangentRestriction f e e' hUle hVle ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
            (Stacks.AffineCotangentSheaf.specRestriction hUle)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (affineCotangentComparison f hU' e')
declarations.comment: the whole lemma, in one covering statement: (1) the canonical map, pinned as the adjunct under the tilde-Gamma adjunction of the canonical map L_{B/A} -> Gamma(L_{X/Y}|_U) built from A -> (f^{-1}O_Y)(U) and Remark 08SX; (2) it is an isomorphism in D(O_U); (3) it is compatible with restriction to smaller affine opens U' of X and opens V' of Y. Hypotheses: exactly the source's, U and V affine with f(U) inside V

declarations.name: Stacks.AffineCotangentSheaf.affineCotangentComparison_restriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08T3, assertion 3, as sheaves.** For a morphism of schemes `f : X ⟶ Y`, affine opens
`U' ≤ U` of `X` and opens `V' ≤ V` of `Y` with `f(U) ⊂ V` and `f(U') ⊂ V'`, the canonical map
`~(L_{𝒪_X(U)/𝒪_Y(V)}) ⟶ L_{X/Y}|_U` of Tag 08T3 is compatible with restriction: writing
`ρ : Spec 𝒪_X(U') ⟶ Spec 𝒪_X(U)` for the morphism induced by restriction, the square formed by
the two comparison maps and the two restriction maps commutes as an equality of maps of complexes
of `𝒪_{Spec 𝒪_X(U)}`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem affineCotangentComparison_restriction (e : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (e' : U' ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V')
    (hUle : U' ≤ U) (hVle : V' ≤ V) :
    affineCotangentComparison f hU e ≫ restrictedCotangentRestriction f hU hU' hUle =
      tildeCotangentRestriction f e e' hUle hVle ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (specRestriction hUle)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (affineCotangentComparison f hU' e')
declarations.comment: ASSERTION 3 ONLY, and AS SHEAVES: the canonical map of this tag, ~(L_{O_X(U)/O_Y(V)}) -> L_{X/Y}|_U, is compatible with restriction along affine opens U' <= U and opens V' <= V, as an EQUALITY of maps of complexes of sheaves of O_{Spec O_X(U)}-modules -- not a Nonempty and not the sectionwise statement. The two vertical maps of the square are tildeCotangentRestriction and restrictedCotangentRestriction; the latter is the genuine sheaf restriction map, which restrictionUnit_app_app proves acts on sections as presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op. CARRIED: IsAffineOpen U and IsAffineOpen U', which are the source's own hypotheses -- the comparison map is only defined for an affine open -- and nothing else; IsAffineOpen V and IsAffineOpen V' are NOT carried, so this is more general than the source in the base variables. ASSERTIONS 1 AND 2 ARE NOT CLAIMED HERE

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.RingedSpaceCotangent.baseStructureMap_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08T4**, the tower. The structure map of `g ∘ f` factors through the
structure map of `f` by `baseStructureMap`, so that `(g ∘ f)⁻¹𝒪_Z ⟶ f⁻¹𝒪_Y ⟶ 𝒪_X` is a tower
of sheaves of commutative rings on `X` whose composite is the structure map of `g ∘ f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseStructureMap_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    baseStructureMap f g ≫ inverseImageStructureMap f = inverseImageStructureMap (f ≫ g)
declarations.comment: the canonical tower of inverse images, whose fundamental triangle is the triangle of this tag

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.RingedSpaceCotangent.cotangentChangeOfBase
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08T4**, the second displayed arrow `L_{X/Z} ⟶ L_{X/Y}`: the
change-of-base-ring map of Tag 08SZ for the tower `(g ∘ f)⁻¹𝒪_Z ⟶ f⁻¹𝒪_Y ⟶ 𝒪_X`.
declarations.comment: the second displayed arrow L_{X/Z} ⟶ L_{X/Y}, unconditionally. Distinguishedness of the triangle is not claimed by this declaration

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.RingedSpaceCotangent.exists_distTriang_of_shortExact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08T4, under one carried hypothesis.** For morphisms of ringed spaces
`f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` the triangle

`L_{f⁻¹𝒪_Y/(g ∘ f)⁻¹𝒪_Z} ⊗_{f⁻¹𝒪_Y} 𝒪_X ⟶ L_{X/Z} ⟶ L_{X/Y} ⟶ ⋯`

on the two canonical arrows `cotangentBaseChange` and `cotangentChangeOfBase` is distinguished
in `D(𝒪_X)`.

The hypothesis carried is the one carried by Tag 08SZ, in the same shape: a short complex `S`
of complexes of sheaves of `𝒪_X`-modules that is short exact (`hS`), whose three terms are the
three vertices (`e₁`, `e₂`, `e₃`) and whose two maps are the two canonical arrows (`hf`, `hg`).
See the "What is proved and what is not" section of the module documentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_distTriang_of_shortExact (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex (structureModules X) ℤ))
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (e₁ : S.X₁ ≅ baseChangedCotangentComplex f g)
    (e₂ : S.X₂ ≅ cotangentComplex (f ≫ g)) (e₃ : S.X₃ ≅ cotangentComplex f)
    (hf : S.f = e₁.hom ≫ cotangentBaseChange f g ≫ e₂.inv)
    (hg : S.g = e₂.hom ≫ cotangentChangeOfBase f g ≫ e₃.inv) :
    ∃ δ : (DerivedCategory.Q (C := structureModules X)).obj (cotangentComplex f) ⟶
        ((DerivedCategory.Q (C := structureModules X)).obj
          (baseChangedCotangentComplex f g))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      Triangle.mk ((DerivedCategory.Q (C := structureModules X)).map (cotangentBaseChange f g))
          ((DerivedCategory.Q (C := structureModules X)).map (cotangentChangeOfBase f g)) δ ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory (structureModules X))
declarations.comment: the triangle with FIRST VERTEX THE DEGREEWISE base change L_{f⁻¹O_Y/(g∘f)⁻¹O_Z} ⊗_{f⁻¹O_Y} O_X, not Lf^* L_{Y/Z}, and under the ONE carried hypothesis of Tag 08SZ: the short exact sequence `S`/`hS`, the sheaf-level analogue of Tag 08SD, absent from this library. See the docstring above

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.RingedSpaceCotangent.exists_distTriang_degreewisePullback_of_shortExact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08T4, under two carried hypotheses.** For morphisms of ringed spaces
`f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` the triangle

`f^*L_{Y/Z} ⟶ L_{X/Z} ⟶ L_{X/Y} ⟶ f^*L_{Y/Z}[1]`

is distinguished in `D(𝒪_X)`, its first arrow being the base-change arrow of Tag 08SZ for the
tower read on `f^*L_{Y/Z}` and its second the canonical map `cotangentChangeOfBase`.

Two hypotheses are carried. `e` is Tag 08SV for the tower: the degreewise pullback of `L_{Y/Z}`
is the first vertex `L_{f⁻¹𝒪_Y/(g ∘ f)⁻¹𝒪_Z} ⊗_{f⁻¹𝒪_Y} 𝒪_X` of the triangle of Tag 08SZ. The
short exact sequence `S`, `hS` is the hypothesis Tag 08SZ itself carries. The first vertex is
the degreewise pullback `f^*L_{Y/Z}`; it is `Lf^*L_{Y/Z}` as soon as `L_{Y/Z}` is K-flat, by
`isIso_derivedPullbackComparison_cotangentComplex`. See the "What is proved and what is not"
section of the module documentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_distTriang_degreewisePullback_of_shortExact (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (e : degreewisePullbackCotangentComplex f g ≅ baseChangedCotangentComplex f g)
    (S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex (structureModules X) ℤ))
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (e₁ : S.X₁ ≅ baseChangedCotangentComplex f g)
    (e₂ : S.X₂ ≅ cotangentComplex (f ≫ g)) (e₃ : S.X₃ ≅ cotangentComplex f)
    (hf : S.f = e₁.hom ≫ cotangentBaseChange f g ≫ e₂.inv)
    (hg : S.g = e₂.hom ≫ cotangentChangeOfBase f g ≫ e₃.inv) :
    ∃ δ : (DerivedCategory.Q (C := structureModules X)).obj (cotangentComplex f) ⟶
        ((DerivedCategory.Q (C := structureModules X)).obj
          (degreewisePullbackCotangentComplex f g))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      Triangle.mk ((DerivedCategory.Q (C := structureModules X)).map
            (e.hom ≫ cotangentBaseChange f g))
          ((DerivedCategory.Q (C := structureModules X)).map (cotangentChangeOfBase f g)) δ ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory (structureModules X))
declarations.comment: the triangle with first vertex the DEGREEWISE pullback f^* L_{Y/Z}, not Lf^* L_{Y/Z}; the two agree in D(O_X) exactly when L_{Y/Z} is K-flat, which is NOT proved here. TWO carried hypotheses: `e` is Tag 08SV for this tower, `S`/`hS` is what Tag 08SZ carries. See the docstring above and the module documentation

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.RingedSpaceCotangent.sheafPullbackCompIso_hom_app_comp_inverseImageStructureMap
declarations.doc:
The structure map of `g ∘ f` is the structure map of `g` pulled back along `f` followed by
the structure map of `f`, across `(g ∘ f)⁻¹𝒪_Z ≅ f⁻¹g⁻¹𝒪_Z` (Tag 008I).
declarations.statement:
theorem sheafPullbackCompIso_hom_app_comp_inverseImageStructureMap (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (sheafPullbackCompIso f.hom.base g.hom.base CommRingCat.{u}).hom.app Z.sheaf ≫
        (TopCat.Sheaf.pullback CommRingCat.{u} f.hom.base).map (inverseImageStructureMap g) ≫
          inverseImageStructureMap f =
      inverseImageStructureMap (f ≫ g)
declarations.comment: the tower (g ∘ f)⁻¹O_Z = f⁻¹g⁻¹O_Z ⟶ f⁻¹O_Y ⟶ O_X of the proof: the structure map of g ∘ f is the composite of the tower

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.RingedSpaceCotangent.transitivityUnit
declarations.doc:
The first arrow `Lf^* L_{Y/Z} ⟶ L_{X/Z}` of the transitivity triangle: the first arrow of
the triangle of Tag 08V1 for the presented morphisms of ringed topoi, read through
`derivedPullbackCotangentComplexIso` and `compCotangentComplexIsoRingedTopos`.
declarations.comment: the canonical first arrow Lf^* L_{Y/Z} ⟶ L_{X/Z} of the triangle

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.RingedSpaceCotangent.transitivityCounit
declarations.doc:
The second arrow `L_{X/Z} ⟶ L_{X/Y}` of the transitivity triangle: the second arrow of the
triangle of Tag 08V1 for the presented morphisms of ringed topoi, read through
`compCotangentComplexIsoRingedTopos` and `cotangentComplexIsoRingedTopos`.
declarations.statement:
def transitivityCounit (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    cotangentComplexDerived (f ≫ g) ⟶ cotangentComplexDerived f
declarations.comment: the canonical second arrow L_{X/Z} ⟶ L_{X/Y} of the triangle

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.RingedSpaceCotangent.exists_distTriang_transitivity
declarations.doc:
**The transitivity triangle.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` be morphisms of ringed
spaces. The canonical triangle

`Lf^* L_{Y/Z} ⟶ L_{X/Z} ⟶ L_{X/Y} ⟶ Lf^* L_{Y/Z}[1]`

is distinguished in `D(𝒪_X)`. Here `L_{X/S}` is the cotangent complex of Definition 08UU,
`Lf^*` is the derived pullback of Tag 06YJ, and the two arrows are `transitivityUnit` and
`transitivityCounit`, those of the fundamental triangle of the tower
`(g ∘ f)⁻¹𝒪_Z = f⁻¹g⁻¹𝒪_Z ⟶ f⁻¹𝒪_Y ⟶ 𝒪_X` (Tags 08SZ and 08V1).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_distTriang_transitivity (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    ∃ δ : cotangentComplexDerived f ⟶
        ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback f).obj
          (cotangentComplexDerived g))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      Triangle.mk (transitivityUnit f g) (transitivityCounit f g) δ ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PolynomialChart.hasLeftDerivedFunctor_horizontalModuleInverseImage
declarations.doc:
**`Li^*` exists on the site of polynomial charts.** Degreewise `i^*` followed by
localization to the derived category has a total left derived functor with respect to the
quasi-isomorphisms of complexes of `𝒪`-modules.

On the small model this is the derived pullback of Tag 06YY along a change of coefficient rings;
the quasi-isomorphisms of the chart site are the inverse image of those of the small model, and
total left derived functors are preserved by conjugation by equivalences.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasLeftDerivedFunctor_horizontalModuleInverseImage :
    ((horizontalModuleInverseImage.{u, u + 1} Λ X structureMap).mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh).HasLeftDerivedFunctor
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (_root_.SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
        ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
            (J := (topology Λ X structureMap)))
          (affineSheaf.{u, u + 1} Λ X structureMap))) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
declarations.comment:
the first link of the chain L_{X/Λ} = Lπ_!(Li^*Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲}) = Lπ_!(i^*Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲}) =
Lπ_!(Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲} ⊗_𝒪 π⁻¹𝒪_X): the existence of the total left derived functor Li^* of the module
pullback along the horizontal arrow of the diagram of Tag 08VA, on the chart site itself

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PolynomialChart.derivedLowerShriekInverseImageDifferentialsIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08T9, the second isomorphism** `Lπ_!(Li^*Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲}) ≅ Lπ_!(i^*Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲})`:
`Lπ_!` applied to the canonical map `Li^*Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲} ⟶ i^*Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲}`, an isomorphism because
`Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲}` is a flat `𝒪`-module (`derivedHorizontalInverseImageDifferentialsIso`).
declarations.statement:
def derivedLowerShriekInverseImageDifferentialsIso :
    (chartDerivedLowerShriek Λ X structureMap).obj
        ((derivedHorizontalInverseImage Λ X structureMap).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            (chartDifferentials.{u, u + 1} Λ X structureMap))) ≅
      (chartDerivedLowerShriek Λ X structureMap).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          (pulledBackDifferentials.{u, u + 1} Λ X structureMap))
declarations.comment:
second isomorphism Lπ_!(Li^*Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲}) = Lπ_!(i^*Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲}), induced by the canonical
map Li^*Ω ⟶ i^*Ω, an isomorphism since Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲} is flat

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PolynomialChart.derivedLowerShriekPulledBackDifferentialsIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08T9, the third isomorphism**
`Lπ_!(i^*Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲}) ≅ Lπ_!(Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲} ⊗_𝒪 𝒪̲_X)`: `Lπ_!` applied to the canonical identification of
the pullback `i^*Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲}` with the extension of scalars of `Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲}` along `i♯`
(`pulledBackDifferentialsIsoBaseChange`).
declarations.statement:
def derivedLowerShriekPulledBackDifferentialsIso :
    (chartDerivedLowerShriek Λ X structureMap).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          (pulledBackDifferentials.{u, u + 1} Λ X structureMap)) ≅
      (chartDerivedLowerShriek Λ X structureMap).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          (chartDifferentialsBaseChange Λ X structureMap))
declarations.comment:
third isomorphism Lπ_!(i^*Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲}) = Lπ_!(Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲} ⊗_𝒪 𝒪̲_X), induced by the
canonical identification of i^* with extension of scalars along i♯

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PolynomialChart.cotangentComplexIsoDerivedLowerShriekInverseImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08T9, the first isomorphism** `L_{X/Λ} ≅ Lπ_!(Li^*Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲})` in `D(𝒪_X)`,
for the site of polynomial charts of Tag 08VA of a scheme `X` over a ring `Λ`. Here
`L_{X/Λ} = L_{X/Spec Λ}` is the cotangent complex of the structure morphism
(`SchemeOverRing.cotangentComplexRelative`, Tag 08UU), read in the coefficient universe of the
chart topos through `chartBaseLift`; `Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲}` is `chartDifferentials`; `Li^*` is
`derivedHorizontalInverseImage`; and `Lπ_!` is `chartDerivedLowerShriek`.

It is the composite of the canonical maps of the source's proof, read from right to left:
`Li^*Ω ⟶ i^*Ω` (an isomorphism because `Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲}` is flat), `i^*Ω ≅ Ω ⊗_𝒪 𝒪̲_X`, the
identification of `Lπ_!(Ω ⊗_𝒪 𝒪̲_X)` with the complex of the standard resolutions (Tag 08VB at
module coefficients), the identification of that complex with the sheafification of
`U ↦ L_{𝒪_X(U)/Λ}` and with `L_{𝒪_X/Λ̲}` (Tag 08SX), and the comparison map
`L_{𝒪_X/Λ̲} ⟶ L_{X/Spec Λ}`, a quasi-isomorphism by Tag 08V6.
declarations.statement:
def cotangentComplexIsoDerivedLowerShriekInverseImage :
    DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((chartBaseLift Λ X structureMap).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (SchemeOverRing.cotangentComplexRelative Λ structureMap)) ≅
      (chartDerivedLowerShriek Λ X structureMap).obj
        ((derivedHorizontalInverseImage Λ X structureMap).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            (chartDifferentials.{u, u + 1} Λ X structureMap)))
declarations.comment:
first isomorphism L_{X/Λ} = Lπ_!(Li^*Ω_{𝒪/Λ̲}) in D(𝒪_X), for the site of polynomial
charts of a scheme X over a ring Λ, with L_{X/Λ} the cotangent complex of X ⟶ Spec Λ and D(𝒪_X)
taken in the coefficient universe of the chart topos; built from the canonical maps of the proof:
flatness of Ω, Tag 08VB, Tag 08SX and the Tag 08V6 comparison

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.IsDerivedLimit
declarations.doc:
An object `K` of a pre-triangulated category `D` is a **derived limit**, or **homotopy
limit**, of an inverse system `F : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ D` of objects of `D` whose objects have a product —
written `K = R lim Kₙ` — if there is a distinguished triangle
`K ⟶ ∏ Kₙ ⟶ ∏ Kₙ ⟶ K⟦1⟧` in which the middle map is the difference map
`(kₙ) ↦ (kₙ - fₙ₊₁(kₙ₊₁))`, where `Kₙ = F.obj ⟨n⟩` and `fₙ₊₁ = F.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op`
is the transition map `Kₙ₊₁ ⟶ Kₙ`. Such a `K` is unique only up to non-unique isomorphism, which
is why this is a predicate and not a construction.
declarations.statement: public def IsDerivedLimit (F : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ D) [HasProduct fun n : ℕ => F.obj ⟨n⟩] (K : D) : Prop

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeDifferentialStalk.stalkModuleOfDifferentialsKaehlerLinearEquiv
declarations.doc:
