declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PolynomialChart.standardResolutionChart_computes_derivedLowerShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08VB.** Let `X` be a scheme over a ring `Λ`, and for an open `U ⊆ X` let `P_{•,U}` be
the standard resolution of `𝒪_X(U)` over `Λ` and `A_{•,U} = Spec(P_{•,U})`, the functorial
cosimplicial charts `standardResolutionChart`. Then:

1. the fibre category of `C_{X/Λ}` over `U` is `C_{𝒪_X(U)/Λ}`, and `A_{•,U}` is a cosimplicial
   object of it (`standardResolutionFibreChart`) which is as in Stacks 08Q9: every simplicial set
   `Mor(A_{•,U}, W)` is homotopy equivalent to a point;
2. for every abelian sheaf `F` on `C_{X/Λ}` the cohomology groups of the complex of presheaves
   `U ↦ F(A_{•,U})` compute the homology of `F` on the fibre category over `U`;
3. their sheafification computes `L_nπ_!(F)`;
4. the complex of sheaves whose term in degree `-n` is the sheafification of `U ↦ F(A_{n,U})`
   computes `Lπ_!(F)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem standardResolutionChart_computes_derivedLowerShriek :
    (∀ U : X.Opens, Nonempty ((openFunctor (Λ := Λ) (X := X)
        (structureMap := structureMap)).Fiber U ≌
      CommAlgCat.polynomialSite Λ ((openAlgebra Λ X structureMap).obj (op U)))) ∧
    (∀ (U : X.Opens) (W : (openFunctor (Λ := Λ) (X := X) (structureMap := structureMap)).Fiber U),
      ∃ f : (standardResolutionFibreChart Λ X structureMap U).op ⋙ yoneda.obj W ⟶
          (Functor.const SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ).obj PUnit.{u + 1},
        SimplicialObject.homotopyEquivalences (Type u) f) ∧
    (∀ (F : Sheaf (fibredCategorySituation Λ X structureMap).topology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
      (U : (fibredCategorySituation Λ X structureMap).base.C) (n : ℕ),
      Nonempty (((((fibredCategorySituation Λ X structureMap).pointMooreComplex
          (standardResolutionChart Λ X structureMap :
            (fibredCategorySituation Λ X structureMap).base.C ⥤
              CosimplicialObject (fibredCategorySituation Λ X structureMap).C)).obj
            F.obj).homology n).obj (op U) ≅
        Stacks.CategoryHomology.categoryHomology.{u + 1, u + 1}
          ((fibredCategorySituation Λ X structureMap).smallFiberRestriction F.obj U) n)) ∧
    (∀ (F : Sheaf (fibredCategorySituation Λ X structureMap).topology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
      (n : ℕ),
      Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ (-(n : ℤ))).obj
          ((fibredCategorySituation Λ X structureMap).derivedAbelianLowerShriek.obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)) ≅
        (presheafToSheaf (fibredCategorySituation Λ X structureMap).base.J
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
          ((((fibredCategorySituation Λ X structureMap).pointMooreComplex
            (standardResolutionChart Λ X structureMap :
              (fibredCategorySituation Λ X structureMap).base.C ⥤
                CosimplicialObject (fibredCategorySituation Λ X structureMap).C)).obj
              F.obj).homology n))) ∧
    (∀ F : Sheaf (fibredCategorySituation Λ X structureMap).topology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1},
      Nonempty ((fibredCategorySituation Λ X structureMap).derivedAbelianLowerShriek.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((fibredCategorySituation Λ X structureMap).pointSheafComplex
          (standardResolutionChart Λ X structureMap :
            (fibredCategorySituation Λ X structureMap).base.C ⥤
              CosimplicialObject (fibredCategorySituation Λ X structureMap).C) F.obj)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cotangentComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08VD.** The cotangent complex `L_{X/Y}` of a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of
algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`: the cotangent complex of the canonical morphism of ringed
topoi `f_small` between the small étale sites of `X` and `Y`, that is, the cotangent complex of
the map of sheaves of commutative rings `f_small⁻¹𝒪_Y ⟶ 𝒪_X` on the small étale site of `X`.

It is a complex of modules over `𝒪_X`, so it depends on `X` alone.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev cotangentComplex (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    CochainComplex (smallEtaleModulesULift B S hS X) ℤ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cotangentComplexDerived
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08VD.** The cotangent complex `L_{X/Y}` regarded as an object of the
derived category `D(𝒪_X)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev cotangentComplexDerived (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{t} (smallEtaleModulesULift B S hS X)] :
    DerivedCategory (smallEtaleModulesULift B S hS X)
declarations.comment: the derived object

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleRestrictionCotangentComplexIso
declarations.doc:
For a commutative diagram of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`

```
U --g--> V
|p       |q
X --f--> Y
```

with `p` and `q` étale, the restriction of the cotangent complex `L_{X/Y}` to the small étale
site of `U` is the cotangent complex `L_{U/V}`:

`L_{X/Y}|_{U_étale} = L_{U/V}`.

Formation of the cotangent complex commutes with inverse image (Stacks 08SV), and the structure
maps of `f` and of `g` are carried to one another by the comparisons of Stacks 03LV and
Stacks 03G8, which commute by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleRestrictionCotangentSquare`; square
functoriality of the cotangent complex then transports the complex.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def etaleRestrictionCotangentComplexIso {p : U ⟶ X} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : U ⟶ V}
    {q : V ⟶ Y} (hp : IsEtale B S hS p.hom) (hq : IsEtale B S hS q.hom) (h : p ≫ f = g ≫ q) :
    ((etaleRestrictModules B S hS p hp).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (cotangentComplex B S hS f) ≅
      cotangentComplex B S hS g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasiIso_representedCotangentComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08VF.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be the morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` represented by
a morphism `T₁ ⟶ T₂` of the big fppf site, so that `X` and `Y` are representable by the schemes
`X₀` and `Y₀` underlying `T₁` and `T₂`. Then the canonical map `ε^*L_{X₀/Y₀} ⟶ L_{X/Y}`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.representedCotangentComparison`) is a quasi-isomorphism.

The source's proof checks this on stalks at geometric points; here the map is factored through
the two canonical arrows of the fundamental triangles of Stacks 08SZ, and the two vertices that
must vanish, `L_{𝒪_X/ε⁻¹𝒪_{X₀}}` and `L_{f_small⁻¹𝒪_Y/ε⁻¹f₀⁻¹𝒪_{Y₀}} ⊗ 𝒪_X`, vanish because
their stalks at the geometric points are the cotangent complexes of the strict henselizations
`𝒪_{X₀,x} ⟶ 𝒪_{X,x̄}` and `𝒪_{Y₀,y} ⟶ 𝒪_{Y,ȳ}` (Stacks 04K5, 08T0, 05V1, 04KF, 08R2); this is the
content of Lemma 08UN that the source invokes.
declarations.statement:
theorem quasiIso_representedCotangentComparison :
    QuasiIso (representedCotangentComparison B S hS h)
declarations.comment: the canonical map `ε^*L_{X₀/Y₀} ⟶ L_{X/Y}` is a quasi-isomorphism, for the morphism of algebraic spaces represented by a morphism `T₁ ⟶ T₂` of the big fppf site over `S` (so `X` and `Y` are represented by the schemes `X₀`, `Y₀` underlying `T₁`, `T₂`); `ε` is the comparison of Section 071P (`representedToZariskiRingedToposHom`), `L_{X₀/Y₀}` the cotangent complex of Definition 08T2 lifted to the universe of the small étale site, `ε^*` the degreewise pullback of sheaves of modules along `ε`. The map is `representedCotangentComparison`; its transpose is the functoriality of the cotangent complex over the square of Remark 08GH (`towerCotangentUnit_comp_representedBaseChangedComparison`)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.representedCotangentComplexDerivedIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08VF.** The canonical identification `L_{X/Y} = ε^*L_{X₀/Y₀}` in `D(𝒪_X)`, for the
morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces represented by a morphism `T₁ ⟶ T₂` of the big fppf
site over `S`: the image in the derived category of the canonical map
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.representedCotangentComparison`, which is a quasi-isomorphism
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasiIso_representedCotangentComparison`).
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def representedCotangentComplexDerivedIso
    [HasDerivedCategory.{t}
      (smallEtaleModulesULift B S hS ⟨yoneda.obj T₁, isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B S hS T₁⟩)] :
    DerivedCategory.Q.obj (representedPulledBackCotangentComplex B S hS h) ≅
      cotangentComplexDerived B S hS (representedSpaceMap B S hS h)
declarations.comment: the canonical identification `ε^*L_{X₀/Y₀} ≅ L_{X/Y}` in `D(𝒪_X)`, for the morphism of algebraic spaces represented by a morphism `T₁ ⟶ T₂` of the big fppf site over `S`, as the image in the derived category of the canonical map `representedCotangentComparison`; any derived category of `Mod(𝒪_X)` may be used

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom.cotangentComplexOverConstantRingIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08VG.** Let `Λ` be a commutative ring and let `X` be a space over `Λ`, with
structure morphism `G : X ⟶ Y` of ringed topoi and with `b : Λ̲ ⟶ G⁻¹𝒪_Y` the `Λ`-algebra
structure of its base, `Λ̲` being the constant sheaf with value `Λ` on the site of `X`. Then

`L_{X/Y} ≅ L_{𝒪_X/Λ̲}`

in `D(𝒪_X)`: the cotangent complex of the morphism agrees with the cotangent complex of the
homomorphism of sheaves of rings `Λ̲ ⟶ 𝒪_X`.

Two hypotheses are carried, both inputs of the source's proof: the fundamental triangle of the
tower `Λ̲ ⟶ G⁻¹𝒪_Y ⟶ 𝒪_X`, in the shape Tag 08V1 carries it, and the acyclicity `hv` of its
first vertex, which is the source's `L_q = 0` pulled back to `X` by
`firstVertexOverInverseImageBaseIso`. See the module documentation.
declarations.statement:
def cotangentComplexOverConstantRingIso
    (b : X.constantRing Λ ⟶ G.toToposHom.inverseImageRing.obj Y.O)
    (S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex (Sheaf.targetModules.{u, v, w} X.J X.O) ℤ))
    (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (e₁ : S.X₁ ≅ firstVertexOverBase G b)
    (e₂ : S.X₂ ≅ cotangentComplexOverBase G b)
    (e₃ : S.X₃ ≅ G.cotangentComplex)
    (hv : IsZero (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (firstVertexOverBase G b))) :
    G.cotangentComplexDerived ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cotangentComplexOverBase G b)
declarations.comment: an isomorphism in `D(𝒪_X)` rather than an equality of complexes, as the source's own proof produces. `L_{X/Spec(Λ)}` is the cotangent complex of the morphism of ringed topoi (Tag 08SU) and `L_{𝒪_X/Λ̲}` is the cotangent complex of `Λ̲ ⟶ 𝒪_X` with `Λ̲` the constant sheaf of Mathlib's `constantSheaf`, so no identification of `Λ̲` with an iterated inverse image is used. TWO carried hypotheses, both inputs of the source's argument and neither the conclusion: (1) the short exact sequence `S`, `hS`, `e₁`, `e₂`, `e₃` giving the fundamental triangle of Tag 08SZ for the tower `Λ̲ ⟶ G⁻¹𝒪_Y ⟶ 𝒪_X`, carried in the same shape and for the same reason as in Tag 08V1 (the sheaf-level analogue of Tag 08SD is absent here); (2) `hv`, the acyclicity of the FIRST vertex `L_{G⁻¹𝒪_Y/Λ̲} ⊗ 𝒪_X`, which is the source's `L_q = 0` for `q : Spec(Λ)_étale ⟶ (*, Λ)` pulled back to `X` — `firstVertexOverInverseImageBaseIso` proves that a first vertex over an inverse-image base is `G^*G⁻¹L_{𝒪_Y/Λ_Y}` — and which the source obtains from Tags 04K5, 08T0, 04KF and 08R2, none of which this library has in a form applying to acyclicity of a complex of sheaves of modules on a site. The conclusion's two objects do not occur in either hypothesis. What is proved: the passage from the short exact sequence to a distinguished triangle, the identification of the first vertex over an inverse-image base through Tag 08SV, and the degeneration of the triangle. The first vertex carries the DEGREEWISE extension of scalars, as in Tag 08V1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.cotangentComplexOverConstantSheafIso
declarations.doc:
Let `Λ` be a ring and `X` an algebraic space over `Λ`, with structure morphism
`p : X ⟶ Spec Λ`. Let `Λ̲` be the constant sheaf with value `Λ` on `X_et` and `Λ̲ ⟶ 𝒪_X` its
canonical map, the one adjoint to the structure map `Λ → Γ(X, 𝒪_X)`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.constantStructureMapOfSpace`). Then the cotangent complex of
`Λ̲ ⟶ 𝒪_X` is isomorphic in `D(𝒪_X)` to the cotangent complex `L_{X/Spec Λ}` of Tag 08VD.

The tower `Λ̲ ⟶ p⁻¹𝒪_{Spec Λ} ⟶ 𝒪_X` composes to the canonical map
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.towerConstantLower_comp_towerUpper`); its fundamental triangle
(Tag 08SZ) has first vertex `L_{p⁻¹𝒪/Λ̲} ⊗ 𝒪_X`, which vanishes stalkwise: at a geometric point
its stalk is the base change of the cotangent complex of the germ map
`Λ → 𝒪_{Spec Λ, p(x̄)}`, a strict henselization of a localization of `Λ` (Tags 04KF, 08R2).
declarations.statement:
def cotangentComplexOverConstantSheafIso
    [HasDerivedCategory.{t} (smallEtaleModulesULift B (Spec (CommRingCat.of Λ)) hS X)] :
    DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.cotangentComplex.{u + 1, u, u}
        (smallEtaleRingedTopos B (Spec (CommRingCat.of Λ)) hS X).J
        ((SheafOfModules.sheafULift.{u, u + 1, u}
          (smallEtaleRingedTopos B (Spec (CommRingCat.of Λ)) hS X).J).map
          (constantStructureMapOfSpace Λ B hS X))) ≅
      cotangentComplexDerived B (Spec (CommRingCat.of Λ)) hS (structureToSpec Λ B hS X)
declarations.comment: an isomorphism in `D(𝒪_X)`, as the source's proof produces. `Λ̲` is Mathlib's `constantSheaf` with value `Λ` on `X_et`, and `Λ̲ ⟶ 𝒪_X` is the canonical map, adjoint to the structure map `Λ → Γ(X, 𝒪_X)`, global sections being taken at the terminal object of the spaces-étale site of `X` (Stacks 03G1). Both cotangent complexes are formed after lifting sections to universe `u + 1` (`SheafOfModules.sheafULift`), the universe in which Tag 08VD defines `L_{X/Spec Λ}`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PolynomialChart.openFunctor_isFibered
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08VJ.** The category `C_{X/Λ}` of polynomial charts of an algebraic space `X` over
`Λ` is fibred over the small étale site of `X`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable instance openFunctor_isFibered (Λ : Type u) [CommRing Λ] (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains (Spec (CommRingCat.of Λ)))
    (X : (BigFppfOver B (Spec (CommRingCat.of Λ)) hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.PolynomialChart.piSpacesDiagram
declarations.doc:
The diagram of ringed topoi of the polynomial charts of an algebraic space over a ring: the
morphisms of ringed topoi `i : (Sh(C_{X/Λ}), π⁻¹𝒪_X) ⟶ (Sh(C_{X/Λ}), 𝒪)` and
`π : (Sh(C_{X/Λ}), π⁻¹𝒪_X) ⟶ (Sh(X_étale), 𝒪_X)`, with all of their data pinned to the
canonical ones.
declarations.statement:

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpen_flatLocus_and_preimage_subset_flatLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08VP.**  Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, `I ⊆ A` an ideal, and `X` an algebraic space
locally of finite presentation over `S = Spec A`.  For `n ≥ 0` let `Xₙ = Spec(A/Iⁿ⁺¹) ×_S X` be
the adic fibres, and let `F` be a coherent `𝒪_X`-module whose pullback `Fₙ` to every `Xₙ` is flat
over `Spec(A/Iⁿ⁺¹)`.  Then the locus of points of `|X|` where `F` is flat over `S` is open, and it
contains the inverse image of `V(I) = |Spec(A/I)|` under `|X| ⟶ |S|`.

The source's thickenings are indexed by `n ≥ 1` and are `Spec(A/Iⁿ)`; here they are indexed by
`n ≥ 0` and are `Spec(A/Iⁿ⁺¹)`, the convention of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.adicFibre`.  The
flatness of `Fₙ` is Stacks 05VV for the projection `Xₙ ⟶ Spec(A/Iⁿ⁺¹)`, and the flat locus is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.flatLocus` of Stacks 05VV (1).  Openness is Stacks 05WV.

At a geometric point `x̄` above `V(I)` the proof follows the source's reduction to Stacks 0523,
carried out on étale local rings rather than on an affine étale chart: `x̄` lifts to every `Xₙ`,
flatness of the stalks of `Fₙ` gives flatness of `(A/Iⁿ⁺¹) ⊗_A F_{x̄}` over `A/Iⁿ⁺¹`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.flat_quotient_tensor_geometricModuleStalk`), and Stacks 0523 over the
Noetherian ring `A`, applied to the finite module `F_{x̄}` over the Noetherian local ring
`𝒪_{X, x̄}`, gives flatness over `A`, hence over the weakly étale `A`-algebra `𝒪_{S, ȳ}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpen_flatLocus_and_preimage_subset_flatLocus [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (X : AlgebraicSpaces B (Spec (.of A)) hA) (f : X ⟶ schemeSpace (baseObject A B hA))
    (hf : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B (Spec (.of A)) hA f.hom)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of A)) hA X.1 X.2) [IsCoherent B (Spec (.of A)) hA X.1 X.2 F]
    (hflat : ∀ n : ℕ, IsFlatOver B (Spec (.of A)) hA (adicFibreSpaceOf A I B hA X f n).2
      (adicFibreProjection A I B hA X f n).hom
      ((modulePullback B (Spec (.of A)) hA (adicFibreInclusion A I B hA X f n)).obj F)) :
    IsOpen (flatLocus B (Spec (.of A)) hA X.2 f.hom F) ∧
      pointsMap B (Spec (.of A)) hA X.1 f.hom ⁻¹'
          Set.range (pointsMap B (Spec (.of A)) hA
            (yoneda.obj (adicThickeningObject A I B hA (contains_adicThickening A I B hA) 0))
            (yoneda.map (adicThickeningMap A I B hA (contains_adicThickening A I B hA) 0))) ⊆
        flatLocus B (Spec (.of A)) hA X.2 f.hom F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFlatOverAtGeometricPoint_of_flat_quotient_pow
declarations.doc:
**The local step of Stacks 08VP.**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over
`S`, let `F` be an `𝒪_X`-module and let `x̄` be a geometric point of `X` whose étale local ring
`T = 𝒪_{X, x̄}` and whose image's étale local ring `R = 𝒪_{Y, ȳ}` are Noetherian, with geometric
stalk `M = F_{x̄}` finite over `T`.  Let `J ⊆ R` be an ideal whose image in `T` is a proper
ideal, which is the condition that `x̄` lies over `V(J)`.  If `M/JⁿM` is flat over `R/Jⁿ` for
every `n ≥ 1`, then `F` is flat over `Y` at `x̄`.

The scalars of `M` over `R` are restricted along the canonical homomorphism of étale local
rings `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleLocalRingMap` of Stacks 04NG, as they are in the conclusion
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFlatOverAtGeometricPoint`.

The statement does not include the openness of the flat locus (Stacks 05WV), the identification
of the hypothesis with flatness of the pullbacks `F_n` to the thickenings `X_n` (Stacks 05VQ), or
the passage from the base ring `A` and its ideal `I` to the étale local ring of the base.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFlatOverAtGeometricPoint_of_flat_quotient_pow
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (F : Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2) (xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1)
    [IsNoetherianRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y.1 (geometricPointMap f.hom xbar))]
    [IsNoetherianRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)]
    [Module.Finite (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F)]
    (J : Ideal (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y.1 (geometricPointMap f.hom xbar)))
    (hJ : J.map (etaleLocalRingMap X.2 f.hom xbar) ≠ ⊤)
    (hflat : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      letI : Module (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y.1 (geometricPointMap f.hom xbar))
          (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F) :=
        Module.compHom _ (etaleLocalRingMap X.2 f.hom xbar)
      Module.Flat (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y.1 (geometricPointMap f.hom xbar) ⧸ J ^ n)
        (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F ⧸
          (J ^ n • (⊤ : Submodule (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y.1 (geometricPointMap f.hom xbar))
            (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F))))) :
    IsFlatOverAtGeometricPoint B S hS f F xbar
declarations.comment: the local step at a geometric point lying over V(J)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.preimage_zeroLocus_subset_flatLocus_of_isFlatOver_adicFibre
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08VP.**  Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, let `I ⊆ A` be an ideal and let `X` be an
algebraic space locally of finite presentation over `S = Spec A`.  For `n ≥ 1` set
`S_n = Spec (A / Iⁿ)` and `X_n = S_n ×_S X`, and let `F` be a coherent `𝒪_X`-module.  If for
every `n ≥ 1` the pullback `F_n` of `F` to `X_n` is flat over `S_n`, then the locus where `F` is
flat over `S` is open and contains the inverse image of `V(I)` under `X → S`.

The openness is Stacks 05WV,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpen_flatLocus_of_isFinitePresentationOnCharts`, a coherent module
being of finite presentation.  Here `X_n` is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.adicFibreSpace`, the fibre
product of algebraic spaces `X ×_S S_n` with `S_n = Spec (A / I^{n+1})` for `n : ℕ`, so that `n`
runs over the exponents `≥ 1`; `F_n` is the pullback of modules
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.modulePullback` along the projection
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.adicFibreFst`; flatness over `S_n` is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFlatOver`
of Stacks 05VV along `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.adicFibreSnd`; coherence is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsCoherent` of Stacks 07UA; and the locus is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.flatLocus`.
declarations.statement:
theorem preimage_zeroLocus_subset_flatLocus_of_isFlatOver_adicFibre [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hf : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B (Spec (.of A)) hA f)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B (Spec (.of A)) hA X hX) [IsCoherent B (Spec (.of A)) hA X hX F]
    (hflat : ∀ n : ℕ, IsFlatOver B (Spec (.of A)) hA (adicFibreSpace A I B hA hX f n).2
      (adicFibreSnd A I B hA f n)
      ((modulePullback B (Spec (.of A)) hA (adicFibreFst A I B hA hX f n)).obj F)) :
    IsOpen (flatLocus B (Spec (.of A)) hA hX f F) ∧
      (fun x => pointsToScheme B (Spec (.of A)) hA (baseObject A B hA)
          (pointsMap B (Spec (.of A)) hA X f x)) ⁻¹'
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set A) ⊆
        flatLocus B (Spec (.of A)) hA hX f F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.FlatModuleDeformation.nonempty_flatLift_iff_flatDeformationObstruction_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08VR**, clause (1). Let `(f, f')` be a strict morphism of first order
thickenings of ringed spaces with `f'` flat, and let `ℱ` be an `𝒪_X`-module flat over `S`. There
is an `𝒪_{X'}`-module `ℱ'` flat over `S'` with `i^* ℱ' ≅ ℱ` if and only if the class
`o(ℱ, f^* 𝒥 ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ, 1)` of **Stacks 08L8** vanishes.

This is **Stacks 08LN** read through the identification `ℐ = f^* 𝒥`
(`isIso_baseToSourceIdeal_of_isFlat`), which makes its first condition automatic.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_flatLift_iff_flatDeformationObstruction_eq_zero
    (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening D.i) (ht : IsFirstOrderThickening D.t) (hs : D.IsStrict)
    (hf' : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlat D.f') (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.X))
    (hF : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f F) :
    Nonempty (FlatLift D F) ↔
      flatDeformationObstruction D hi (isIso_baseToSourceIdeal_of_isFlat D hs hf') F = 0
declarations.comment: clause (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.FlatModuleDeformation.flatLiftClassDifferenceBase_isPrincipalHomogeneous
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08VR**, clause (2). Let `(f, f')` be a strict morphism of first order
thickenings of ringed spaces with `f'` flat, and let `ℱ` be an `𝒪_X`-module flat over `S`. The
isomorphism classes of lifts of `ℱ` to `𝒪_{X'}`-modules flat over `S'` form a principal
homogeneous space under `Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, f^* 𝒥 ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ)`: the difference
`flatLiftClassDifferenceBase` is additive, and for every class `b` the map `a ↦ d(a, b)` is a
bijection onto `Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, f^* 𝒥 ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ)`. When no lift exists both conditions hold
vacuously.

This is **Stacks 08LM** read through the identification `ℐ = f^* 𝒥`.
declarations.statement:
theorem flatLiftClassDifferenceBase_isPrincipalHomogeneous (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening D.i)
    (ht : IsFirstOrderThickening D.t) (hs : D.IsStrict) (hf' : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlat D.f')
    {F : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.X)} (hF : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f F) :
    (∀ a b c : FlatLiftClass D F,
      flatLiftClassDifferenceBase D hi hs (isIso_baseToSourceIdeal_of_isFlat D hs hf') F a b +
          flatLiftClassDifferenceBase D hi hs (isIso_baseToSourceIdeal_of_isFlat D hs hf') F b c =
        flatLiftClassDifferenceBase D hi hs (isIso_baseToSourceIdeal_of_isFlat D hs hf') F a c) ∧
      ∀ b : FlatLiftClass D F, Function.Bijective fun a : FlatLiftClass D F =>
        flatLiftClassDifferenceBase D hi hs (isIso_baseToSourceIdeal_of_isFlat D hs hf') F a b
declarations.comment: clause (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.FlatModuleDeformation.exists_identityLiftAut_equiv_ext_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08VR**, clause (3). Given a lift `ℱ'` of `ℱ` to an `𝒪_{X'}`-module
flat over `S'`, the set of automorphisms of `ℱ'` which pull back to the identity of `ℱ` is
canonically isomorphic to `Ext⁰_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, f^* 𝒥 ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ)`: the class `ξ` corresponds to the
automorphism `1 + ε_ξ`, where `ε_ξ` is `ξ ∈ Hom_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, f^* 𝒥 ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ)` read through
**Stacks 08LJ** as an endomorphism `ℱ' ⟶ ℐℱ' ⟶ ℱ'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_identityLiftAut_equiv_ext_zero [CategoryTheory.HasExt.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.X))]
    (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening D.i) (hs : D.IsStrict)
    {F : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.X)} (A : FlatLift D F) :
    ∃ e : { φ : A.module' ≅ A.module' //
          (modulePullback D.i).map φ.hom = 𝟙 ((modulePullback D.i).obj A.module') } ≃
        CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{w} F (baseIdealTensor D F) 0,
      ∀ φ, φ.1.hom = 𝟙 A.module' +
        liftInfinitesimalEndo D hi hs A (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.homEquiv₀ (e φ))
declarations.comment: clause (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.boundary_flatLiftClassDifferenceBase_eq_flatDeformationObstruction
declarations.doc:
In the situation of **Stacks 08VS** the two `𝒪'₁`-modules
`π^* ℱ` and `h^* ℱ'₂` are flat over `S'₁` and restrict to `ℱ` on `X`, so **Stacks 08VR**
clause (2) attaches to them a difference `θ ∈ Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, f^* 𝒥₁ ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ)`. The boundary of
`θ` along `0 ⟶ f^* 𝒥₃ ⊗ ℱ ⟶ f^* 𝒥₂ ⊗ ℱ ⟶ f^* 𝒥₁ ⊗ ℱ ⟶ 0` is the obstruction of **Stacks 08VR**
clause (1) to lifting `ℱ` to an `𝒪'₃`-module flat over `S'₃`.

The difference is taken in the order `(h^* ℱ'₂, π^* ℱ)`; the other order negates both it and its
boundary. The hypotheses carrying inputs of the source are described in the Scope section of the
module docstring.
declarations.statement:
theorem boundary_flatLiftClassDifferenceBase_eq_flatDeformationObstruction
    (D : FlatShortExactThickeningDiagram.{u})
    [CategoryTheory.HasExt.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.upper.X))]
    [CategoryTheory.HasExt.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.upper.X₁))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.upper.X))]
    (hI₁ : IsIso D.morphism₁.baseToSourceIdeal)
    (hI₂ : IsIso D.morphism₂.baseToSourceIdeal)
    (hI₃ : IsIso D.morphism₃.baseToSourceIdeal)
    (k₃₂ : baseIdealTensor D.morphism₃ D.restriction ⟶
      baseIdealTensor D.morphism₂ D.restriction)
    (k₂₁ : baseIdealTensor D.morphism₂ D.restriction ⟶
      baseIdealTensor D.morphism₁ D.restriction)
    (hk : k₃₂ ≫ k₂₁ = 0) (hK : (ShortComplex.mk k₃₂ k₂₁ hk).ShortExact)
    (hk₃₂ : (baseIdealTensorIso D.morphism₃ hI₃ D.restriction).inv ≫ k₃₂ =
      D.idealTensorTransition₃₂ ≫ (baseIdealTensorIso D.morphism₂ hI₂ D.restriction).inv)
    (hk₂₁ : (baseIdealTensorIso D.morphism₂ hI₂ D.restriction).inv ≫ k₂₁ =
      D.idealTensorTransition₂₁ ≫ (baseIdealTensorIso D.morphism₁ hI₁ D.restriction).inv)
    (Aπ Bh : FlatLift D.morphism₁ D.restriction)
    (hAπ : underlyingExtensionClass D.upper.i₁ D.trivialization D.upper.firstOrder₁.1.1
      D.restriction (idealTensor D.morphism₁ D.restriction)
      (Aπ.kernelExtension D.upper.firstOrder₁ D.isStrict₁) = 0)
    (w : PushedExtension D.upper.i₁ D.upper.i₂ D.upper.f₁₂ D.upper.comm₁₂ D.restriction
      (idealTensor D.morphism₁ D.restriction) (idealTensor D.morphism₂ D.restriction)
      D.idealTensorTransition₂₁
      (D.liftOfModule₂.kernelExtension D.upper.firstOrder₂ D.isStrict₂)
      (Bh.kernelExtension D.upper.firstOrder₁ D.isStrict₁))
    (hw : IsPushout (D.liftOfModule₂.kernelExtension D.upper.firstOrder₂ D.isStrict₂).f
      ((modulePushforward D.upper.i₂).map D.idealTensorTransition₂₁ ≫
        (thickeningPushforwardComp D.upper.i₁ D.upper.i₂ D.upper.f₁₂ D.upper.comm₁₂).inv.app
          (idealTensor D.morphism₁ D.restriction))
      w.hom ((modulePushforward D.upper.f₁₂).map
        (Bh.kernelExtension D.upper.firstOrder₁ D.isStrict₁).f))
    (hrestrict : (firstOrderExtensionAction D.upper.i₃ D.restriction
        (idealTensor D.morphism₂ D.restriction) D.upper.firstOrder₃
        (sequenceRestrictedExtension D.upper D.restriction
          (idealTensor D.morphism₂ D.restriction)
          (D.liftOfModule₂.kernelExtension D.upper.firstOrder₂ D.isStrict₂))).val =
      D.idealTensorTransition₃₂) :
    (flatLiftClassDifferenceBase D.morphism₁ D.upper.firstOrder₁ D.isStrict₁ hI₁ D.restriction
          (Quotient.mk (flatLiftSetoid D.morphism₁ D.restriction) Bh)
          (Quotient.mk (flatLiftSetoid D.morphism₁ D.restriction) Aπ)).comp
        hK.extClass (by decide) =
      flatDeformationObstruction D.morphism₃ D.upper.firstOrder₃ hI₃ D.restriction
declarations.comment: the boundary of the difference of `π^* ℱ` and `h^* ℱ'₂` is the obstruction to lifting `ℱ` to an `𝒪'₃`-module flat over `S'₃`, difference in the order `(h^* ℱ'₂, π^* ℱ)`; inputs of the source are hypotheses -- the 08VQ identifications `ℐᵢ = f^* 𝒥ᵢ`, as 08VR already carries them, the short exactness of the tensored ideal sequence, and 08LF's own `hrestrict` -- each named in the Scope section of the module docstring

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpaceThickening.FlatShortExactThickeningDiagram.boundary_difference_trivialLift_pulledLift_eq_flatDeformationObstruction
declarations.doc:
In Situation **Stacks 08VS** — a commutative diagram of short exact sequences of first order
thickenings `X'₁ ⟶ X'₂ ⟶ X'₃` of `X` over `S'₁ ⟶ S'₂ ⟶ S'₃` of `S`, with every
`(f, f'ᵢ)` strict and every `f'ᵢ` flat, and an `𝒪'₂`-module `ℱ'₂` flat over `S'₂` with
`ℱ = ℱ'₂|_X` — let `π : X'₁ ⟶ X` be the canonical splitting of **Stacks 08LE**.
Then `π^* ℱ` and `h^* ℱ'₂` are `𝒪'₁`-modules flat over `S'₁` (the first two conjuncts); they
restrict to `ℱ` on `X` through `i₁^* π^* ℱ ≅ (i₁ ≫ π)^* ℱ = ℱ` and
`i₁^* h^* ℱ'₂ ≅ (i₁ ≫ h)^* ℱ'₂ = ℱ`, which makes them the flat lifts `trivialLift` and
`pulledLift`. Their difference `θ ∈ Ext¹_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, f^* 𝒥₁ ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ)`, the difference of
**Stacks 08VR** (2) of the two isomorphism classes, has for boundary along
`0 ⟶ f^* 𝒥₃ ⊗ ℱ ⟶ f^* 𝒥₂ ⊗ ℱ ⟶ f^* 𝒥₁ ⊗ ℱ ⟶ 0` — the sequence induced by the lower row, short
exact by `baseTransition_shortExact` — the obstruction of **Stacks 08VR** (1) to lifting `ℱ` to an
`𝒪'₃`-module flat over `S'₃`.

The difference is taken in the order `(h^* ℱ'₂, π^* ℱ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem boundary_difference_trivialLift_pulledLift_eq_flatDeformationObstruction
    [CategoryTheory.HasExt.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.upper.X))]
    [CategoryTheory.HasExt.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.upper.X₁))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing D.upper.X))] :
    AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f₁
        ((modulePullback D.trivialization.retraction).obj D.restriction) ∧
      AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver D.f₁ ((modulePullback D.upper.f₁₂).obj D.module₂) ∧
      (flatLiftClassDifferenceBase D.morphism₁ D.upper.firstOrder₁ D.isStrict₁
          D.isIso_baseToSourceIdeal₁ D.restriction
          (Quotient.mk (flatLiftSetoid D.morphism₁ D.restriction) D.pulledLift)
          (Quotient.mk (flatLiftSetoid D.morphism₁ D.restriction) D.trivialLift)).comp
          D.baseTransition_shortExact.extClass (by decide) =
        flatDeformationObstruction D.morphism₃ D.upper.firstOrder₃ D.isIso_baseToSourceIdeal₃
          D.restriction

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.isFinitePresentation_iff_pullbackModules_of_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08VU.** Let `(f, f')` be a morphism of first order thickenings of ringed topoi as
in Situation 08M7, let `ℱ'` be an `O'`-module and set `ℱ = i^*ℱ'`. Assume that `ℱ'` is flat
over `O_{ℬ'}` and that `(f, f')` is a strict morphism of thickenings. Then `ℱ'` is an
`O'`-module of finite presentation if and only if `ℱ` is an `O`-module of finite
presentation.

Flatness of `ℱ'` over `O_{ℬ'}` is flatness of `ℱ'` read as an `(f')^{-1}O_{ℬ'}`-module, as in
`Deformation.ToposThickening.HasFlatLift`, and `ℱ = i^*ℱ'` is the pullback of Stacks 03D6.

The direction (1) ⇒ (2) is Stacks 03DO and uses none of the hypotheses. For (2) ⇒ (1), Stacks
03DM moves `ℱ` to the site of the thickening, where each local presentation of it lifts to one of
`ℱ'`; flatness and strictness enter only through the injectivity of the action of `I` on `ℱ'`
(`Deformation.ToposThickening.isIdealActionMono`). See the module docstring.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_iff_pullbackModules_of_isFlat
    (i : RingedToposHom X X') (t : RingedToposHom S S') (f : RingedToposHom X S)
    (f' : RingedToposHom X' S') (hi : FirstOrderThickening i) (ht : FirstOrderThickening t)
    (comm : f'.comp i = t.comp f) (F' : SheafOfModules.{w} (ringSheaf X'.O))
    (hflat : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        ((sheafCompose X'.J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).map
          f'.fSharpInverseImage)).obj F'))
    (hstrict : (MorphismOfThickenings.ofFirstOrderThickenings i t f f' hi ht comm).IsStrict) :
    F'.IsFinitePresentation ↔
      (i.toRingedToposModulesHom.pullbackModules.obj F').IsFinitePresentation

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.hasFlatLift_iff_basePullbackIdeal_obstruction_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08VW, part (1).** In Situation 08VV — `(f, f')` a strict morphism of first order
thickenings of ringed topoi with `f'` flat, and `ℱ` an `O`-module flat over `O_ℬ` — there is an
`O'`-module `ℱ'` flat over `O_{ℬ'}` with `i^*ℱ' ≅ ℱ` if and only if the class
`o(ℱ, f^*J ⊗_O ℱ, 1) ∈ Ext²_O(ℱ, f^*J ⊗_O ℱ)` of Stacks 08MF vanishes.

Here `1` is the action `I ⊗_O ℱ ⟶ f^*J ⊗_O ℱ` which is the identity under the identification
`I = f^*J` of Situation 08VV, i.e. the inverse of
`Deformation.ToposThickening.basePullbackIdealTensorIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFlatLift_iff_basePullbackIdeal_obstruction_eq_zero
    (F : SheafOfModules.{w}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))]
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X'.O))]
    (hstrict : (MorphismOfThickenings.ofFirstOrderThickenings i t f f' hi ht comm).IsStrict)
    (hf' : f'.IsFlat) (hflat : IsFlatOverBase i f F) :
    HasFlatLift i f' hi F ↔
      existenceObstructionClass hi F
        (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
          ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).flip.obj F).obj
          (basePullbackIdealOverThickened i t f ht))
        (basePullbackIdealTensorIso i t f f' hi ht comm hf' hstrict F).inv = 0
declarations.comment: part (1): a flat lift exists iff o(ℱ, f^*J ⊗_O ℱ, 1) vanishes

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.exists_addTorsor_flatLiftClass_basePullbackIdeal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08VW, part (2).** In Situation 08VV, if `ℱ` has a lift to an `O'`-module flat over
`O_{ℬ'}`, then the isomorphism classes of such lifts form a principal homogeneous set under
`Ext¹_O(ℱ, f^*J ⊗_O ℱ)`.

The action is the one of Stacks 08MU, read through the identification `f^*J ⊗_O ℱ ≅ I ⊗_O ℱ`
(`Deformation.ToposThickening.basePullbackIdealTensorIso`): a lift `ℱ'` gives the extension
`0 ⟶ I ⊗_O ℱ ⟶ ℱ' ⟶ ℱ ⟶ 0` of `O'`-modules
(`Deformation.ToposThickening.FlatLift.fixedActionExtension`), and `a` sends the class of `ℱ'` to
the class of `𝒢'` exactly when the `Ext¹_{O'}` class of the extension of `𝒢'` is that of `ℱ'` plus
the image of `a` in `Ext¹_{O'}(ℱ, I ⊗_O ℱ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_addTorsor_flatLiftClass_basePullbackIdeal
    (F : SheafOfModules.{w}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))]
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X'.O))]
    (hstrict : (MorphismOfThickenings.ofFirstOrderThickenings i t f f' hi ht comm).IsStrict)
    (hf' : f'.IsFlat) (hflat : IsFlatOverBase i f F) (hne : Nonempty (FlatLift i f' hi F)) :
    ∃ T : AddTorsor
        (Abelian.Ext.{e} F
          (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
            ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).flip.obj F).obj
            (basePullbackIdealOverThickened i t f ht)) 1)
        (FlatLiftClass i f' hi F),
      ∀ (a : Abelian.Ext.{e} F
          (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
            ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).flip.obj F).obj
            (basePullbackIdealOverThickened i t f ht)) 1)
        (A B : FlatLift i f' hi F),
        T.vadd a (Quotient.mk (flatLiftSetoid i f' hi F) A) =
            Quotient.mk (flatLiftSetoid i f' hi F) B ↔
          extensionClass F
              (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
                ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).flip.obj F).obj hi.I)
              (B.fixedActionExtension i t f f' hi ht comm F
                ((isStrictPullbackIdealMap_iff_isStrict i t f f' hi ht comm).mpr hstrict)
                (isFlat_reducedBaseModule_of_isFlatOverBase i t f f' hi ht comm F hflat)) =
            (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (structureRingMap i)).mapExtAddHom F
                (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
                  ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).flip.obj F).obj hi.I) 1
                (a.comp (Abelian.Ext.mk₀
                  (basePullbackIdealTensorIso i t f f' hi ht comm hf' hstrict F).hom)
                  (add_zero 1)) +
              extensionClass F
                (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
                  ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)).flip.obj F).obj hi.I)
                (A.fixedActionExtension i t f f' hi ht comm F
                  ((isStrictPullbackIdealMap_iff_isStrict i t f f' hi ht comm).mpr hstrict)
                  (isFlat_reducedBaseModule_of_isFlatOverBase i t f f' hi ht comm F hflat))
declarations.comment: part (2): the lift classes are a torsor under Ext¹_O(ℱ, f^*J ⊗_O ℱ)

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.autOverIdentityExtZeroEquiv_spec
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08VW, part (3).** In Situation 08VV, given a lift `ℱ'` of `ℱ` to an `O'`-module flat
over `O_{ℬ'}`, the set of automorphisms of `ℱ'` which pull back to the identity of `ℱ` is
canonically isomorphic to `Ext⁰_O(ℱ, f^*J ⊗_O ℱ)` (with `ℱ` written as `i^*ℱ'`): the bijection
`Deformation.ToposThickening.autOverIdentityExtZeroEquiv` sends `α` to `1 + α`, and it carries
addition to composition, so it is an isomorphism of groups.
declarations.statement:
theorem autOverIdentityExtZeroEquiv_spec
    (F : SheafOfModules.{w}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf ((pushforwardCommRingFunctor i.toToposHom).obj X.O)))
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))]
    (hstrict : (MorphismOfThickenings.ofFirstOrderThickenings i t f f' hi ht comm).IsStrict)
    (L : FlatLift i f' hi F) :
    (∀ α, (autOverIdentityExtZeroEquiv.{_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, e} i t f f' hi ht comm F
        hstrict L α).val.hom =
      𝟙 L.module' + idealProductHomEquiv hi L.module' L.module'
          (Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ α ≫
            (idealProductTensorIso i t f f' hi ht comm L.module' hstrict L.isFlat).hom) ≫
        (idealProductSubmodule hi L.module').ι) ∧
    ∀ α β, autOverIdentityExtZeroEquiv i t f f' hi ht comm F hstrict L (α + β) =
      autOverIdentityExtZeroEquiv i t f f' hi ht comm F hstrict L α *
        autOverIdentityExtZeroEquiv i t f f' hi ht comm F hstrict L β
declarations.comment: part (3): automorphisms of a lift over id_ℱ are Ext⁰_O(ℱ, f^*J ⊗_O ℱ)

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.FlatThickeningComplexSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08VX.** A short exact sequence of first order thickenings `O'₃ ⟶ O'₂ ⟶ O'₁` of a
ringed topos `(Sh(C), O)`, over a short exact sequence of first order thickenings of a ringed
topos `(Sh(B), O_ℬ)`, by three strict flat deformations `f'₁, f'₂, f'₃` of one morphism
`f : (Sh(C), O) ⟶ (Sh(B), O_ℬ)` compatible with the two rows, together with an `O'₂`-module
`ℱ'₂` flat over `O_{ℬ'₂}`.

The first thickening of each row is `i : (Sh(C), O) ⟶ (Sh(C'₁), O'₁)`, respectively
`t : (Sh(B), O_ℬ) ⟶ (Sh(B'₁), O_{ℬ'₁})`, and the other two are presented on its site, as in
`Deformation.ToposThickening.FirstOrderThickeningComplex`.

Short exactness of each row is that of Stacks 08ML: the maps `I₃ ⟶ I₂ ⟶ I₁` of defining ideals
are the restrictions of the ring maps `O'₃ ⟶ O'₂ ⟶ O'₁`, and `0 ⟶ I₃ ⟶ I₂ ⟶ I₁ ⟶ 0` is a short
exact sequence of `O`-modules, read through the equivalence of topoi of the thickening as
modules over `i_*O` (respectively `t_*O_ℬ`) on the common underlying site. The squares of the
diagram are equalities of morphisms of ringed topoi: the horizontal arrows are the identity on
underlying topoi, so this is the source's identification of the underlying topoi of a
thickening and of its base (Stacks 08M7, `f = f'` on underlying topoi).
declarations.statement: structure FlatThickeningComplexSituation (i : RingedToposHom X Y) (t : RingedToposHom B B')
declarations.comment:
the situation: both rows short exact sequences of first order thickenings in the
sense of 08ML (exactness of `0 ⟶ I₃ ⟶ I₂ ⟶ I₁ ⟶ 0` of defining ideals as modules over the
base), each `f'ᵢ` restricting to `f`, each `(f, f'ᵢ)` strict, each `f'ᵢ` flat, and `ℱ'₂` an
`O'₂`-module flat over `O_{ℬ'₂}`

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.FlatThickeningComplexSituation.π
declarations.doc:
**The canonical splitting `π : (Sh(C'₁), O'₁) ⟶ (Sh(C), O)` of Remark Stacks 08ML**, the
trivialization of the first thickening of the upper row through which the composite
`(Sh(C'₁), O'₁) ⟶ (Sh(C'₃), O'₃)` factors.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def π : Trivialization i
declarations.comment: the canonical splitting `π` of the upper row (Remark 08ML)

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.FlatThickeningComplexSituation.reduction
declarations.doc:
**The `O`-module `ℱ = ℱ'₂ ⊗ O` of Stacks 08VX**: the pullback `i₂^*ℱ'₂` of `ℱ'₂` along the
second thickening of the upper row.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def reduction : SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)
declarations.comment: the module `ℱ = ℱ'₂ ⊗ O`

declarations.name: Deformation.ToposThickening.FlatThickeningComplexSituation.boundary_difference_trivialLift_pulledLift_eq_obstruction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08VY.** In Situation **Stacks 08VX** — a short exact sequence of first
order thickenings `O'₃ ⟶ O'₂ ⟶ O'₁` of `(Sh(C), O)` over a short exact sequence of first order
thickenings of `(Sh(B), O_ℬ)`, every `(f, f'ₖ)` strict and every `f'ₖ` flat, and an `O'₂`-module
`ℱ'₂` flat over `O_{ℬ'₂}`, with `ℱ = ℱ'₂ ⊗ O` — let `π : (Sh(C'₁), O'₁) ⟶ (Sh(C), O)` be the
canonical splitting of Remark Stacks 08ML.

* `π^*ℱ` and `h^*ℱ'₂` are `O'₁`-modules flat over `O_{ℬ'₁}` (the first two conjuncts) restricting
  to `ℱ` on `(Sh(C), O)`: they are the flat lifts `trivialLift` and `pulledLift` of `ℱ` across the
  first column (the third and fourth conjuncts record their modules), whose maps to `i₁_*ℱ` are
  the canonical identifications (the fifth and sixth conjuncts): for `π^*ℱ = k^*ι_*ℱ`, with
  `π = ι^{-1} ∘ k` the canonical splitting, the transpose under `k^* ⊣ s^*` of `ι_*ℱ = s^*q^*ι_*ℱ`;
  for `h^*ℱ'₂`, the transpose under `h^* ⊣ h_*` of the unit `ℱ'₂ ⟶ i₂_*i₂^*ℱ'₂ = h_*i₁_*ℱ`.
* The maps `f^*𝒥₃ ⟶ f^*𝒥₂ ⟶ f^*𝒥₁` of the coefficient sequence below, defined as the maps
  `I₃ ⟶ I₂ ⟶ I₁` of the upper row read through the identifications `f^*𝒥ₖ = Iₖ`, are the maps
  induced by the maps `𝒥₃ ⟶ 𝒥₂ ⟶ 𝒥₁` of the lower row (the seventh and eighth conjuncts), as in
  Stacks 08VT.
* The isomorphism classes of flat lifts of `ℱ` across the first column form a principal
  homogeneous set under `Ext¹_O(ℱ, f^*𝒥₁ ⊗_O ℱ)` with the action of Stacks 08VW (2)
  (`Deformation.ToposThickening.exists_addTorsor_flatLiftClass_basePullbackIdeal`), and the
  difference `θ = [h^*ℱ'₂] - [π^*ℱ]` has for boundary along
  `0 ⟶ f^*𝒥₃ ⊗_O ℱ ⟶ f^*𝒥₂ ⊗_O ℱ ⟶ f^*𝒥₁ ⊗_O ℱ ⟶ 0` (short exact by
  `baseIdealTensor_shortExact`) the class `o(ℱ, f^*𝒥₃ ⊗_O ℱ, 1)` of Stacks 08VW (1) for the third
  column, which vanishes exactly when `ℱ` lifts to an `O'₃`-module flat over `O_{ℬ'₃}` (the last
  conjunct).
declarations.statement:
theorem boundary_difference_trivialLift_pulledLift_eq_obstruction
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (baseRing i)))]
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))]
    [HasExt.{e} (SheafOfModules.{w} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf D.upper.O₃))] :
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat
        ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
          ((sheafCompose Y.J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).map
            D.f₁.fSharpInverseImage)).obj D.trivialModule) ∧
      AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat
        ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
          ((sheafCompose Y.J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).map
            D.f₁.fSharpInverseImage)).obj D.pulledModule) ∧
      D.trivialLift.module' = D.trivialModule ∧ D.pulledLift.module' = D.pulledModule ∧
      D.trivialLift.π = D.trivialModuleIsoPullback.hom ≫
        (D.splittingChangeAdjunction.homEquiv _ _).symm
          (splitRestrictionRestrictScalarsIso i D.upper.lower.first D.π D.F).inv ∧
      D.pulledLift.π = (D.adjH.homEquiv _ _).symm
        (D.i₂.pullbackAdjPushforwardModulesViaComparison.unit.app D.F' ≫
          (D.upper.lower.restrictHIso D.F).inv) ∧
      D.baseIdealMap₃₂ = D.inducedBaseIdealMap₃₂ ∧ D.baseIdealMap₂₁ = D.inducedBaseIdealMap₂₁ ∧
      ∃ T : AddTorsor
          (Abelian.Ext.{e} D.F
            (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor (baseRing i)).flip.obj D.F).obj
              (basePullbackIdealOverThickened i t D.f D.lower.lower.first)) 1)
          (FlatLiftClass i D.f₁ D.upper.lower.first D.F),
        (∀ (a : Abelian.Ext.{e} D.F
            (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor (baseRing i)).flip.obj D.F).obj
              (basePullbackIdealOverThickened i t D.f D.lower.lower.first)) 1)
          (A B : FlatLift i D.f₁ D.upper.lower.first D.F),
          T.vadd a (Quotient.mk (flatLiftSetoid i D.f₁ D.upper.lower.first D.F) A) =
              Quotient.mk (flatLiftSetoid i D.f₁ D.upper.lower.first D.F) B ↔
            extensionClass D.F
                (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor (baseRing i)).flip.obj D.F).obj
                  D.upper.lower.first.I)
                (B.fixedActionExtension i t D.f D.f₁ D.upper.lower.first D.lower.lower.first
                  D.restrict₁ D.F D.isStrictPullbackIdealMap₁ D.isFlat_reducedBaseModule₁) =
              (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (structureRingMap i)).mapExtAddHom D.F
                  (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor (baseRing i)).flip.obj D.F).obj
                    D.upper.lower.first.I) 1
                  (a.comp (Abelian.Ext.mk₀
                    (basePullbackIdealTensorIso i t D.f D.f₁ D.upper.lower.first D.lower.lower.first
                      D.restrict₁ D.flat₁ D.strict₁ D.F).hom) (add_zero 1)) +
                extensionClass D.F
                  (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor (baseRing i)).flip.obj D.F).obj
                    D.upper.lower.first.I)
                  (A.fixedActionExtension i t D.f D.f₁ D.upper.lower.first D.lower.lower.first
                    D.restrict₁ D.F D.isStrictPullbackIdealMap₁ D.isFlat_reducedBaseModule₁)) ∧
        (@VSub.vsub _ _ T.toVSub
            (Quotient.mk (flatLiftSetoid i D.f₁ D.upper.lower.first D.F) D.pulledLift)
            (Quotient.mk (flatLiftSetoid i D.f₁ D.upper.lower.first D.F) D.trivialLift)).comp
            D.baseIdealTensor_shortExact.extClass (by decide) =
          existenceObstructionClass D.upper.third D.F
            (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor (baseRing i)).flip.obj D.F).obj
              (basePullbackIdealOverThickened D.upper.thirdHom D.lower.thirdHom D.f D.lower.third))
            (basePullbackIdealTensorIso D.upper.thirdHom D.lower.thirdHom D.f D.f₃ D.upper.third
              D.lower.third D.restrict₃ D.flat₃ D.strict₃ D.F).inv ∧
        (HasFlatLift D.upper.thirdHom D.f₃ D.upper.third D.F ↔
          existenceObstructionClass D.upper.third D.F
            (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor (baseRing i)).flip.obj D.F).obj
              (basePullbackIdealOverThickened D.upper.thirdHom D.lower.thirdHom D.f D.lower.third))
            (basePullbackIdealTensorIso D.upper.thirdHom D.lower.thirdHom D.f D.f₃ D.upper.third
              D.lower.third D.restrict₃ D.flat₃ D.strict₃ D.F).inv = 0)
declarations.comment: the full statement in Situation 08VX: π^*ℱ and h^*ℱ'₂ are flat over O_{ℬ'₁} and restrict to ℱ, their difference lies in the Ext¹_O(ℱ, f^*𝒥₁ ⊗ ℱ)-torsor of 08VW (2), and its boundary along the short exact sequence of the f^*𝒥ₖ ⊗ ℱ is the 08VW obstruction for the third column, which vanishes exactly when ℱ lifts to an O'₃-module flat over O_{ℬ'₃}.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CoherentSituation.projection_isFiberedInGroupoids
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08W5.**  In the situation of Stacks 08KB the projection
`p : Coh_{X/Y} ⟶ (Sch/S)_fppf`, which sends an object `(T, g, F)` to its test scheme `T`, is
fibred in groupoids.

`Coh_{X/Y}` is the category of Stacks 08KB as constructed in
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CoherentSituation.categoryData`: its objects are
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CoherentObject` (a test scheme `T` over `Y` and a quasi-coherent
`𝒪_{X_T}`-module of finite presentation, flat over `T`, with support proper over `T`), and its
morphisms are `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CoherentHom` (a morphism `h` of test schemes and an
isomorphism `(X_h)^*F' ⟶ F`).  The base-change stability the lifting half needs is the proved
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.modulePullbackStabilityOfFinitePresentation`, so nothing is assumed.
declarations.statement:
theorem projection_isFiberedInGroupoids :
    letI : Category.{u + 1} (CoherentObject D) := D.categoryData.category
    Functor.IsFiberedInGroupoids
      (D.categoryData.projection ⋙ CostructuredArrow.proj (schemeSpaceFunctor B S hS) D.Y)
declarations.comment: Coh_{X/Y} with the category structure of Stacks 08KB; no hypotheses

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CoherentSituation.coherentCFG_diagonal_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08W6.** In Situation 08KB, with `𝒳 = Coh_{X/Y}` the stack of coherent sheaves with
proper support of a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of finite presentation of algebraic spaces over `S`,
the diagonal `Δ : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳 × 𝒳` is representable by algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem coherentCFG_diagonal_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces (D : CoherentSituation B S hS) :
    Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS
      (Stack.diagonalBasedFunctor B S hS D.coherentCFG)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinitePresentationOnSite_tfae_of_isPullback_of_isFirstOrderThickening
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08W7.** Let `X ⟶ X'` over `T ⟶ T'` be a cartesian square of algebraic spaces in
which `t : T ⟶ T'` is a first order thickening, let `ℱ'` be an `𝒪_{X'}`-module flat over `T'`
and set `ℱ = i^*ℱ'`.  Then the following are equivalent: (1) `ℱ'` is a quasi-coherent
`𝒪_{X'}`-module of finite presentation; (2) `ℱ'` is an `𝒪_{X'}`-module of finite presentation;
(3) `ℱ` is a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module of finite presentation; (4) `ℱ` is an `𝒪_X`-module of
finite presentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinitePresentationOnSite_tfae_of_isPullback_of_isFirstOrderThickening
    {T T' X X' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (t : T ⟶ T') [Mono t.hom]
    (ht : IsFirstOrderThickening B S hS T' (Subfunctor.range t.hom))
    (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ T) (f' : X' ⟶ T') (hsq : IsPullback i f f' t)
    (F' : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X'.1 X'.2) (hflat : IsFlatOver B S hS X'.2 f'.hom F') :
    List.TFAE
      [F'.IsQuasicoherentOnSite ∧ F'.IsFinitePresentationOnSite,
        F'.IsFinitePresentationOnSite,
        ((modulePullback B S hS i).obj F').IsQuasicoherentOnSite ∧
          ((modulePullback B S hS i).obj F').IsFinitePresentationOnSite,
        ((modulePullback B S hS i).obj F').IsFinitePresentationOnSite]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CoherentSituation.finiteDimensional_tangentSpace_and_infinitesimalAutomorphisms_cohDef
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08W8.** In Situation 08KB (`f : X ⟶ Y` of finite presentation) assume that `S` is
locally Noetherian and `Y ⟶ S` locally of finite presentation. Let `k` be a field of finite type
over `S`, with `Spec Λ ⊆ S` an affine open through which `Spec k ⟶ S` factors and `Λ → k` finite
as in Section 07T2, and let `x₀ = (Spec k, g₀, 𝒢₀)` be an object of `Coh_{X/Y}` over `Spec k`.
Then the tangent space `T𝓕` and the infinitesimal automorphisms `Inf(𝓕)` of
`𝓕 = 𝓕_{Coh_{X/Y}, k, x₀}` are finite-dimensional over `k`. The vector-space structures are those
of the deformation category `𝓕` (Stacks 07WU with Stacks 07WQ), which the conclusion records.

The conclusion spells out the two clauses of `Deformation.IsFiniteDimensionalDeformationCategory`:
that predicate asks the morphisms of `𝓕` to live in the universe of the rings of `𝒞_Λ`, while the
morphisms of `Coh_{X/Y}`, which carry morphisms of sheaves of modules, live one universe higher.
declarations.statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_tangentSpace_and_infinitesimalAutomorphisms_cohDef
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    (hlfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS (terminal.from D.Y.1)) [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (hiΛ : AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion iΛ)
    (hfinite : AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ k)) ≫ iΛ) ∧
      AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiCompact (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ k)) ≫ iΛ)) :
    ∃ hp : IsDeformationCategory.{u, u, u} (D.cohDef iΛ x₀ hx₀).projection,
      (letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory.{u, u, u}
          (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (D.cohDef iΛ x₀ hx₀).projection).p) := ⟨hp.predeformation⟩;
        letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2 (Functor.Elements.π
          (isomorphismClasses (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (D.cohDef iΛ x₀ hx₀).projection)
            hp.predeformation.cofibered))) := ⟨tangentConditionS2.{u, u, u} hp⟩;
        FiniteDimensional k (tangentSpaceArtinian.{u, u, u} Λ k
          (isomorphismClasses (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (D.cohDef iΛ x₀ hx₀).projection)
            hp.predeformation.cofibered))) ∧
      ∀ (x : (D.cohDef iΛ x₀ hx₀).carrier),
        (D.cohDef iΛ x₀ hx₀).projection.obj x = Deformation.residueFieldObject.{u, u, u} Λ k →
        ∀ PF : ChosenPushforwardsAt (D.cohDef iΛ x₀ hx₀).projection x, FiniteDimensional k
          ↥((infinitesimalAutomorphismLinearLift.{u, u, u} PF hp.satisfiesRS).functor.obj
            (FGModuleCat.of k (ULift.{u} k)))

of finite type over `S` to formal objects — is an equivalence. No Noetherian hypothesis on `S` is

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CoherentSituation.hasOpenVersality_coherentCFG_of_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Openness of versality for `Coh_{X/B}`** (Stacks 08WA). In Situation Stacks 08KB assume that
`S` is a locally Noetherian scheme, `S = B` (here: the base `Y` is final) and `f : X → B` is flat.
Then `𝒳 = Coh_{X/B}` satisfies openness of versality (Stacks 07XQ).

This is the second proof of the source, through Stacks 0CYF: the diagonal of `𝒳` is representable
by algebraic spaces (Stacks 08W6), `𝒳` satisfies (RS*) (Stacks 08LQ) and is limit preserving
(Stacks 08KD), and over a Noetherian affine chart `x = (Spec A, ℱ)` the tangent space is
`T_x(M) = Ext¹_{X_A}(ℱ, ℱ ⊗ f^*M̃)`, naturally in `M`, and the obstruction class of a
square-zero thickening `A' → A` with kernel `I` lies in `Ext²_{X_A}(ℱ, ℱ ⊗ f^*Ĩ)`, functorially
along surjections of thickenings (Stacks 08VW, 0CYE).
declarations.statement:
theorem hasOpenVersality_coherentCFG_of_isFlat
    [_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyNoetherian S] (hY : IsTerminal D.Y)
    (hflat : IsFlat B S hS D.f.hom) :
    HasOpenVersality ((coherentCFG D).val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CoherentSituation.isAlgebraicStack_coherentCFG_of_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Algebraicity of the stack of coherent sheaves, flat case.** Let `S` be a scheme and
`f : X ⟶ B` a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is of finite presentation (a field of the
standing datum `D` of Situation 08KB), separated and flat. Then `Coh_{X/B}` is an algebraic stack
over `S`. As the source's footnote says, flatness is not needed, so the flatness hypothesis is
omitted.

declarations.name: Stacks.Descent.IsEqualizerDiagram
declarations.doc:
The diagram `A ⟶ B ⇉ C` consisting of `f : A ⟶ B` and a parallel pair `g₁, g₂ : B ⟶ C`
*is an equalizer*: the two composites `f ≫ g₁` and `f ≫ g₂` agree, and `f` is universal for
that property, meaning that every `e : A' ⟶ B` equalizing `g₁` and `g₂` factors as `e = d ≫ f`
for a unique `d : A' ⟶ A`.
declarations.statement: structure IsEqualizerDiagram (f : A ⟶ B) (g₁ g₂ : B ⟶ C) : Prop
declarations.comment: the displayed diagram is an equalizer

declarations.doc:

      (ModuleCat.ofHom (dual w))) :

      (ModuleCat.ofHom (dual (v.rTensor Q))) (ModuleCat.ofHom (dual (w.rTensor Q)))

theorem universallyInjective_iff_dual_splitSurjective
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]

declarations.name: exists_functorialCharacterModuleSplitting
declarations.doc:
A universally injective map admits a section after applying the character
module functor, and the section obtained on `C(P ⊗ -)` by postcomposition is a splitting
functorial in the module `P`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_functorialCharacterModuleSplitting
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {M N : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (hf : UniversallyInjective f) :
    ∃ g : CharacterModule M →ₗ[R] CharacterModule N,
      CharacterModule.dual f ∘ₗ g = LinearMap.id ∧
      (∀ (P : Type v) [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P],
        CharacterModule.dual (LinearMap.lTensor P f) ∘ₗ
            functorialCharacterModuleSection g P =
          LinearMap.id) ∧
      ∀ (P Q : Type v) [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P]
        [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] (h : P →ₗ[R] Q),
        functorialCharacterModuleSection g P ∘ₗ
            CharacterModule.dual (LinearMap.rTensor M h) =
          CharacterModule.dual (LinearMap.rTensor N h) ∘ₗ
            functorialCharacterModuleSection g Q

declarations.name: ModuleCat.DescentData.isSplitEqualizer_inverseTransitionUnitHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08WZ.** For a descent datum `(M, θ)` relative to `R → S`, the diagram
```
      θ ∘ (1 ⊗ δ₀¹)                    (θ ⊗ δ₂²) ∘ (1 ⊗ δ₀²)
  M ---------------> M ⊗_{S, δ₁¹} S₂ ========================> M ⊗_{S, δ₁₂¹} S₃
                                            1 ⊗ δ₁²
```
is a split equalizer of `S`-modules. Here `M ⊗_{S, δ₁¹} S₂ = N ⊗[R] A` and
`M ⊗_{S, δ₁₂¹} S₃ = (N ⊗[R] A) ⊗[R] A`, on which `S` acts through the last tensor factor, and
`θ` is `inverseTransition`, the inverse of the transition isomorphism; see the module docstring
for the identifications. The auxiliary maps are `1 ⊗ σ₀⁰` and `1 ⊗ σ₀¹`, see
`inverseTransitionUnitSplitEqualizer`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSplitEqualizer_inverseTransitionUnitHom (D : DescentData.{u, v, w} R A) :
    Nonempty (IsSplitEqualizer (inverseTransition01AfterUnitHom D) (middleUnitInsertionHom D)
      (inverseTransitionUnitHom D))

declarations.name: ModuleCat.DescentData.isSplitCoequalizer_characterModule_descentComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08X1.** Character duality turns the descent equalizer into a split
coequalizer.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSplitCoequalizer_characterModule_descentComparison
    (D : DescentData.{u, v, w} R A) :
    Nonempty (IsSplitCoequalizer
      (ModuleCat.ofHom (CharacterModule.dual (transition12AfterUnitHom R A D)))
      (ModuleCat.ofHom (CharacterModule.dual (rightUnitBaseChangeHom R A D)))
      (ModuleCat.ofHom (CharacterModule.dual (descentComparisonHom R A D))))

declarations.name: Stacks.Descent.isSplitEqualizerTensorInsertOne
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 08X3.** The diagram `S₁ --δ¹₁--> S₂ ⇉ S₃` of tensor powers of `A`
over `R`, whose parallel arrows are `δ²₂` and `δ²₁`, is a split equalizer of commutative
`R`-algebras. Its splittings are the codegeneracy maps `σ⁰₀` and `σ¹₀`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def isSplitEqualizerTensorInsertOne :
    IsSplitEqualizer (tensorInsertOne R A 1 2) (tensorInsertOne R A 1 1)
      (tensorInsertOne R A 0 1)

declarations.name: ModuleCat.pushforward
declarations.doc:
Pushforward sends a module descent datum to the equalizer of its two pullbacks to
`A ⊗[R] A`.
declarations.statement: def pushforward : DescentData.{u, v, w} R A ⥤ ModuleCat.{w} R

declarations.name: ModuleCat.tensorPushforwardComparison_tmul
declarations.doc:
Under tensor symmetry, the first arrow applies the descent transition to
the unit pullback of the scalar multiple of an invariant section.
declarations.statement:
public theorem tensorPushforwardComparison_tmul
    (D : DescentData.{u, v, w} R A)
    (a : A) (m : invariantSubmodule R A D) :
    tensorPushforwardComparison R A D (a ⊗ₜ[R] m) =
      D.transitionRestrictScalars R A
        ((a • (m.1 : restrictModule R A D.module)) ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : A))
declarations.comment: comparison formula

declarations.name: ModuleCat.tensorPushforwardComparison_condition
declarations.doc: The base-changed inclusion equalizes the two pullbacks of a descent datum.
declarations.statement:
public theorem tensorPushforwardComparison_condition
    (D : DescentData.{u, v, w} R A) :
    ModuleCat.ofHom (tensorPushforwardComparison R A D) ≫
        ModuleCat.ofHom (DescentData.transition12AfterUnitHom R A D) =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (tensorPushforwardComparison R A D) ≫
        ModuleCat.ofHom (DescentData.rightUnitBaseChangeHom R A D)
declarations.comment: fork condition

declarations.name: ModuleCat.tensorPushforward_isEqualizer
declarations.doc:
For a universally injective ring map, the displayed diagram of `A`-modules
is an equalizer. The middle and right objects and both parallel arrows use the
canonical identifications from the descent datum.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def tensorPushforward_isEqualizer
    (h : Stacks.UniversalInjectivity.LocalizationCriteria.UniversallyInjective.{u}
      (Algebra.linearMap R A))
    (D : DescentData.{u, v, w} R A) :
    CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit
      (CategoryTheory.Limits.Fork.ofι
        (ModuleCat.ofHom (tensorPushforwardComparison R A D))
        (tensorPushforwardComparison_condition R A D))
declarations.comment: equalizer

declarations.name: Module.IsEssentialEpi
declarations.doc:
A morphism is an essential epimorphism if it is an epimorphism and the direct image of
every proper subobject of its source is proper.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsEssentialEpi {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [HasImages C] {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop
declarations.comment: essential_surjection

declarations.name: Module.IsEssentialMono
declarations.doc:
A monomorphism is essential if every nonzero subobject of its codomain has nonzero
intersection with its image.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsEssentialMono {𝒜 : Type u} [Category.{v} 𝒜] [HasZeroObject 𝒜] [HasPullbacks 𝒜]
    {A B : 𝒜} (i : A ⟶ B) [Mono i] : Prop
declarations.comment: essential_injection

declarations.name: Module.isEssentialEpi_comp
declarations.doc: The composite of two essential epimorphisms is an essential epimorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEssentialEpi_comp [HasImages 𝒜] {A B C : 𝒜} {f : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ C}
    (hf : IsEssentialEpi f) (hg : IsEssentialEpi g) : IsEssentialEpi (f ≫ g)
declarations.comment: essential_surjection_comp

declarations.name: Module.isEssentialMono_comp
declarations.doc: The composite of two essential monomorphisms is essential.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEssentialMono_comp {A B C : 𝒜} (i : A ⟶ B) (j : B ⟶ C) [Mono i] [Mono j]
    (hi : IsEssentialMono i) (hj : IsEssentialMono j) : IsEssentialMono (i ≫ j)
declarations.comment: essential_extension_trans

declarations.name: Module.isEssentialMono_pullback
declarations.doc:
The intersection of an essential subobject with another subobject is essential in that
subobject.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEssentialMono_pullback {B : 𝒜} (A C : Subobject B) (hA : IsEssentialMono A.arrow) :
    IsEssentialMono ((Subobject.pullback C.arrow).obj A).arrow
declarations.comment: essential_extension_intersection

declarations.name: Module.essentialEpi_epiDesc_cokernel
declarations.doc:
The quotient of an essential epimorphism by the image of the kernel of an epimorphism
with the same source remains an essential epimorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem essentialEpi_epiDesc_cokernel (hf : IsEssentialEpi f) :
    IsEssentialEpi
      (Abelian.epiDesc q (f ≫ cokernel.π (kernel.ι q ≫ f))
        (by simpa only [Category.assoc] using
          (cokernel.condition (kernel.ι q ≫ f))))
declarations.comment: essential_surjection_quotient

declarations.name: Module.isEssentialMono_colimit
declarations.doc:
A compatible filtered system of essential embeddings of a module induces an essential
embedding into its colimit.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEssentialMono_colimit {R : Type u} [Ring R]
    {J : Type v} [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J]
    (M : ModuleCat.{max v w u, u} R)
    (E : Functor J (ModuleCat.{max v w u, u} R)) [HasColimit E]
    (ι : (Functor.const J).obj M ⟶ E)
    (hι : ∀ j, ∃ h : Mono (ι.app j),
      let _ : Mono (ι.app j) := h
      IsEssentialMono (ι.app j))
    (j : J) :
    ∃ h : Mono (ι.app j ≫ colimit.ι E j),
      let _ : Mono (ι.app j ≫ colimit.ι E j) := h
      IsEssentialMono (ι.app j ≫ colimit.ι E j)

declarations.name: Module.isEssentialMono_subtype_iff
declarations.doc:
A submodule inclusion is essential if and only if every nonzero element of the ambient
module has a nonzero scalar multiple lying in the submodule.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEssentialMono_subtype_iff {R : Type u} [Ring R]
    {N : ModuleCat.{v} R} (M : Submodule R N) :
    IsEssentialMono (ModuleCat.ofHom M.subtype) ↔
      ∀ x : N, x ≠ 0 → ∃ f : R, (f • x ∈ M ∧ f • x ≠ 0)

declarations.name: Module.Injective.restrictScalars_of_flat'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08XQ.** Let `R → S` be a flat ring map. If `E` is an injective `S`-module, then
`E` is injective as an `R`-module.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictScalars_of_flat' (R : Type*) {S E : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] [Module.Flat R S] [AddCommGroup E] [Module R E] [Module S E]
    [IsScalarTower R S E] (h : Module.Injective S E) : Module.Injective R E

declarations.name: Dualizing.injective_coextendScalars_obj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 08XR.** For a ring map `f : A →+* B` and an injective `A`-module `M`, the
`B`-module `Hom_A(B, M)` is injective. Indeed coextension of scalars is right adjoint to
restriction of scalars, which is exact and in particular preserves monomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem injective_coextendScalars_obj (f : A →+* B) (M : ModuleCat.{max v u} A) [Injective M] :
    Injective ((ModuleCat.coextendScalars.{u, u, max v u} f).obj M)

declarations.name: Module.injective_iff_eq_of_essential_extension
declarations.doc:
A submodule of an injective module is injective if and only if it has no
proper essential extension inside the ambient module.
declarations.statement:
lemma injective_iff_eq_of_essential_extension
    (R : Type u) [Ring R] (I : Type v) [AddCommGroup I] [Module R I]
    [Module.Injective R I] (E : Submodule R I) :
    Module.Injective R E ↔
      ∀ (E' : Submodule R I) (h : E ≤ E'),
        let i := ModuleCat.ofHom (Submodule.inclusion h)
        letI : Mono i := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective i).mpr
          (Submodule.inclusion_injective h)
        IsEssentialMono i → E = E'
declarations.comment: characterization inside an injective module

declarations.name: Module.injective_iff_isIso_essentialMono
declarations.doc: A module is injective if and only if every essential monomorphism from it is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
lemma injective_iff_isIso_essentialMono
    (R : Type u) [Ring R] (Q : Type v) [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] :
    Module.Injective R Q ↔
      ∀ (E' : ModuleCat.{v} R) (i : ModuleCat.of R Q ⟶ E') [Mono i],
        IsEssentialMono i → IsIso i
declarations.comment: intrinsic characterization

declarations.name: Module.bijective_hom_localizationAtPrime
declarations.doc:
For any module, maps into the localization at a prime are exactly the
maps from its localized module, via canonical precomposition.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_hom_localizationAtPrime
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] :
    Function.Bijective
      (fun f : LocalizedModule.AtPrime p M →ₗ[Localization.AtPrime p]
          Localization.AtPrime p =>
        (f.restrictScalars R).comp (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap p.primeCompl M))
declarations.comment: canonical identification of Hom modules

declarations.name: Module.injective_localizationAtPrime_of_minimal
declarations.doc:
The localization of a reduced ring at a minimal prime is injective as
an `R`-module.
declarations.statement:
theorem injective_localizationAtPrime_of_minimal
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsReduced R] (p : Ideal R)
    [p.IsPrime] (hp : p ∈ minimalPrimes R) :
    Module.Injective R (Localization.AtPrime p)
declarations.comment: injectivity at a minimal prime

declarations.name: Module.directSum_injective
declarations.doc:
An arbitrary direct sum of injective modules over a Noetherian ring is
injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem directSum_injective
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {ι : Type v} (M : ι → Type (max v w)) [∀ i, AddCommGroup (M i)]
    [∀ i, Module R (M i)] [∀ i, Module.Injective R (M i)]
    : Module.Injective R (⨁ i, M i)

declarations.name: Module.injective_iSup_torsionBy_pow
declarations.doc:
The submodule of an injective module consisting of the elements annihilated by some power
of `f` is injective. This is part (1) of Stacks Project, Tag 08XW.
declarations.statement:
lemma injective_iSup_torsionBy_pow (f : R) :
    Module.Injective R (⨆ n : ℕ, Submodule.torsionBy R I (f ^ n) : Submodule R I)
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: Module.injective_primaryComponent
declarations.doc:
The submodule of an injective module consisting of the elements annihilated by some power
of `J` is injective. This is part (2) of Stacks Project, Tag 08XW.
declarations.statement:
lemma injective_primaryComponent (J : Ideal R) :
    Module.Injective R (Ideal.primaryComponent I J)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: Module.IsProjectiveCover
declarations.doc:
A morphism is a projective cover if its source is projective and it is an essential
epimorphism.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsProjectiveCover {P M : C} (f : P ⟶ M) : Prop

declarations.name: Module.isProjectiveCover_unique
declarations.doc: Two projective covers of the same object are isomorphic over that object.

declarations.name: Module.exists_projectiveCover_of_finite
declarations.doc: A finite module over a local ring has a projective cover.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_projectiveCover_of_finite
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M] :
    ∃ (P : ModuleCat.{max u v} R)
      (f : P ⟶ ModuleCat.of R (Shrink.{max u v} M)),
      IsProjectiveCover f

declarations.name: Module.IsInjectiveHull
declarations.doc: An injective hull is an essential monomorphism into an injective object.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsInjectiveHull {𝒜 : Type u} [Category.{v} 𝒜]
    [Limits.HasZeroObject 𝒜] [Limits.HasPullbacks 𝒜] {M I : 𝒜} (i : M ⟶ I) [Mono i] : Prop

declarations.name: Module.exists_isInjectiveHull
declarations.doc: Every module over a ring has an injective hull.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isInjectiveHull (R : Type u) [Ring R]
    (M : ModuleCat.{max v u} R) :
    ∃ (I : ModuleCat.{max v u} R) (i : M ⟶ I) (h : Mono i),
      let _ : Mono i := h
      IsInjectiveHull i

declarations.name: Module.mono_of_isEssentialMono_of_comp_eq
declarations.doc: A morphism which is monic on an essential subobject is a monomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem mono_of_isEssentialMono_of_comp_eq {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    {M E N J : C} (i : M ⟶ E) [Mono i] (hi : IsEssentialMono i) (φ : M ⟶ N) [Mono φ]
    (j : N ⟶ J) [Mono j] (ψ : E ⟶ J) (hψ : i ≫ ψ = φ ≫ j) : Mono ψ
declarations.comment: injective_extension

declarations.name: Module.isIso_of_isInjectiveHull_of_isEssentialMono
declarations.doc: A morphism between injective hulls which extends an essential monomorphism is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_of_isInjectiveHull_of_isEssentialMono
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    {M E N E' : C} (i : M ⟶ E) (j : N ⟶ E')
    [Mono i] [Mono j]
    (hi : IsInjectiveHull i)
    (hj : IsInjectiveHull j)
    (phi : M ⟶ N) [Mono phi]
    (hphi : IsEssentialMono phi)
    (psi : E ⟶ E') (hpsi : i ≫ psi = phi ≫ j) :
    IsIso psi
declarations.comment: essential_extension_iso

declarations.name: Module.isIso_of_isInjectiveHull_of_extends_iso
declarations.doc:
A morphism between injective hulls which extends an isomorphism of the embedded modules is an
isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
lemma isIso_of_isInjectiveHull_of_extends_iso
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] {M N E E' : C}
    (i : M ⟶ E) (j : N ⟶ E') [Mono i] [Mono j]
    (hi : IsInjectiveHull i)
    (hj : IsInjectiveHull j)
    (e : M ≅ N) (f : E ⟶ E')
    (comm : i ≫ f = e.hom ≫ j) :
    IsIso f
declarations.comment: iso_extension

declarations.name: Module.exists_iso_of_isInjectiveHull
declarations.doc:
Any two injective hulls of an object are isomorphic compatibly with their embeddings of that
object.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_iso_of_isInjectiveHull {𝒜 : Type u} [Category.{v} 𝒜]
    [Abelian 𝒜]
    {M I J : 𝒜} (i : M ⟶ I) (j : M ⟶ J) [Mono i] [Mono j]
    (hi : IsInjectiveHull i) (hj : IsInjectiveHull j) :
    ∃ e : I ≅ J, i ≫ e.hom = j
declarations.comment: unique_up_to_iso

declarations.name: Module.exists_iso_biprod_of_isInjectiveHull
declarations.doc:
An injective hull is a direct summand of any injective module containing the original module,
compatibly with the two embeddings.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_iso_biprod_of_isInjectiveHull
    {R : Type u} [Ring R] {M E I : ModuleCat.{v} R}
    (i : M ⟶ E) [Mono i] (hi : IsInjectiveHull i)
    (j : M ⟶ I) [Mono j] [CategoryTheory.Injective I] :
    ∃ I' : ModuleCat.{v} R, ∃ e : I ≅ E ⊞ I',
      j ≫ e.hom = i ≫ Limits.biprod.inl
declarations.comment: splits_in_injective
